e.en: The {IAAF} was renamed World Athletics in 2019.
e.zh: 国际田联于2019年更名为世界田径联合会。

e.en: She broke the {IAAF} world record in the 400 meters.
e.zh: 她打破了国际田联400米的世界纪录。

e.en: The {IAEA} sent inspectors to verify the nuclear site.
e.zh: 国际原子能机构派检查员核查这处核设施。

e.en: {IAEA} reports are crucial for global nuclear safety.
e.zh: 国际原子能机构的报告对全球核安全至关重要。

iago.t: n. 伊阿古（奥赛罗中的反派）

e.en: {Iago} is one of Shakespeare's most cunning villains.
e.zh: 伊阿古是莎士比亚笔下最狡猾的反派之一。

e.en: The actor's portrayal of {Iago} was chillingly convincing.
e.zh: 那位演员对伊阿古的演绎令人毛骨悚然又十分可信。

iambic.t:
adj. 抑扬格的
n. 抑扬格诗

e.en: Shakespeare wrote most of his plays in {iambic} pentameter.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的大部分剧作都用抑扬格五音步写成。

e.en: The poem flows naturally in a soft {iambic} rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗以柔和的抑扬格节奏自然流淌。

iata.t: n. 国际航空运输协会

e.en: Every airport has a unique three-letter {IATA} code.
e.zh: 每个机场都有一个独特的三字母国际航协代码。

e.en: The {IATA} forecasts strong travel demand next summer.
e.zh: 国际航空运输协会预测明年夏天旅行需求强劲。

iatrogenic.t: adj. 医源性的（由治疗引起的）

e.en: Doctors must minimize the risk of {iatrogenic} infections.
e.zh: 医生必须将医源性感染的风险降到最低。

e.en: His symptoms turned out to be {iatrogenic}, caused by medication.
e.zh: 他的症状其实是药物引起的医源性反应。

iba.t: n. 独立广播局；国际拳联 (缩写)

e.en: She passed the {IBA} exam and joined a top firm.
e.zh: 她通过了律师协会考试，进入了一家顶尖律所。

e.en: The {IBA} hosts an annual conference for global lawyers.
e.zh: 国际律师协会每年为全球律师举办一次会议。

ibanez.t: n. 依班娜（日本吉他品牌）

e.en: He plays a vintage {Ibanez} guitar in his band.
e.zh: 他在乐队里弹一把复古的依班娜吉他。

e.en: The new {Ibanez} model has a smoother neck profile.
e.zh: 新款依班娜的琴颈手感更顺滑。

e.en: Analysts often cite {Ibbotson} data for long-term return estimates.
e.zh: 分析师常引用伊博森的数据来估算长期回报。

e.en: Her thesis relied heavily on {Ibbotson} historical market series.
e.zh: 她的论文大量引用了伊博森的历史市场数据。

e.en: Chemicals are usually shipped in 1000-liter {IBC} totes.
e.zh: 化学品通常用1000升的中型散装容器运输。

e.en: The {IBC} sets international standards for building safety.
e.zh: 国际建筑规范制定了全球性的建筑安全标准。

e.en: We flew {Iberia} from Madrid to Buenos Aires.
e.zh: 我们乘坐伊比利亚航空从马德里飞到布宜诺斯艾利斯。

e.en: The Moors ruled much of {Iberia} for centuries.
e.zh: 摩尔人统治了伊比利亚半岛大部分地区好几个世纪。

iberian.t:
adj. 伊比利亚半岛的
n. 伊比利亚人

e.en: {Iberian} ham is a prized delicacy across Europe.
e.zh: 伊比利亚火腿是欧洲各地备受推崇的美食。

e.en: The {Iberian} peninsula includes both Spain and Portugal.
e.zh: 伊比利亚半岛包含西班牙和葡萄牙两国。

e.en: An {ibex} balanced gracefully on the steep cliff.
e.zh: 一只野山羊优雅地立在陡峭的悬崖上。

e.en: Photographers waited hours to capture the {ibex} on camera.
e.zh: 摄影师们等了好几个小时才拍到那只野山羊。

e.en: He won the {IBF} heavyweight title last Saturday.
e.zh: 他上周六赢得了国际拳击联合会重量级冠军。

e.en: The {IBF} ranks her as the top contender this year.
e.zh: 国际拳联将她列为今年的头号挑战者。

e.en: The footnote simply read "{ibid}, page 47".
e.zh: 那个脚注只写着"同上，第47页"。

e.en: Use {ibid} when citing the same source consecutively.
e.zh: 连续引用同一来源时使用"同上"这个标注。

e.en: A white {ibis} waded through the shallow marsh.
e.zh: 一只白鹮在浅浅的沼泽中涉水而行。

e.en: The sacred {ibis} was worshipped in ancient Egypt.
e.zh: 神圣的朱鹭在古埃及曾被人们崇拜。

ibiza.t: n. 伊比萨岛（西班牙度假胜地）

e.en: They partied all night at a beach club in {Ibiza}.
e.zh: 他们在伊比沙岛的海滩俱乐部狂欢了一整夜。

e.en: {Ibiza} is famous for its sunsets and electronic music.
e.zh: 伊比沙岛以日落和电子音乐而闻名。

ibm.t: n. 国际商业机器公司

e.en: She landed an internship at {IBM} this summer.
e.zh: 她今年夏天在IBM拿到了一份实习。

e.en: {IBM} is investing heavily in quantum computing research.
e.zh: IBM正在大力投资量子计算研究。

ibn.t: n.（阿拉伯姓名中）某人之子

e.en: {Ibn} Battuta traveled across three continents in the 14th century.
e.zh: 伊本·白图泰在14世纪游历了三大洲。

e.en: The philosopher {Ibn} Sina influenced both Islamic and European thought.
e.zh: 哲学家伊本·西那对伊斯兰和欧洲思想都产生了影响。

ibsen.t: n. 易卜生（挪威剧作家）

e.en: {Ibsen}'s plays still feel surprisingly modern today.
e.zh: 易卜生的戏剧今天看依然出人意料地现代。

e.en: We read {Ibsen}'s "A Doll's House" in literature class.
e.zh: 我们在文学课上读了易卜生的《玩偶之家》。

e.en: I took some {ibuprofen} for my headache this morning.
e.zh: 今早我吃了点布洛芬来缓解头痛。

e.en: {Ibuprofen} can irritate the stomach if taken on empty.
e.zh: 空腹服用布洛芬可能会刺激肠胃。

ica.t: n. 当代艺术学院；独立通讯局

e.en: We grabbed groceries at the local {ICA} supermarket.
e.zh: 我们在当地的ICA超市买了些日用品。

e.en: The {ICA} hosts cutting-edge contemporary art exhibitions.
e.zh: 当代艺术学院举办前沿的当代艺术展览。

ide.t: n. 集成开发环境（Integrated Development Environment）

e.en: VS Code is my favorite {IDE} for web development.
e.zh: VS Code是我做网页开发最喜欢的集成开发环境。

e.en: The new {IDE} has built-in AI code completion.
e.zh: 这个新的集成开发环境内置了AI代码补全功能。

e.en: That's a brilliant {idea} for the marketing campaign.
e.zh: 那是个非常棒的营销活动点子。

e.en: I have no {idea} where I left my keys.
e.zh: 我完全不知道把钥匙落哪儿了。

ideal.t:
adj. 理想的；完美的
n. 理想

e.en: This apartment is {ideal} for a small family.
e.zh: 这套公寓非常适合一个小家庭居住。

e.en: She still believes in the {ideal} of true democracy.
e.zh: 她仍然相信真正民主的理想。

idealisation.t: n. 理想化（idealization 的英式拼写）

e.en: The film is a romantic {idealisation} of small-town life.
e.zh: 这部电影是对小镇生活的浪漫化理想化呈现。

e.en: His {idealisation} of his father blinded him to the truth.
e.zh: 他对父亲的理想化让他看不到真相。

idealise.t: v. 把……理想化（英式拼写）

e.en: People often {idealise} their childhood after many years.
e.zh: 人们经常在多年后把童年理想化。

e.en: Don't {idealise} your ex — remember why it ended.
e.zh: 别把前任理想化，记住为什么会分手。

idealised.t: adj. 被理想化的（英式拼写）

e.en: The painting shows an {idealised} version of country life.
e.zh: 这幅画展现了一种理想化的乡村生活。

e.en: Magazines often present an {idealised} image of the body.
e.zh: 杂志经常呈现一种理想化的身材形象。

idealism.t: n. 理想主义；唯心主义

e.en: Her youthful {idealism} drove her to join the nonprofit.
e.zh: 她年轻时的理想主义促使她加入了非营利组织。

e.en: A bit of {idealism} is healthy in any political movement.
e.zh: 任何政治运动中都需要一点理想主义。

idealist.t: n. 理想主义者；唯心论者

e.en: He's an {idealist} who believes the world can change.
e.zh: 他是个理想主义者，相信世界是可以改变的。

e.en: As a young {idealist}, she joined the peace corps.
e.zh: 作为一个年轻的理想主义者，她加入了和平队。

idealistic.t: adj. 理想主义的；不切实际的

e.en: Her plan sounds great but is a bit too {idealistic}.
e.zh: 她的计划听起来不错，但有点过于理想化了。

e.en: Young engineers are often {idealistic} about changing the industry.
e.zh: 年轻的工程师们往往对改变行业抱有理想化的看法。

idealistically.t: adv. 理想主义地；不切实际地

e.en: He {idealistically} hoped that hard work alone would be enough.
e.zh: 他理想化地希望仅凭努力工作就够了。

e.en: She {idealistically} pictured a workplace without office politics.
e.zh: 她理想化地想象出一个没有办公室政治的工作场所。

e.en: The novel's {idealization} of war ignores its real horrors.
e.zh: 小说对战争的理想化忽略了它真正的恐怖。

e.en: Therapy helped him let go of his {idealization} of his mother.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮他放下了对母亲的理想化。

e.en: It's easy to {idealize} a country you've never visited.
e.zh: 把一个从未去过的国家理想化是很容易的。

e.en: Many people {idealize} startup culture without seeing the burnout.
e.zh: 许多人把创业文化理想化，却看不到背后的倦怠。

idealized.t: adj. 被理想化的；被美化的

e.en: Movies often show an {idealized} version of romantic love.
e.zh: 电影常常呈现一种理想化的爱情。

e.en: Her memory of childhood is heavily {idealized}.
e.zh: 她对童年的记忆被严重美化了。

e.en: {Ideally}, we'd ship the feature before Friday.
e.zh: 理想情况下，我们会在周五前上线该功能。

e.en: This apartment is {ideally} located near the subway.
e.zh: 这间公寓地理位置极佳，紧邻地铁。

ideals.t: n. 理想；信念（ideal 的复数）

e.en: She refused to compromise her {ideals} for money.
e.zh: 她拒绝为金钱而放弃自己的理想。

e.en: The company's {ideals} are printed on every wall.
e.zh: 公司的核心理念印在每一面墙上。

ideas.t: n. 想法；主意（idea 的复数）

e.en: Drop your {ideas} into the shared doc before noon.
e.zh: 中午前把你的想法写进共享文档里。

e.en: He always has wild {ideas} during brainstorming sessions.
e.zh: 头脑风暴时他总有些天马行空的点子。

e.en: The team spent Monday on product {ideation}.
e.zh: 团队周一整天都在做产品创意构思。

e.en: Good {ideation} requires turning off your inner critic.
e.zh: 好的创意构思需要先关掉内心的批评声。

e.en: The artist works at a purely {ideational} level.
e.zh: 这位艺术家只在纯粹的观念层面创作。

e.en: His paintings explore {ideational} rather than visual themes.
e.zh: 他的画作探索的是观念主题而非视觉主题。

idem.t: adv. 同上；同前（引用标注用语）

e.en: In academic citations, {idem} means the same author.
e.zh: 在学术引用中，idem 表示同一作者。

e.en: She used {idem} to avoid repeating the source name.
e.zh: 她用 idem 来避免重复写出来源名称。

identical.t: adj. 完全相同的；同一的

e.en: The twins wore {identical} blue jackets to school.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎穿着一模一样的蓝色外套上学。

e.en: Two files are {identical} if their hashes match.
e.zh: 如果哈希值相同，两个文件就是完全一致的。

identically.t: adv. 相同地；一模一样地

e.en: The sisters dress {identically} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 姐妹俩每个周日早上都穿得一模一样。

e.en: Both servers respond {identically} to the same request.
e.zh: 两台服务器对同一请求的响应完全相同。

identifiable.t: adj. 可识别的；可辨认的

e.en: Please remove any personally {identifiable} information from the logs.
e.zh: 请从日志中删除任何可识别个人身份的信息。

e.en: The bird has an easily {identifiable} red crest.
e.zh: 这种鸟有一个容易辨认的红色冠羽。

identifiably.t: adv. 可识别地；可辨认地

e.en: His writing style is {identifiably} sarcastic in every paragraph.
e.zh: 他的文风在每一段都明显带着讽刺意味。

e.en: The dish is {identifiably} Sichuan from the first bite.
e.zh: 这道菜一入口就能明显尝出川菜的味道。

e.en: You'll need photo {identification} to enter the building.
e.zh: 进入这栋楼需要带有照片的身份证件。

e.en: Early {identification} of the bug saved the launch.
e.zh: 及早发现这个 bug 拯救了整个产品发布。

identifications.t: n. 识别；身份证明（复数）

e.en: Police made several {identifications} from the security footage.
e.zh: 警方根据监控录像辨认出了几个人。

e.en: All {identifications} must be checked at the front desk.
e.zh: 所有身份证件都必须在前台检查。

identified.t: v. 识别；确认（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: Engineers {identified} the root cause within an hour.
e.zh: 工程师在一小时内就定位到了问题根源。

e.en: The witness {identified} the suspect from a lineup.
e.zh: 目击者从列队辨认中指认出了嫌疑人。

e.en: Each user gets a unique {identifier} in the database.
e.zh: 每个用户在数据库中都有一个唯一标识符。

e.en: Use a descriptive {identifier} instead of single letters.
e.zh: 用一个有意义的标识符，别只用单个字母。

identifies.t: v. 识别；确认（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {identifies} songs playing in the background.
e.zh: 这款应用能识别背景中播放的歌曲。

e.en: She {identifies} as a freelance designer these days.
e.zh: 她现在认为自己是一名自由设计师。

e.en: Can you {identify} the bird in this photo?
e.zh: 你能认出这张照片里的鸟是什么吗？

e.en: We need to {identify} bottlenecks before scaling up.
e.zh: 在扩容之前，我们需要先找出性能瓶颈。

identifying.t:
v. 识别；确认（现在分词）
adj. 用于辨认的

e.en: She's good at {identifying} patterns in messy data.
e.zh: 她很擅长从杂乱的数据中找出规律。

e.en: The form asks for any {identifying} marks or scars.
e.zh: 表格要求填写任何可识别的特征或疤痕。

identikit.t: n. 嫌犯拼图画像（警方用合成肖像）

e.en: Police released an {identikit} sketch of the suspect.
e.zh: 警方公布了一张嫌疑人的拼图画像。

e.en: The suburb is full of {identikit} new houses.
e.zh: 这个郊区满是千篇一律的新房子。

identities.t: n. 身份；特性（identity 的复数）

e.en: Hackers stole thousands of {identities} from the leaked database.
e.zh: 黑客从泄露的数据库中盗取了数千个身份信息。

e.en: People often juggle multiple online {identities} these days.
e.zh: 如今人们常常在多个网络身份之间切换。

e.en: Two-factor authentication helps protect your online {identity}.
e.zh: 双重验证有助于保护你的网络身份安全。

e.en: Moving abroad made her question her cultural {identity}.
e.zh: 移居海外让她开始反思自己的文化身份。

ideogram.t: n. 表意文字；象形符号

e.en: Each Chinese character is essentially an {ideogram}.
e.zh: 每个汉字本质上都是一种表意符号。

e.en: The logo uses an {ideogram} to suggest growth.
e.zh: 这个标志用一个表意符号来寓意成长。

e.en: The ancient script uses an {ideograph} for each concept.
e.zh: 这种古文字为每个概念使用一个表意字符。

e.en: Linguists debated whether the symbol was truly an {ideograph}.
e.zh: 语言学家们争论这个符号是否真的是表意字。

ideographic.t: adj. 表意文字的；象形的

e.en: Chinese is often called an {ideographic} writing system.
e.zh: 汉语常被称为一种表意文字系统。

e.en: The artist mixed alphabetic and {ideographic} elements in her piece.
e.zh: 这位艺术家在作品中混合了字母和表意元素。

ideological.t: adj. 意识形态的；思想上的

e.en: The two parties have deep {ideological} differences.
e.zh: 两党之间存在深刻的意识形态分歧。

e.en: His refusal was {ideological}, not personal.
e.zh: 他的拒绝出于意识形态原因，并非针对个人。

ideologically.t: adv. 意识形态上；思想上

e.en: The newsroom is {ideologically} more diverse than people assume.
e.zh: 这间编辑部在意识形态上比人们想象得更多元。

e.en: They're {ideologically} opposed but personally good friends.
e.zh: 他们在意识形态上对立，但私下是好朋友。

ideologies.t: n. 意识形态（ideology 的复数）

e.en: Competing political {ideologies} dominated the twentieth century.
e.zh: 相互竞争的政治意识形态主导了二十世纪。

e.en: The book compares the {ideologies} of three major movements.
e.zh: 这本书比较了三大运动的意识形态。

e.en: He's more of an {ideologist} than a practical leader.
e.zh: 他更像一个意识形态家，而不是务实的领导者。

e.en: The party's chief {ideologist} drafted the manifesto.
e.zh: 党内首席理论家起草了这份宣言。

ideologue.t: n. 意识形态信奉者；空想理论家

e.en: She's a true {ideologue} who never compromises on principle.
e.zh: 她是个彻底的理论派，从不在原则上妥协。

e.en: The board needs pragmatists, not another {ideologue}.
e.zh: 董事会需要务实的人，而不是又一个空谈理论的人。

ideology.t: n. 意识形态；思想体系

e.en: Free-market {ideology} shaped his entire career.
e.zh: 自由市场意识形态塑造了他的整个职业生涯。

e.en: The startup runs on a quirky engineering {ideology}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司奉行一种独特的工程理念。

e.en: The abbreviation {idi} appeared in the field's metadata.
e.zh: 缩写 idi 出现在该字段的元数据中。

e.en: He typed {idi} by mistake instead of "id".
e.zh: 他不小心把 id 打成了 idi。

e.en: Forwarding that email was pure {idiocy}.
e.zh: 转发那封邮件简直是愚蠢之极。

e.en: He laughed at the {idiocy} of the new policy.
e.zh: 他嘲笑这项新政策的荒唐愚蠢。

idiographic.t: adj. 描述个别事物的；特例研究的

e.en: Case studies use an {idiographic} approach to understanding individuals.
e.zh: 案例研究采用个体特异性方法来理解个人。

e.en: Her research is {idiographic} rather than statistical.
e.zh: 她的研究偏重个案分析，而非统计概括。

idiolect.t: n. 个人语言习惯；个人用语

e.en: Every speaker has a unique {idiolect} shaped by experience.
e.zh: 每个人都有由经历塑造的独特个人语言习惯。

e.en: Forensic linguists analyze {idiolect} to identify anonymous writers.
e.zh: 司法语言学家通过分析个人语言风格来识别匿名作者。

e.en: "Spill the beans" is a common English {idiom}.
e.zh: "spill the beans" 是一个常见的英语习语。

e.en: Her playing has a distinctly jazz {idiom}.
e.zh: 她的演奏有着鲜明的爵士乐风格。

idiomatic.t: adj. 地道的；符合习惯用法的

e.en: His Mandarin is fluent and surprisingly {idiomatic}.
e.zh: 他的普通话流利得令人惊讶，地道又自然。

e.en: Try to write more {idiomatic} Python instead of Java-style code.
e.zh: 试着写更地道的 Python，而不是 Java 风格的代码。

idiomatically.t: adv. 地道地；按习惯用法

e.en: She speaks French {idiomatically}, like a native.
e.zh: 她说法语地道得像母语者一样。

e.en: The function is named {idiomatically} for the language.
e.zh: 这个函数的命名符合该语言的惯用风格。

idioms.t: n. 习语；成语（idiom 的复数）

e.en: Learning {idioms} is the hardest part of any language.
e.zh: 学习习语是任何语言中最难的部分。

e.en: Each programming community has its own {idioms}.
e.zh: 每个编程社区都有自己惯用的写法。

icarus.t: n. 伊卡洛斯（希腊神话人物）

e.en: {Icarus} flew too close to the sun and fell.
e.zh: 伊卡洛斯飞得离太阳太近，最终坠落。

e.en: His startup's rapid rise mirrored the myth of {Icarus}.
e.zh: 他创业公司的迅速崛起像极了伊卡洛斯的神话。

icc.t:
n. 国际刑事法院（ICC）
n. 国际板球理事会

e.en: The {ICC} issued an arrest warrant for the dictator.
e.zh: 国际刑事法院对那名独裁者发出了逮捕令。

e.en: India will host the next {ICC} cricket world cup.
e.zh: 印度将举办下一届国际板球理事会世界杯。

ice.t:
n. 冰
v. 给（蛋糕）加糖霜

e.en: Could you put more {ice} in my drink, please?
e.zh: 麻烦再给我饮料里加点冰块好吗？

e.en: The lake had completely frozen into thick {ice}.
e.zh: 湖面已经完全冻成了厚厚的冰层。

e.en: Let's grab some {ice-cream} after dinner tonight.
e.zh: 今晚饭后我们去吃个冰淇淋吧。

e.en: Her favorite {ice-cream} flavor is salted caramel.
e.zh: 她最喜欢的冰淇淋口味是咸焦糖。

e.en: The Titanic struck a massive {iceberg} in the Atlantic.
e.zh: 泰坦尼克号在大西洋撞上了一座巨大的冰山。

e.en: What you see online is just the tip of the {iceberg}.
e.zh: 你在网上看到的只是冰山一角。

e.en: Grandma still calls the fridge an {icebox}.
e.zh: 奶奶到现在还把冰箱叫做冰柜。

e.en: Put the leftover pie in the {icebox} for tomorrow.
e.zh: 把剩下的派放进冰箱明天吃。

icebreaker.t:
n. 破冰船
n. 打破僵局的话或活动

e.en: The host started with a fun {icebreaker} question.
e.zh: 主持人用一个有趣的破冰问题开场。

e.en: A powerful {icebreaker} cleared the way through the frozen sea.
e.zh: 一艘强力的破冰船在冰封的海面上开出了通道。

e.en: Scientists worry the polar {icecap} is melting too fast.
e.zh: 科学家担心极地冰盖融化得太快。

e.en: The Greenland {icecap} stores enormous amounts of fresh water.
e.zh: 格陵兰冰盖储存着大量的淡水。

e.en: The kids begged for {icecream} after the movie.
e.zh: 看完电影后孩子们吵着要吃冰淇淋。

e.en: He sells homemade {icecream} from a small cart downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心用一辆小推车卖自制冰淇淋。

e.en: I'll have an {iced} latte with oat milk, please.
e.zh: 我要一杯加燕麦奶的冰拿铁，谢谢。

e.en: She {iced} the cake with pink buttercream frosting.
e.zh: 她给蛋糕涂上了粉色的奶油糖霜。

e.en: The climbers carefully crossed the dangerous {icefall} at dawn.
e.zh: 登山者在黎明时小心翼翼地穿越了危险的冰瀑。

e.en: A massive {icefall} blocked the route up the glacier.
e.zh: 一道巨大的冰瀑挡住了上冰川的路线。

e.en: The old {icehouse} kept food cold before refrigerators existed.
e.zh: 在冰箱出现之前，老式冰窖用来给食物保鲜。

e.en: They restored the stone {icehouse} behind the manor.
e.zh: 他们修复了庄园后面的那座石砌冰窖。

e.en: We saw the northern lights during our trip to {Iceland}.
e.zh: 我们在冰岛旅行时看到了北极光。

e.en: {Iceland} is famous for its volcanoes and hot springs.
e.zh: 冰岛以其火山和温泉而闻名。

icelandic.t:
adj. 冰岛的
n. 冰岛语

e.en: She is learning {Icelandic} before moving to Reykjavik.
e.zh: 她在搬去雷克雅未克之前正在学冰岛语。

e.en: The book was translated from an {Icelandic} novel.
e.zh: 这本书是从一部冰岛语小说翻译过来的。

e.en: The {iceman} delivered blocks of ice door to door.
e.zh: 送冰人挨家挨户地送大块冰。

e.en: Scientists studied the frozen {iceman} found in the Alps.
e.zh: 科学家研究了在阿尔卑斯山发现的冰人遗骸。

e.en: In old neighborhoods, {icemen} carried huge blocks on their shoulders.
e.zh: 在老社区里，送冰工人肩扛着巨大的冰块。

e.en: Two {icemen} loaded the truck before sunrise.
e.zh: 两个送冰工人在日出前装好了卡车。

e.en: He used an {icepick} to chip away at the frozen lock.
e.zh: 他用冰锥一点点凿开冻住的锁。

e.en: The bartender broke the block with a sharp {icepick}.
e.zh: 酒保用一把锋利的冰锥敲碎了冰块。

e.en: The aquarium fish developed white spots from {ich} infection.
e.zh: 鱼缸里的鱼因白点病感染长出了白斑。

e.en: Treating {ich} requires raising the tank temperature gradually.
e.zh: 治疗白点病需要逐渐提高鱼缸的水温。

ichor.t:
n. 神血（希腊神话）
n. 脓水

e.en: In Greek myth, the gods bled golden {ichor} instead of blood.
e.zh: 希腊神话中，神明流的是金色灵液而不是血。

e.en: The wounded creature leaked black {ichor} onto the floor.
e.zh: 那只受伤的生物把黑色的灵液漏到了地板上。

e.en: The {ichthyologist} discovered a new species of deep-sea fish.
e.zh: 这位鱼类学家发现了一种新的深海鱼类。

e.en: She trained as an {ichthyologist} at a marine institute.
e.zh: 她在一家海洋研究所接受鱼类学家培训。

ichthyosaur.t: n. 鱼龙（史前爬行动物）

e.en: The museum displays a complete {ichthyosaur} fossil from the Jurassic.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具完整的侏罗纪鱼龙化石。

e.en: An {ichthyosaur} looked like a dolphin but was actually a reptile.
e.zh: 鱼龙看起来像海豚，但实际上是一种爬行动物。

ici.t: n. 帝国化学工业公司（缩写）

e.en: {ICI} was once one of Britain's largest chemical companies.
e.zh: ICI曾是英国最大的化工公司之一。

e.en: He spent his entire career working for {ICI} in Manchester.
e.zh: 他整个职业生涯都在曼彻斯特的ICI工作。

e.en: A long {icicle} hung from the edge of the roof.
e.zh: 屋檐上挂着一根长长的冰柱。

e.en: The child carefully snapped an {icicle} off the railing.
e.zh: 那孩子小心地从栏杆上掰下一根冰柱。

e.en: She {icily} replied that she was no longer interested.
e.zh: 她冷冰冰地回答说自己已经不感兴趣了。

e.en: He stared {icily} at the journalist asking the question.
e.zh: 他冷冷地盯着那位提问的记者。

e.en: There was a clear {iciness} in her voice during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议上她的语气中带着明显的冷漠。

e.en: The {iciness} of the morning air made my fingers numb.
e.zh: 清晨空气的寒冷让我的手指都麻木了。

icing.t:
n. 糖霜（蛋糕上的）
n. 结冰

e.en: She spread chocolate {icing} evenly across the cake.
e.zh: 她把巧克力糖霜均匀地涂在蛋糕上。

e.en: A free upgrade was the {icing} on the cake.
e.zh: 免费升级简直是锦上添花。

e.en: The leftover food in the fridge looked really {icky}.
e.zh: 冰箱里的剩菜看起来真恶心。

e.en: I get an {icky} feeling whenever he tries to flatter me.
e.zh: 每次他想拍我马屁我都会觉得很不舒服。

icl.t: n. 国际计算机有限公司（缩写）

e.en: My grandfather worked as an engineer at {ICL} in the 1970s.
e.zh: 我祖父七十年代在ICL公司当工程师。

e.en: {ICL} was a major British computer manufacturer for decades.
e.zh: ICL曾是英国主要的电脑制造商，长达数十年。

icm.t: n. 国际数学家大会（缩写）

e.en: The mathematician presented her work at the {ICM} in Berlin.
e.zh: 那位数学家在柏林的国际数学家大会上展示了她的研究。

e.en: Winning the Fields Medal at the {ICM} is a huge honor.
e.zh: 在国际数学家大会上获得菲尔兹奖是巨大的荣誉。

e.en: The startup raised millions through an {ICO} in 2018.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在2018年通过首次代币发行筹集了数百万。

e.en: Many {ICO} projects failed to deliver on their promises.
e.zh: 许多ICO项目都未能兑现承诺。

icon.t:
n. 图标（界面）
n. 偶像；圣像

e.en: Tap the camera {icon} to upload a new photo.
e.zh: 点击相机图标即可上传新照片。

e.en: She became a fashion {icon} in the late nineties.
e.zh: 她在九十年代末成为了时尚偶像。

e.en: The Eiffel Tower is one of the most {iconic} landmarks.
e.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是最具标志性的地标之一。

e.en: Her red dress became an {iconic} look from that movie.
e.zh: 她的红裙子成了那部电影中的标志性造型。

iconoclasm.t: n. 打破传统；破坏偶像

e.en: His writings are full of cheerful {iconoclasm} toward tradition.
e.zh: 他的作品充满了对传统欢快的反叛精神。

e.en: The artist's {iconoclasm} shocked the conservative art world.
e.zh: 这位艺术家的反传统作风震惊了保守的艺术界。

iconoclast.t: n. 反传统者；破除偶像者

e.en: He was an {iconoclast} who challenged every rule in journalism.
e.zh: 他是一位打破偶像的人，挑战新闻业的每一条规则。

e.en: The young {iconoclast} refused to follow the school's traditions.
e.zh: 这位年轻的反传统者拒绝遵守学校的传统。

iconoclastic.t: adj. 反传统的；破除偶像的

e.en: Her {iconoclastic} approach to design upset many critics.
e.zh: 她反传统的设计风格让许多评论家不满。

e.en: The professor was known for his {iconoclastic} views on history.
e.zh: 这位教授以其反传统的历史观点而闻名。

e.en: The mural displays rich {iconographic} symbols of medieval saints.
e.zh: 这幅壁画展示了丰富的中世纪圣徒图像符号。

e.en: Scholars studied the {iconographic} meaning of each painted figure.
e.zh: 学者们研究了画中每个人物的图像学含义。

e.en: She wrote an {iconographical} analysis of Renaissance altarpieces.
e.zh: 她对文艺复兴时期祭坛画做了一篇图像学分析。

e.en: The catalog includes detailed {iconographical} notes for each piece.
e.zh: 该目录为每件作品都附有详细的图像学注释。

e.en: The film borrows heavily from religious {iconography}.
e.zh: 这部电影大量借用了宗教图像学元素。

e.en: Her tattoos draw on the {iconography} of old sailor culture.
e.zh: 她的纹身借鉴了老水手文化的图像符号。

e.en: The new app has clean, minimalist {icons} on the home screen.
e.zh: 这款新应用主屏幕上的图标简洁而极简。

e.en: They are considered {icons} of twentieth-century cinema.
e.zh: 他们被誉为二十世纪电影界的偶像人物。

e.en: The virus has an {icosahedral} protein shell protecting its genome.
e.zh: 这种病毒有一个二十面体的蛋白质外壳保护着基因组。

e.en: Mathematicians studied the {icosahedral} symmetry of the structure.
e.zh: 数学家研究了该结构的二十面体对称性。

e.en: A standard role-playing die is shaped like an {icosahedron}.
e.zh: 标准的角色扮演骰子形状是一个二十面体。

e.en: He folded paper to construct a perfect {icosahedron}.
e.zh: 他通过折纸做出了一个完美的二十面体。

icrc.t: n. 红十字国际委员会（缩写）

e.en: The {ICRC} delivered medical supplies to the conflict zone.
e.zh: 红十字国际委员会向冲突地区运送了医疗物资。

e.en: She volunteered with the {ICRC} for two years overseas.
e.zh: 她在红十字国际委员会做了两年海外志愿者。

ics.t:
n. 事故指挥系统
n. icon 复数

e.en: Send me an {ICS} file so I can add it to my calendar.
e.zh: 给我发个ICS文件，我好把它加到日历里。

e.en: Most calendar apps can import {ICS} files directly.
e.zh: 大多数日历应用都可以直接导入ICS文件。

e.en: After the surgery he spent three days in the {ICU}.
e.zh: 手术后他在重症监护室里待了三天。

e.en: The hospital expanded its {ICU} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 该医院在疫情期间扩建了重症监护室。

icy.t:
adj. 冰冷的；结冰的
adj. 冷淡的

e.en: Drive carefully — the roads are very {icy} tonight.
e.zh: 开车要小心，今晚路面结冰很严重。

e.en: She gave him an {icy} stare and walked away.
e.zh: 她冷冷地瞪了他一眼便走开了。

e.en: {Idaho} is famous for its potatoes and beautiful mountains.
e.zh: 爱达荷州以盛产土豆和美丽的山脉而闻名。

e.en: They moved to {Idaho} for the quieter pace of life.
e.zh: 他们搬到了爱达荷州，过更悠闲的生活。

idb.t: n. 美洲开发银行（缩写）

e.en: The web app stores user data locally using {IDB}.
e.zh: 该网页应用使用IndexedDB在本地存储用户数据。

e.en: {IDB} is great for caching large amounts of structured data.
e.zh: IndexedDB非常适合缓存大量结构化数据。

idc.t:
n. 互联网数据中心（IDC）
n. 我不在乎（I don't care）

e.en: She just texted '{idc}' when I asked which restaurant.
e.zh: 我问选哪家餐厅，她就回了一句'我不在乎'。

e.en: Honestly {idc} what they think about my outfit.
e.zh: 老实说我才不在乎他们怎么看我的穿着。

idiopathic.t: adj. 特发的（病因不明的）

e.en: Doctors diagnosed her with {idiopathic} chronic pain.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有原因不明的慢性疼痛。

e.en: Many cases of tinnitus are simply {idiopathic}.
e.zh: 许多耳鸣的病例其实都病因不明。

idiosyncrasies.t: n. 怪癖；独特习性（idiosyncrasy 的复数）

e.en: Every old codebase has its own {idiosyncrasies}.
e.zh: 每个老代码库都有自己独特的怪癖。

e.en: You learn to love a partner's small {idiosyncrasies}.
e.zh: 你会渐渐喜欢上伴侣那些小小的怪癖。

idiosyncrasy.t: n. 个人特有的癖好或特质

e.en: His habit of pacing while thinking is a charming {idiosyncrasy}.
e.zh: 他思考时来回踱步是个可爱的小习惯。

e.en: That syntax quirk is an {idiosyncrasy} of the compiler.
e.zh: 那种语法怪象是这个编译器特有的怪癖。

e.en: Her cooking style is delicious but highly {idiosyncratic}.
e.zh: 她的烹饪风格很好吃，但相当与众不同。

e.en: The artist has an {idiosyncratic} approach to color.
e.zh: 这位艺术家对色彩有着独特个性的处理方式。

idiosyncratically.t: adv. 以独特方式；古怪地

e.en: He dresses {idiosyncratically}, mixing eras and patterns.
e.zh: 他穿衣风格独树一帜，混搭不同年代和图案。

e.en: The startup runs {idiosyncratically} compared to its peers.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的运作方式跟同行很不一样。

e.en: Don't be an {idiot} and click suspicious links.
e.zh: 别犯傻去点那些可疑链接。

e.en: I felt like an {idiot} after locking myself out.
e.zh: 把自己反锁在门外后，我觉得自己像个傻瓜。

e.en: Sending that text was an {idiotic} thing to do.
e.zh: 发那条短信真是件蠢事。

e.en: The plot of the movie was completely {idiotic}.
e.zh: 那部电影的剧情简直蠢得不行。

e.en: He grinned {idiotically} at his own bad joke.
e.zh: 他对着自己的烂笑话傻乎乎地咧嘴笑。

e.en: I {idiotically} replied-all to the entire company.
e.zh: 我蠢到对全公司点了"全部回复"。

idiots.t: n. 白痴们（idiot 的复数）

e.en: Only {idiots} share their passwords on chat.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会在聊天里发自己的密码。

e.en: We were {idiots} for not backing up the database.
e.zh: 我们没备份数据库，真是太蠢了。

idle.t:
adj. 空闲的；闲置的
v. (引擎) 空转

e.en: My laptop goes to sleep after ten minutes {idle}.
e.zh: 我的笔记本闲置十分钟后就会进入睡眠。

e.en: Don't believe {idle} gossip from the comments section.
e.zh: 别信评论区里那些没根据的闲话。

idled.t: v. 空转；闲置（idle 的过去式）

e.en: The factory {idled} for weeks during the supply shortage.
e.zh: 供应短缺期间，这家工厂停工了好几周。

e.en: He {idled} the engine while waiting in the parking lot.
e.zh: 他在停车场等候时让引擎一直空转着。

e.en: Long stretches of {idleness} made him restless.
e.zh: 长时间的无所事事让他变得焦躁不安。

e.en: She used her enforced {idleness} to learn piano.
e.zh: 她利用这段被迫的闲暇时间学起了钢琴。

e.en: The {idler} on the assembly line was warned by his manager.
e.zh: 流水线上那个偷懒的人被经理警告了。

e.en: The bike's chain {idler} needs replacing after years of use.
e.zh: 用了多年，这辆自行车的链条惰轮该换了。

idles.t: v. 空转；闲置（idle 第三人称单数）

e.en: The engine {idles} smoothly when the car is parked.
e.zh: 汽车停下时，引擎怠速运转得很平稳。

e.en: He {idles} away his weekends watching old movies.
e.zh: 他周末总是无所事事地看老电影消磨时间。

idling.t: v. 空转；闲置（idle 的现在分词）

e.en: The taxi was {idling} outside the hotel for twenty minutes.
e.zh: 出租车在酒店外怠速等了二十分钟。

e.en: Stop {idling} and finish your homework before dinner.
e.zh: 别再混日子了，晚饭前把作业做完。

idly.t: adv. 无所事事地；空闲地

e.en: She stood {idly} by while the others did all the work.
e.zh: 别人在干活，她却袖手旁观。

e.en: He scrolled {idly} through his phone during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时他漫无目的地刷着手机。

e.en: Taylor Swift has been her musical {idol} since childhood.
e.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特从小就是她的音乐偶像。

e.en: Ancient worshippers placed offerings before the stone {idol}.
e.zh: 古代信徒在石像前摆放祭品。

e.en: The priest condemned every {idolater} who worshipped false gods.
e.zh: 祭司谴责每一个崇拜假神的偶像崇拜者。

e.en: He's such an {idolater} of celebrity culture that it's worrying.
e.zh: 他对名人文化的崇拜程度令人担忧。

e.en: Fans tend to {idolatrize} musicians without knowing their real lives.
e.zh: 粉丝往往把音乐人神化，却不了解他们真实的生活。

e.en: Don't {idolatrize} tech founders—they make plenty of mistakes too.
e.zh: 别把科技创始人神化，他们也会犯很多错。

idolatrous.t: adj. 盲目崇拜的；偶像崇拜的

e.en: The crowd's {idolatrous} devotion to the singer made her uncomfortable.
e.zh: 人群对那位歌手近乎崇拜的痴迷让她不安。

e.en: Critics called the film an {idolatrous} portrait of the dictator.
e.zh: 评论家称这部电影是对独裁者的盲目美化。

idolatry.t: n. 偶像崇拜；盲目崇拜

e.en: Modern celebrity culture often borders on {idolatry}.
e.zh: 现代名人文化常常近乎一种偶像崇拜。

e.en: The ancient text warns followers against {idolatry} of any kind.
e.zh: 古经文警告信徒不要进行任何形式的偶像崇拜。

idolise.t: v. 把…当偶像崇拜（英式拼写）

e.en: Many young players {idolise} Messi and copy his moves.
e.zh: 许多年轻球员崇拜梅西，模仿他的动作。

e.en: She used to {idolise} her older sister growing up.
e.zh: 她小时候非常崇拜自己的姐姐。

idolised.t: v. 崇拜（idolise 过去式，英式拼写）

e.en: He {idolised} his grandfather and followed his every advice.
e.zh: 他崇拜爷爷，听从他的每一句话。

e.en: The {idolised} singer was mobbed by fans at the airport.
e.zh: 那位备受崇拜的歌手在机场被粉丝围堵。

idolises.t: v. 崇拜（idolise 第三人称单数）

e.en: My daughter {idolises} her ballet teacher.
e.zh: 我女儿对她的芭蕾老师崇拜得不得了。

e.en: He {idolises} every player on the national team.
e.zh: 国家队每一名球员他都奉若神明。

idolising.t: v. 崇拜（idolise 现在分词）

e.en: Stop {idolising} influencers and start building your own life.
e.zh: 别再崇拜网红了，开始打造自己的人生吧。

e.en: She caught herself {idolising} her boss a little too much.
e.zh: 她发觉自己有点过分崇拜上司了。

e.en: The {idolization} of startup founders ignores the role of luck.
e.zh: 对创业者的神化忽视了运气的作用。

e.en: His {idolization} of his father shaped his whole career.
e.zh: 他对父亲的崇拜塑造了他的整个职业生涯。

e.en: Kids often {idolize} the athletes they see on TV.
e.zh: 孩子们常常崇拜电视上看到的运动员。

e.en: Don't {idolize} anyone—everyone has flaws you can't see.
e.zh: 别神化任何人，每个人都有你看不见的缺点。

e.en: He {idolized} his coach throughout his entire high school career.
e.zh: 整个高中时期他都对教练崇拜有加。

e.en: The {idolized} actress finally retired after fifty years on screen.
e.zh: 那位备受推崇的女演员在荧幕上活跃五十年后终于退休。

idolizes.t: v. 崇拜（idolize 第三人称单数）

e.en: My nephew {idolizes} every superhero in the Marvel universe.
e.zh: 我侄子把漫威里的每个超级英雄都奉为偶像。

e.en: She {idolizes} her mentor and quotes her in every meeting.
e.zh: 她崇拜她的导师，开会时句句都引用导师的话。

idolizing.t: v. 崇拜（idolize 现在分词）

e.en: Fans were {idolizing} the new K-pop group within a week.
e.zh: 粉丝们一周之内就把这个新韩团捧成了偶像。

e.en: He stopped {idolizing} tech CEOs after reading their biographies.
e.zh: 读完那些科技CEO的传记后，他不再崇拜他们了。

idols.t: n. 偶像们（idol 的复数）

e.en: The walls of his bedroom were covered with posters of his {idols}.
e.zh: 他卧室墙上贴满了偶像的海报。

e.en: Many K-pop {idols} train for years before debuting.
e.zh: 许多韩国流行偶像出道前要训练好几年。

ids.t: n. 身份证件；ID 的复数

e.en: Please scan your student {ids} at the library entrance.
e.zh: 请在图书馆入口刷一下学生证。

e.en: The database stores user {ids} as unique integers.
e.zh: 数据库把用户ID存为唯一的整数。

idyll.t: n. 田园诗；田园般的情景

e.en: Their summer in Tuscany was a perfect rural {idyll}.
e.zh: 他们在托斯卡纳度过的那个夏天宛如田园诗。

e.en: The poem describes a quiet {idyll} beside a mountain stream.
e.zh: 这首诗描绘了山间溪畔一段静谧的田园画面。

idyllic.t: adj. 田园诗般的；恬静美好的

e.en: They got married on an {idyllic} beach in Bali.
e.zh: 他们在巴厘岛一处风景如画的海滩上结了婚。

e.en: His childhood in the village was almost {idyllic}.
e.zh: 他在村里的童年几乎像田园诗一般美好。

idyllically.t: adv. 田园诗般地；恬静美好地

e.en: The cottage sat {idyllically} between two rolling green hills.
e.zh: 那座小屋恬静地坐落在两座青翠山丘之间。

e.en: They lived {idyllically} for a year before reality intruded.
e.zh: 他们过了一年田园般的生活，之后现实闯了进来。

ifa.t: n. 免疫荧光检测（医学缩写）

e.en: The {ifa} priest performed a traditional Yoruba divination ceremony.
e.zh: 那位伊法祭司举行了一场传统的约鲁巴占卜仪式。

e.en: She studied {ifa} as part of her West African religion course.
e.zh: 她在西非宗教课上研究了伊法体系。

iff.t: conj. 当且仅当（数学/逻辑学）

e.en: In math, 'A {iff} B' means A is true exactly when B is.
e.zh: 数学中“A当且仅当B”表示A与B同真同假。

e.en: The function returns true {iff} all inputs are positive.
e.zh: 该函数当且仅当所有输入为正数时才返回真。

e.en: The weather looks a bit {iffy} for our picnic tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天野餐的天气看起来有点悬。

e.en: His explanation sounded {iffy}, so I asked for proof.
e.zh: 他的解释听起来不太靠谱，所以我要求拿出证据。

ifs.t: n. 假设；不确定因素（if 的复数）

e.en: No {ifs} or buts—finish your homework before dinner.
e.zh: 没什么如果或可是，晚饭前把作业写完。

e.en: There are too many {ifs} in this business plan.
e.zh: 这份商业计划里的不确定因素太多了。

e.en: Doctors measured her {iga} levels to check immune function.
e.zh: 医生检测了她的IgA水平以评估免疫功能。

e.en: Low {iga} can make people more prone to respiratory infections.
e.zh: IgA偏低的人更容易患上呼吸道感染。

e.en: The blood test showed elevated {igg} antibodies after vaccination.
e.zh: 血检显示接种疫苗后IgG抗体水平升高。

e.en: Doctors use {igg} levels to confirm past viral infections.
e.zh: 医生通过IgG水平来确认既往的病毒感染。

e.en: We visited a beautiful {iglesia} in the heart of Madrid.
e.zh: 我们参观了马德里市中心一座漂亮的教堂。

e.en: The word {iglesia} simply means 'church' in Spanish.
e.zh: iglesia在西班牙语里就是“教堂”的意思。

igloo.t: n. 冰屋（因纽特人的圆顶屋）

e.en: The children built a small {igloo} out of packed snow.
e.zh: 孩子们用压实的雪堆了一个小冰屋。

e.en: Inuit hunters traditionally used an {igloo} as winter shelter.
e.zh: 因纽特猎人传统上把冰屋用作冬季庇护所。

e.en: High {igm} levels often indicate a recent infection.
e.zh: IgM水平偏高通常说明近期发生过感染。

e.en: The lab tested for {igm} antibodies to confirm the diagnosis.
e.zh: 实验室检测了IgM抗体以确认诊断。

e.en: Granite is a common type of {igneous} rock.
e.zh: 花岗岩是一种常见的火成岩。

e.en: The volcano produced layers of dark {igneous} rock over centuries.
e.zh: 几个世纪以来，那座火山堆积出层层深色的火成岩。

e.en: A single spark can {ignite} dry grass in seconds.
e.zh: 一点火星几秒钟内就能点燃干草。

e.en: Her speech helped {ignite} a movement across the country.
e.zh: 她的演讲在全国掀起了一场运动。

e.en: The gas stove's {igniter} clicks but won't produce a flame.
e.zh: 煤气灶的点火器响个不停，却打不出火来。

e.en: Engineers replaced the faulty {igniter} on the rocket engine.
e.zh: 工程师更换了火箭发动机上有问题的点火器。

ignition.t: n. 点火；（发动机）点火装置

e.en: Turn the key in the {ignition} and let the engine warm up.
e.zh: 插钥匙启动，然后让发动机预热一下。

e.en: Her comment was the {ignition} for a heated online debate.
e.zh: 她的那句话引爆了一场激烈的网络辩论。

e.en: Lying to his friends was an {ignoble} way to win the bet.
e.zh: 为了赢这场赌注就骗朋友，这种做法太卑鄙了。

e.en: The hero's {ignoble} defeat shocked everyone watching.
e.zh: 那位英雄不光彩的失败让所有观众都震惊了。

e.en: The team suffered an {ignominious} defeat in the first round.
e.zh: 球队在首轮就遭遇了耻辱性的失败。

e.en: His career ended in an {ignominious} scandal last year.
e.zh: 去年他的职业生涯在一场丢脸的丑闻中结束。

e.en: The CEO was {ignominiously} fired after the fraud was uncovered.
e.zh: 欺诈行为曝光后，那位CEO被颜面尽失地解雇了。

e.en: Their startup collapsed {ignominiously} within a year of launch.
e.zh: 他们的创业公司上线不到一年就丢人地倒闭了。

e.en: He couldn't bear the {ignominy} of being publicly fired.
e.zh: 被当众解雇的耻辱让他难以承受。

e.en: The team faced the {ignominy} of relegation after a terrible season.
e.zh: 那支球队在糟糕的赛季后蒙受了降级的耻辱。

e.en: Don't be such an {ignoramus}—at least read the article first.
e.zh: 别这么无知，起码先把文章读一下。

e.en: He called the critic an {ignoramus} for misunderstanding the film.
e.zh: 他骂那个影评人是无知之辈，根本看不懂电影。

e.en: Her {ignorance} of basic safety rules nearly caused an accident.
e.zh: 她对基本安全规则的无知差点酿成事故。

e.en: {ignorance} of the law is no excuse in court.
e.zh: 在法庭上，不懂法律不能作为借口。

e.en: The book exposes the many {ignorances} of so-called experts.
e.zh: 这本书揭露了那些所谓专家的种种无知之处。

e.en: We all carry small {ignorances} we're not even aware of.
e.zh: 我们每个人都怀有一些自己都没意识到的小盲点。

e.en: I was completely {ignorant} of the company's new policy.
e.zh: 我对公司的新政策完全一无所知。

e.en: His {ignorant} comments online sparked a wave of criticism.
e.zh: 他在网上的无知言论引来了一波批评。

e.en: He {ignorantly} insulted the chef without knowing she'd won awards.
e.zh: 他毫无根据地侮辱那位主厨，却不知道她得过大奖。

e.en: Many people {ignorantly} repeat rumors without checking the facts.
e.zh: 许多人不加核实就盲目地传播谣言。

e.en: Just {ignore} the rude comments under your post.
e.zh: 帖子下面那些没礼貌的评论别理就好。

e.en: Doctors told him not to {ignore} the pain in his chest.
e.zh: 医生告诉他不要忽视胸口的疼痛。

ignored.t: v. 忽略（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: She {ignored} his text messages for the whole weekend.
e.zh: 她整个周末都没理他的短信。

e.en: The warning signs were {ignored} until it was too late.
e.zh: 警告信号被忽视了，直到为时已晚。

ignores.t: v. 忽略（第三人称单数）

e.en: He completely {ignores} emails from anyone he doesn't know.
e.zh: 他对陌生人发来的邮件一概不理。

e.en: This report {ignores} several important factors in the analysis.
e.zh: 这份报告在分析中忽略了几个重要因素。

e.en: She kept {ignoring} my calls until I showed up at her door.
e.zh: 她一直不接我电话，直到我跑到她家门口。

e.en: {ignoring} climate science won't make the problem disappear.
e.zh: 无视气候科学并不能让问题消失。

e.en: A green {iguana} was sunning itself on the rock.
e.zh: 一只绿鬣蜥正趴在岩石上晒太阳。

e.en: Keeping an {iguana} as a pet requires a large heated tank.
e.zh: 养一只鬣蜥当宠物需要一个带加热的大型饲养箱。

e.en: The {iia} report ranks countries by internet adoption rates.
e.zh: 该iia报告按互联网普及率对各国进行排名。

e.en: She cited an {iia} study in her thesis introduction.
e.zh: 她在论文引言中引用了一项iia研究。

e.en: King Henry {iii} ruled England in the thirteenth century.
e.zh: 亨利三世于十三世纪统治英格兰。

e.en: Chapter {iii} explains the basics of cell biology.
e.zh: 第三章讲解细胞生物学的基础知识。

ikat.t: n. 伊卡织布；绞缬染织物

e.en: She bought a colorful {ikat} scarf at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场上买了一条色彩鲜艳的伊卡织围巾。

e.en: Traditional {ikat} weaving requires dyeing yarn before the loom.
e.zh: 传统伊卡织工艺要求在上织机前先染纱线。

ikon.t: n. 圣像（icon 的变体拼法）

e.en: The chapel displayed an ancient {ikon} of the saint.
e.zh: 小教堂里陈列着一幅古老的圣徒圣像。

e.en: Collectors paid millions for the rare Russian {ikon}.
e.zh: 收藏家们花了数百万购买这幅稀有的俄罗斯圣像。

e.en: The French word {ile} simply means island in English.
e.zh: 法语单词ile在英语中就是岛屿的意思。

e.en: Tourists love visiting the small {ile} off the coast.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢游览海岸边的那座小岛。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {ileal} resection to remove the tumor.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了回肠切除手术以摘除肿瘤。

e.en: Doctors monitored her {ileal} function after the operation.
e.zh: 医生在术后监测她的回肠功能。

e.en: He adjusted to life with an {ileostomy} after surgery.
e.zh: 他在手术后逐渐适应了带回肠造口的生活。

e.en: Nurses taught her how to clean the {ileostomy} bag.
e.zh: 护士教她如何清洁回肠造口袋。

e.en: The map shows several small {iles} near the coast.
e.zh: 地图上显示了海岸附近的几座小岛。

e.en: Sailors navigated carefully between the rocky {iles}.
e.zh: 水手们在多岩的小岛之间小心航行。

e.en: The {ileum} is the final section of the small intestine.
e.zh: 回肠是小肠的最后一段。

e.en: Nutrients are absorbed primarily through the {ileum}.
e.zh: 营养物质主要通过回肠吸收。

e.en: The doctor checked her {iliac} artery for any blockages.
e.zh: 医生检查了她的髂动脉是否有堵塞。

e.en: Athletes sometimes injure muscles near the {iliac} crest.
e.zh: 运动员有时会拉伤髂嵴附近的肌肉。

iliad.t: n. 伊利亚特（荷马史诗）

e.en: Homer's {iliad} tells the story of the Trojan War.
e.zh: 荷马的《伊利亚特》讲述了特洛伊战争的故事。

e.en: Students read the {iliad} in their literature class.
e.zh: 学生们在文学课上阅读《伊利亚特》。

e.en: The {ilium} is the largest bone in the pelvis.
e.zh: 髂骨是骨盆中最大的骨头。

e.en: She fractured her {ilium} during the cycling accident.
e.zh: 她在那次自行车事故中骨折了髂骨。

ilk.t: n. 同类；一类人（多含贬义）

e.en: Politicians of his {ilk} rarely admit their mistakes.
e.zh: 他那一类的政客很少承认自己的错误。

e.en: I avoid restaurants of that {ilk} on busy weekends.
e.zh: 周末忙碌时我会避开那种类型的餐厅。

ill.t:
adj. 生病的；不好的
adv. 恶劣地

e.en: She felt {ill} after eating the leftover seafood.
e.zh: 她吃了剩下的海鲜后感到不舒服。

e.en: The decision had {ill} consequences for the entire team.
e.zh: 这个决定对整个团队造成了不良后果。

e.en: Downloading copyrighted movies is {illegal} in most countries.
e.zh: 下载有版权的电影在大多数国家都是违法的。

e.en: The referee called an {illegal} move during the match.
e.zh: 裁判在比赛中判定了一个违例动作。

e.en: The court confirmed the {illegality} of the surveillance program.
e.zh: 法院确认了该监控项目的非法性。

e.en: Activists protested the {illegality} of the new immigration policy.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议这项新移民政策的非法性。

e.en: He parked {illegally} and got a hefty fine.
e.zh: 他违规停车,被罚了一大笔钱。

e.en: The company {illegally} collected user data without consent.
e.zh: 该公司未经同意非法收集了用户数据。

e.en: The {illegibility} of his handwriting frustrated every teacher.
e.zh: 他难以辨认的字迹让每位老师都感到头疼。

e.en: Faded ink caused the {illegibility} of the historical document.
e.zh: 褪色的墨水导致这份历史文件难以辨认。

e.en: The doctor's prescription was completely {illegible} to me.
e.zh: 医生的处方对我来说完全难以辨认。

e.en: Rain made the chalk message on the sidewalk {illegible}.
e.zh: 雨水让人行道上的粉笔字变得无法辨认。

e.en: Critics challenged the {illegitimacy} of the election results.
e.zh: 批评人士质疑选举结果的不合法性。

e.en: The scandal raised questions about the {illegitimacy} of his claim.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻引发了对他主张合法性的质疑。

e.en: Many citizens viewed the new government as {illegitimate}.
e.zh: 许多公民认为新政府不具合法性。

e.en: He made an {illegitimate} attempt to seize the company.
e.zh: 他试图通过非法手段夺取公司控制权。

illegitimately.t: adv. 非法地；以私生身份

e.en: The CEO {illegitimately} transferred funds to offshore accounts.
e.zh: 这位CEO非法将资金转入了离岸账户。

e.en: He was accused of {illegitimately} claiming the inheritance.
e.zh: 他被指控非法主张继承遗产。

e.en: The new law was criticized as deeply {illiberal} and unjust.
e.zh: 这项新法律因极不开明且不公正而遭到批评。

e.en: Several European countries have drifted toward {illiberal} democracy.
e.zh: 几个欧洲国家已经滑向不自由的民主体制。

e.en: Police seized millions of dollars in {illicit} drugs.
e.zh: 警方缴获了价值数百万美元的非法毒品。

e.en: The couple's {illicit} affair eventually became public knowledge.
e.zh: 这对情侣的不正当恋情最终被公之于众。

e.en: He {illicitly} downloaded confidential files from the server.
e.zh: 他非法地从服务器下载了机密文件。

e.en: The artwork was {illicitly} sold to a private collector.
e.zh: 这件艺术品被非法卖给了一位私人收藏家。

illimitable.t: adj. 无限的；无边无际的

e.en: The astronauts marveled at the {illimitable} expanse of space.
e.zh: 宇航员们惊叹于无边无际的太空。

e.en: Her curiosity about the natural world seemed {illimitable}.
e.zh: 她对自然世界的好奇心似乎永无止境。

e.en: Chicago is the largest city in {illinois} by population.
e.zh: 芝加哥是伊利诺伊州人口最多的城市。

e.en: She moved to {illinois} for her new teaching job.
e.zh: 她为了新的教学工作搬到了伊利诺伊州。

illiquid.t: adj. 难以变现的；非流动性的（资产）

e.en: Real estate is generally an {illiquid} asset to own.
e.zh: 房地产通常是一种流动性较差的资产。

e.en: The company became {illiquid} and could not pay suppliers.
e.zh: 该公司流动资金不足,无法支付供应商款项。

illiquidity.t: n. 流动性不足；非流动性

e.en: The market faced severe {illiquidity} during the financial crisis.
e.zh: 金融危机期间市场面临严重的流动性不足。

e.en: {Illiquidity} forced the hedge fund to suspend redemptions.
e.zh: 流动性不足迫使该对冲基金暂停了赎回。

e.en: The charity works to reduce adult {illiteracy} in rural areas.
e.zh: 该慈善机构致力于减少农村地区的成人文盲率。

e.en: Digital {illiteracy} prevents many seniors from using online banking.
e.zh: 数字文盲使许多老年人无法使用网上银行。

illiterate.t:
adj. 不识字的；无知的
n. 文盲

e.en: Nearly a billion adults worldwide remain functionally {illiterate}.
e.zh: 全球仍有近十亿成年人实际上是文盲。

e.en: He felt {illiterate} when trying to use the new app.
e.zh: 使用这个新应用时他感觉自己像文盲一样。

e.en: She missed two weeks of work due to {illness}.
e.zh: 她因病缺勤了两周。

e.en: Mental {illness} affects millions of people every year.
e.zh: 精神疾病每年影响着数百万人。

e.en: Chronic {illnesses} require long-term medical management and care.
e.zh: 慢性疾病需要长期的医疗管理和护理。

e.en: Vaccines protect children from many serious childhood {illnesses}.
e.zh: 疫苗保护儿童免受许多严重的儿童疾病侵害。

illocutionary.t: adj. 言外行为的（语言学）

e.en: Linguists study the {illocutionary} force of everyday speech acts.
e.zh: 语言学家研究日常言语行为的言外之力。

e.en: A promise carries a different {illocutionary} meaning than a request.
e.zh: 承诺所带的言外之意与请求不同。

illogical.t: adj. 不合逻辑的；荒谬的

e.en: His argument was completely {illogical} and full of contradictions.
e.zh: 他的论点完全不合逻辑,充满矛盾。

e.en: It seems {illogical} to drive when the train is faster.
e.zh: 火车更快时还开车似乎不合逻辑。

e.en: The {illogicality} of the policy frustrated many economists.
e.zh: 该政策的不合逻辑让许多经济学家感到沮丧。

e.en: Critics highlighted the {illogicality} of his main argument.
e.zh: 批评者指出了他主要论点的不合逻辑之处。

e.en: She acted {illogically} when she heard the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息时,她的反应不合常理。

e.en: The software {illogically} crashes only on weekends.
e.zh: 这个软件莫名其妙地只在周末崩溃。

e.en: Streetlights {illuminate} the empty roads after midnight.
e.zh: 路灯在午夜后照亮空无一人的街道。

e.en: The professor's lecture helped {illuminate} the complex theory.
e.zh: 教授的讲座帮助阐明了这个复杂的理论。

illuminated.t:
adj. 被照亮的
v. 照亮（过去式）

e.en: The fireworks {illuminated} the night sky over the harbor.
e.zh: 烟花照亮了海港上空的夜空。

e.en: Medieval monks created beautifully {illuminated} manuscripts by hand.
e.zh: 中世纪的僧侣手工制作了精美的彩绘手稿。

illuminates.t: v. 照亮；阐明（第三人称单数）

e.en: This study {illuminates} how children acquire their first language.
e.zh: 这项研究阐明了儿童如何习得母语。

e.en: A single candle {illuminates} the entire small room.
e.zh: 一支蜡烛就能照亮整个小房间。

illuminati.t: n. 光明会；先知先觉者

e.en: Conspiracy theorists often blame the {illuminati} for world events.
e.zh: 阴谋论者常将世界大事归咎于光明会。

e.en: The novel features a secret society called the {illuminati}.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一个名为光明会的秘密组织。

illuminating.t: adj. 有启发性的；照明的

e.en: Her interview gave an {illuminating} look into startup culture.
e.zh: 她的访谈让人深入了解了创业文化。

e.en: The documentary was both entertaining and deeply {illuminating}.
e.zh: 这部纪录片既有趣又极具启发性。

e.en: The room needed better {illumination} for detailed reading work.
e.zh: 这个房间需要更好的照明以便进行精细阅读。

e.en: His book offers genuine {illumination} on a confusing topic.
e.zh: 他的书对一个令人困惑的话题提供了真正的启发。

e.en: The medieval {illuminator} spent years decorating a single manuscript.
e.zh: 那位中世纪的彩绘师花了数年装饰一部手稿。

e.en: Photographers use a ring {illuminator} to light their subjects.
e.zh: 摄影师使用环形补光灯来照亮拍摄对象。

illumine.t: v. 照亮；启迪（文学用法）

e.en: Candles softly {illumine} the chapel during evening prayer.
e.zh: 晚祷时烛光柔和地照亮着小教堂。

e.en: Her wisdom seemed to {illumine} every difficult question we asked.
e.zh: 她的智慧似乎能阐明我们提出的每一个难题。

e.en: The textbook lists {illus} on page twelve of chapter three.
e.zh: 教科书在第三章第十二页列出了插图。

e.en: Each entry includes {illus} from the original 1890 edition.
e.zh: 每个条目都包含1890年原版的插图。

e.en: The magician created the {illusion} of floating in midair.
e.zh: 魔术师制造出了悬浮在半空中的错觉。

e.en: He clung to the {illusion} that everything would improve soon.
e.zh: 他抱着一切很快就会好转的幻想。

e.en: The promise of quick wealth proved entirely {illusionary} for investors.
e.zh: 快速致富的承诺对投资者来说完全是虚幻的。

e.en: Her sense of safety turned out to be {illusionary}.
e.zh: 她的安全感原来只是虚幻的。

illusionism.t: n. 错觉主义（艺术/哲学）

e.en: Renaissance painters mastered {illusionism} to create realistic depth.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的画家掌握了制造真实景深的幻觉主义技法。

e.en: Stage {illusionism} relies on misdirection and clever lighting.
e.zh: 舞台幻术依赖于转移注意力和巧妙的灯光。

e.en: The famous {illusionist} made an elephant disappear on stage.
e.zh: 那位著名的魔术师在舞台上让一头大象消失了。

e.en: David Copperfield is perhaps the best-known modern {illusionist}.
e.zh: 大卫·科波菲尔或许是当代最著名的幻术大师。

illusionistic.t: adj. 制造错觉的（艺术手法）

e.en: The painter used {illusionistic} techniques to make walls look three-dimensional.
e.zh: 画家用错觉技法让墙面看起来立体。

e.en: Baroque ceilings often feature {illusionistic} skies that seem endless.
e.zh: 巴洛克天顶常绘有看似无尽的错视天空。

e.en: The magician performed several stunning {illusions} on stage.
e.zh: 魔术师在台上表演了几个惊艳的幻术。

e.en: Many people still hold {illusions} about overnight success.
e.zh: 很多人对一夜成名仍抱有幻想。

e.en: Lasting happiness can feel {illusive} when you chase it directly.
e.zh: 幸福一旦刻意追求,反而显得虚幻。

e.en: His promises turned out to be {illusive} and empty.
e.zh: 他的承诺最后证明是虚假空洞的。

e.en: The sense of safety online is often {illusory}.
e.zh: 网络上的安全感往往只是幻觉。

e.en: Quick profits in crypto can be {illusory} for new investors.
e.zh: 加密货币的快速收益对新手而言往往是假象。

e.en: Let me {illustrate} the idea with a simple example.
e.zh: 让我用一个简单的例子来说明这个想法。

e.en: She was hired to {illustrate} a children's picture book.
e.zh: 她受聘为一本儿童绘本画插图。

illustrated.t:
adj. 带插图的
v. 说明（过去式）

e.en: The teacher {illustrated} the concept with a colorful diagram.
e.zh: 老师用彩色图表说明了这个概念。

e.en: He bought a beautifully {illustrated} edition of the novel.
e.zh: 他买了一本插图精美的小说版本。

illustrates.t: v. 说明；举例（第三人称单数）

e.en: This chart {illustrates} how user growth slowed last quarter.
e.zh: 这张图表展示了上季度用户增长如何放缓。

e.en: Her story {illustrates} the risks of trusting strangers online.
e.zh: 她的经历说明了轻信网络陌生人的风险。

e.en: She spent months {illustrating} the cover for the new novel.
e.zh: 她花了几个月为这本新小说绘制封面。

e.en: The report includes charts {illustrating} recent climate trends.
e.zh: 报告中附有展示近期气候趋势的图表。

e.en: The book has a stunning {illustration} on every page.
e.zh: 这本书每一页都有精美的插图。

e.en: As an {illustration}, consider how Netflix recommends shows.
e.zh: 举个例子,想想 Netflix 是怎么推荐剧集的。

e.en: The children's book is full of colorful {illustrations}.
e.zh: 这本儿童读物里满是彩色插图。

e.en: He gave several {illustrations} to clarify his point.
e.zh: 他举了好几个例子来阐明观点。

illustrative.t: adj. 说明性的；作为例证的

e.en: The case study is highly {illustrative} of common startup mistakes.
e.zh: 这个案例很好地展现了创业公司常犯的错误。

e.en: She added an {illustrative} chart to support her argument.
e.zh: 她加了一张说明性图表来支持论点。

e.en: The {illustrator} drew every character by hand on her tablet.
e.zh: 插画师在数位板上手绘了每一个角色。

e.en: He works as a freelance {illustrator} for tech magazines.
e.zh: 他是一名为科技杂志供稿的自由插画师。

e.en: She comes from an {illustrious} family of scientists.
e.zh: 她出身于一个名声显赫的科学世家。

e.en: The professor had an {illustrious} career in astrophysics.
e.zh: 那位教授在天体物理学界有着辉煌的职业生涯。

ilo.t: n. 国际劳工组织（International Labour Organization）

e.en: The {ILO} sets international standards for workers' rights.
e.zh: 国际劳工组织制定关于劳工权益的国际标准。

e.en: Geneva hosts the headquarters of the {ILO}.
e.zh: 国际劳工组织总部设在日内瓦。

e.en: Modern CPUs exploit {ILP} to run multiple instructions simultaneously.
e.zh: 现代 CPU 利用指令级并行同时执行多条指令。

e.en: The compiler reorders code to maximize {ILP}.
e.zh: 编译器会重排代码以最大化指令级并行。

image.t:
n. 图像；形象
v. 成像

e.en: Please upload a clear {image} of your ID.
e.zh: 请上传一张清晰的身份证照片。

e.en: The brand spent millions improving its public {image}.
e.zh: 该品牌花了数百万美元来改善公众形象。

e.en: The doctor {imaged} her brain to rule out a tumor.
e.zh: 医生为她的大脑做了影像检查以排除肿瘤。

e.en: Astronomers {imaged} the distant galaxy in stunning detail.
e.zh: 天文学家以惊人的细节拍下了那个遥远的星系。

imageries.t: n. 意象；图像（imagery 的复数）

e.en: The two poems use very different {imageries} of the sea.
e.zh: 这两首诗用了截然不同的海洋意象。

e.en: His novels are known for vivid wartime {imageries}.
e.zh: 他的小说以生动的战时意象著称。

e.en: The poem is full of vivid nature {imagery}.
e.zh: 这首诗充满了生动的自然意象。

e.en: Satellite {imagery} showed the extent of the flooding.
e.zh: 卫星图像显示了洪水蔓延的范围。

e.en: The app compresses {images} before uploading them.
e.zh: 这款应用会在上传前压缩图片。

e.en: Disturbing {images} from the war flooded social media.
e.zh: 战争的惨烈画面在社交媒体上铺天盖地。

e.en: They tried every {imaginable} way to fix the bug.
e.zh: 他们想尽了一切办法来修这个 bug。

e.en: The buffet had every dessert {imaginable}.
e.zh: 自助餐上有你能想到的各种甜点。

imaginal.t: adj. 想象的；成虫的（生物学）

e.en: Therapists use {imaginal} exposure to treat trauma safely.
e.zh: 治疗师用想象暴露法安全地治疗创伤。

e.en: The {imaginal} stage is when an insect becomes an adult.
e.zh: 成虫期就是昆虫发育为成体的阶段。

e.en: As a kid she had an {imaginary} friend named Lulu.
e.zh: 小时候她有个名叫 Lulu 的假想朋友。

e.en: The danger he describes is entirely {imaginary}.
e.zh: 他描述的那种危险完全是想象出来的。

e.en: Kids have an incredible {imagination} when they play.
e.zh: 孩子们玩耍时有着惊人的想象力。

e.en: His designs really capture the public's {imagination}.
e.zh: 他的设计真正抓住了大众的想象力。

e.en: I enjoyed the concert {immensely} from start to finish.
e.zh: 这场音乐会从头到尾我都乐在其中。

e.en: The new feature is {immensely} popular with younger users.
e.zh: 这项新功能在年轻用户中极受欢迎。

e.en: Standing at the canyon's edge, I felt the {immensity} of nature.
e.zh: 站在峡谷边缘,我感受到了大自然的浩瀚。

e.en: He underestimated the {immensity} of the task ahead.
e.zh: 他低估了眼前这项任务的艰巨规模。

e.en: VR headsets {immerse} you completely in a virtual world.
e.zh: VR头显能让你完全沉浸在虚拟世界中。

e.en: She likes to {immerse} herself in a novel on weekends.
e.zh: 她喜欢在周末沉浸在小说里。

immersed.t:
adj. 沉浸的
v. immerse 的过去式

e.en: He was so {immersed} in the game that he forgot dinner.
e.zh: 他完全沉迷于游戏中,连晚饭都忘了吃。

e.en: She {immersed} the brush in clean water before painting.
e.zh: 她在作画前先把画笔浸入清水里。

immerses.t: v. immerse 的第三人称单数

e.en: This documentary {immerses} viewers in the lives of refugees.
e.zh: 这部纪录片让观众身临其境地体验难民的生活。

e.en: The app {immerses} learners in real Spanish conversations.
e.zh: 这款应用让学习者沉浸在真实的西班牙语对话中。

e.en: She's {immersing} herself in Japanese culture before the trip.
e.zh: 她在出行前正全身心地投入日本文化中。

e.en: {Immersing} yourself in the language is the fastest way to learn.
e.zh: 沉浸式学习是掌握一门语言最快的方法。

e.en: Language {immersion} programs deliver fast results.
e.zh: 语言沉浸式课程能带来快速的学习效果。

e.en: The game's stunning graphics enhance player {immersion}.
e.zh: 这款游戏惊艳的画面提升了玩家的沉浸感。

immersive.t: adj. 沉浸式的（体验、游戏）

e.en: The museum offers an {immersive} VR tour of ancient Rome.
e.zh: 这家博物馆提供古罗马的沉浸式VR游览。

e.en: Headphones make movies feel more {immersive}.
e.zh: 戴上耳机看电影会更有沉浸感。

e.en: She is a first-generation {immigrant} from Vietnam.
e.zh: 她是来自越南的第一代移民。

e.en: The neighborhood has a strong {immigrant} community.
e.zh: 这个社区有一个庞大的移民群体。

e.en: Many {immigrants} start small businesses in their new country.
e.zh: 许多移民会在新国家开办小生意。

e.en: The city celebrates the contributions of {immigrants}.
e.zh: 这座城市表彰移民们做出的贡献。

e.en: Her family decided to {immigrate} to Canada last year.
e.zh: 她的家人去年决定移民到加拿大。

e.en: It can take years to {immigrate} legally to the United States.
e.zh: 合法移民美国可能要花上数年时间。

e.en: My grandparents {immigrated} from Italy in the 1950s.
e.zh: 我的祖父母在1950年代从意大利移民过来。

e.en: He {immigrated} to Australia for better job opportunities.
e.zh: 他为了更好的工作机会移民到了澳大利亚。

immigrates.t: v. immigrate 的第三人称单数

e.en: When someone {immigrates}, they often face cultural challenges.
e.zh: 一个人移民时,常常会面临文化上的挑战。

e.en: She {immigrates} next month after years of paperwork.
e.zh: 在多年的文件准备之后,她下个月就要移民了。

e.en: They are seriously considering {immigrating} to New Zealand.
e.zh: 他们正在认真考虑移民到新西兰。

e.en: {Immigrating} with young children requires careful planning.
e.zh: 带着年幼的孩子移民需要周密的规划。

e.en: {Immigration} reform has been debated for decades.
e.zh: 移民改革已经争论了几十年。

e.en: He works as an {immigration} lawyer in Toronto.
e.zh: 他在多伦多做移民律师。

e.en: Historical {immigrations} have shaped American culture profoundly.
e.zh: 历史上的多次移民潮深刻塑造了美国文化。

e.en: The textbook compares {immigrations} from different eras.
e.zh: 教科书对比了不同时代的移民潮。

e.en: The {imminence} of the deadline made everyone anxious.
e.zh: 截止日期迫在眉睫,让大家都焦虑不安。

e.en: Forecasters warned of the {imminence} of the storm.
e.zh: 气象预报员警告说风暴即将来临。

imminent.t: adj. 即将发生的；迫近的

e.en: Heavy clouds suggest that rain is {imminent}.
e.zh: 乌云密布,看来马上要下雨了。

e.en: The company announced an {imminent} round of layoffs.
e.zh: 公司宣布即将进行新一轮裁员。

e.en: The product launch is expected {imminently}, perhaps next week.
e.zh: 该产品预计很快就会发布,也许就在下周。

e.en: His resignation is reportedly arriving {imminently}.
e.zh: 据报道他的辞职即将到来。

e.en: After the injury, his left arm remained {immobile} for weeks.
e.zh: 受伤之后,他的左臂连续几周都动弹不得。

e.en: The deer stood completely {immobile}, watching us closely.
e.zh: 那只鹿一动不动地站着,紧紧盯着我们。

immobilise.t: v. 使不能动；固定（英式拼写）

e.en: Doctors had to {immobilise} the broken leg with a splint.
e.zh: 医生不得不用夹板固定住断腿。

e.en: A power cut can {immobilise} the entire factory.
e.zh: 一次停电就能让整个工厂瘫痪。

e.en: The storm {immobilised} traffic across the whole city.
e.zh: 这场风暴让全城的交通陷入瘫痪。

e.en: Her broken ankle was {immobilised} in a plaster cast.
e.zh: 她断掉的脚踝被打上石膏固定住了。

e.en: Long periods of {immobility} can cause blood clots.
e.zh: 长时间不活动可能引发血栓。

e.en: He hated the {immobility} of being stuck in bed.
e.zh: 他讨厌卧床不起、动弹不得的状态。

e.en: Proper {immobilization} of the spine is critical after a fall.
e.zh: 摔倒之后正确固定脊柱至关重要。

e.en: The {immobilization} of assets froze the company's operations.
e.zh: 资产被冻结使公司的运营陷入停滞。

e.en: Paramedics will {immobilize} the patient before transport.
e.zh: 急救人员在转运病人前会先把病人固定好。

e.en: A single virus can {immobilize} an entire computer network.
e.zh: 一个病毒就能让整个计算机网络瘫痪。

e.en: Heavy snow {immobilized} cars all along the highway.
e.zh: 大雪让高速公路上的车辆全都动弹不得。

e.en: Fear {immobilized} him for several seconds.
e.zh: 恐惧让他僵在原地好几秒钟。

e.en: Doctors warned him about his {immoderate} drinking habits.
e.zh: 医生警告他要注意他过度的饮酒习惯。

e.en: Her {immoderate} spending eventually led to debt.
e.zh: 她无节制的消费最终让她陷入债务。

e.en: He laughed {immoderately} at his own joke.
e.zh: 他对自己讲的笑话笑得过分夸张。

e.en: She had been drinking {immoderately} all evening.
e.zh: 她整个晚上都在毫无节制地喝酒。

immodest.t: adj. 不谦虚的；不庄重的

e.en: Her {immodest} bragging at the party annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 她在派对上不谦虚的吹嘘惹恼了大家。

e.en: He made an {immodest} claim about being the best coder.
e.zh: 他自夸是最厉害的程序员，毫不谦虚。

immodestly.t: adv. 不谦虚地；不庄重地

e.en: He {immodestly} compared himself to famous inventors.
e.zh: 他毫不谦虚地把自己比作著名的发明家。

e.en: She spoke {immodestly} about her exam results.
e.zh: 她大言不惭地谈论自己的考试成绩。

e.en: His {immodesty} during the interview cost him the job.
e.zh: 他在面试中的不谦逊让他丢了那份工作。

e.en: The author was criticized for his obvious {immodesty}.
e.zh: 那位作者因明显的自负而受到批评。

e.en: Protesters threatened to {immolate} themselves outside the embassy.
e.zh: 抗议者威胁要在大使馆外自焚。

e.en: Ancient priests would {immolate} animals to please the gods.
e.zh: 古代祭司会焚烧动物以取悦众神。

e.en: The monk's {immolation} shocked the entire world.
e.zh: 那位僧人的自焚震惊了全世界。

e.en: Self-{immolation} became a powerful form of political protest.
e.zh: 自焚成为一种强烈的政治抗议形式。

e.en: Cheating on the exam is clearly {immoral}.
e.zh: 在考试中作弊显然是不道德的。

e.en: Many consider price gouging during disasters to be {immoral}.
e.zh: 许多人认为灾难期间哄抬物价是不道德的。

e.en: The film explores the {immorality} of corporate greed.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了企业贪婪的不道德性。

e.en: He was fired for his {immorality} in business dealings.
e.zh: 他因商业交易中的不道德行为被解雇。

e.en: The company acted {immorally} by hiding the safety risks.
e.zh: 该公司隐瞒安全风险，行为很不道德。

e.en: He behaved {immorally} toward his business partners.
e.zh: 他对生意伙伴的行为极不道德。

immortal.t:
adj. 不朽的；永生的
n. 神；不朽人物

e.en: Vampires are often portrayed as {immortal} in movies.
e.zh: 电影里吸血鬼常被描绘成不死之身。

e.en: Shakespeare wrote {immortal} lines that we still quote today.
e.zh: 莎士比亚写下了我们至今仍引用的不朽诗句。

immortalise.t: v. 使流芳百世（英式拼写）

e.en: The artist sought to {immortalise} her grandmother in oil paint.
e.zh: 那位艺术家想用油画让她的祖母永垂不朽。

e.en: This song will {immortalise} the band's legacy forever.
e.zh: 这首歌将让乐队的遗产永世流传。

e.en: The novel imagines different {immortalities} across alien cultures.
e.zh: 这部小说想象了不同外星文化中各种各样的永生。

e.en: Philosophers debate the various {immortalities} promised by religions.
e.zh: 哲学家们辩论各宗教所承诺的种种永生。

e.en: Tech billionaires are spending fortunes chasing {immortality}.
e.zh: 科技亿万富翁们正花巨资追求永生。

e.en: Her bestselling novels gave her literary {immortality}.
e.zh: 她的畅销小说让她在文学上永垂不朽。

immortalize.t: v. 使流芳百世；使永存

e.en: The statue was built to {immortalize} the war heroes.
e.zh: 这座雕像是为了让战争英雄永垂不朽而建造的。

e.en: Photographers {immortalize} fleeting moments with a single click.
e.zh: 摄影师用一次按快门让转瞬即逝的瞬间永恒。

e.en: Van Gogh {immortalized} the night sky in his famous painting.
e.zh: 梵高在他著名的画作中让夜空永垂不朽。

e.en: The athlete was {immortalized} with a bronze statue downtown.
e.zh: 市中心立起一尊铜像让这位运动员永世流传。

immortalizes.t: v. immortalize 的第三人称单数

e.en: The documentary {immortalizes} the lives of frontline doctors.
e.zh: 这部纪录片让一线医生的生活永世流传。

e.en: Her memoir {immortalizes} the struggles of immigrant families.
e.zh: 她的回忆录让移民家庭的奋斗故事永垂不朽。

e.en: He spent years {immortalizing} his hometown through photography.
e.zh: 他花了多年时间通过摄影让家乡永世流传。

e.en: The biographer is {immortalizing} the scientist's groundbreaking work.
e.zh: 传记作家正在让那位科学家的开创性工作永垂不朽。

immovable.t: adj. 不可移动的；坚定的

e.en: The boulder proved {immovable} despite our best efforts.
e.zh: 尽管我们竭尽全力，那块巨石仍纹丝不动。

e.en: She remained {immovable} on her decision to quit.
e.zh: 她辞职的决定不可动摇。

immune.t: adj. 免疫的；不受影响的

e.en: Vaccines help your {immune} system fight off viruses.
e.zh: 疫苗帮助你的免疫系统抵抗病毒。

e.en: No one is {immune} to criticism on social media.
e.zh: 在社交媒体上没人能免受批评。

immunisation.t: n. 免疫接种（英式拼写）

e.en: Childhood {immunisation} has saved millions of lives worldwide.
e.zh: 儿童免疫接种在全球拯救了数百万人的生命。

e.en: The clinic offers free {immunisation} for travelers.
e.zh: 该诊所为旅行者提供免费免疫接种。

immunise.t: v. 使免疫；接种疫苗（英式）

e.en: Doctors aim to {immunise} every child against measles.
e.zh: 医生们的目标是让每个孩子接种麻疹疫苗。

e.en: The new program will {immunise} thousands of refugees.
e.zh: 新项目将为数千名难民进行免疫接种。

e.en: Getting the flu builds some short-term {immunity}.
e.zh: 得过流感能产生一些短期免疫力。

e.en: Diplomats often enjoy legal {immunity} in foreign countries.
e.zh: 外交官在国外通常享有法律豁免权。

immunization.t: n. 免疫接种；疫苗接种

e.en: Her {immunization} record was required for school enrollment.
e.zh: 入学时需要提供她的免疫接种记录。

e.en: Mass {immunization} campaigns helped eradicate smallpox.
e.zh: 大规模免疫接种运动帮助根除了天花。

imaginative.t: adj. 富有想象力的；有创意的

e.en: She wrote an {imaginative} story about talking robots.
e.zh: 她写了一个关于会说话机器人的奇思妙想故事。

e.en: The team came up with an {imaginative} solution to the bug.
e.zh: 团队想出了一个富有创意的方法来解决这个 bug。

imaginatively.t: adv. 富有想象力地；有创意地

e.en: The chef {imaginatively} combined Thai and Italian flavors.
e.zh: 厨师别出心裁地把泰式和意式风味融合在一起。

e.en: She decorated the small apartment {imaginatively}.
e.zh: 她极具想象力地把这个小公寓布置了一番。

e.en: Can you {imagine} working from a beach every day?
e.zh: 你能想象每天在海滩上办公吗?

e.en: I {imagine} the meeting will run a bit late.
e.zh: 我猜会议会稍微拖一会儿。

imagined.t:
v. 想象（过去式）
adj. 想象中的

e.en: She had {imagined} the city would be much bigger.
e.zh: 她原本以为这座城市会大得多。

e.en: He {imagined} a future where cars drove themselves.
e.zh: 他设想了一个汽车能自动驾驶的未来。

imagines.t: v. 想象（第三人称单数）

e.en: The novel {imagines} a world without the internet.
e.zh: 这部小说构想了一个没有互联网的世界。

e.en: She often {imagines} herself living in Paris.
e.zh: 她常常幻想自己住在巴黎。

imaging.t:
n. 成像（技术）
v. 想象

e.en: Medical {imaging} has improved dramatically over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里医学影像技术有了显著进步。

e.en: The phone's {imaging} sensor performs well in low light.
e.zh: 这款手机的影像传感器在弱光下表现出色。

imagining.t:
v. 想象（进行时）
n. 想象；设想

e.en: She kept {imagining} what the trip would feel like.
e.zh: 她不停地想象那趟旅行会是什么感觉。

e.en: Stop {imagining} the worst before it even happens.
e.zh: 别还没发生就先想象最坏的情况。

imagistic.t: adj. 意象派的；富含意象的

e.en: His poetry is famously {imagistic} and concise.
e.zh: 他的诗以意象鲜明、语言精炼著称。

e.en: The film tells its story in an {imagistic} rather than verbal way.
e.zh: 这部电影用画面而非语言来讲述故事。

e.en: The butterfly emerged as a fully formed {imago}.
e.zh: 那只蝴蝶羽化为完全成形的成虫。

e.en: Many insects only live briefly in their {imago} stage.
e.zh: 许多昆虫在成虫阶段只能存活很短时间。

imam.t: n. 伊玛目（伊斯兰教领袖）

e.en: The local {imam} led prayers at the new mosque.
e.zh: 当地的伊玛目在新清真寺带领礼拜。

e.en: The {imam} gave a sermon about kindness to neighbors.
e.zh: 伊玛目就善待邻里发表了一段讲道。

e.en: There's a clear {imbalance} between supply and demand.
e.zh: 供需之间存在明显的失衡。

e.en: A hormonal {imbalance} can cause fatigue and mood swings.
e.zh: 激素失衡可能引起疲劳和情绪波动。

e.en: The training data was {imbalanced}, so the model performed poorly.
e.zh: 训练数据不均衡,所以模型表现很差。

e.en: Their relationship felt emotionally {imbalanced}.
e.zh: 他们的关系在情感上显得不对等。

imbecile.t:
n. 蠢货；低能者
adj. 愚蠢的

e.en: Don't act like an {imbecile} in front of the clients.
e.zh: 别在客户面前表现得像个白痴。

e.en: He called the driver an {imbecile} after the near collision.
e.zh: 差点撞上后他骂那个司机是蠢货。

e.en: That was an absolutely {imbecilic} thing to post online.
e.zh: 把那种东西发到网上简直是愚蠢透顶。

e.en: The plot of the movie was downright {imbecilic}.
e.zh: 那部电影的剧情简直愚蠢至极。

e.en: His latest tweet was a new height of {imbecility}.
e.zh: 他最新那条推文堪称愚蠢的新高度。

e.en: The pure {imbecility} of the plan shocked everyone.
e.zh: 这个计划的极度愚蠢让所有人震惊。

e.en: You can {imbed} a YouTube clip directly into the slide.
e.zh: 你可以把 YouTube 视频直接嵌入幻灯片。

e.en: Try to {imbed} keywords naturally into the article.
e.zh: 尽量把关键词自然地融入文章里。

imbedded.t:
adj. 嵌入的
v. 嵌入（过去式）

e.en: A small chip is {imbedded} in every new passport.
e.zh: 每本新护照里都嵌有一枚小芯片。

e.en: The video is {imbedded} at the top of the article.
e.zh: 视频嵌在文章的顶部。

e.en: The students came to {imbibe} their teacher's wisdom.
e.zh: 学生们前来汲取老师的智慧。

e.en: It's unwise to {imbibe} too much coffee before bed.
e.zh: 睡前喝太多咖啡可不明智。

imbricate.t:
adj. 叠瓦状的
v. 叠覆

e.en: Roof tiles {imbricate} so rainwater flows away cleanly.
e.zh: 屋顶瓦片层层叠压,这样雨水才能顺畅流走。

e.en: The fish's scales {imbricate} like tiny shields.
e.zh: 鱼鳞像小盾牌一样层层覆盖。

e.en: The {imbrication} of the shingles keeps the roof watertight.
e.zh: 瓦片的层叠铺设让屋顶不漏水。

e.en: Notice the careful {imbrication} of feathers on the bird's wing.
e.zh: 注意鸟翼上羽毛精巧的层叠排列。

e.en: The CEO got tangled in a messy legal {imbroglio}.
e.zh: 那位 CEO 卷入了一场混乱的法律纠纷。

e.en: The whole email leak became a major political {imbroglio}.
e.zh: 那次邮件泄露演变成一场严重的政治风波。

imbue.t: v. 灌输；充满（情感、思想）

e.en: Good teachers {imbue} students with a love of learning.
e.zh: 好老师能让学生爱上学习。

e.en: She tries to {imbue} her designs with a sense of warmth.
e.zh: 她试着让自己的设计透出一种温暖感。

imf.t: n. 国际货币基金组织（IMF）

e.en: The country requested an emergency loan from the {IMF}.
e.zh: 该国向国际货币基金组织申请了紧急贷款。

e.en: The {IMF} forecasts modest global growth next year.
e.zh: 国际货币基金组织预计明年全球经济温和增长。

e.en: {IMI} is a leading global engineering company based in the UK.
e.zh: IMI 是总部位于英国的全球领先工程公司。

e.en: He bought shares of {IMI} after the strong earnings report.
e.zh: 看到亮眼财报后,他买入了 IMI 的股票。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {imipramine} for her chronic depression.
e.zh: 医生给她开了丙咪嗪治疗慢性抑郁。

e.en: {Imipramine} is sometimes used to treat childhood bedwetting.
e.zh: 丙咪嗪有时用于治疗儿童尿床。

e.en: Parrots can {imitate} human speech surprisingly well.
e.zh: 鹦鹉模仿人类说话的能力出奇地强。

e.en: Kids naturally {imitate} the adults around them.
e.zh: 小孩会自然而然地模仿身边的大人。

e.en: The child {imitated} his father's accent perfectly at dinner.
e.zh: 那个小孩在晚餐时把他爸爸的口音模仿得惟妙惟肖。

e.en: Her early paintings {imitated} the style of Monet.
e.zh: 她早期的画作模仿了莫奈的风格。

imitates.t: v. 模仿（第三人称单数）

e.en: This bird {imitates} human speech surprisingly well.
e.zh: 这种鸟模仿人类说话的能力出奇地强。

e.en: The new app {imitates} the look of an old typewriter.
e.zh: 这款新应用模仿了老式打字机的外观。

e.en: He kept {imitating} his teacher's voice during class.
e.zh: 他在课上一直模仿老师的声音。

e.en: The startup is just {imitating} features from bigger competitors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司只是在抄袭大公司的功能。

imitation.t:
n. 模仿；仿制品
adj. 仿造的

e.en: That bag is a cheap {imitation} of a designer brand.
e.zh: 那个包是名牌的廉价仿冒品。

e.en: His {imitation} of the celebrity made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他模仿那位名人逗得大家哈哈大笑。

e.en: The market is full of {imitations} of luxury watches.
e.zh: 市场上充斥着各种奢侈手表的仿冒品。

e.en: His {imitations} of famous actors went viral online.
e.zh: 他对名演员的模仿在网上爆红。

e.en: Critics called the film derivative and {imitative}.
e.zh: 影评人称这部电影缺乏原创、纯属模仿。

e.en: Young children are highly {imitative} of their parents.
e.zh: 小孩子非常喜欢模仿自己的父母。

e.en: He's a brilliant {imitator} of regional accents.
e.zh: 他模仿地方口音的功夫一流。

e.en: The brand sued an {imitator} for copying its logo.
e.zh: 该品牌起诉了一家抄袭其商标的仿冒者。

immaculate.t: adj. 洁净的；完美无瑕的

e.en: Her apartment is always {immaculate}, even on busy days.
e.zh: 即使在忙碌的日子里,她的公寓也总是一尘不染。

e.en: He showed up in an {immaculate} white suit.
e.zh: 他穿着一身洁白无瑕的西装出现。

immaculately.t: adv. 一尘不染地；完美地

e.en: The hotel rooms are {immaculately} cleaned every morning.
e.zh: 酒店房间每天早上都打扫得一尘不染。

e.en: He was {immaculately} dressed for the interview.
e.zh: 他为面试穿戴得整洁体面。

e.en: The philosopher wrote about the {immanence} of God in nature.
e.zh: 这位哲学家写到了上帝内在于自然之中。

e.en: Her poetry explores the {immanence} of meaning in everyday objects.
e.zh: 她的诗歌探讨日常事物中蕴含的内在意义。

e.en: Many traditions see the divine as {immanent} in the world.
e.zh: 许多传统认为神是内在于世界之中的。

e.en: Justice should be an {immanent} value in any legal system.
e.zh: 正义应是任何法律体系中固有的内在价值。

immaterial.t: adj. 无关紧要的；非物质的

e.en: Whether he apologized first is {immaterial} to the verdict.
e.zh: 他是否先道歉与判决无关紧要。

e.en: Some philosophers argue the mind is {immaterial}.
e.zh: 一些哲学家认为心灵是非物质的。

immateriality.t: n. 非物质性；无关紧要

e.en: Descartes argued for the {immateriality} of the soul.
e.zh: 笛卡尔主张灵魂的非物质性。

e.en: The {immateriality} of digital goods complicates property law.
e.zh: 数字商品的非物质性让产权法变得复杂。

e.en: His reaction to criticism was childish and {immature}.
e.zh: 他面对批评的反应既幼稚又不成熟。

e.en: The fruit is still too {immature} to pick.
e.zh: 这些果实还太嫩,不能采摘。

e.en: His {immaturity} cost him the promotion.
e.zh: 他的不成熟让他失去了升职的机会。

e.en: The {immaturity} of the technology limits its real-world use.
e.zh: 该技术尚不成熟,限制了它的实际应用。

immeasurable.t: adj. 无法衡量的；无限的

e.en: Her support during that period was of {immeasurable} value.
e.zh: 她在那段时期给予的支持有着难以估量的价值。

e.en: The damage to the ecosystem is {immeasurable}.
e.zh: 对生态系统造成的破坏无法估量。

immeasurably.t: adv. 无法衡量地；极大地

e.en: Her advice helped me {immeasurably} during the project.
e.zh: 在这个项目中,她的建议对我帮助极大。

e.en: Life has improved {immeasurably} since the surgery.
e.zh: 手术之后,生活改善得难以言喻。

e.en: Live video gives news a powerful sense of {immediacy}.
e.zh: 现场直播让新闻具有强烈的即时感。

e.en: Text messages lack the {immediacy} of a phone call.
e.zh: 短信缺乏电话那种即时的临场感。

e.en: The CEO demanded an {immediate} response from the team.
e.zh: 首席执行官要求团队立即作出回应。

e.en: My {immediate} concern is keeping the servers online.
e.zh: 我眼下最关心的是让服务器保持在线。

e.en: Please call me back {immediately} after the meeting ends.
e.zh: 会议一结束请马上给我回电话。

e.en: The medicine starts working {immediately} after you swallow it.
e.zh: 这种药一咽下去就立刻开始起效。

e.en: This festival has been celebrated since time {immemorial}.
e.zh: 这个节日自远古以来就一直在庆祝。

e.en: The villagers have farmed this land from time {immemorial}.
e.zh: 村民们自远古时代起就在这片土地上耕种。

e.en: Building the bridge required an {immense} amount of steel.
e.zh: 建造这座桥需要大量的钢材。

e.en: She felt {immense} pride watching her daughter graduate.
e.zh: 看着女儿毕业,她感到无比自豪。

e.en: Doctors {immunize} babies against several diseases at birth.
e.zh: 医生在婴儿出生时为他们接种多种疾病的疫苗。

e.en: This training will {immunize} you against common scams.
e.zh: 这次培训会让你对常见骗局免疫。

immunized.t:
adj. 已免疫的
v. immunize 的过去式

e.en: All staff members were {immunized} before flu season.
e.zh: 所有员工都在流感季节前接种了疫苗。

e.en: She felt {immunized} against rejection after years of auditions.
e.zh: 经过多年试镜，她对被拒已经免疫了。

e.en: The lab uses an {immunoassay} to detect early pregnancy.
e.zh: 实验室使用免疫测定法来检测早期妊娠。

e.en: Doctors ordered an {immunoassay} to confirm the diagnosis.
e.zh: 医生开了免疫测定来确认诊断。

e.en: The vaccine works best in {immunocompetent} adults.
e.zh: 该疫苗在免疫功能正常的成年人身上效果最好。

e.en: Most {immunocompetent} patients recover from this virus quickly.
e.zh: 大多数免疫功能正常的患者都能很快从这种病毒中康复。

e.en: {Immunocompromised} patients should avoid crowded indoor spaces.
e.zh: 免疫功能低下的患者应避免拥挤的室内场所。

e.en: Cancer treatment can leave patients severely {immunocompromised}.
e.zh: 癌症治疗可能使患者免疫功能严重低下。

e.en: HIV causes a serious {immunodeficiency} that requires lifelong treatment.
e.zh: 艾滋病毒导致严重的免疫缺陷，需要终身治疗。

e.en: Children with primary {immunodeficiency} need specialized medical care.
e.zh: 原发性免疫缺陷儿童需要专门的医疗护理。

e.en: Researchers used {immunofluorescence} to visualize the protein in cells.
e.zh: 研究人员使用免疫荧光技术观察细胞中的蛋白质。

e.en: The {immunofluorescence} image clearly showed the antibody binding sites.
e.zh: 免疫荧光图像清晰地显示了抗体结合位点。

e.en: Scientists designed a new {immunogen} to trigger antibody production.
e.zh: 科学家设计了一种新的免疫原来触发抗体生成。

e.en: The protein serves as a powerful {immunogen} in the vaccine.
e.zh: 这种蛋白在疫苗中起着强效免疫原的作用。

e.en: Researchers tested the vaccine's {immunogenicity} in clinical trials.
e.zh: 研究人员在临床试验中测试了疫苗的免疫原性。

e.en: High {immunogenicity} usually means a stronger immune response.
e.zh: 高免疫原性通常意味着更强的免疫反应。

e.en: Doctors administered {immunoglobulin} to boost the patient's immune defense.
e.zh: 医生给病人注射免疫球蛋白以增强免疫防御。

e.en: The blood test measured several types of {immunoglobulin} levels.
e.zh: 血液检测测量了几种类型的免疫球蛋白水平。

e.en: Pathologists rely on {immunohistochemical} staining to diagnose tumors.
e.zh: 病理学家依靠免疫组化染色来诊断肿瘤。

e.en: The {immunohistochemical} analysis revealed abnormal protein expression.
e.zh: 免疫组化分析显示蛋白表达异常。

e.en: The patient showed an unusual {immunologic} response to the drug.
e.zh: 病人对该药物表现出不寻常的免疫学反应。

e.en: Researchers are studying {immunologic} markers for early cancer detection.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究用于癌症早期检测的免疫学标志物。

e.en: The lab specializes in {immunological} testing for autoimmune diseases.
e.zh: 该实验室专门进行自身免疫疾病的免疫学检测。

e.en: Stress can have a measurable {immunological} impact on the body.
e.zh: 压力对身体可以产生可测量的免疫学影响。

e.en: Newborns are {immunologically} vulnerable during their first months.
e.zh: 新生儿在出生头几个月免疫学上很脆弱。

e.en: The two diseases are {immunologically} distinct despite similar symptoms.
e.zh: 尽管症状相似，这两种疾病在免疫学上截然不同。

e.en: The {immunologist} explained how vaccines train the body.
e.zh: 那位免疫学家解释了疫苗如何训练人体。

e.en: She became a leading {immunologist} after years of cancer research.
e.zh: 经过多年癌症研究，她成为顶尖免疫学家。

e.en: She studied {immunology} before joining the vaccine research team.
e.zh: 她学过免疫学，之后加入了疫苗研究团队。

e.en: Modern {immunology} has transformed how we treat allergies.
e.zh: 现代免疫学改变了我们治疗过敏的方式。

e.en: The tissue showed strong {immunoreactivity} to the test antibody.
e.zh: 该组织对测试抗体显示出强烈的免疫反应性。

e.en: Researchers measured {immunoreactivity} in samples from infected mice.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了受感染小鼠样本中的免疫反应性。

e.en: Transplant patients must take an {immunosuppressant} every day.
e.zh: 器官移植病人必须每天服用免疫抑制剂。

e.en: This {immunosuppressant} reduces the risk of organ rejection.
e.zh: 这种免疫抑制剂降低了器官排斥的风险。

e.en: Long-term {immunosuppression} increases the risk of infections.
e.zh: 长期免疫抑制会增加感染的风险。

e.en: Doctors carefully balance {immunosuppression} after kidney transplants.
e.zh: 医生在肾移植后会仔细平衡免疫抑制程度。

immunosuppressive.t:
adj. 免疫抑制的
n. 免疫抑制剂

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {immunosuppressive} drug for her arthritis.
e.zh: 医生给她的关节炎开了免疫抑制药物。

e.en: {Immunosuppressive} therapy is essential after most organ transplants.
e.zh: 大多数器官移植后免疫抑制治疗是必不可少的。

e.en: {Immunotherapy} has transformed treatment for many cancer patients.
e.zh: 免疫疗法已经改变了许多癌症患者的治疗方式。

e.en: She started {immunotherapy} after chemotherapy stopped working.
e.zh: 在化疗失效后她开始接受免疫治疗。

e.en: The villain threatened to {immure} her in the tower forever.
e.zh: 反派威胁要把她永远囚禁在塔中。

e.en: Monks would {immure} themselves to focus on prayer.
e.zh: 僧侣们会把自己幽禁起来专心祈祷。

immutability.t: n. 不可变性（编程中常用）

e.en: The {immutability} of data is a core idea in functional programming.
e.zh: 数据的不可变性是函数式编程的核心理念。

e.en: Blockchain relies on the {immutability} of recorded transactions.
e.zh: 区块链依赖于已记录交易的不可变性。

immutable.t: adj. 不可变的（数据、对象）

e.en: In React, state should be treated as {immutable}.
e.zh: 在 React 中，状态应被视为不可变的。

e.en: The laws of physics seem {immutable} across the universe.
e.zh: 物理定律在整个宇宙中似乎都是不可改变的。

imo.t: abbr. in my opinion 的缩写，依我看

e.en: {Imo}, that new phone isn't worth the high price.
e.zh: 在我看来，那款新手机不值这么高的价钱。

e.en: This restaurant has the best ramen in town, {imo}.
e.zh: 在我看来，这家餐厅有镇上最好的拉面。

e.en: That little {imp} hid all my socks again!
e.zh: 那个小淘气鬼又把我的袜子全藏起来了！

e.en: In the game, an {imp} appeared from a fiery portal.
e.zh: 游戏里，一个小恶魔从火焰传送门里冒了出来。

impact.t:
n. 影响；冲击
v. 影响；撞击

e.en: Social media has a huge {impact} on teenagers' self-esteem.
e.zh: 社交媒体对青少年的自尊心有巨大影响。

e.en: The new policy will {impact} small businesses the most.
e.zh: 新政策将对小企业影响最大。

e.en: The pandemic {impacted} millions of workers worldwide.
e.zh: 疫情影响了全球数百万工人。

e.en: She had her {impacted} wisdom tooth removed last week.
e.zh: 她上周拔掉了那颗阻生智齿。

impactful.t: adj. 有影响力的；效果显著的

e.en: Her speech was the most {impactful} moment of the conference.
e.zh: 她的演讲是整场会议最具影响力的时刻。

e.en: The startup wants to build {impactful} products for rural users.
e.zh: 这家初创公司想为农村用户打造有实际影响的产品。

impacting.t: v. 正在影响；冲击（impact 的现在分词）

e.en: Heavy rain is {impacting} flights across the east coast.
e.zh: 大雨正在影响东海岸各地的航班。

e.en: New tariffs are {impacting} small online retailers the most.
e.zh: 新关税对小型网店的冲击最大。

impaction.t: n. 嵌塞；阻生（如阻生牙）

e.en: The dentist diagnosed an {impaction} of the lower wisdom tooth.
e.zh: 牙医诊断为下颌智齿阻生。

e.en: Severe stool {impaction} sent the patient to the emergency room.
e.zh: 严重的粪便嵌塞使病人被送入急诊室。

e.en: NASA's {impactor} successfully nudged the asteroid off course.
e.zh: 美国航空航天局的撞击器成功将小行星推离原轨道。

e.en: Scientists believe a massive {impactor} formed the Moon.
e.zh: 科学家认为一颗巨大的撞击天体形成了月球。

impacts.t:
n. 影响（复数）
v. 影响（三单）

e.en: Climate change {impacts} coastal cities more than inland ones.
e.zh: 气候变化对沿海城市的影响大于内陆城市。

e.en: The report lists the social {impacts} of remote work.
e.zh: 报告列出了远程办公带来的社会影响。

impair.t: v. 损害；削弱（能力、功能）

e.en: Lack of sleep can seriously {impair} your judgment at work.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会严重削弱你在工作中的判断力。

e.en: Loud headphones over time may {impair} your hearing.
e.zh: 长期使用大音量耳机可能损害你的听力。

impaired.t: adj. 受损的；功能障碍的

e.en: Driving while {impaired} is a serious criminal offense.
e.zh: 在意识受损的情况下开车是严重的刑事罪行。

e.en: The app offers subtitles for hearing-{impaired} viewers.
e.zh: 该应用为听力受损的观众提供字幕。

impairing.t: v. 正在损害（impair 的现在分词）

e.en: Smoke from the fires is {impairing} visibility on the highway.
e.zh: 火灾产生的烟雾正在降低高速公路上的能见度。

e.en: Stress is {impairing} her ability to focus on coding.
e.zh: 压力正在削弱她专注于编程的能力。

impairment.t: n. 损害；缺陷；功能障碍

e.en: The accident left him with a permanent visual {impairment}.
e.zh: 那场事故让他留下了永久性的视力障碍。

e.en: The bank reported a large {impairment} on its loan portfolio.
e.zh: 该银行报告其贷款组合出现了大额减值。

e.en: Even one drink {impairs} reaction time behind the wheel.
e.zh: 即使只喝一杯酒也会削弱开车时的反应速度。

e.en: Constant multitasking {impairs} deep, focused thinking.
e.zh: 不停地多任务处理会损害深度专注的思考。

e.en: An {impala} leapt across the trail just ahead of the jeep.
e.zh: 一只黑斑羚从吉普车前方跃过小径。

e.en: He restored a classic Chevy {Impala} from the sixties.
e.zh: 他修复了一辆六十年代的经典雪佛兰黑斑羚轿车。

e.en: Be careful not to {impale} your hand on that loose nail.
e.zh: 小心别让你的手被那颗松动的钉子刺穿。

e.en: Knights would {impale} their enemies on long wooden stakes.
e.zh: 骑士们会用长木桩将敌人刺穿。

impaled.t: v. 被刺穿（impale 的过去式）

e.en: A branch fell and nearly {impaled} the tent below.
e.zh: 一根树枝掉下来,差点把下面的帐篷刺穿。

e.en: The chef {impaled} the chunks of lamb on metal skewers.
e.zh: 厨师把羊肉块串在金属签子上。

impalpable.t: adj. 摸不到的；难以理解的

e.en: There was an {impalpable} tension in the meeting room.
e.zh: 会议室里弥漫着一种难以察觉的紧张气氛。

e.en: The dust was so fine it felt almost {impalpable}.
e.zh: 那粉尘极其细腻,几乎触摸不到。

impart.t: v. 传授；赋予（知识、性质）

e.en: Good teachers {impart} curiosity, not just facts.
e.zh: 好老师传授的是好奇心,而不仅仅是知识点。

e.en: A splash of lemon will {impart} brightness to the sauce.
e.zh: 加一点柠檬汁能为酱汁增添清新的味道。

e.en: Jurors must remain {impartial} throughout the trial.
e.zh: 陪审员必须在整个审判过程中保持公正。

e.en: We need an {impartial} reviewer to settle the dispute.
e.zh: 我们需要一位公正的评审来解决这场争议。

e.en: The judge is known for her strict {impartiality}.
e.zh: 这位法官以严格的公正态度而闻名。

e.en: News outlets often claim {impartiality} they rarely deliver.
e.zh: 新闻媒体常宣称中立,却很少真正做到。

impartially.t: adv. 公正地；不偏不倚地

e.en: The referee called the fouls {impartially} on both teams.
e.zh: 裁判公正地对两队的犯规一视同仁地吹罚。

e.en: Please review each application {impartially} and on merit.
e.zh: 请公正地、按实际表现审阅每一份申请。

e.en: Heavy snow made the mountain road completely {impassable}.
e.zh: 大雪使这条山路彻底无法通行。

e.en: The flooded bridge was {impassable} for two full days.
e.zh: 被洪水淹没的桥整整两天都无法通行。

e.en: Salary talks reached an {impasse} after six long hours.
e.zh: 薪资谈判在漫长的六小时后陷入僵局。

e.en: Both sides need to compromise to break this {impasse}.
e.zh: 双方都需要妥协,才能打破这一僵局。

e.en: His face remained {impassible} as the verdict was read.
e.zh: 宣读判决时,他的脸上毫无表情。

e.en: The monk seemed {impassible} to pain or pleasure.
e.zh: 那位僧人似乎对痛苦和快乐都无动于衷。

imperishable.t: adj. 不朽的；不会腐烂的

e.en: Stainless steel cookware is practically {imperishable} with proper care.
e.zh: 不锈钢炊具只要保养得当几乎永不损坏。

e.en: His novels left an {imperishable} mark on modern literature.
e.zh: 他的小说在现代文学中留下了不朽的印记。

e.en: Rome's {imperium} once stretched from Britain to the Middle East.
e.zh: 罗马的统治权曾从不列颠延伸到中东。

e.en: The tech company built a digital {imperium} over two decades.
e.zh: 这家科技公司用二十年时间打造了一个数字帝国。

e.en: Buddhism teaches the {impermanence} of all things.
e.zh: 佛教教导万物皆无常的道理。

e.en: Cloud storage accepts the {impermanence} of physical hardware.
e.zh: 云存储接受了实体硬件无法长存这一现实。

e.en: Tattoos that are {impermanent} fade within a few weeks.
e.zh: 非永久性的纹身会在几周内褪色。

e.en: Online trends are {impermanent} and quickly forgotten.
e.zh: 网络潮流转瞬即逝,很快就被人遗忘。

impermeability.t: n. 不透水性；不可渗透性

e.en: The {impermeability} of the membrane prevents water leakage.
e.zh: 这种膜的不透水性可以防止漏水。

e.en: Engineers tested the {impermeability} of the new roofing material.
e.zh: 工程师们测试了这种新型屋顶材料的不渗透性。

impermeable.t: adj. 不透水的；不可渗透的

e.en: Raincoats are made from {impermeable} synthetic fabric.
e.zh: 雨衣是用不透水的合成面料制成的。

e.en: The committee seemed {impermeable} to outside criticism.
e.zh: 该委员会似乎对外界批评毫不在意。

impermissible.t: adj. 不允许的；不许可的

e.en: Sharing customer data with third parties is {impermissible}.
e.zh: 将客户数据分享给第三方是不被允许的。

e.en: The judge ruled that evidence {impermissible} in court.
e.zh: 法官裁定该证据在法庭上不可采纳。

impermissibly.t: adv. 不许可地；不被允许地

e.en: The contract was {impermissibly} vague about payment terms.
e.zh: 这份合同在付款条款上模糊得不可接受。

e.en: He acted {impermissibly} by accessing private accounts.
e.zh: 他访问私人账户的行为越过了不可逾越的界限。

impersonal.t: adj. 非个人的；客观的；冷漠的

e.en: Automated emails feel cold and {impersonal} to most customers.
e.zh: 对大多数客户来说,自动邮件显得冷冰冰、缺乏人情味。

e.en: The hotel lobby had a sleek but {impersonal} atmosphere.
e.zh: 酒店大堂时尚却缺乏温度。

e.en: The {impersonality} of big-city life can feel isolating.
e.zh: 大城市生活的冷漠感会让人觉得孤独。

e.en: Critics noted the {impersonality} of the chatbot's replies.
e.zh: 批评者指出这款聊天机器人的回复缺乏个性化。

e.en: The HR system addressed each applicant {impersonally} by ID number.
e.zh: 人事系统以编号冷冰冰地称呼每位申请人。

e.en: He spoke {impersonally} about the layoffs, avoiding eye contact.
e.zh: 他用毫无感情的口吻谈起裁员,避开眼神交流。

e.en: Scammers often {impersonate} bank staff to steal passwords.
e.zh: 骗子常常冒充银行职员来盗取密码。

e.en: He can {impersonate} every president since Reagan.
e.zh: 他能模仿里根以来的每一位总统。

impersonated.t: v. 冒充（impersonate 的过去式）

e.en: The hacker {impersonated} the CEO in a phishing email.
e.zh: 黑客在钓鱼邮件中冒充了首席执行官。

e.en: She {impersonated} her favorite singer at the talent show.
e.zh: 她在才艺表演上模仿了自己最喜欢的歌手。

impersonates.t: v. 冒充（impersonate 第三人称单数）

e.en: This comedian {impersonates} celebrities with uncanny accuracy.
e.zh: 这位喜剧演员模仿名人惟妙惟肖。

e.en: The bot {impersonates} real users to spread misinformation.
e.zh: 这个机器人冒充真实用户传播虚假信息。
