e.en: The young {infielder} made a diving catch in the ninth.
e.zh: 那位年轻的内野手在第九局做出鱼跃接球。

infighting.t: n. 内部斗争；近身搏斗

e.en: Political {infighting} weakened the ruling party badly.
e.zh: 内斗严重削弱了执政党的实力。

e.en: Constant {infighting} stalled every major company decision.
e.zh: 持续的内斗让公司每个重大决策都搁浅。

infill.t:
n. 填充物；填入
v. 填充

e.en: The city encourages {infill} development on vacant lots.
e.zh: 该市鼓励在空地上进行填充式开发。

e.en: Artificial turf often uses rubber {infill} between the fibers.
e.zh: 人造草皮常在纤维间填充橡胶颗粒。

e.en: Urban planners support {infilling} to reduce suburban sprawl.
e.zh: 城市规划者支持填充式建设以减少郊区蔓延。

e.en: Workers are {infilling} the trench with gravel today.
e.zh: 工人今天正用碎石填埋这条沟。

e.en: Undercover agents managed to {infiltrate} the smuggling ring.
e.zh: 卧底特工成功打入了走私团伙。

e.en: Rainwater can {infiltrate} cracks and damage the foundation.
e.zh: 雨水会渗入裂缝并损坏地基。

e.en: The army feared enemy {infiltration} along the border.
e.zh: 军方担心敌方沿边境进行渗透。

e.en: Water {infiltration} caused mold throughout the basement.
e.zh: 渗水导致地下室到处发霉。

infiltrative.t: adj. 浸润性的；渗透性的

e.en: The scan revealed an {infiltrative} tumor in the liver.
e.zh: 扫描显示肝脏中有一个浸润性肿瘤。

e.en: Doctors warned that {infiltrative} cancers spread silently.
e.zh: 医生警告说浸润性癌症会悄无声息地扩散。

e.en: The group discovered an {infiltrator} reporting to the police.
e.zh: 该组织发现有内奸正在向警方告密。

e.en: A skilled {infiltrator} can blend in for years undetected.
e.zh: 熟练的渗透者可以隐藏多年不被发觉。

e.en: Streaming platforms offer an almost {infinite} library of shows.
e.zh: 流媒体平台提供几乎无限的影视库。

e.en: Parents need {infinite} patience with toddlers.
e.zh: 家长面对幼儿需要无尽的耐心。

e.en: This new phone is {infinitely} better than my old one.
e.zh: 这部新手机比我那部旧的好太多了。

e.en: The universe seems {infinitely} large from our vantage point.
e.zh: 从我们的视角看,宇宙似乎无限广阔。

e.en: The chance of winning is {infinitesimal}, but people still play.
e.zh: 中奖的概率极小,但人们还是照玩不误。

e.en: Scientists detected an {infinitesimal} change in temperature.
e.zh: 科学家测到了一个极其微小的温度变化。

e.en: Stock prices moved {infinitesimally} during the quiet session.
e.zh: 在那段平静的交易时段里,股价微乎其微地波动。

e.en: The two designs differ {infinitesimally} in weight.
e.zh: 这两种设计的重量差异微乎其微。

e.en: In English, the {infinitive} usually starts with the word "to".
e.zh: 英语中,不定式通常以"to"开头。

e.en: Some grammarians frown on splitting an {infinitive}.
e.zh: 一些语法学家不赞成分裂不定式。

e.en: Students often confuse gerunds with {infinitives} in writing.
e.zh: 学生写作时常混淆动名词和不定式。

e.en: Latin {infinitives} change form to show tense and voice.
e.zh: 拉丁语的不定式会变形以表达时态和语态。

e.en: Poets often celebrate the {infinitude} of the night sky.
e.zh: 诗人常常赞美夜空的浩瀚无垠。

e.en: He stared at the ocean's {infinitude} in silent awe.
e.zh: 他默默地凝视着大海的无边无际,心生敬畏。

e.en: The mirrors reflected each other into apparent {infinity}.
e.zh: 两面镜子相互映照,延伸至无穷远处。

e.en: Mathematicians use a sideways eight to denote {infinity}.
e.zh: 数学家用横着的8来表示无穷大。

e.en: The nursing home cares for elderly and {infirm} residents.
e.zh: 这家养老院照顾年长和体弱的居民。

e.en: Her grandmother grew {infirm} after the long illness.
e.zh: 长期患病后,她的祖母变得十分虚弱。

e.en: The injured player was rushed to the school {infirmary}.
e.zh: 受伤的球员被紧急送往学校医务室。

e.en: A small {infirmary} on board treats minor injuries at sea.
e.zh: 船上有间小医务室,可处理海上的轻伤。

e.en: Despite her age and {infirmity}, she remained sharp-witted.
e.zh: 尽管年迈体弱,她思路依然敏捷。

e.en: The job demands stamina that rules out any serious {infirmity}.
e.zh: 这份工作需要体力,任何严重的体弱都无法胜任。

e.en: Such remarks only {inflame} an already tense situation.
e.zh: 这种言论只会让本已紧张的局势更加激化。

e.en: Spicy foods can {inflame} a sensitive stomach.
e.zh: 辛辣食物会刺激敏感的胃部。

e.en: His throat was red and {inflamed} from the infection.
e.zh: 他的喉咙因感染而红肿发炎。

e.en: The speech {inflamed} passions on both sides of the debate.
e.zh: 那场演讲点燃了辩论双方的激烈情绪。

e.en: The truck carried {inflammable} liquids and drove cautiously.
e.zh: 那辆卡车装着易燃液体,行驶得格外小心。

e.en: Keep all {inflammable} materials away from open flames.
e.zh: 所有易燃物品都要远离明火。

e.en: Ice helps reduce swelling and {inflammation} after an injury.
e.zh: 受伤后冰敷有助于减轻肿胀和炎症。

e.en: Chronic {inflammation} is linked to many serious diseases.
e.zh: 慢性炎症与许多严重疾病有关。

e.en: Repeated joint {inflammations} eventually damaged her knees.
e.zh: 反复的关节炎症最终损伤了她的膝盖。

e.en: Skin {inflammations} often respond well to topical creams.
e.zh: 皮肤炎症通常对外用药膏反应良好。

inflammatory.t:
adj. 煽动性的
adj. (医) 炎症的

e.en: His {inflammatory} tweets sparked outrage across the internet.
e.zh: 他那些煽动性的推文在网上引发了愤怒。

e.en: Doctors prescribed an anti-{inflammatory} drug for the pain.
e.zh: 医生开了一种消炎药来止痛。

inflatable.t:
adj. 可充气的
n. 充气物

e.en: The kids spent all afternoon on the {inflatable} pool.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都泡在充气泳池里。

e.en: Pack an {inflatable} pillow for long international flights.
e.zh: 长途国际航班记得带个充气枕头。

e.en: Use the pump to {inflate} the bike tires fully.
e.zh: 用打气筒把自行车胎打到充足气压。

e.en: Job seekers sometimes {inflate} their accomplishments on resumes.
e.zh: 求职者有时会在简历上夸大自己的成就。

e.en: Tourists complained about the {inflated} prices near the beach.
e.zh: 游客抱怨海滩附近的物价被哄抬得太高。

e.en: He has an {inflated} sense of his own importance.
e.zh: 他对自己的重要性有一种过分膨胀的认知。

inflates.t: v. 充气（第三人称单数）

e.en: The airbag {inflates} within milliseconds of a crash.
e.zh: 碰撞发生后几毫秒内,安全气囊就会弹出。

e.en: Heavy demand {inflates} ticket prices during the holidays.
e.zh: 假期里强劲的需求会推高票价。

inflating.t: v. 正在充气（现在分词）

e.en: He spent ten minutes {inflating} the air mattress.
e.zh: 他花了十分钟给气垫床打气。

e.en: Critics accused the company of {inflating} its user numbers.
e.zh: 批评者指控公司虚报用户数量。

inflation.t:
n. 通货膨胀
n. 充气，膨胀

e.en: Rising {inflation} has squeezed household budgets this year.
e.zh: 今年不断上升的通胀挤压了家庭预算。

e.en: The central bank raised rates to fight {inflation}.
e.zh: 央行通过加息来对抗通货膨胀。

e.en: Economists warned of {inflationary} pressures on food prices.
e.zh: 经济学家警告食品价格面临通胀压力。

e.en: Wage hikes can create an {inflationary} spiral.
e.zh: 工资上涨可能引发通胀螺旋。

e.en: I keep a small tire {inflator} in the trunk.
e.zh: 我后备箱里常备着一个小型轮胎充气泵。

e.en: The lifeboat's automatic {inflator} deploys on contact with water.
e.zh: 救生艇的自动充气装置一接触水就会展开。

e.en: Speakers naturally {inflect} their voice to show emotion.
e.zh: 说话者会自然地通过语调变化来表达情感。

e.en: In Spanish, verbs {inflect} to indicate person and tense.
e.zh: 在西班牙语中,动词会变形以表示人称和时态。

e.en: Latin is a heavily {inflected} language with many endings.
e.zh: 拉丁语是一种屈折变化丰富、词尾繁多的语言。

e.en: She {inflected} the question with a hint of sarcasm.
e.zh: 她语气一扬,带着一丝讽刺地问道。

inflection.t:
n. 词形变化
n. 语调变化

e.en: His voice rose with a questioning {inflection}.
e.zh: 他的声音上扬,带着疑问的语调。

e.en: The startup reached an {inflection} point after going viral.
e.zh: 那家初创公司爆红后迎来了转折点。

e.en: English has fewer {inflectional} endings than German.
e.zh: 英语的屈折词尾比德语少。

e.en: Children gradually master {inflectional} morphology as they learn.
e.zh: 孩子们在学习过程中逐步掌握屈折形态。

e.en: The {inflexibility} of the rules frustrated new employees.
e.zh: 规章制度的死板让新员工感到沮丧。

e.en: Her {inflexibility} on the schedule cost the team a deal.
e.zh: 她在日程上的不肯让步让团队失去了一笔交易。

e.en: The boss is {inflexible} about start times in the morning.
e.zh: 老板对早上的上班时间毫不通融。

e.en: Steel beams are strong but largely {inflexible}.
e.zh: 钢梁很坚固,但基本上没有什么柔韧性。

e.en: He stuck {inflexibly} to the original plan despite new data.
e.zh: 尽管有新数据,他仍然死板地坚持原计划。

e.en: The court applied the law {inflexibly} in every case.
e.zh: 法院在每一个案件中都僵硬地适用法律。

e.en: British English often spells the word as {inflexion}.
e.zh: 英式英语常把这个词拼作 inflexion(语调变化)。

e.en: A subtle {inflexion} in his tone revealed his doubt.
e.zh: 他语调中微妙的变化透露出他的疑虑。

inflict.t: v. 使遭受，施加（打击、痛苦）

e.en: The storm could {inflict} serious damage on coastal homes.
e.zh: 这场风暴可能给沿海房屋造成严重破坏。

e.en: Please don't {inflict} your bad mood on the kids.
e.zh: 请不要把你的坏心情发泄到孩子身上。

e.en: The accident {inflicted} lasting trauma on the survivors.
e.zh: 那场事故给幸存者留下了长久的心理创伤。

e.en: Years of drought {inflicted} heavy losses on local farmers.
e.zh: 多年干旱给当地农民带来了惨重损失。

inflicting.t: v. 正在施加（现在分词）

e.en: He was charged with {inflicting} grievous bodily harm.
e.zh: 他被控对他人造成严重身体伤害。

e.en: The new tax is {inflicting} pain on small businesses.
e.zh: 新税正在让小企业苦不堪言。

e.en: The lawsuit alleged intentional {infliction} of emotional distress.
e.zh: 诉讼指控对方蓄意造成精神伤害。

e.en: Critics condemned the {infliction} of harsh penalties on minors.
e.zh: 批评者谴责对未成年人施加严厉惩罚。

inflicts.t: v. 施加（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new tax {inflicts} real pain on small businesses.
e.zh: 新税让小企业承受了实实在在的痛苦。

e.en: A careless comment often {inflicts} more damage than people realize.
e.zh: 一句无心的话往往造成的伤害比人们意识到的更大。

e.en: The orchid's {inflorescence} can hold dozens of tiny blooms.
e.zh: 这种兰花的花序上能开出几十朵小花。

e.en: Botanists study the {inflorescence} pattern to identify plant species.
e.zh: 植物学家通过花序结构来识别植物种类。

e.en: The fund saw record {inflow} after the strong quarterly results.
e.zh: 在强劲的季度业绩后,该基金录得创纪录的资金流入。

e.en: A steady {inflow} of tourists keeps the local economy alive.
e.zh: 稳定的游客流入让当地经济保持活力。

influence.t:
n. 影响，影响力
v. 影响

e.en: Social media has a huge {influence} on how teenagers shop.
e.zh: 社交媒体对青少年的购物方式有巨大影响。

e.en: Don't let stress {influence} your decision about the job offer.
e.zh: 别让压力影响你对这份工作邀请的决定。

e.en: Her writing style was heavily {influenced} by Japanese poetry.
e.zh: 她的写作风格深受日本诗歌的影响。

e.en: The judge's ruling {influenced} how similar cases are handled today.
e.zh: 法官的裁决影响了今天处理类似案件的方式。

influences.t: n./v. 影响（复数/第三人称单数）

e.en: Diet directly {influences} how well you sleep at night.
e.zh: 饮食直接影响你晚上的睡眠质量。

e.en: The artist cites jazz and street art as her main {influences}.
e.zh: 这位艺术家将爵士乐和街头艺术列为她的主要灵感来源。

influencing.t: v. 正在影响（现在分词）

e.en: Algorithms are quietly {influencing} what news we read each day.
e.zh: 算法正在悄悄影响我们每天阅读的新闻。

e.en: She was accused of {influencing} the jury during the trial.
e.zh: 她在审判期间被指控影响陪审团。

influent.t:
adj. 流入的
n. 支流

e.en: The treatment plant measures the {influent} water for harmful chemicals.
e.zh: 污水处理厂会检测进水中是否含有有害化学物质。

e.en: Engineers monitor the {influent} flow rate every hour.
e.zh: 工程师每小时监测一次进水流量。

e.en: She is one of the most {influential} voices in tech today.
e.zh: 她是当今科技领域最具影响力的声音之一。

e.en: That book was hugely {influential} during my college years.
e.zh: 那本书在我大学期间影响极大。

e.en: Doctors recommend a flu shot to prevent {influenza} this winter.
e.zh: 医生建议接种流感疫苗以预防今年冬天的流感。

e.en: The 1918 {influenza} pandemic killed millions worldwide.
e.zh: 1918年的流感大流行在全球夺去了数百万人的生命。

e.en: Researchers track new {influenzas} that emerge each flu season.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪每个流感季出现的新型流感病毒。

e.en: Different {influenzas} require different vaccine formulations each year.
e.zh: 不同的流感病毒每年需要不同配方的疫苗。

e.en: The city saw a sudden {influx} of remote workers last year.
e.zh: 这座城市去年迎来了远程工作者的突然涌入。

e.en: Stores are preparing for the holiday {influx} of shoppers.
e.zh: 商店正在为节日购物人潮做准备。

e.en: Tap the icon to see more {info} about this product.
e.zh: 点击图标查看这款产品的更多信息。

e.en: I sent you the contact {info} for the new dentist.
e.zh: 我把新牙医的联系方式发给你了。

e.en: The child {ingenuously} admitted he had eaten all the cookies.
e.zh: 孩子天真地承认饼干全是他吃的。

e.en: She spoke {ingenuously} about her hopes and fears.
e.zh: 她坦率天真地谈起了自己的希望和恐惧。

e.en: Her {ingenuousness} was refreshing in a world of cynics.
e.zh: 在愤世嫉俗的世界里，她的天真显得格外清新。

e.en: The reporter was charmed by the actor's {ingenuousness}.
e.zh: 记者被那位演员的坦率天真所打动。

ingest.t: v. 摄入（食物）；导入（数据）

e.en: Do not {ingest} the cleaning solution under any circumstances.
e.zh: 任何情况下都不要吞食这种清洁剂。

e.en: The system can {ingest} millions of log entries per second.
e.zh: 该系统每秒能摄取数百万条日志数据。

e.en: The dog accidentally {ingested} a small piece of plastic.
e.zh: 那只狗不小心吞下了一小块塑料。

e.en: Our pipeline {ingested} the dataset overnight without errors.
e.zh: 我们的管道一夜之间无差错地导入了整个数据集。

e.en: Accidental {ingestion} of the chemical can cause serious harm.
e.zh: 误食这种化学品可能造成严重伤害。

e.en: Data {ingestion} is the first step in our analytics pipeline.
e.zh: 数据摄取是我们分析流程的第一步。

e.en: They cuddled by the cozy {inglenook} during the snowstorm.
e.zh: 暴风雪中他们依偎在温馨的壁炉角落里。

e.en: The old cottage had a stone {inglenook} with a fireplace.
e.zh: 那座老屋里有一个带壁炉的石砌炉边角落。

e.en: We hiked the famous waterfalls trail near {Ingleton} village.
e.zh: 我们徒步走了英格尔顿村附近著名的瀑布步道。

e.en: {Ingleton} is a popular base for exploring the Yorkshire Dales.
e.zh: 英格尔顿是探索约克郡谷地的热门落脚点。

e.en: The team's {inglorious} defeat ended their championship hopes.
e.zh: 球队不光彩的失利终结了他们的冠军梦想。

e.en: His career came to an {inglorious} end after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后他的职业生涯不光彩地结束了。

e.en: The startup collapsed {ingloriously} within its first year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司不光彩地在第一年就倒闭了。

e.en: He was {ingloriously} fired after the budget scandal.
e.zh: 预算丑闻之后他被不光彩地解雇了。

e.en: The vault stored a heavy gold {ingot} worth millions.
e.zh: 金库里存放着一块价值数百万的沉甸甸的金锭。

e.en: Workers carefully poured molten metal into each {ingot} mold.
e.zh: 工人们小心地将熔化的金属倒入每个铸锭模具。

e.en: Good schools try to {ingrain} curiosity in young students.
e.zh: 好学校努力把好奇心深植于年轻学生心中。

e.en: Daily practice helps {ingrain} healthy habits over time.
e.zh: 日复一日的练习有助于把健康习惯深植于生活。

ingrained.t: adj. 根深蒂固的；深入的

e.en: His love for music is deeply {ingrained} in his identity.
e.zh: 对音乐的热爱已深深融入他的人格之中。

e.en: These habits become {ingrained} after years of repetition.
e.zh: 这些习惯经过多年的重复已经根深蒂固。

e.en: Calling her an {ingrate} after all that help was unfair.
e.zh: 在那么多帮助之后还说她忘恩负义实在不公平。

e.en: He felt like an {ingrate} for forgetting his mom's birthday.
e.zh: 忘了妈妈的生日让他觉得自己像个忘恩负义的人。

ingrates.t: n. 忘恩负义之人（复数）

e.en: The boss complained that his employees were spoiled {ingrates}.
e.zh: 老板抱怨自己的员工是一群被宠坏的忘恩负义之徒。

e.en: Don't waste kindness on {ingrates} who never appreciate it.
e.zh: 别把善意浪费在那些从不懂感恩的人身上。

e.en: He tried to {ingratiate} himself with the new manager.
e.zh: 他试图讨好那位新来的经理。

e.en: Some interns {ingratiate} themselves through constant flattery.
e.zh: 有些实习生靠不停地拍马屁来讨好别人。

e.en: She {ingratiated} herself with the team by bringing donuts.
e.zh: 她靠带甜甜圈来讨好团队成员。

e.en: He {ingratiated} himself with executives through clever flattery.
e.zh: 他靠巧妙的奉承讨好了高管们。

ingratiates.t: v. 讨好（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {ingratiates} himself with clients by remembering their birthdays.
e.zh: 他记住客户的生日，以此讨好他们。

e.en: She {ingratiates} herself with teachers through endless compliments.
e.zh: 她靠不停地恭维讨好老师们。

e.en: His {ingratiating} smile made his coworkers slightly uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那讨好的笑容让同事们感到有点不舒服。

e.en: She used an {ingratiating} tone when asking for favors.
e.zh: 她请人帮忙时用着讨好的语气。

e.en: He smiled {ingratiatingly} as he asked for a raise.
e.zh: 他讨好地笑着请求加薪。

e.en: The salesperson spoke {ingratiatingly} to close the deal.
e.zh: 销售员用讨好的口吻说话以促成交易。

e.en: His {ingratitude} after all our help really hurt me.
e.zh: 我们帮了他那么多，他却忘恩负义，让我很伤心。

e.en: Few things sting more than {ingratitude} from a close friend.
e.zh: 很少有什么比挚友的忘恩负义更让人心痛。

e.en: Trust is the most important {ingredient} in any relationship.
e.zh: 信任是任何关系中最重要的要素。

e.en: Sugar is the main {ingredient} in this dessert recipe.
e.zh: 糖是这道甜点食谱的主要原料。

e.en: Read the {ingredients} list before buying packaged snacks.
e.zh: 购买包装零食前请先看一下成分表。

e.en: Mix all the {ingredients} in a large bowl until smooth.
e.zh: 把所有食材放进大碗里搅拌至顺滑。

e.en: The Louvre displays several portraits painted by {Ingres}.
e.zh: 卢浮宫展出了几幅安格尔创作的肖像画。

e.en: Art students often study {Ingres} for his elegant draftsmanship.
e.zh: 艺术学生常研究安格尔，因他的素描功底优雅出众。

e.en: The fence prevents {ingress} by unauthorized vehicles at night.
e.zh: 夜间这道围栏可阻止未经授权的车辆驶入。

e.en: Configure the {ingress} controller to route external traffic.
e.zh: 配置入站控制器以路由外部流量。

e.en: Tight shoes can cause toenails to {ingrow} painfully.
e.zh: 鞋子太紧会让脚趾甲痛苦地向内生长。

e.en: Hairs sometimes {ingrow} after shaving against the grain.
e.zh: 逆着毛发方向刮胡子有时会让毛发倒长进皮肤里。

ingrown.t: adj. 向内生长的（如指甲）

e.en: He had an {ingrown} toenail removed at the clinic.
e.zh: 他去诊所做了嵌甲拔除手术。

e.en: Exfoliating regularly helps prevent {ingrown} hairs after shaving.
e.zh: 定期去角质有助于防止刮毛后出现倒长毛发。

e.en: He underwent surgery to repair an {inguinal} hernia last month.
e.zh: 上个月他做了腹股沟疝修补手术。

e.en: The doctor examined the {inguinal} area for swelling.
e.zh: 医生检查了腹股沟区域是否有肿胀。

e.en: Many rare birds {inhabit} this remote island year-round.
e.zh: 许多稀有鸟类常年栖息在这座偏远的岛屿上。

e.en: Memories still {inhabit} every corner of my childhood home.
e.zh: 童年家中的每个角落仍萦绕着回忆。

e.en: Scientists debate whether Mars could ever become {inhabitable}.
e.zh: 科学家们争论火星是否有朝一日能适合居住。

e.en: With repairs, the old cabin became {inhabitable} again.
e.zh: 经过修缮，那栋旧小屋又能住人了。

e.en: Every {inhabitant} of the village knew her grandmother personally.
e.zh: 村里的每一位居民都认识她的奶奶。

e.en: The bear was the sole {inhabitant} of the abandoned cave.
e.zh: 那只熊是这个废弃洞穴里唯一的居住者。

e.en: The town's {inhabitants} welcomed the tourists with warm smiles.
e.zh: 小镇的居民们用温暖的笑容欢迎游客。

e.en: Local {inhabitants} protested the new highway plan loudly.
e.zh: 当地居民大声抗议这项新的高速公路计划。

e.en: This island has been {inhabited} for over two thousand years.
e.zh: 这座岛屿已有两千多年的居住历史。

e.en: Few people realize the cave was once {inhabited} by humans.
e.zh: 很少有人知道这个洞穴曾经有人居住过。

e.en: Strange creatures {inhabiting} the deep sea fascinate marine biologists.
e.zh: 栖息在深海里的奇异生物让海洋生物学家着迷。

e.en: Families {inhabiting} the village have lived there for generations.
e.zh: 住在这个村子里的家庭已经世代相传。

inhabits.t: v. 居住（第三人称单数）

e.en: A friendly cat {inhabits} the bookstore on the corner.
e.zh: 街角那家书店里住着一只友好的猫。

e.en: Hope still {inhabits} her heart despite the difficult diagnosis.
e.zh: 尽管诊断结果艰难，希望仍住在她的心里。

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {inhalant} to ease his asthma symptoms.
e.zh: 医生开了一种吸入剂来缓解他的哮喘症状。

e.en: Teenagers were warned about the dangers of {inhalant} abuse.
e.zh: 青少年被警告滥用吸入剂的危险性。

e.en: Deep {inhalation} during yoga helps calm the nervous system.
e.zh: 瑜伽中的深吸气有助于平复神经系统。

e.en: Smoke {inhalation} sent several residents to the hospital.
e.zh: 吸入浓烟让几名居民被送进了医院。

e.en: {Inhale} slowly through your nose and hold for five seconds.
e.zh: 慢慢用鼻子吸气，并屏住五秒。

e.en: He was so hungry he could {inhale} a whole pizza.
e.zh: 他饿得能一口气吃掉一整个披萨。

e.en: She accidentally {inhaled} some pepper and started sneezing.
e.zh: 她不小心吸入了一些胡椒粉，开始打喷嚏。

e.en: The kids {inhaled} their dinner before rushing back outside.
e.zh: 孩子们狼吞虎咽地吃完晚饭，就又冲到外面去了。

e.en: She always carries an {inhaler} in case her asthma flares up.
e.zh: 她总是随身带着吸入器以防哮喘发作。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a new {inhaler} for his allergies.
e.zh: 医生为他的过敏开了一种新的吸入器。

inhales.t: v. 吸入（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {inhales} deeply before diving into the pool.
e.zh: 他在跳入泳池前深深吸了一口气。

e.en: She {inhales} the scent of fresh coffee every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早晨都会闻一闻新鲜咖啡的香气。

e.en: Avoid {inhaling} the fumes when you open the bottle.
e.zh: 打开瓶子时要避免吸入这些气体。

e.en: He sat by the window {inhaling} the cool night air.
e.zh: 他坐在窗边吸着凉爽的夜晚空气。

e.en: Certain rights {inhere} in every citizen by birth.
e.zh: 某些权利与生俱来地属于每一位公民。

e.en: Risks naturally {inhere} in any new business venture.
e.zh: 任何新的商业冒险都天然存在风险。

e.en: There's an {inherent} risk in driving without a seatbelt.
e.zh: 不系安全带开车存在固有的风险。

e.en: Curiosity seems to be {inherent} in young children.
e.zh: 好奇心似乎是幼儿与生俱来的特质。

e.en: Some tasks are {inherently} more difficult than others.
e.zh: 有些任务在本质上就比其他任务更困难。

e.en: The system is {inherently} secure against most attacks.
e.zh: 该系统在本质上能抵御大多数攻击。

infoes.t: n. 信息（information 的非正式复数，罕用）

e.en: The form rejected the entry because the {infoes} fields were blank.
e.zh: 表单拒绝提交,因为信息栏是空白的。

e.en: Different forums use {infoes} as a quirky plural for info.
e.zh: 不同的论坛会用 infoes 作为 info 的奇特复数形式。

infomercial.t: n. 电视购物式长广告

e.en: That late-night {infomercial} convinced my dad to buy a juicer.
e.zh: 那个深夜电视购物广告说服我爸买了一台榨汁机。

e.en: The {infomercial} ran for thirty minutes straight on cable.
e.zh: 那则电视购物广告在有线电视上连续播了三十分钟。

inform.t:
v. 通知，告知
v. 影响，启发

e.en: Please {inform} the team if you'll be late tomorrow.
e.zh: 如果你明天会迟到,请通知团队一下。

e.en: User research helps {inform} our product design choices.
e.zh: 用户研究有助于指导我们的产品设计决策。

e.en: The meeting was {informal}, so jeans were totally fine.
e.zh: 这次会议很随意,所以穿牛仔裤完全没问题。

e.en: We had an {informal} chat over coffee about the project.
e.zh: 我们一边喝咖啡一边非正式地聊了聊这个项目。

e.en: The startup's {informality} makes new hires feel welcome quickly.
e.zh: 这家创业公司的随意氛围让新员工很快感到融入。

e.en: There's a refreshing {informality} to how the team communicates.
e.zh: 团队的沟通方式有种令人耳目一新的随意感。

e.en: He told me {informally} that the promotion was already approved.
e.zh: 他私下告诉我升职已经获批了。

e.en: The group meets {informally} every Friday for lunch.
e.zh: 这个小组每周五非正式地聚在一起吃午饭。

informant.t:
n. 线人，告密者
n. 信息提供者

e.en: The police protected the {informant} who exposed the smuggling ring.
e.zh: 警方保护了揭发走私团伙的线人。

e.en: A trusted {informant} tipped off the journalist about the scandal.
e.zh: 一名可靠的线人向记者透露了这桩丑闻。

informants.t: n. 线人们，信息提供者（复数）

e.en: Detectives rely on {informants} to gather street-level intelligence.
e.zh: 侦探依靠线人来收集街头层面的情报。

e.en: The researcher interviewed twenty {informants} for her field study.
e.zh: 这位研究员为她的实地研究访谈了二十位受访者。

e.en: She studies health {informatics} at a top medical school.
e.zh: 她在一所顶尖医学院学习健康信息学。

e.en: Bio {informatics} combines biology with computer science and statistics.
e.zh: 生物信息学结合了生物学、计算机科学与统计学。

e.en: You can find more {information} on the company's help page.
e.zh: 你可以在公司的帮助页面上找到更多信息。

e.en: Please don't share personal {information} with strangers online.
e.zh: 请不要在网上向陌生人分享个人信息。

e.en: The app sends weekly {informational} emails about new features.
e.zh: 该应用每周会发送关于新功能的资讯邮件。

e.en: We had an {informational} call before the actual interview.
e.zh: 我们在正式面试前先进行了一次咨询性通话。

informative.t: adj. 内容丰富的，有帮助的

e.en: That documentary was both entertaining and really {informative}.
e.zh: 那部纪录片既有趣又非常有教育意义。

e.en: Her presentation was the most {informative} one of the day.
e.zh: 她的演讲是当天最有信息量的一场。

informatively.t: adv. 提供信息地，翔实地

e.en: The guide explained each exhibit clearly and {informatively}.
e.zh: 导游对每件展品的讲解都清晰且富有信息量。

e.en: She answered the reporter's questions {informatively} but cautiously.
e.zh: 她回答记者提问时既详尽又谨慎。

informativeness.t: n. 信息量，信息丰富程度

e.en: We rate articles by their {informativeness} and overall accuracy.
e.zh: 我们根据文章的信息量和整体准确性来评分。

e.en: The chart's {informativeness} dropped once we removed the labels.
e.zh: 去掉标签后,这张图表的信息量明显下降。

informed.t:
adj. 知情的，有根据的
v. 告知（inform 过去式）

e.en: Voters need accurate data to make {informed} decisions.
e.zh: 选民需要准确的数据才能做出明智的决定。

e.en: She {informed} her boss that she was resigning next month.
e.zh: 她通知老板自己下个月将辞职。

e.en: A secret {informer} helped the FBI crack the drug case.
e.zh: 一名秘密线人帮助联邦调查局破获了这起毒品案。

e.en: Nobody trusted him after they discovered he was an {informer}.
e.zh: 他被发现是告密者后,没人再信任他。

informing.t: v. 告知；告发（inform 进行时）

e.en: Thanks for {informing} me about the schedule change so early.
e.zh: 谢谢你这么早告诉我日程变动的事。

e.en: User feedback is {informing} the next version of the app.
e.zh: 用户反馈正在为这款应用的下一版提供参考。

informix.t: n. Informix（IBM 数据库产品名）

e.en: Our legacy system still runs on an old IBM {Informix} database.
e.zh: 我们的遗留系统仍运行在一个旧的 IBM Informix 数据库上。

e.en: The team is migrating data from {Informix} to PostgreSQL this year.
e.zh: 团队今年正在把数据从 Informix 迁移到 PostgreSQL。

informs.t: v. 通知，告知（第三人称单数）

e.en: This dashboard {informs} managers about real-time sales performance.
e.zh: 这个仪表盘向经理们实时反映销售业绩。

e.en: Her travel experience {informs} every photo she posts online.
e.zh: 她的旅行经历影响着她在网上发布的每一张照片。

infotainment.t: n. 资讯娱乐（新闻+娱乐的结合）

e.en: Modern cars come with large {infotainment} screens on the dashboard.
e.zh: 现代汽车的中控台上配有大尺寸的信息娱乐屏幕。

e.en: The {infotainment} system supports both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.
e.zh: 这套信息娱乐系统同时支持 Apple CarPlay 和 Android Auto。

infra.t:
adv. 下文，以下（拉丁语）
prefix. 下；内（词根）

e.en: Our cloud {infra} costs doubled after we scaled the service.
e.zh: 扩展服务后,我们的云基础设施成本翻了一倍。

e.en: The {infra} team handles servers, networking, and deployment pipelines.
e.zh: 基础架构团队负责服务器、网络和部署流水线。

e.en: A minor traffic {infraction} added two points to her license.
e.zh: 一次轻微的交通违章给她的驾照增加了两分。

e.en: Any safety {infraction} on the factory floor must be reported immediately.
e.zh: 工厂车间任何违反安全规定的行为都必须立即上报。

infrared.t:
adj. 红外的
n. 红外线

e.en: The remote uses {infrared} signals to control the TV.
e.zh: 这个遥控器使用红外线信号来控制电视。

e.en: Night vision goggles detect heat through {infrared} light.
e.zh: 夜视镜通过红外光来探测热量。

e.en: The country needs major {infrastructural} upgrades to its power grid.
e.zh: 该国的电网需要大规模的基础设施升级。

e.en: {Infrastructural} weaknesses became obvious after the heavy storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,基础设施的薄弱之处暴露无遗。

infrastructure.t: n. 基础设施；底层架构

e.en: The city is investing billions in transportation {infrastructure}.
e.zh: 这座城市正在投入数十亿资金用于交通基础设施。

e.en: Cloud {infrastructure} allows startups to scale without owning servers.
e.zh: 云基础设施让创业公司无需自建服务器就能扩展业务。

e.en: Different countries built their digital {infrastructures} at very different speeds.
e.zh: 不同国家建设数字基础设施的速度差异很大。

e.en: Aging power {infrastructures} struggle to handle today's electricity demand.
e.zh: 老化的电力基础设施难以应对当今的用电需求。

e.en: The dentist explained that the nerve runs through the {infratemporal} fossa.
e.zh: 牙医解释说这条神经穿过颞下窝。

e.en: Surgeons must navigate carefully around the {infratemporal} region.
e.zh: 外科医生必须小心地在颞下区域周围操作。

e.en: The {infrequency} of buses makes commuting from this town difficult.
e.zh: 公交班次稀少使得从这个小镇通勤变得困难。

e.en: Doctors were surprised by the {infrequency} of side effects in trials.
e.zh: 医生们对试验中副作用的罕见感到惊讶。

e.en: Earthquakes are {infrequent} here, but residents stay prepared.
e.zh: 这里地震不常见,但居民们仍保持警惕。

e.en: His visits home became increasingly {infrequent} after he moved abroad.
e.zh: 他出国后,回家的次数变得越来越少。

e.en: I {infrequently} check my personal email during the workday.
e.zh: 工作时间我很少查看个人邮箱。

e.en: This rare bird is {infrequently} spotted outside the rainy season.
e.zh: 这种珍稀鸟类在雨季之外很少被看到。

e.en: The new law could {infringe} on basic privacy rights.
e.zh: 这项新法律可能会侵犯基本的隐私权。

e.en: Copying that logo would {infringe} the company's trademark.
e.zh: 复制那个标志会侵犯该公司的商标权。

e.en: The court found that the startup had {infringed} on the patent.
e.zh: 法庭认定这家初创公司侵犯了该专利。

e.en: Critics argued the policy {infringed} their right to free speech.
e.zh: 批评者认为该政策侵犯了他们的言论自由权。

e.en: The studio sued the website for copyright {infringement}.
e.zh: 制片厂以版权侵权为由起诉了该网站。

e.en: Sharing pirated movies is a clear {infringement} of the law.
e.zh: 分享盗版电影是明显的违法行为。

e.en: The agency tracks online {infringements} of registered trademarks daily.
e.zh: 该机构每天追踪注册商标在网上的侵权行为。

e.en: Repeated {infringements} can lead to account suspension on the platform.
e.zh: 反复的违规行为可能导致在该平台上账号被封禁。

infringes.t: v. 侵犯，违反（第三人称单数）

e.en: That feature {infringes} a patent held by a rival company.
e.zh: 该功能侵犯了一家竞争对手公司持有的专利。

e.en: The new rule arguably {infringes} on workers' personal freedom.
e.zh: 这条新规可以说侵犯了员工的个人自由。

infringing.t:
adj. 侵权的
v. 正在侵犯

e.en: YouTube removes videos {infringing} on copyrighted music.
e.zh: YouTube 会下架侵犯音乐版权的视频。

e.en: The company stopped selling the product to avoid {infringing} the patent.
e.zh: 该公司停止销售这款产品以避免侵犯该专利。

e.en: Slow Wi-Fi can {infuriate} even the most patient person.
e.zh: 再有耐心的人也会被龟速 Wi-Fi 气炸。

e.en: Her dismissive comments tend to {infuriate} the whole team.
e.zh: 她那些不屑一顾的评论常常激怒整个团队。

e.en: She was {infuriated} by the rude customer service reply.
e.zh: 她被那粗鲁的客服回复气坏了。

e.en: Fans felt {infuriated} when the match was canceled last minute.
e.zh: 球迷们对比赛临时取消感到非常愤怒。

infuriating.t: adj. 令人恼火的，抓狂的

e.en: The slow Wi-Fi at this cafe is absolutely {infuriating}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的网速慢得让人抓狂。

e.en: He has an {infuriating} habit of interrupting every conversation.
e.zh: 他有个令人恼火的毛病，总爱打断别人说话。

e.en: The app is {infuriatingly} slow to load on older phones.
e.zh: 这款应用在旧手机上加载得慢得让人火大。

e.en: She remained {infuriatingly} calm during the heated argument.
e.zh: 激烈争吵中她依然冷静得令人恼火。

infuse.t:
v. 注入，灌输
v. 泡（茶）

e.en: Let the tea {infuse} for five minutes before serving.
e.zh: 让茶浸泡五分钟再端上来。

e.en: The new manager hopes to {infuse} fresh energy into the team.
e.zh: 新经理希望为团队注入新的活力。

infusion.t:
n. 注入，灌输
n. 输液；浸泡液

e.en: The startup received a major cash {infusion} from investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司获得了投资者的一大笔资金注入。

e.en: She sipped a warm herbal {infusion} before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前喝了一杯温热的草本茶。

ing.t: suffix. 动词进行时/名词化后缀

e.en: Add the suffix {ing} to form the present participle.
e.zh: 加上后缀 ing 构成现在分词。

e.en: Verbs ending in {ing} often describe ongoing actions.
e.zh: 以 ing 结尾的动词通常表示正在进行的动作。

e.en: She came up with an {ingenious} solution to the bug.
e.zh: 她想出了一个解决这个漏洞的巧妙办法。

e.en: The folding chair has an {ingenious} locking mechanism.
e.zh: 这把折叠椅有一个非常巧妙的锁定装置。

e.en: The designer {ingeniously} hid storage inside the staircase.
e.zh: 设计师巧妙地在楼梯里藏了储物空间。

e.en: He {ingeniously} repurposed old bottles into stylish lamps.
e.zh: 他巧妙地把旧瓶子改造成时尚的台灯。

e.en: The film cast a young {ingenue} as the lead.
e.zh: 这部电影选了一位年轻的清纯女演员担任主角。

e.en: She played the wide-eyed {ingenue} in the romantic comedy.
e.zh: 她在浪漫喜剧中饰演天真烂漫的少女角色。

e.en: Human {ingenuities} have transformed how we communicate online.
e.zh: 人类的种种巧思改变了我们的网络沟通方式。

e.en: Engineering {ingenuities} solved problems once thought impossible.
e.zh: 工程上的种种巧思解决了曾被认为无解的难题。

e.en: Solving this puzzle requires real {ingenuity} and patience.
e.zh: 解开这道谜题需要真正的巧思和耐心。

e.en: Her {ingenuity} turned a small kitchen into a café.
e.zh: 她的巧思把一间小厨房变成了咖啡馆。

ingenuous.t: adj. 天真坦率的，单纯的

e.en: His {ingenuous} smile made everyone trust him immediately.
e.zh: 他坦率的笑容让大家立刻信任他。

e.en: She gave an {ingenuous} reply that surprised the interviewer.
e.zh: 她给出了一个天真坦率的回答，让面试官很意外。

e.en: She will {inherit} the family business next year.
e.zh: 她明年将继承家族企业。

e.en: Child classes {inherit} methods from their parent class.
e.zh: 子类会从父类继承方法。

e.en: Certain diseases are {inheritable} through specific genes.
e.zh: 某些疾病可以通过特定基因遗传。

e.en: The property is fully {inheritable} by his children.
e.zh: 这份财产可完全由他的子女继承。

e.en: He used his {inheritance} to start a tech company.
e.zh: 他用继承的遗产创办了一家科技公司。

e.en: JavaScript supports prototypal {inheritance} between objects.
e.zh: JavaScript 支持对象之间的原型继承。

e.en: Large {inheritances} are often subject to heavy taxes.
e.zh: 大笔遗产通常需要缴纳高额税款。

e.en: Multiple {inheritances} in C++ can complicate class design.
e.zh: C++ 中的多重继承会使类设计变得复杂。

inherited.t:
adj. 继承来的
v. inherit 的过去式

e.en: She {inherited} her grandmother's blue eyes and quick smile.
e.zh: 她遗传了祖母蓝色的眼睛和爽朗的笑容。

e.en: He {inherited} a messy codebase from the previous team.
e.zh: 他从上一个团队接手了一份混乱的代码库。

e.en: She is {inheriting} a small farm from her uncle.
e.zh: 她正在继承叔叔的一座小农场。

e.en: The new manager is {inheriting} a struggling sales team.
e.zh: 这位新经理接手的是一个业绩不佳的销售团队。

e.en: He is the sole {inheritor} of his father's estate.
e.zh: 他是父亲遗产的唯一继承人。

e.en: This startup sees itself as the {inheritor} of open-source ideals.
e.zh: 这家初创公司视自己为开源理念的传承者。

inherits.t: v. inherit 的第三人称单数

e.en: The dog class {inherits} all behaviors from the animal class.
e.zh: Dog 类从 Animal 类继承所有行为。

e.en: She {inherits} her father's love of old movies.
e.zh: 她继承了父亲对老电影的喜爱。

e.en: Loud noise can {inhibit} a child's ability to focus.
e.zh: 嘈杂的声音会抑制孩子的专注力。

e.en: This drug is designed to {inhibit} tumor growth.
e.zh: 这种药物旨在抑制肿瘤生长。

inhibited.t:
adj. 拘谨的
v. inhibit 的过去式

e.en: He felt too {inhibited} to speak up in the meeting.
e.zh: 他在会议上感到拘束不敢发言。

e.en: The cold weather {inhibited} the plants from blooming.
e.zh: 寒冷的天气抑制了植物开花。

e.en: Strict rules are {inhibiting} creativity in the classroom.
e.zh: 严苛的规则正在抑制课堂上的创造力。

e.en: The medication works by {inhibiting} a specific enzyme.
e.zh: 这种药物通过抑制某种特定的酶起作用。

e.en: After a few drinks, his {inhibition} began to fade.
e.zh: 喝了几杯后,他的拘谨开始消退。

e.en: The drug causes {inhibition} of the targeted enzyme.
e.zh: 该药物会抑制目标酶的活性。

e.en: This medication is a powerful {inhibitor} of stomach acid.
e.zh: 这种药物是强效的胃酸抑制剂。

e.en: He uses a rust {inhibitor} to protect the metal parts.
e.zh: 他使用防锈剂来保护金属零件。

e.en: The neuron sends {inhibitory} signals to nearby cells.
e.zh: 该神经元向附近的细胞发送抑制性信号。

e.en: The drug has an {inhibitory} effect on bacterial growth.
e.zh: 这种药物对细菌生长有抑制作用。

inhibits.t: v. inhibit 的第三人称单数

e.en: Caffeine often {inhibits} sleep if consumed late at night.
e.zh: 深夜摄入咖啡因常常会妨碍睡眠。

e.en: This protein {inhibits} the spread of the virus.
e.zh: 这种蛋白质能抑制病毒的传播。

e.en: The {inhomogeneity} of the rock surface affects the measurements.
e.zh: 岩石表面的不均匀性会影响测量结果。

e.en: Magnetic field {inhomogeneity} can blur the MRI image.
e.zh: 磁场的不均匀性会使核磁共振图像变模糊。

e.en: The mixture became {inhomogeneous} after sitting overnight.
e.zh: 这种混合物放置一夜后变得不均匀。

e.en: They studied wave behavior in an {inhomogeneous} medium.
e.zh: 他们研究了波在不均匀介质中的传播行为。

inhospitable.t: adj. 不好客的；（环境）险恶的

e.en: The desert is an {inhospitable} place for most animals.
e.zh: 沙漠对大多数动物来说是个不宜生存的地方。

e.en: She found the new office culture cold and {inhospitable}.
e.zh: 她觉得新办公室的氛围冷漠又不友好。

e.en: The prisoners were kept in {inhuman} conditions for years.
e.zh: 囚犯们多年来被关押在惨无人道的环境中。

e.en: He works {inhuman} hours to meet his deadlines.
e.zh: 他为了赶截止日期工作时间长得不像人样。

e.en: Activists protested the {inhumane} treatment of farm animals.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议农场动物遭受的不人道待遇。

e.en: Locking workers in the building is clearly {inhumane}.
e.zh: 把工人锁在大楼里显然是不人道的。

e.en: The novel exposes the {inhumanity} of war.
e.zh: 这部小说揭露了战争的残酷与无人性。

e.en: She was shocked by the {inhumanity} shown in the video.
e.zh: 视频中显露的非人性令她震惊。

e.en: High taxes can be {inimical} to small business growth.
e.zh: 高税收可能不利于小企业的发展。

e.en: Their policies are openly {inimical} to free speech.
e.zh: 他们的政策公然敌视言论自由。

inimitable.t: adj. 无法模仿的；独特的

e.en: The chef has an {inimitable} style that no one can copy.
e.zh: 这位主厨有一种无人能仿的独特风格。

e.en: She told the story with her {inimitable} humor.
e.zh: 她以无人能及的幽默讲述了那个故事。

e.en: The judge condemned the {iniquitous} practices of the company.
e.zh: 法官谴责了这家公司不道德的做法。

e.en: They fought against an {iniquitous} system of forced labor.
e.zh: 他们与一个邪恶的强迫劳动制度作斗争。

e.en: The report exposed the {iniquity} hidden inside the regime.
e.zh: 报告揭露了该政权内部隐藏的罪恶。

e.en: He spoke passionately against the {iniquity} of slavery.
e.zh: 他慷慨激昂地谴责奴隶制的邪恶。

initial.t:
adj. 最初的；初始的
n. 首字母

e.en: My {initial} reaction to the news was complete shock.
e.zh: 我对这则消息的最初反应是完全震惊。

e.en: Please sign your {initial} next to each correction.
e.zh: 请在每处修改旁签上你的姓名首字母。

e.en: The app crashes during {initialization} of the database.
e.zh: 应用程序在初始化数据库时崩溃。

e.en: Proper variable {initialization} prevents many runtime bugs.
e.zh: 正确的变量初始化可避免许多运行时错误。

e.en: You need to {initialize} the array before using it.
e.zh: 使用数组前你需要先初始化它。

e.en: Click the button to {initialize} the new project.
e.zh: 点击按钮以初始化新项目。

e.en: {Initially}, I thought the task would only take an hour.
e.zh: 起初我以为这项任务只需要一个小时。

e.en: The plan was {initially} rejected but later approved.
e.zh: 该计划最初被否决,但后来获得了批准。

e.en: He carved his {initials} into the old oak tree.
e.zh: 他把自己姓名的首字母刻在那棵老橡树上。

e.en: Please write your {initials} at the bottom of each page.
e.zh: 请在每页底部写上你姓名的首字母。

e.en: The manager will {initiate} the new safety procedures tomorrow.
e.zh: 经理明天将启动新的安全规程。

e.en: Click here to {initiate} a refund for your order.
e.zh: 点击此处发起对你订单的退款申请。

e.en: The company {initiated} a major restructuring last month.
e.zh: 公司上个月启动了一次重大重组。

e.en: She {initiated} the conversation by asking about his weekend.
e.zh: 她通过询问他周末过得如何开启了谈话。

initiates.t: v. initiate 的第三人称单数

e.en: The system automatically {initiates} a backup every night.
e.zh: 系统每晚会自动启动一次备份。

e.en: She always {initiates} the discussion at team meetings.
e.zh: 她总是在团队会议上率先发起讨论。

e.en: They are {initiating} a new pilot program in three cities.
e.zh: 他们正在三个城市启动一项新的试点计划。

e.en: Thanks for {initiating} this conversation about workplace safety.
e.zh: 感谢你发起这场关于职场安全的讨论。

e.en: The {initiation} of the project is scheduled for Monday.
e.zh: 该项目计划于周一启动。

e.en: New members must complete an {initiation} ceremony.
e.zh: 新成员必须完成一次入会仪式。

e.en: She showed great {initiative} by solving the problem alone.
e.zh: 她独自解决了这个问题,展现了很强的主动性。

e.en: The city launched a green {initiative} to reduce emissions.
e.zh: 该市启动了一项减少排放的绿色倡议。

e.en: Several diversity {initiatives} have improved the workplace culture.
e.zh: 几项多元化倡议改善了职场文化。

e.en: The government funds {initiatives} that support small farmers.
e.zh: 政府资助支持小农户的各项计划。

e.en: She was the {initiator} of the company's recycling program.
e.zh: 她是公司回收计划的发起人。

e.en: The {initiator} of the chat is responsible for moderation.
e.zh: 聊天的发起人负责主持秩序。

e.en: The students went through an {initiatory} ritual at the academy.
e.zh: 学生们在学院里经历了一场入门仪式。

e.en: He gave a brief {initiatory} speech before the workshop began.
e.zh: 他在研讨会开始前做了简短的开场致辞。

e.en: The nurse will {inject} the vaccine into your upper arm.
e.zh: 护士会将疫苗注射到你的上臂。

e.en: He tried to {inject} some humor into the tense meeting.
e.zh: 他试图给紧张的会议注入一些幽默气氛。

e.en: This medicine comes in both pill and {injectable} forms.
e.zh: 这种药物有口服片剂和注射剂两种形式。

e.en: The clinic offers a popular {injectable} treatment for wrinkles.
e.zh: 该诊所提供一种很受欢迎的注射式去皱治疗。

e.en: The doctor {injected} the painkiller directly into the joint.
e.zh: 医生将止痛药直接注射进了关节。

e.en: The new CEO {injected} fresh energy into the team.
e.zh: 新任 CEO 给团队注入了新的活力。

e.en: The lab is {injecting} mice with the experimental compound.
e.zh: 实验室正在给小鼠注射这种实验性化合物。

e.en: He kept {injecting} jokes into an otherwise serious presentation.
e.zh: 他不停地往一个原本严肃的演讲中插入笑话。

e.en: The flu {injection} only takes a few seconds to administer.
e.zh: 流感疫苗注射只需几秒钟就能完成。

e.en: The startup received a fresh {injection} of venture capital.
e.zh: 这家初创公司获得了一笔新的风险投资注资。

e.en: The doctor gave him two {injections} of insulin daily.
e.zh: 医生每天给他注射两针胰岛素。

e.en: The startup needs cash {injections} to survive the year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司需要注资才能撑过这一年。

e.en: The fuel {injector} in my car needs cleaning.
e.zh: 我车上的燃油喷射器需要清洗了。

e.en: She used an auto {injector} to deliver the medicine.
e.zh: 她用自动注射器给药。

injects.t: v. inject 的第三人称单数

e.en: The nurse {injects} the vaccine into his upper arm.
e.zh: 护士把疫苗注射到他的上臂。

e.en: His humor {injects} energy into every team meeting.
e.zh: 他的幽默给每次团队会议注入了活力。

e.en: His {injudicious} tweet cost the company millions.
e.zh: 他那条欠考虑的推文让公司损失了数百万。

e.en: It was {injudicious} to lend money to a stranger.
e.zh: 借钱给陌生人是不明智的做法。

e.en: The court issued an {injunction} to stop construction.
e.zh: 法院发出禁令,要求停止施工。

e.en: Lawyers filed for an {injunction} against the new law.
e.zh: 律师申请禁令,反对这项新法律。

e.en: Be careful not to {injure} your back lifting that box.
e.zh: 搬那个箱子时小心别伤到背。

e.en: Harsh words can {injure} someone more than you think.
e.zh: 刺耳的话对人的伤害可能超出你的想象。

injured.t:
adj. 受伤的
v. injure 的过去式

e.en: Three people were {injured} in the highway accident.
e.zh: 高速公路那场事故中有三人受伤。

e.en: She gave him an {injured} look and walked away.
e.zh: 她委屈地看了他一眼便走开了。

injures.t: v. 使受伤；伤害（injure 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Running on hard pavement often {injures} the knees.
e.zh: 在硬地面上跑步常常会伤到膝盖。

e.en: Constant criticism {injures} a child's confidence.
e.zh: 不断的批评会伤害孩子的自信心。

injuries.t: n. 伤害；伤势（injury 的复数）

e.en: The player suffered serious {injuries} in last night's game.
e.zh: 那名球员在昨晚的比赛中受了重伤。

e.en: Most workplace {injuries} can be prevented with training.
e.zh: 大多数工伤都可以通过培训来预防。

injuring.t: v. 伤害；使受伤（injure 的现在分词）

e.en: He fell off the ladder, {injuring} his shoulder badly.
e.zh: 他从梯子上摔下来,肩膀受了重伤。

e.en: The earthquake collapsed walls, {injuring} dozens of residents.
e.zh: 地震震塌了墙壁,几十名居民受伤。

injurious.t: adj. 有害的；造成伤害的

e.en: Smoking is {injurious} to your lungs and heart.
e.zh: 吸烟对你的肺和心脏都有害。

e.en: The article contained {injurious} claims about the mayor.
e.zh: 这篇文章对市长做出了诋毁性的指控。

e.en: He missed the season due to a knee {injury}.
e.zh: 他因膝盖受伤错过了整个赛季。

e.en: The fall caused only a minor {injury} to her wrist.
e.zh: 那一摔只让她的手腕受了点轻伤。

injustice.t: n. 不公正；不公平的事

e.en: The protesters marched against racial {injustice} downtown.
e.zh: 抗议者在市中心游行,反对种族不公。

e.en: It would be an {injustice} to blame her for this.
e.zh: 把这件事怪在她头上是不公平的。

ink.t:
n. 墨水；油墨
v. 签署；上墨

e.en: The printer is out of black {ink} again.
e.zh: 打印机的黑色墨水又用完了。

e.en: She signed the contract in blue {ink}.
e.zh: 她用蓝色墨水签了合同。

inkblot.t: n. 墨迹（常指心理测试用的图案）

e.en: The therapist showed him an {inkblot} and asked what he saw.
e.zh: 治疗师给他看一张墨迹图,问他看到了什么。

e.en: There's a strange {inkblot} on the first page of the book.
e.zh: 书的第一页上有一个奇怪的墨渍。

inked.t: v. 上墨；签署（ink 的过去式）

e.en: The two companies finally {inked} the merger deal yesterday.
e.zh: 两家公司昨天终于正式签署了合并协议。

e.en: He {inked} a new sleeve tattoo last weekend.
e.zh: 他上周末新纹了一整条手臂的纹身。

inkling.t: n. 略知；暗示；模糊的念头

e.en: I had no {inkling} that she was planning to quit.
e.zh: 我一点都没察觉到她打算辞职。

e.en: The email gave us our first {inkling} of trouble.
e.zh: 那封邮件让我们第一次隐约感到不妙。

e.en: An old glass {inkpot} sat on the writer's desk.
e.zh: 作家的桌上摆着一个旧玻璃墨水瓶。

e.en: She dipped her quill carefully into the {inkpot}.
e.zh: 她小心地把羽毛笔蘸进墨水瓶里。

inks.t:
n. 各种墨水
v. 上墨（ink 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This shop sells fountain pens and rare {inks}.
e.zh: 这家店出售钢笔和稀有墨水。

e.en: The artist mixes her own {inks} for each painting.
e.zh: 这位艺术家为每幅画亲手调配墨水。

inkwell.t: n. 墨水池（桌面嵌入式）

e.en: The antique desk had a brass {inkwell} built in.
e.zh: 那张古董书桌上嵌着一个黄铜墨水池。

e.en: He dipped his pen into the {inkwell} and began writing.
e.zh: 他把笔蘸进墨水池,开始写字。

e.en: The squid disappeared into an {inky} cloud of darkness.
e.zh: 那只乌贼消失在一团墨黑的暗云里。

e.en: She stared up at the {inky} night sky.
e.zh: 她抬头望着漆黑的夜空。

inlaid.t:
adj. 镶嵌的
v. inlay 的过去式

e.en: The wooden box was {inlaid} with mother-of-pearl.
e.zh: 那只木盒镶嵌着珍珠母贝。

e.en: He admired the table {inlaid} with intricate ivory patterns.
e.zh: 他欣赏着那张镶有精美象牙花纹的桌子。

inland.t:
adj. 内陆的
adv. 向内陆

e.en: We drove {inland} for two hours away from the coast.
e.zh: 我们离开海岸,向内陆开了两个小时。

e.en: Most of the country's farms are located {inland}.
e.zh: 这个国家大多数农场都在内陆地区。

inlay.t:
v. 镶嵌
n. 镶嵌物

e.en: The guitar has a beautiful pearl {inlay} on the neck.
e.zh: 这把吉他的琴颈上有漂亮的珍珠镶嵌。

e.en: My dentist replaced the old filling with a gold {inlay}.
e.zh: 牙医把旧补牙换成了金嵌体。

e.en: Small fishing boats sheltered in the quiet {inlet}.
e.zh: 几艘小渔船停在那个安静的小海湾里。

e.en: Check that the air {inlet} on the dryer isn't blocked.
e.zh: 检查一下烘干机的进气口有没有堵住。

inmate.t: n. 囚犯；（收容所）被收容者

e.en: The {inmate} was released after serving five years.
e.zh: 那名囚犯服刑五年后获释。

e.en: Each {inmate} gets one phone call per week.
e.zh: 每名囚犯每周可以打一次电话。

inmates.t: n. 囚犯；被收容者（inmate 的复数）

e.en: The prison houses about 800 {inmates}.
e.zh: 这座监狱关押着大约八百名囚犯。

e.en: Several {inmates} signed up for the literacy program.
e.zh: 几名囚犯报名参加了识字课程。

e.en: In the 1980s, {inmos} designed the famous Transputer chip.
e.zh: 上世纪八十年代,Inmos公司设计了著名的Transputer芯片。

e.en: My uncle worked as an engineer at {inmos} in Bristol.
e.zh: 我叔叔曾在布里斯托的Inmos公司当工程师。

inmost.t: adj. 最深处的；内心深处的

e.en: She finally shared her {inmost} fears with a friend.
e.zh: 她终于向朋友倾诉了内心最深处的恐惧。

e.en: The diary revealed his {inmost} thoughts about the war.
e.zh: 日记揭示了他对那场战争最深处的想法。

e.en: We stayed at a charming country {inn} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们住在一家很有特色的乡村小客栈。

e.en: The old {inn} has welcomed travelers for two centuries.
e.zh: 这家老客栈接待旅客已经有两百年了。

e.en: He opened the laptop to inspect its {innards}.
e.zh: 他打开笔记本电脑,查看里面的内部构造。

e.en: The chef carefully removed the fish's {innards}.
e.zh: 厨师小心地清除了鱼的内脏。

innate.t: adj. 天生的；与生俱来的

e.en: Some babies seem to have an {innate} sense of rhythm.
e.zh: 有些婴儿似乎天生就有节奏感。

e.en: Curiosity is {innate} in almost every child.
e.zh: 几乎每个孩子身上都有与生俱来的好奇心。

e.en: Humans are {innately} social creatures who crave connection.
e.zh: 人类天生就是渴望联系的社会性生物。

e.en: She is {innately} talented at picking up languages.
e.zh: 她在学语言方面有着与生俱来的天赋。

e.en: Try to listen to your {inner} voice when deciding.
e.zh: 做决定时试着倾听你内心的声音。

e.en: The {inner} pocket of the jacket holds my passport.
e.zh: 夹克内侧的口袋里放着我的护照。

innermost.t: adj. 最内层的；内心深处的

e.en: She rarely shares her {innermost} feelings with anyone.
e.zh: 她很少向任何人吐露内心最深处的感受。

e.en: The temple's {innermost} chamber is closed to visitors.
e.zh: 寺庙最内层的殿堂不对游客开放。

e.en: These nerves {innervate} the muscles of the lower leg.
e.zh: 这些神经支配着小腿的肌肉。

e.en: Several cranial nerves {innervate} the muscles of the face.
e.zh: 几条脑神经支配着面部的肌肉。

innervation.t: n. 神经支配；神经分布

e.en: The hand has a complex {innervation} pattern from three nerves.
e.zh: 手部受三条神经支配,神经分布相当复杂。

e.en: Damage to the spine disrupted {innervation} of his legs.
e.zh: 脊柱损伤干扰了他双腿的神经支配。

e.en: The Yankees scored four runs in the seventh {inning}.
e.zh: 洋基队在第七局拿下了四分。

e.en: He hit a home run in his first {inning} batting.
e.zh: 他在第一局击球时就打出了本垒打。

innings.t: n. （板球、棒球）一局；轮到的机会

e.en: The pitcher threw eight scoreless {innings} last night.
e.zh: 那位投手昨晚投了八局都没让对手得分。

e.en: England declared after their second {innings} ended.
e.zh: 英格兰队在第二局结束后宣布提前结束击球。

innkeeper.t: n. 客栈老板；旅馆店主

e.en: The friendly {innkeeper} showed us to our room.
e.zh: 友善的店主把我们领到了房间。

e.en: The {innkeeper} cooks breakfast for guests every morning.
e.zh: 客栈老板每天早晨都给客人做早餐。

e.en: The lawyer worked hard to prove her client's {innocence}.
e.zh: 律师努力证明她当事人的清白。

e.en: There's a sweet {innocence} in the way children laugh.
e.zh: 孩子们的笑声里有一种甜美的天真。

innocent.t: adj. 无辜的；天真的；无害的

e.en: The jury found the defendant {innocent} of all charges.
e.zh: 陪审团裁定被告所有指控均不成立。

e.en: It started as an {innocent} question about her job.
e.zh: 事情起初只是一个关于她工作的无心问题。

e.en: The toddler smiled {innocently} after spilling the juice.
e.zh: 小家伙打翻果汁后天真无邪地笑着。

e.en: She asked {innocently} why everyone had stopped talking.
e.zh: 她天真地问为什么大家都不说话了。

innocuous.t: adj. 无害的；无关痛痒的

e.en: What seemed like an {innocuous} comment really upset him.
e.zh: 那句看似无害的话其实让他很难过。

e.en: Most house spiders are completely {innocuous} to people.
e.zh: 大多数家居蜘蛛对人完全无害。

e.en: The email began {innocuously} with a question about the weather.
e.zh: 那封邮件以一个关于天气的无害问题平淡开头。

e.en: The bug sat {innocuously} on the leaf for hours.
e.zh: 那只虫子无害地在叶子上待了好几个小时。

e.en: Companies must {innovate} constantly to stay competitive.
e.zh: 公司必须不断创新才能保持竞争力。

e.en: Small teams often {innovate} faster than large corporations.
e.zh: 小团队往往比大公司创新得更快。

innovated.t: v. 创新（innovate 的过去式）

e.en: Apple {innovated} the smartphone industry with the first iPhone.
e.zh: 苹果凭借第一代iPhone革新了智能手机行业。

e.en: She {innovated} a new way to teach math to kids.
e.zh: 她创新了一种给孩子教数学的新方法。

innovates.t: v. 创新（innovate 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This studio constantly {innovates} in mobile game design.
e.zh: 这家工作室在手游设计方面一直不断创新。

e.en: The chef {innovates} by combining French and Thai flavors.
e.zh: 这位厨师把法式和泰式风味融合,做出新意。

innovating.t: v. 正在创新（innovate 的现在分词）

e.en: The team is {innovating} faster than any competitor.
e.zh: 这个团队的创新速度比任何竞争对手都快。

e.en: She enjoys {innovating} new recipes in her tiny kitchen.
e.zh: 她喜欢在自己的小厨房里琢磨新菜谱。

e.en: The smartphone was a huge {innovation} of the 2000s.
e.zh: 智能手机是二十一世纪初的一项重大创新。

e.en: Our company rewards employees who drive real {innovation}.
e.zh: 我们公司奖励真正推动创新的员工。

innovations.t: n. 各种创新（innovation 的复数）

e.en: Recent {innovations} in battery design have extended phone life.
e.zh: 电池设计的最新创新延长了手机的续航时间。

e.en: The conference showcased {innovations} from dozens of startups.
e.zh: 大会展示了数十家初创公司的创新成果。

innovative.t: adj. 创新的；富有革新精神的

e.en: Her {innovative} approach to teaching engages every student.
e.zh: 她创新的教学方法吸引了每一位学生。

e.en: The startup launched an {innovative} payment app last month.
e.zh: 那家初创公司上个月推出了一款创新的支付应用。

e.en: The team {innovatively} solved the supply chain problem.
e.zh: 团队以创新的方式解决了供应链问题。

e.en: She designs furniture {innovatively} using recycled plastic.
e.zh: 她用回收塑料创新地设计家具。

e.en: The company is famous for the {innovativeness} of its products.
e.zh: 该公司以其产品的创新性而闻名。

e.en: Judges scored each entry on creativity and {innovativeness}.
e.zh: 评委根据创意和创新性为每个作品打分。

insignificantly.t: adv. 无关紧要地；微不足道地

e.en: Sales rose only {insignificantly} this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度的销售额仅有微不足道的增长。

e.en: The new model differs {insignificantly} from the old one.
e.zh: 新款与旧款之间几乎没有明显差别。

e.en: Her apology felt rushed and {insincere}.
e.zh: 她的道歉显得仓促又不真诚。

e.en: Customers can spot an {insincere} compliment instantly.
e.zh: 顾客一眼就能看出敷衍的恭维。

e.en: He smiled {insincerely} at the camera.
e.zh: 他对着镜头假惺惺地笑了笑。

e.en: She thanked the host {insincerely} before leaving early.
e.zh: 她虚情假意地谢过主人后就早早离开了。

e.en: Voters are tired of political {insincerity}.
e.zh: 选民们已经厌倦了政客的虚伪。

e.en: There was a hint of {insincerity} in his promise.
e.zh: 他的承诺中透着一丝虚情假意。

insinuate.t: v. 含沙射影地暗示；旁敲侧击

e.en: Are you trying to {insinuate} that I'm lying?
e.zh: 你是想暗示我在说谎吗?

e.en: The article seemed to {insinuate} corporate misconduct.
e.zh: 这篇文章似乎在含沙射影地指控企业不当行为。

insinuating.t: adj. 含沙射影的；讨好的

e.en: Stop making those {insinuating} remarks about my friend.
e.zh: 别再对我朋友讲那些含沙射影的话了。

e.en: His {insinuating} tone made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他暗示性的语气让大家都感到不自在。

e.en: I resent the {insinuation} that I cheated on the test.
e.zh: 我对这种暗示我考试作弊的说法感到很反感。

e.en: Her email was full of subtle {insinuation}.
e.zh: 她的邮件里充满了微妙的暗讽。

insipid.t:
adj. 乏味的；无趣的
adj. (食物) 淡而无味的

e.en: The hotel served an {insipid} bowl of soup.
e.zh: 酒店端上来一碗淡而无味的汤。

e.en: Critics called the new sitcom utterly {insipid}.
e.zh: 评论家说这部新情景喜剧极其乏味。

e.en: I {insist} on paying for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 我坚持要请今晚的晚餐。

e.en: Doctors {insist} that everyone get enough sleep.
e.zh: 医生强调每个人都要保证充足的睡眠。

insisted.t: v. 坚持（insist 的过去式）

e.en: My mom {insisted} I take an umbrella.
e.zh: 我妈坚持要我带把伞。

e.en: He {insisted} the package was delivered yesterday.
e.zh: 他坚称包裹昨天就送到了。

e.en: At her {insistence}, we changed the meeting time.
e.zh: 在她的坚持下,我们改了会议时间。

e.en: His {insistence} on perfection slows the whole team down.
e.zh: 他对完美的执着拖慢了整个团队的进度。

e.en: My cat is {insistent} about being fed at six.
e.zh: 我家猫坚持要在六点准时吃饭。

e.en: She was {insistent} that we double-check the data.
e.zh: 她坚决要求我们再核对一次数据。

e.en: The phone kept ringing {insistently} all morning.
e.zh: 电话整个上午都不停地响个不停。

e.en: He knocked {insistently} until someone opened the door.
e.zh: 他不停地敲门,直到有人来开。

insisting.t: v. 坚持（insist 的现在分词）

e.en: She kept {insisting} that the receipt was real.
e.zh: 她一直坚称那张收据是真的。

e.en: Stop {insisting} on doing everything yourself.
e.zh: 别再坚持什么事都自己一个人做了。

insists.t: v. 坚持（insist 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Grandma {insists} on cooking dinner every Sunday.
e.zh: 奶奶坚持每个星期天都要亲自做晚饭。

e.en: The CEO {insists} the layoffs were unavoidable.
e.zh: CEO坚称这次裁员是不得已的选择。

e.en: The rule applies {insofar} as it concerns employees.
e.zh: 该规则仅在涉及员工的范围内适用。

e.en: I'll help {insofar} as my schedule allows.
e.zh: 在我时间允许的范围内,我会帮忙的。

e.en: Farmers {insolate} the seeds to boost germination rates.
e.zh: 农民把种子放在阳光下晒以提高发芽率。

e.en: Solar panels {insolate} efficiently on the rooftop.
e.zh: 屋顶上的太阳能板能高效地接受日照。

e.en: Desert regions receive intense {insolation} year-round.
e.zh: 沙漠地区全年都受到强烈的日照辐射。

e.en: Engineers measure {insolation} to design solar farms.
e.zh: 工程师测量日照量来设计太阳能电站。

e.en: I bought a gel {insole} to ease my heel pain.
e.zh: 我买了一双凝胶鞋垫来缓解脚跟疼痛。

e.en: Replace your running shoe {insole} every six months.
e.zh: 跑鞋的鞋垫每六个月就该更换一次。

e.en: The teacher punished the student for his {insolence}.
e.zh: 老师因为那名学生的傲慢无礼而惩罚了他。

e.en: His {insolence} toward customers got him fired.
e.zh: 他对顾客的无礼态度让他被解雇了。

insolent.t: adj. 傲慢无礼的；粗鲁的

e.en: Don't be {insolent} when speaking to your boss.
e.zh: 跟老板说话的时候别那么傲慢无礼。

e.en: The {insolent} reply shocked everyone in the room.
e.zh: 那句无礼的回答让在场所有人都震惊了。

e.en: He stared {insolently} at the security guard.
e.zh: 他傲慢无礼地盯着保安看。

e.en: She rolled her eyes {insolently} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时她无礼地翻了个白眼。

insoluble.t:
adj. 无法解决的
adj. 不可溶解的

e.en: Sand is {insoluble} in water.
e.zh: 沙子在水中是不溶的。

e.en: The traffic problem seemed {insoluble} for years.
e.zh: 多年来,交通问题似乎都无法解决。

e.en: The startup filed for {insolvency} last week.
e.zh: 那家创业公司上周申请破产了。

e.en: Rising debt pushed the firm toward {insolvency}.
e.zh: 不断攀升的债务把公司推向了破产边缘。

insolvent.t: adj. 资不抵债的；破产的

e.en: The retailer has been {insolvent} for months.
e.zh: 这家零售商已经资不抵债好几个月了。

e.en: Banks rarely lend to {insolvent} companies.
e.zh: 银行很少会借钱给资不抵债的公司。

e.en: Caffeine after dinner gives me terrible {insomnia}.
e.zh: 晚饭后喝咖啡会让我严重失眠。

e.en: Stress is a common cause of {insomnia}.
e.zh: 压力是导致失眠的常见原因。

insomniac.t:
n. 失眠者
adj. 失眠的

e.en: As an {insomniac}, I watch too many late-night shows.
e.zh: 作为一个失眠的人,我看了太多深夜节目。

e.en: The app is designed for chronic {insomniac} users.
e.zh: 这款应用是为长期失眠的用户设计的。

insouciance.t: n. 漫不经心；无忧无虑

e.en: He greeted the bad news with surprising {insouciance}.
e.zh: 他对那个坏消息表现出令人意外的漠不关心。

e.en: Her {insouciance} about deadlines drives the team crazy.
e.zh: 她对截止日期的满不在乎让团队都快疯了。

insouciant.t: adj. 满不在乎的；无忧无虑的

e.en: He gave an {insouciant} shrug and walked away.
e.zh: 他满不在乎地耸耸肩就走开了。

e.en: Her {insouciant} attitude masks deep anxiety.
e.zh: 她那副无所谓的态度掩盖着深深的焦虑。

e.en: The form abbreviates 'inspector' as {insp}.
e.zh: 表格里把"inspector"缩写成{insp}。

e.en: Write '{insp}' before the officer's badge number.
e.zh: 在警员警号前面写上"{insp}"。

e.en: Always {inspect} a used car before buying it.
e.zh: 买二手车前一定要先仔细检查。

e.en: Tap an item to {inspect} its details in the app.
e.zh: 点击物品就可以在应用里查看详情。

inspected.t: v. 检查（inspect 的过去式）

e.en: The mechanic {inspected} the brakes carefully.
e.zh: 机修工仔细检查了刹车系统。

e.en: Customs officers {inspected} every suitcase.
e.zh: 海关人员检查了每一只行李箱。

inspecting.t: v. 检查（inspect 的现在分词）

e.en: She is {inspecting} the kitchen for safety violations.
e.zh: 她正在检查厨房是否有违反安全规定的情况。

e.en: He spent the morning {inspecting} the new apartment.
e.zh: 他花了一上午时间察看那间新公寓。

e.en: The car passed its annual safety {inspection}.
e.zh: 那辆车通过了年度安全检测。

e.en: A quick {inspection} revealed several broken tiles.
e.zh: 快速检查后发现有好几块瓷砖碎了。

e.en: Restaurants must pass regular health {inspections}.
e.zh: 餐馆必须定期通过卫生检查。

e.en: Surprise {inspections} keep the factory floor clean.
e.zh: 突击检查让工厂车间保持整洁。

e.en: The fire {inspector} found several code violations.
e.zh: 消防检查员发现了好几处违规问题。

e.en: A police {inspector} interviewed the witnesses.
e.zh: 一位警督询问了几位目击证人。

e.en: The schools {inspectorate} published its annual report.
e.zh: 学校督察团发布了年度报告。

e.en: Complaints can be filed with the local {inspectorate}.
e.zh: 投诉可以向当地督察机构提出。

inspectors.t: n. 检查员（inspector 的复数）

e.en: Health {inspectors} visit the kitchen unannounced.
e.zh: 卫生检查员会不打招呼就来厨房视察。

e.en: Building {inspectors} signed off on the renovations.
e.zh: 建筑检查员通过了这次装修验收。

inspects.t: v. 检查（inspect 的第三人称单数）

e.en: My dad always {inspects} the receipt before leaving.
e.zh: 我爸离开前总要检查一下收据。

e.en: The drone {inspects} power lines for damage.
e.zh: 无人机会检查电线是否有损坏。

e.en: Her travel blog is a huge {inspiration} for me.
e.zh: 她的旅行博客对我来说是巨大的灵感来源。

e.en: The artist found {inspiration} in old family photos.
e.zh: 那位艺术家从老家庭照片中获得了灵感。

inspirational.t: adj. 鼓舞人心的；启发性的

e.en: His TED talk was genuinely {inspirational}.
e.zh: 他的TED演讲真的很鼓舞人心。

e.en: She posts {inspirational} quotes every Monday.
e.zh: 她每个星期一都会发一些励志的名言。

e.en: List your top three creative {inspirations} below.
e.zh: 请在下面列出你最重要的三个创作灵感来源。

e.en: Nature and music are her main {inspirations}.
e.zh: 大自然和音乐是她主要的灵感来源。

inspiratory.t: adj. 吸气的；与吸气有关的

e.en: The doctor measured my {inspiratory} capacity.
e.zh: 医生测量了我的吸气量。

e.en: Asthma can weaken {inspiratory} muscles over time.
e.zh: 哮喘会随时间削弱吸气肌肉的功能。

e.en: Great teachers {inspire} students to keep learning.
e.zh: 优秀的老师能激励学生持续学习。

e.en: This documentary will {inspire} you to travel more.
e.zh: 这部纪录片会激发你去多旅行的欲望。

inspired.t: adj. 受启发的；灵感迸发的

e.en: His speech {inspired} me to start volunteering.
e.zh: 他的演讲激励我开始去做志愿者。

e.en: The recipe was {inspired} by traditional Thai cuisine.
e.zh: 这道食谱的灵感来自传统泰国菜。

e.en: My grandmother was the lifelong {inspirer} of my career.
e.zh: 我祖母是我职业生涯一生的激励者。

e.en: He's known online as a fitness {inspirer} for beginners.
e.zh: 他在网上以激励健身新手而闻名。

inspires.t: v. 启发（inspire 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Her courage {inspires} everyone on the team.
e.zh: 她的勇气激励了团队里的每一个人。

e.en: This app {inspires} users to read more every day.
e.zh: 这款应用激励用户每天多读一点书。

inspiring.t: adj. 鼓舞人心的；激励人的

e.en: The coach gave an {inspiring} speech before the final match.
e.zh: 教练在决赛前发表了一段鼓舞人心的演讲。

e.en: I find her travel blog truly {inspiring}.
e.zh: 我觉得她的旅行博客非常激励人心。

inst.t: n. 实例（instance 的缩写）；本月

e.en: The form lists her job title as {inst} of music.
e.zh: 表格上她的职位写的是音乐讲师的缩写。

e.en: Please write the full word instead of {inst} on official documents.
e.zh: 在正式文件上请写完整单词,而不要用 inst 这个缩写。

e.en: Political {instability} has scared off foreign investors.
e.zh: 政治上的不稳定吓跑了外国投资者。

e.en: The app crashes due to memory {instability}.
e.zh: 由于内存不稳定,这款应用频繁崩溃。

inscriptions.t: n. 铭文；题字（inscription 的复数）

e.en: Archaeologists deciphered the {inscriptions} on the temple walls.
e.zh: 考古学家破译了神庙墙上的铭文。

e.en: The museum displays bronze vessels with detailed {inscriptions}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了带有精美铭文的青铜器。

inscrutability.t: n. 难以捉摸；高深莫测

e.en: His poker face has a famous {inscrutability}.
e.zh: 他那张扑克脸以高深莫测著称。

e.en: The novel explores the {inscrutability} of human motives.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了人类动机的难以捉摸。

inscrutable.t: adj. 难以捉摸的；神秘的

e.en: The CEO gave an {inscrutable} smile during the interview.
e.zh: 采访时,首席执行官露出一个让人捉摸不透的微笑。

e.en: Cats often have an {inscrutable} expression on their faces.
e.zh: 猫脸上常常带着让人难以读懂的神情。

inscrutably.t: adv. 令人费解地；高深莫测地

e.en: She stared {inscrutably} at the screen for a long minute.
e.zh: 她神色莫测地盯着屏幕看了好一会儿。

e.en: The judge nodded {inscrutably} as the lawyer spoke.
e.zh: 律师讲话时,法官神色高深莫测地点了点头。

inseam.t: n. 裤子内侧缝（从裆到脚口）

e.en: Please measure your {inseam} before ordering the jeans.
e.zh: 订购牛仔裤前请先量一下裤子的内长。

e.en: These pants come in a 32-inch {inseam}.
e.zh: 这条裤子的内缝长度为32英寸。

e.en: A tiny {insect} was crawling across the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只小虫子正爬过窗台。

e.en: Mosquito is the most annoying {insect} in summer.
e.zh: 蚊子是夏天最烦人的昆虫。

e.en: Farmers spray {insecticidal} soap on the tomato leaves.
e.zh: 农民在番茄叶上喷洒杀虫皂。

e.en: This plant has natural {insecticidal} properties.
e.zh: 这种植物具有天然的杀虫功效。

e.en: Spray a little {insecticide} around the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 在厨房水槽周围喷一点杀虫剂。

e.en: Organic farms avoid using chemical {insecticide}.
e.zh: 有机农场避免使用化学杀虫剂。

e.en: The robot moved with quick, {insectile} jerks.
e.zh: 那机器人以昆虫般急促的抽动方式移动。

e.en: She found his thin, {insectile} fingers unsettling.
e.zh: 她觉得他那细长如昆虫般的手指让人不安。

e.en: The hedgehog is a small nocturnal {insectivore}.
e.zh: 刺猬是一种夜行性的小型食虫动物。

e.en: Bats are the most common flying {insectivore}.
e.zh: 蝙蝠是最常见的飞行食虫动物。

e.en: The Venus flytrap is a famous {insectivorous} plant.
e.zh: 捕蝇草是著名的食虫植物。

e.en: Many bird species are largely {insectivorous} in summer.
e.zh: 许多鸟类在夏天主要以昆虫为食。

e.en: Bright lights attract {insects} to the porch at night.
e.zh: 夜里明亮的灯光会把昆虫引到门廊上。

e.en: Bees and ants are highly social {insects}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂和蚂蚁都是高度群居的昆虫。

insecure.t:
adj. 缺乏安全感的
adj. 不安全的；不牢固的

e.en: He felt {insecure} about presenting in front of strangers.
e.zh: 在陌生人面前演讲让他感到很不自信。

e.en: Storing passwords in plain text is extremely {insecure}.
e.zh: 以明文形式存储密码是极不安全的。

insecurely.t: adv. 不牢固地；没有安全感地

e.en: The shelf was {insecurely} mounted and fell overnight.
e.zh: 那块架子安装得不牢,一夜之间就掉下来了。

e.en: He spoke {insecurely}, glancing at the floor the whole time.
e.zh: 他说话时缺乏自信,一直盯着地板。

insecurity.t:
n. 不安全感
n. 不安全；不稳固

e.en: Social media often amplifies teenage {insecurity}.
e.zh: 社交媒体常常放大青少年的不安全感。

e.en: The report flagged a serious {insecurity} in the login system.
e.zh: 该报告指出登录系统存在严重的安全漏洞。

e.en: Vets {inseminate} the cows in early spring.
e.zh: 兽医在早春为母牛进行人工授精。

e.en: Bees {inseminate} flowers as they collect nectar.
e.zh: 蜜蜂在采蜜的同时为花朵授粉。

e.en: The clinic offers artificial {insemination} for couples.
e.zh: 该诊所为夫妇提供人工授精服务。

e.en: Most dairy farms now rely on artificial {insemination}.
e.zh: 如今大多数奶牛场都依赖人工授精。

e.en: He fell to the floor, {insensate} from the blow.
e.zh: 他被击中后失去知觉,瘫倒在地。

e.en: The crowd showed {insensate} rage toward the referee.
e.zh: 人群对裁判表现出近乎失去理智的愤怒。

insensibility.t: n. 失去知觉；麻木不仁

e.en: The anesthetic produced complete {insensibility} within seconds.
e.zh: 麻醉剂在几秒钟内就让人完全失去知觉。

e.en: Her {insensibility} to criticism surprised her colleagues.
e.zh: 她对批评的麻木让同事们感到意外。

insensible.t: adj. 失去知觉的；未察觉的

e.en: The boxer was knocked {insensible} in the third round.
e.zh: 那名拳击手在第三回合被打得不省人事。

e.en: He seemed {insensible} to the danger ahead.
e.zh: 他似乎对前方的危险毫无察觉。

insensibly.t: adv. 不知不觉地；难以察觉地

e.en: The temperature dropped {insensibly} as evening came on.
e.zh: 夜幕降临,气温在不知不觉中下降。

e.en: Her accent shifted {insensibly} after years abroad.
e.zh: 在国外生活多年后,她的口音不知不觉地变了。

insensitive.t:
adj. 不敏感的；麻木的
adj. 不顾他人感受的

e.en: That joke was really {insensitive} to grieving families.
e.zh: 那个玩笑对正在悲痛中的家庭非常不体贴。

e.en: My fingertips became {insensitive} to the cold metal.
e.zh: 我的指尖对那冰冷的金属变得麻木无感。

insensitively.t: adv. 不体贴地；不顾他人感受地

e.en: The manager handled the layoff news quite {insensitively}.
e.zh: 那位经理处理裁员消息的方式相当不近人情。

e.en: He responded {insensitively} to her personal struggles.
e.zh: 他对她的个人困境作出了冷漠迟钝的回应。

e.en: His {insensitivity} during the meeting upset several coworkers.
e.zh: 他在会上的麻木冷漠让好几位同事很不爽。

e.en: The ad was criticized for cultural {insensitivity}.
e.zh: 那则广告因缺乏文化敏感度而受到批评。

insentient.t: adj. 无感觉的；无生命的

e.en: Rocks and metal are {insentient} objects.
e.zh: 岩石和金属都是没有知觉的物体。

e.en: Philosophers debate whether AI will ever stop being {insentient}.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论人工智能会不会有一天不再无知觉。

inseparability.t: n. 不可分离；密不可分

e.en: The {inseparability} of mind and body is a classic debate.
e.zh: 身心不可分离是一个经典的哲学议题。

e.en: Their friendship is famous for its {inseparability}.
e.zh: 他们的友谊以形影不离而出名。

inseparable.t: adj. 分不开的；形影不离的

e.en: The twins have been {inseparable} since birth.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎从出生起就形影不离。

e.en: In this dish, flavor and texture are {inseparable}.
e.zh: 在这道菜里,味道和口感密不可分。

e.en: Their names are {inseparably} linked in tech history.
e.zh: 他们的名字在科技史上密不可分地联系在一起。

e.en: Privacy and trust are {inseparably} tied together online.
e.zh: 在网络上,隐私和信任密不可分地紧紧相连。

insert.t:
v. 插入；添加
n. 插入物；插页

e.en: Please {insert} your card and enter the PIN.
e.zh: 请插入您的卡并输入密码。

e.en: You can {insert} an image directly into the document.
e.zh: 你可以直接在文档中插入一张图片。

inserted.t: v. 插入（insert 的过去式）

e.en: She {inserted} a comma to fix the run-on sentence.
e.zh: 她加了个逗号来修正那个流水句。

e.en: The dentist {inserted} a small implant during the procedure.
e.zh: 牙医在手术中植入了一颗小型种植体。

inserting.t: v. 正在插入（insert 的现在分词）

e.en: He's {inserting} new slides into the presentation.
e.zh: 他正在往演示文稿里插入新的幻灯片。

e.en: Be careful when {inserting} the SIM card into the phone.
e.zh: 把SIM卡装进手机时请小心。

e.en: The {insertion} of the catheter was painless.
e.zh: 导管的插入过程毫无痛感。

e.en: That last-minute {insertion} into the contract worried us.
e.zh: 合同里那条临时加进去的条款让我们有些担心。

e.en: The editor flagged several awkward {insertions} in the draft.
e.zh: 编辑标出了草稿里几处生硬的插入内容。

e.en: The diff shows ten {insertions} and two deletions.
e.zh: 差异比较显示有十处新增和两处删除。

inserts.t:
v. 插入（第三人称单数）
n. 插入物（复数）

e.en: The magazine {inserts} a coupon flyer every month.
e.zh: 那本杂志每月都会夹带一份优惠券传单。

e.en: She wears custom shoe {inserts} for arch support.
e.zh: 她穿着定制鞋垫来支撑足弓。

e.en: Teachers must attend an {inservice} training day each fall.
e.zh: 老师们每年秋天必须参加一天在职培训。

e.en: The hospital runs {inservice} workshops on patient safety.
e.zh: 医院定期举办关于病患安全的在职培训研讨会。

inset.t:
n. 嵌入物；插图
v. 嵌入；镶入

e.en: The map has a small {inset} showing the city center.
e.zh: 那张地图有一个显示市中心的小插图。

e.en: Her ring features a tiny diamond {inset} in gold.
e.zh: 她的戒指上有一颗镶嵌在金底座里的小钻石。

inshore.t:
adj. 近岸的
adv. 向岸；近岸地

e.en: Small fishing boats stay {inshore} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间小渔船都停靠在近海。

e.en: The {inshore} waters here are full of crabs.
e.zh: 这里的近岸水域到处都是螃蟹。

inside.t:
prep. 在……里面
n. 内部；里面

e.en: Let's wait {inside} until the rain stops.
e.zh: 我们在屋里等到雨停吧。

e.en: There's a hidden compartment {inside} the old desk.
e.zh: 那张旧书桌里面有一个隐藏的暗格。

e.en: As an {insider}, she knew about the deal months earlier.
e.zh: 作为内部人员,她早在几个月前就知道这笔交易了。

e.en: The blog shares {insider} tips for buying a first home.
e.zh: 那个博客分享首次购房的内部小贴士。

e.en: Industry {insiders} predicted the merger weeks ago.
e.zh: 业内人士几周前就预测到这次合并了。

e.en: Only a few {insiders} knew the launch date.
e.zh: 只有少数内部人士知道发布日期。

e.en: The coconut's {insides} are sweet and creamy.
e.zh: 椰子的内部果肉香甜而绵密。

e.en: My {insides} were churning before the big interview.
e.zh: 大面试之前,我的肚子里翻江倒海。

insidious.t: adj. 暗中为害的；潜伏的

e.en: Stress has an {insidious} effect on long-term health.
e.zh: 压力会对长期健康产生潜移默化的有害影响。

e.en: The malware uses an {insidious} method to evade detection.
e.zh: 这种恶意软件用一种阴险的方式来躲避检测。

e.en: The disease spreads {insidiously} before symptoms appear.
e.zh: 这种疾病在症状出现前就已悄然蔓延。

e.en: Bias can {insidiously} shape hiring decisions.
e.zh: 偏见会在不知不觉中影响招聘决策。

e.en: Her talk gave me real {insight} into customer behavior.
e.zh: 她的演讲让我对消费者行为有了真正的洞察。

e.en: The dashboard offers useful {insight} into daily traffic.
e.zh: 这个仪表板能很好地洞察每日的流量情况。

insightful.t: adj. 富有洞察力的；见解深刻的

e.en: That was a really {insightful} comment about the design.
e.zh: 那条关于设计的评论真是很有见地。

e.en: She wrote an {insightful} essay on social media addiction.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于社交媒体上瘾的精辟文章。

e.en: He {insightfully} pointed out the flaw in our plan.
e.zh: 他敏锐地指出了我们计划中的漏洞。

e.en: The book {insightfully} explores how habits are formed.
e.zh: 这本书深入透彻地探讨了习惯是如何形成的。

e.en: The report offers fresh {insights} into consumer behavior.
e.zh: 这份报告对消费者行为提出了新的见解。

e.en: Her therapy sessions led to important personal {insights}.
e.zh: 她的心理咨询带来了重要的自我领悟。

e.en: The officer's jacket bore a gold military {insignia}.
e.zh: 军官的外套上佩戴着金色军徽。

e.en: Each team wore a custom {insignia} on their sleeves.
e.zh: 每支队伍的袖子上都印有专属徽章。

e.en: Stargazing reminds me of my own {insignificance}.
e.zh: 看星星让我意识到自己的渺小。

e.en: He dismissed the error as a matter of {insignificance}.
e.zh: 他把这个错误当作微不足道的小事。

insignificant.t: adj. 无关紧要的；微不足道的

e.en: The price difference is {insignificant} for most users.
e.zh: 对大多数用户来说,价格差距微不足道。

e.en: Don't feel {insignificant} just because you're new here.
e.zh: 别因为你是新人就觉得自己无足轻重。

instal.t: v. 安装（install 的异体拼写）

e.en: You can {instal} the update from the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单里安装这个更新。

e.en: British texts sometimes {instal} software with one L.
e.zh: 英式拼写有时把 install 写成只有一个 L 的 instal。

instaled.t: v. 已安装（installed 的异体拼写）

e.en: She {instaled} the new printer driver last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚安装了新的打印机驱动。

e.en: The technician {instaled} our router in under ten minutes.
e.zh: 技术员不到十分钟就装好了我们的路由器。

instaling.t: v. 正在安装（installing 的异体拼写）

e.en: He is {instaling} the latest version on his laptop.
e.zh: 他正在笔记本上安装最新版本。

e.en: We spent the afternoon {instaling} solar panels on the roof.
e.zh: 我们用了一下午在屋顶上安装太阳能板。

e.en: Tap the button to {install} the app on your phone.
e.zh: 点一下按钮就可以把这款应用装到你的手机上。

e.en: Engineers will {install} a new server next week.
e.zh: 工程师下周会安装一台新的服务器。

installation.t:
n. 安装；装置
n. 安装包

e.en: The {installation} took about ten minutes to finish.
e.zh: 安装过程大概用了十分钟完成。

e.en: Her latest art {installation} fills the entire gallery.
e.zh: 她最新的艺术装置占满了整间画廊。

e.en: The museum features five new {installations} this month.
e.zh: 博物馆这个月新增了五件装置艺术作品。

e.en: Solar panel {installations} have doubled in the past year.
e.zh: 太阳能板的安装数量在过去一年里翻了一番。

installed.t:
v. 已安装
adj. 已装好的

e.en: I just {installed} the latest update on my phone.
e.zh: 我刚把最新更新装到了手机上。

e.en: They {installed} security cameras at every entrance.
e.zh: 他们在每个入口都安装了监控摄像头。

installer.t: n. 安装程序；安装人员

e.en: Run the {installer} and follow the on-screen instructions.
e.zh: 运行安装程序,然后按屏幕提示操作。

e.en: The {installer} arrived to set up our new dishwasher.
e.zh: 安装工人来给我们装新洗碗机。

e.en: She is {installing} a new graphics card in her PC.
e.zh: 她正在给电脑装一块新的显卡。

e.en: {Installing} this app takes less than a minute.
e.zh: 安装这款应用用不了一分钟。

installment.t:
n. 分期付款
n. (连载的) 一期

e.en: I pay for the laptop in monthly {installment} plans.
e.zh: 我用按月分期付款的方式买这台笔记本。

e.en: The next {installment} of the series comes out in June.
e.zh: 这个系列的下一部将在六月上映。

installs.t:
v. 安装（第三人称单数）
n. 安装次数

e.en: The app already has over a million {installs} worldwide.
e.zh: 这款应用在全球的安装量已经超过一百万。

e.en: He {installs} home theater systems for a living.
e.zh: 他以安装家庭影院系统为生。

instalment.t: n. 分期付款（英式拼写）

e.en: I'll pay the rest in a second {instalment} next month.
e.zh: 剩下的钱我下个月再分期付一笔。

e.en: The new {instalment} of the novel just hit the bookstores.
e.zh: 这部小说的最新一卷刚刚上架书店。

instals.t: v. 安装（instals 异体拼写）

e.en: The app {instals} quickly even on older phones.
e.zh: 这款应用即使在旧手机上也安装得很快。

e.en: He {instals} fiber internet in rural villages.
e.zh: 他在乡村地区安装光纤宽带。

instamatic.t: n. 傻瓜相机（柯达品牌）

e.en: Grandpa still keeps his old {instamatic} camera in the drawer.
e.zh: 爷爷至今还把那台老式傻瓜相机放在抽屉里。

e.en: The party photos were taken with a vintage {instamatic}.
e.zh: 派对的照片是用一台复古的傻瓜相机拍的。

instance.t:
n. 实例；例子
v. 举例

e.en: For {instance}, you can change the theme in settings.
e.zh: 举个例子,你可以在设置里更换主题。

e.en: The server runs a separate {instance} for each user.
e.zh: 服务器为每个用户运行一个独立的实例。

e.en: There were several {instances} of bugs in the latest release.
e.zh: 最新版本里出现了好几个 bug 的实例。

e.en: Cloud platforms let you spin up new {instances} in seconds.
e.zh: 云平台让你能在几秒内启动新的实例。

instant.t:
n. 瞬间
adj. 立即的；速溶的

e.en: The app gives you {instant} feedback on your pronunciation.
e.zh: 这款应用能即时反馈你的发音情况。

e.en: I just need an {instant} to grab my coat.
e.zh: 我只需要一会儿去拿件外套。

e.en: The translation is almost {instantaneous} in this app.
e.zh: 这款应用里的翻译几乎是瞬间完成的。

e.en: Her reaction was {instantaneous} when the alarm sounded.
e.zh: 警报响起时,她的反应是瞬间发生的。

e.en: Messages are delivered {instantaneously} across the globe.
e.zh: 消息可以在全球范围内瞬间送达。

e.en: The screen refreshed {instantaneously} after the update.
e.zh: 更新之后屏幕瞬间刷新完成。

e.en: You need to {instantiate} the class before calling its methods.
e.zh: 你需要先实例化这个类,再调用它的方法。

e.en: The framework will {instantiate} a new object for each request.
e.zh: 该框架会为每个请求实例化一个新对象。

e.en: Object {instantiation} happens automatically at startup.
e.zh: 对象实例化会在程序启动时自动完成。

e.en: Lazy {instantiation} can improve app performance.
e.zh: 延迟实例化可以提升应用的性能。

e.en: The page loads {instantly} on a fast connection.
e.zh: 在网速快的情况下,这个页面瞬间就加载好了。

e.en: I {instantly} recognized her voice on the phone.
e.zh: 我一接电话就立刻认出了她的声音。

e.en: The caterpillar molts to enter its next {instar}.
e.zh: 毛毛虫蜕皮以进入下一个龄期。

e.en: Biologists carefully tracked each larval {instar} stage.
e.zh: 生物学家仔细追踪了每一个幼虫龄期的阶段。

e.en: The board voted to {instate} her as the new CEO.
e.zh: 董事会投票任命她为新任首席执行官。

e.en: The committee will {instate} fresh rules next quarter.
e.zh: 委员会将在下季度正式确立新的规则。

e.en: I usually drink tea {instead} of coffee in the morning.
e.zh: 我早上一般喝茶,而不是喝咖啡。

e.en: The meeting was canceled, so we went out for lunch {instead}.
e.zh: 会议取消了,所以我们改成出去吃午饭。

e.en: These shoes feel tight across the {instep}.
e.zh: 这双鞋脚背那里穿着有点紧。

e.en: The dancer arched her {instep} gracefully.
e.zh: 那位舞者优雅地绷起了她的脚背。

e.en: He tried to {instigate} a fight in the comments section.
e.zh: 他试图在评论区挑起一场争吵。

e.en: The new manager will {instigate} major workflow changes.
e.zh: 新经理将推动一系列重大的流程变革。

e.en: The protest happened at the {instigation} of student leaders.
e.zh: 这次抗议是在学生领袖的鼓动下发生的。

e.en: The reform began at the {instigation} of the new minister.
e.zh: 这场改革是在新部长的推动下开始的。

e.en: Police identified him as the main {instigator} of the riot.
e.zh: 警方认定他是这场骚乱的主要煽动者。

e.en: She is often the {instigator} of office pranks.
e.zh: 她经常是办公室恶作剧的发起人。

e.en: Good teachers {instil} a love of learning in their students.
e.zh: 好老师能在学生心中培养出对学习的热爱。

e.en: Parents try to {instil} kindness in their children early.
e.zh: 父母会尽早把善良的品质灌输给孩子。

e.en: Her coach {instiled} confidence in every player.
e.zh: 她的教练在每位队员心中都灌注了自信。

e.en: The training {instiled} discipline in the new recruits.
e.zh: 这次训练给新兵们灌输了纪律意识。

instiling.t: v. 正在灌输（异体拼写）

e.en: The school focuses on {instiling} curiosity in young children.
e.zh: 这所学校着重在小朋友心中培养好奇心。

e.en: He believes in {instiling} good habits from an early age.
e.zh: 他相信要从小培养好习惯。

e.en: Coaches try to {instill} confidence in their athletes.
e.zh: 教练努力在运动员心中树立自信。

e.en: Reading bedtime stories can {instill} a love of books.
e.zh: 睡前讲故事能在孩子心中培养对书籍的喜爱。

e.en: The {instillation} of values starts at home.
e.zh: 价值观的灌输从家庭开始。

e.en: Daily practice supports the {instillation} of good habits.
e.zh: 日常练习有助于良好习惯的养成。

e.en: My father {instilled} a strong work ethic in me.
e.zh: 父亲在我身上培养了强烈的职业道德。

e.en: The trip {instilled} a deep respect for nature.
e.zh: 这次旅行让我心中产生了对大自然的深切敬意。

e.en: The mentor focused on {instilling} confidence in young coders.
e.zh: 那位导师重点在年轻程序员心中培养自信。

e.en: Her speech aimed at {instilling} hope in the audience.
e.zh: 她的演讲旨在为听众心中注入希望。

instills.t: v. 灌输（第三人称单数）

e.en: Daily journaling {instills} a sense of mindfulness.
e.zh: 每天写日记能培养出一种正念的感觉。

e.en: Good leadership {instills} trust within a team.
e.zh: 良好的领导力能在团队中建立信任感。

e.en: The program {instils} healthy habits in young children.
e.zh: 该项目在小朋友身上培养健康的生活习惯。

e.en: Her calm voice {instils} confidence during emergencies.
e.zh: 她冷静的声音在紧急情况下让人感到安心。

e.en: Trust your {instinct} when something feels off.
e.zh: 当感觉不对劲时,要相信自己的直觉。

e.en: Birds build nests by pure {instinct}.
e.zh: 鸟类筑巢完全是凭着本能。

e.en: Her {instinctive} reaction was to protect the child.
e.zh: 她出于本能的反应就是去保护那个孩子。

e.en: Smiling at babies is an almost {instinctive} response.
e.zh: 对着宝宝微笑几乎是一种本能的反应。

e.en: He {instinctively} ducked when the ball flew toward him.
e.zh: 球飞过来时,他本能地低下了头。

e.en: She {instinctively} reached for her phone every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都会下意识地伸手去拿手机。

e.en: A good designer trusts their {instincts} on color choices.
e.zh: 优秀的设计师会相信自己在配色上的直觉。

e.en: His {instincts} as a journalist told him the story was real.
e.zh: 作为记者,他的直觉告诉他这个故事是真的。

instinctual.t: adj. 本能的；出于直觉的

e.en: Maternal care in mammals is largely {instinctual}.
e.zh: 哺乳动物的母性照顾主要是本能性的。

e.en: Her response to danger was purely {instinctual}.
e.zh: 她对危险的反应完全是本能性的。

institute.t:
n. 研究所；学院
v. 设立；开始

e.en: She studied at a top research {institute} in Boston.
e.zh: 她曾在波士顿一所顶尖的研究院学习。

e.en: The government plans to {institute} new privacy laws.
e.zh: 政府计划设立新的隐私保护法律。

e.en: The company {instituted} a four-day workweek last year.
e.zh: 公司去年开始推行每周四天工作制。

e.en: New safety rules were {instituted} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后,新的安全规定开始实施。

institutes.t:
n. 机构（复数）
v. 设立

e.en: Several research {institutes} are studying the new virus.
e.zh: 几所研究机构正在研究这种新型病毒。

e.en: The university {institutes} a writing test for all freshmen.
e.zh: 这所大学为所有新生开设了写作测试。

instituting.t: v. 正在设立；正在实行

e.en: The school is {instituting} new safety rules next semester.
e.zh: 学校将在下学期推行新的安全规定。

e.en: The company is {instituting} a four-day workweek as a trial.
e.zh: 公司正在试行四天工作制。

e.en: Harvard is a world-renowned academic {institution}.
e.zh: 哈佛是举世闻名的学术机构。

e.en: Marriage is still considered an important social {institution}.
e.zh: 婚姻仍被视为重要的社会制度。

e.en: The bank serves both retail and {institutional} investors.
e.zh: 该银行同时服务于散户和机构投资者。

e.en: There is deep {institutional} bias against newcomers.
e.zh: 对新人存在根深蒂固的体制性偏见。

e.en: The {institutionalisation} of remote work changed office culture.
e.zh: 远程办公的制度化改变了办公文化。

e.en: Long-term {institutionalisation} can harm a patient's autonomy.
e.zh: 长期住院安置可能损害病人的自主能力。

e.en: Steve Jobs is remembered as a great {innovator}.
e.zh: 史蒂夫·乔布斯被人们铭记为一位伟大的创新者。

e.en: The young {innovator} won a national science award.
e.zh: 那位年轻的创新者获得了国家科学奖。

e.en: Tech {innovators} gathered in Berlin for the annual summit.
e.zh: 科技创新者们齐聚柏林参加年度峰会。

e.en: The program supports young {innovators} in rural communities.
e.zh: 该项目支持农村社区的年轻创新者。

e.en: The architect's {innovatory} design won several awards.
e.zh: 那位建筑师的创新设计赢得了多个奖项。

e.en: The lab is known for its {innovatory} research methods.
e.zh: 该实验室以其创新的研究方法而闻名。

innsbruck.t: n. 因斯布鲁克（奥地利城市）

e.en: We skied near {Innsbruck} during our winter holiday.
e.zh: 我们冬假期间在因斯布鲁克附近滑雪。

e.en: {Innsbruck} hosted the Winter Olympics twice in history.
e.zh: 因斯布鲁克历史上曾两度举办冬奥会。

e.en: His comment was full of sexual {innuendo}.
e.zh: 他的评论充满了性暗示。

e.en: She ignored the {innuendo} and stayed focused on work.
e.zh: 她无视那些含沙射影的话,专注于工作。

e.en: The article was filled with nasty {innuendoes} about the mayor.
e.zh: 那篇文章充满了对市长恶意的影射。

e.en: He responded calmly to the {innuendoes} from his rivals.
e.zh: 他冷静地回应了对手们的含沙射影。

e.en: There are {innumerable} stars visible from the desert.
e.zh: 在沙漠里可以看到数不清的星星。

e.en: She has helped {innumerable} students with their applications.
e.zh: 她帮助过无数学生申请学校。

e.en: Farmers add a soil {inoculant} to boost crop growth.
e.zh: 农民添加土壤接种剂以促进作物生长。

e.en: The lab developed a new {inoculant} for soybean roots.
e.zh: 实验室研发了一种用于大豆根部的新型接种剂。

e.en: Doctors {inoculate} children against measles every year.
e.zh: 医生每年为儿童接种麻疹疫苗。

e.en: Reading widely can {inoculate} you against fake news.
e.zh: 广泛阅读可以让你对假新闻产生免疫力。

inoculated.t: v. 接种（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: All staff were {inoculated} before the flu season started.
e.zh: 所有员工在流感季开始前都接种了疫苗。

e.en: She felt {inoculated} against criticism after years of practice.
e.zh: 经过多年的历练,她对批评已经免疫了。

e.en: The clinic offers free {inoculation} for travelers.
e.zh: 该诊所为旅行者提供免费的疫苗接种服务。

e.en: Mass {inoculation} has nearly eliminated polio worldwide.
e.zh: 大规模接种几乎已在全球消灭了脊髓灰质炎。

e.en: The scientist prepared a small {inoculum} of bacteria.
e.zh: 科学家准备了少量的细菌接种物。

e.en: A fresh {inoculum} was added to each culture flask.
e.zh: 每个培养瓶中都加入了新鲜的接种菌液。

inoffensive.t: adj. 无害的；不冒犯人的

e.en: He told an {inoffensive} joke to break the silence.
e.zh: 他讲了一个无伤大雅的笑话来打破沉默。

e.en: The hotel music was bland but {inoffensive}.
e.zh: 酒店的音乐平淡但不刺耳。

inoperable.t:
adj. 不能动手术的
adj. 无法运行的

e.en: The doctors said her tumor was sadly {inoperable}.
e.zh: 医生说她的肿瘤遗憾地无法手术切除。

e.en: The old elevator has been {inoperable} for months.
e.zh: 那部旧电梯已经停用好几个月了。

inoperative.t: adj. 失效的；无法运行的

e.en: The vending machine has been {inoperative} since Monday.
e.zh: 那台自动售货机从周一起就一直无法使用。

e.en: That clause becomes {inoperative} once the contract expires.
e.zh: 合同到期后该条款即失效。

inopportune.t: adj. 不合时宜的；不凑巧的

e.en: His call came at an {inopportune} moment during dinner.
e.zh: 他的电话在晚餐时不合时宜地打来了。

e.en: The rain started at the most {inopportune} time.
e.zh: 雨在最不合时宜的时候下了起来。

e.en: She spent an {inordinate} amount of time on email.
e.zh: 她在电子邮件上花了过多的时间。

e.en: The project required an {inordinate} number of meetings.
e.zh: 这个项目需要开过多的会议。

e.en: He is {inordinately} proud of his vintage car collection.
e.zh: 他对自己的老爷车收藏感到极为自豪。

e.en: The flight was {inordinately} delayed by bad weather.
e.zh: 航班因恶劣天气被极度延误。

e.en: The soil lacked {inorganic} nutrients like nitrogen and phosphorus.
e.zh: 土壤缺乏氮和磷等无机营养素。

e.en: Her smile in the photo looked stiff and {inorganic}.
e.zh: 她在照片里的笑容显得僵硬而不自然。

e.en: She stayed as an {inpatient} for three nights after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后她以住院病人身份住了三晚。

e.en: The hospital expanded its {inpatient} mental health unit.
e.zh: 医院扩建了其住院精神健康病房。

input.t:
n. 输入；输入内容
v. 输入（数据）

e.en: Please type your password in the {input} field below.
e.zh: 请在下方的输入框中输入您的密码。

e.en: We value your {input} on the new product design.
e.zh: 我们重视您对新产品设计的意见。

inputs.t:
n. 输入内容（复数）
v. 输入（第三人称单数）

e.en: The model accepts both text and image {inputs}.
e.zh: 该模型接受文本和图像两种输入。

e.en: She gathered {inputs} from every team before deciding.
e.zh: 她在决定前征集了每个团队的意见。

e.en: The coroner opened an {inquest} into the swimmer's death.
e.zh: 验尸官就那名游泳者的死亡展开了调查。

e.en: An {inquest} will determine the cause of the fire.
e.zh: 将进行一项调查以确定火灾原因。

e.en: Please {inquire} at the front desk for room service.
e.zh: 请到前台咨询客房服务事宜。

e.en: Several customers called to {inquire} about the refund policy.
e.zh: 几位顾客打电话询问退款政策。

inquired.t: v. 询问（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: She {inquired} politely about the price of the painting.
e.zh: 她礼貌地询问了那幅画的价格。

e.en: He {inquired} whether the restaurant was still open.
e.zh: 他打听餐厅是否还在营业。

e.en: The librarian patiently answered every {inquirer}'s question.
e.zh: 图书管理员耐心地回答了每位询问者的问题。

e.en: An anonymous {inquirer} asked about the rental terms.
e.zh: 一位匿名询问者询问了租赁条款。

inquires.t: v. 询问（第三人称单数）

e.en: He often {inquires} about my parents' health.
e.zh: 他经常询问我父母的健康状况。

e.en: The reporter {inquires} into local government spending.
e.zh: 那位记者调查当地政府的开支。

e.en: We received hundreds of {inquiries} after launching the website.
e.zh: 网站上线后我们收到了数百条咨询。

e.en: Police {inquiries} are still ongoing into the burglary.
e.zh: 警方对入室盗窃案的调查仍在进行中。

e.en: She gave him an {inquiring} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他投去探询的目光。

e.en: Children have naturally {inquiring} minds about the world.
e.zh: 孩子们天生对世界充满好奇心。

e.en: The dog tilted its head {inquiringly} at the sound.
e.zh: 狗听到声音后好奇地歪着头。

e.en: She raised an eyebrow {inquiringly} when he arrived late.
e.zh: 他迟到时她好奇地扬了扬眉毛。

e.en: The government launched an official {inquiry} into the scandal.
e.zh: 政府就这起丑闻展开了正式调查。
