e.en: Send your {inquiry} to our customer service email.
e.zh: 请将您的咨询发送至我们的客服邮箱。

e.en: The interview felt more like an {inquisition} than a chat.
e.zh: 那次面试感觉更像是审讯而非交谈。

e.en: She survived a brutal {inquisition} from the board members.
e.zh: 她挺过了董事会成员严厉的盘问。

e.en: My cat is naturally {inquisitive} about every new visitor.
e.zh: 我的猫天生对每位新访客都充满好奇。

e.en: He was an {inquisitive} child who asked endless questions.
e.zh: 他是个好奇的孩子,问个不停。

e.en: The toddler stared {inquisitively} at the goldfish bowl.
e.zh: 那个幼儿好奇地盯着金鱼缸看。

e.en: She peered {inquisitively} into the dusty old box.
e.zh: 她好奇地窥视着那个落满灰尘的旧盒子。

e.en: His {inquisitiveness} made him an excellent investigative journalist.
e.zh: 他的好奇心使他成为一名出色的调查记者。

e.en: Children's {inquisitiveness} should be encouraged, not suppressed.
e.zh: 孩子的好奇心应当被鼓励,而不是压抑。

e.en: The detective played {inquisitor} during the long interrogation.
e.zh: 侦探在漫长的审讯中扮演了审问者的角色。

e.en: She faced the {inquisitor} with calm and confidence.
e.zh: 她沉着自信地面对那位审问者。

inquisitorial.t: adj. 审问的；盘根问底的

e.en: His {inquisitorial} tone made the witness uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他审问般的语气让证人感到不安。

e.en: The manager's {inquisitorial} questions felt invasive to staff.
e.zh: 经理审问式的问题让员工感觉受到冒犯。

e.en: The brand made a small {inroad} into the Asian market.
e.zh: 该品牌在亚洲市场打开了一个小缺口。

e.en: Electric cars have made an {inroad} on gasoline sales.
e.zh: 电动汽车已在汽油车销量上打开了局面。

e.en: Streaming services have made huge {inroads} into traditional TV.
e.zh: 流媒体服务已大幅侵蚀了传统电视的市场。

e.en: Chinese phone makers are making {inroads} in Europe.
e.zh: 中国手机制造商正在欧洲市场逐步打开局面。

insane.t: adj. 疯狂的；精神错乱的

e.en: The traffic on Friday evening was absolutely {insane}.
e.zh: 周五傍晚的交通简直疯狂。

e.en: You'd be {insane} to quit such a stable job.
e.zh: 放弃这么稳定的工作你简直是疯了。

e.en: This new phone is {insanely} fast and lightweight.
e.zh: 这款新手机快得离谱,而且很轻。

e.en: The concert tickets were {insanely} expensive this year.
e.zh: 今年的演唱会门票贵得离谱。

e.en: The kitchen was closed due to {insanitary} conditions.
e.zh: 厨房因卫生条件不达标而被关闭。

e.en: Workers refused to enter the {insanitary} warehouse.
e.zh: 工人们拒绝进入那间不卫生的仓库。

e.en: His lawyer pleaded {insanity} during the murder trial.
e.zh: 他的律师在谋杀案审判中提出了精神失常的辩护。

e.en: It would be {insanity} to drive in this blizzard.
e.zh: 在这场暴风雪中开车简直是疯狂之举。

insatiable.t: adj. 无法满足的；贪得无厌的

e.en: Teenagers often have an {insatiable} appetite for snacks.
e.zh: 青少年对零食常常有着难以满足的胃口。

e.en: She has an {insatiable} curiosity about ancient history.
e.zh: 她对古代历史有着无尽的好奇心。

e.en: The puppy ate {insatiably} after his long walk.
e.zh: 小狗在长途散步后贪婪地吃个不停。

e.en: He reads {insatiably}, finishing several books each week.
e.zh: 他贪婪地阅读,每周读完好几本书。

e.en: The jeweler will {inscribe} your initials on the ring.
e.zh: 珠宝商会在戒指上刻上你的姓名首字母。

e.en: Please {inscribe} the date on the back of the photo.
e.zh: 请在照片背面写上日期。

inscribed.t: v. 题写（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The trophy was {inscribed} with the winner's name.
e.zh: 奖杯上刻着获胜者的名字。

e.en: She {inscribed} a heartfelt message inside the book.
e.zh: 她在书的扉页写下了一段真挚的留言。

inscribes.t: v. 题写（第三人称单数）

e.en: The jeweler {inscribes} each ring with the couple's initials.
e.zh: 珠宝匠在每枚戒指上刻上情侣的姓名首字母。

e.en: The author always {inscribes} her books for fans.
e.zh: 那位作者总会为粉丝在书上签名留言。

e.en: He spent hours {inscribing} the gravestone by hand.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时手工雕刻那块墓碑。

e.en: The artist is {inscribing} a poem on the bracelet.
e.zh: 那位艺术家正在手镯上刻一首诗。

e.en: The ancient coin bears a Latin {inscription}.
e.zh: 这枚古钱币上刻有拉丁文铭文。

e.en: I love the {inscription} my grandfather wrote in this novel.
e.zh: 我很喜欢爷爷写在这本小说上的题词。

institutionalise.t: v. 使制度化（英式拼写）

e.en: The reform aims to {institutionalise} transparency in government.
e.zh: 这项改革旨在将政府透明度制度化。

e.en: Doctors used to routinely {institutionalise} mentally ill patients.
e.zh: 医生过去常把精神病患者送进收容机构。

institutionalised.t:
adj. 已制度化的
v. institutionalise 的过去式

e.en: Racism remains {institutionalised} in many hiring practices.
e.zh: 种族主义在许多招聘做法中仍是制度性的。

e.en: After decades inside, the prisoner became completely {institutionalised}.
e.zh: 被关押数十年后,这名囚犯已完全机构化。

institutionalism.t: n. 制度主义；墨守成规

e.en: His critique targeted the rigid {institutionalism} of academia.
e.zh: 他的批评针对学术界僵化的制度主义。

e.en: Modern economics has rediscovered the value of {institutionalism}.
e.zh: 现代经济学重新发现了制度主义的价值。

e.en: The {institutionalization} of innovation requires patience and funding.
e.zh: 创新的制度化需要耐心和资金。

e.en: Critics warn against the {institutionalization} of homeless youth.
e.zh: 批评者警告不要将无家可归的青少年送入机构。

institutionalize.t: v. 使制度化；使成为常规

e.en: The startup hopes to {institutionalize} its open feedback culture.
e.zh: 这家初创公司希望将开放反馈文化制度化。

e.en: Society should not {institutionalize} people simply for being different.
e.zh: 不该仅因与众不同就把人关进机构。

institutionalized.t: adj. 已制度化的；被收容的

e.en: The team has {institutionalized} weekly retrospectives across all squads.
e.zh: 团队已将每周复盘制度化推广到所有小组。

e.en: Many elderly residents feel {institutionalized} after years in care homes.
e.zh: 许多老人在养老院多年后感到被机构化了。

institutionally.t: adv. 在制度上；由机构地

e.en: The policy is {institutionally} supported at every level.
e.zh: 该政策在各层级都获得了制度上的支持。

e.en: These biases are {institutionally} embedded and hard to remove.
e.zh: 这些偏见根植于体制之中,难以消除。

e.en: Public trust in major {institutions} has steadily declined.
e.zh: 公众对主要机构的信任持续下降。

e.en: Financial {institutions} tightened lending after the crisis.
e.zh: 危机过后,金融机构收紧了放贷。

e.en: Please {instruct} the new hires on our security policies.
e.zh: 请向新员工讲解我们的安全规定。

e.en: The judge will {instruct} the jury before deliberations begin.
e.zh: 法官将在陪审团审议前向其作出指示。

instructed.t:
v. instruct 的过去式
adj. 受过训练的

e.en: The pilot was {instructed} to circle until the runway cleared.
e.zh: 飞行员被指示盘旋等待跑道清空。

e.en: She {instructed} her assistant to reschedule all meetings.
e.zh: 她吩咐助理把所有会议重新安排。

instructing.t: v. 指导；下达指令（进行时）

e.en: He spent the morning {instructing} interns on database queries.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在教实习生写数据库查询。

e.en: The manual is {instructing} users to update the firmware first.
e.zh: 手册指示用户先更新固件。

e.en: Follow each {instruction} carefully when assembling the bookshelf.
e.zh: 组装书架时请仔细按每条说明操作。

e.en: Online {instruction} has become standard at most universities.
e.zh: 线上教学已成为大多数大学的常态。

e.en: The channel posts {instructional} videos on home repair.
e.zh: 该频道发布家居维修的教学视频。

e.en: She designs {instructional} materials for elementary classrooms.
e.zh: 她为小学课堂设计教学材料。

e.en: Read the {instructions} before plugging in the device.
e.zh: 插电前请先阅读使用说明。

e.en: The chatbot follows the {instructions} in its system prompt.
e.zh: 聊天机器人按照系统提示中的指令执行。

instructive.t: adj. 有启发的；有教益的

e.en: Her failure was painful but ultimately very {instructive}.
e.zh: 她的失败令人痛苦,但极具启发意义。

e.en: Comparing the two drafts proved highly {instructive} for students.
e.zh: 对比这两份草稿对学生很有启发性。

e.en: My yoga {instructor} corrected my posture gently.
e.zh: 我的瑜伽老师轻声纠正了我的姿势。

e.en: The driving {instructor} reminded me to check my mirrors.
e.zh: 驾驶教练提醒我要检查后视镜。

e.en: All {instructors} must complete safety training before the season.
e.zh: 所有教练必须在赛季前完成安全培训。

e.en: The platform pays its {instructors} based on course enrollment.
e.zh: 该平台根据课程报名情况向讲师付酬。

instructs.t: v. 指示；指导（第三人称单数）

e.en: The recipe {instructs} you to preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
e.zh: 菜谱要求你将烤箱预热到180度。

e.en: The label clearly {instructs} users to keep the bottle refrigerated.
e.zh: 标签清楚地指示使用者将瓶子冷藏。

e.en: The violin is a notoriously difficult {instrument} to master.
e.zh: 小提琴是一种公认难以掌握的乐器。

e.en: This survey is the main {instrument} for measuring satisfaction.
e.zh: 这份问卷是衡量满意度的主要工具。

instrumental.t:
adj. 起重要作用的
n. 器乐曲

e.en: She was {instrumental} in launching the new product line.
e.zh: 她在推出新产品线中起了关键作用。

e.en: I prefer {instrumental} music when I'm coding.
e.zh: 我写代码时更喜欢纯音乐。

e.en: His philosophy reflects a pragmatic {instrumentalism} about truth.
e.zh: 他的哲学反映出对真理的实用工具主义观点。

e.en: Critics accused the policy of crude political {instrumentalism}.
e.zh: 批评者指责该政策是粗暴的政治工具主义。

instrumentalist.t: n. 器乐演奏者；工具主义者

e.en: She is widely regarded as the finest {instrumentalist} of her generation.
e.zh: 她被公认为同代人中最杰出的器乐演奏家。

e.en: An {instrumentalist} view treats theories as useful predictive tools.
e.zh: 工具主义观点把理论视为有用的预测工具。

e.en: The agency acts as an {instrumentality} of the federal government.
e.zh: 该机构作为联邦政府的执行工具运作。

e.en: He emphasized the {instrumentality} of language in shaping thought.
e.zh: 他强调语言在塑造思维中的工具性作用。

e.en: Activists protested the {instrumentalization} of refugees for political gain.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议把难民工具化以谋取政治利益。

e.en: She criticized the {instrumentalization} of art by big brands.
e.zh: 她批评艺术被大品牌工具化利用。

instrumentally.t: adv. 作为手段地；借助工具地

e.en: The CEO contributed {instrumentally} to the merger's success.
e.zh: 首席执行官对并购的成功起到了关键作用。

e.en: Knowledge can be valued {instrumentally} or for its own sake.
e.zh: 知识可以因其工具价值或自身价值而被看重。

e.en: The lab upgraded its scientific {instrumentation} last year.
e.zh: 实验室去年升级了科研仪器设备。

e.en: Adding {instrumentation} helps engineers track production performance.
e.zh: 加入监测埋点能帮助工程师追踪生产性能。

instrumented.t: adj. 装有仪器的；带埋点的

e.en: We {instrumented} the API to log every slow request.
e.zh: 我们给API加了埋点以记录每个慢请求。

e.en: The car is heavily {instrumented} with sensors for testing.
e.zh: 这辆测试车装有大量传感器。

e.en: Children are encouraged to try several musical {instruments} early on.
e.zh: 鼓励孩子早早尝试多种乐器。

e.en: Surgeons sterilize all {instruments} before each operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在每次手术前都对所有器械消毒。

e.en: He was suspended for being repeatedly {insubordinate} to his manager.
e.zh: 他因屡次违抗经理而被停职。

e.en: The captain would not tolerate an {insubordinate} crew member.
e.zh: 船长不会容忍不服从命令的船员。

e.en: He grinned {insubordinately} as the supervisor walked past.
e.zh: 主管走过时他不服气地咧嘴一笑。

e.en: She replied {insubordinately}, refusing to follow the new rule.
e.zh: 她不服从地回应,拒绝遵守新规定。

e.en: The soldier was court-martialed for blatant {insubordination}.
e.zh: 那名士兵因公然抗命被送上军事法庭。

e.en: Her email was treated as outright {insubordination} by HR.
e.zh: 她那封邮件被人事部门视为公然抗命。

e.en: His file documented several minor {insubordinations} over the year.
e.zh: 他的档案记录了一年中几次轻微的抗命行为。

e.en: The captain logged each of the sailor's {insubordinations} carefully.
e.zh: 船长仔细记录了那名水手每一次的抗命行为。

insubstantial.t: adj. 不实在的；无实质的

e.en: Their evidence was too {insubstantial} to support a conviction.
e.zh: 他们的证据过于薄弱,无法支持定罪。

e.en: I felt hungry again after such an {insubstantial} lunch.
e.zh: 吃了这么不顶饱的午餐后我又饿了。

e.en: His smug attitude after winning was simply {insufferable}.
e.zh: 他赢了之后那副得意的样子简直让人受不了。

e.en: The heat in the tent became absolutely {insufferable} by noon.
e.zh: 中午时分帐篷里的高温让人无法忍受。

e.en: He talks {insufferably} about himself at every dinner party.
e.zh: 他每次聚餐都没完没了地谈自己,让人受不了。

e.en: The film was {insufferably} long and full of clichés.
e.zh: 这部电影长得让人难以忍受,充满了老套桥段。

insufficiency.t: n. 不足；（器官）功能不全

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with mild kidney {insufficiency}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有轻度肾功能不全。

e.en: An {insufficiency} of funding stalled the entire project.
e.zh: 资金不足使整个项目陷入停滞。

e.en: Sorry, your account has {insufficient} funds for this purchase.
e.zh: 抱歉,您的账户余额不足以完成此次购买。

e.en: There was {insufficient} evidence to file formal charges.
e.zh: 证据不足,无法正式提出指控。

e.en: The new employees were {insufficiently} trained for the role.
e.zh: 新员工的岗位培训不够充分。

e.en: The bridge was {insufficiently} reinforced to handle heavy trucks.
e.zh: 这座桥加固不足,无法承受重型卡车。

insular.t: adj. 思想狭隘的；岛屿的

e.en: The village remained {insular} and suspicious of outsiders.
e.zh: 这个村子封闭保守,对外来人心存戒备。

e.en: Tech companies are often criticized for their {insular} culture.
e.zh: 科技公司常因文化封闭而受到批评。

e.en: The team's {insularity} prevented good ideas from getting in.
e.zh: 团队的封闭性使好的想法难以进入。

e.en: Critics noted the {insularity} of the literary establishment.
e.zh: 批评者指出文学界的封闭排外。

e.en: We need to {insulate} the attic to lower heating bills.
e.zh: 我们得给阁楼做保温,以降低取暖费。

e.en: Wealth can {insulate} people from the consequences of failure.
e.zh: 财富可使人免受失败后果的影响。

e.en: This jacket is well {insulated} for winter hiking.
e.zh: 这件外套保暖性好,适合冬季徒步。

e.en: Senior executives are often {insulated} from frontline complaints.
e.zh: 高管往往与一线投诉隔绝。

insulating.t:
v. 绝缘；隔离（进行时）
adj. 绝缘的

e.en: Wool is excellent at {insulating} the body from cold.
e.zh: 羊毛能很好地为身体保暖隔寒。

e.en: The company is {insulating} its profits from currency swings.
e.zh: 该公司正在让利润免受汇率波动的影响。

e.en: Better wall {insulation} cut our energy bill by half.
e.zh: 更好的墙体保温让我们的能源账单减少了一半。

e.en: Politicians enjoy a level of {insulation} from public anger.
e.zh: 政客在某种程度上不受公众愤怒的影响。

e.en: Rubber is an excellent electrical {insulator}.
e.zh: 橡胶是极好的电绝缘体。

e.en: Down feathers are nature's most efficient {insulator}.
e.zh: 绒毛是自然界最高效的保温材料。

e.en: Diabetic patients often inject {insulin} before meals.
e.zh: 糖尿病患者常在饭前注射胰岛素。

e.en: The price of {insulin} has become a major political issue.
e.zh: 胰岛素的价格已成为一个重大政治议题。

insult.t:
v. 侮辱
n. 侮辱的言行

e.en: Don't {insult} the chef by leaving food untouched.
e.zh: 别一口不吃，那是对厨师的侮辱。

e.en: His comment was a clear {insult} to the team.
e.zh: 他的话明显是对团队的侮辱。

insulted.t:
v. insult 的过去式
adj. 被冒犯的

e.en: She felt {insulted} by the dismissive reply.
e.zh: 那句敷衍的回复让她觉得受了侮辱。

e.en: He {insulted} the referee and got ejected.
e.zh: 他辱骂裁判，被罚下场。

e.en: That tip was honestly {insulting} after great service.
e.zh: 服务那么好，给这点小费简直是侮辱人。

e.en: Stop using {insulting} language in the chat.
e.zh: 别在聊天里说带侮辱性的话。

e.en: The offer was {insultingly} low for that position.
e.zh: 那个职位给的薪水低得让人觉得受辱。

e.en: He spoke to the waiter {insultingly}.
e.zh: 他用侮辱性的口气对服务员说话。

e.en: Many {intellectuals} debated the new policy on Twitter.
e.zh: 许多知识分子在推特上讨论这项新政策。

e.en: The café was a gathering place for young {intellectuals}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆是年轻知识分子的聚集地。

e.en: Artificial {intelligence} is changing how we work.
e.zh: 人工智能正在改变我们的工作方式。

e.en: The agency gathered {intelligence} on the suspect's network.
e.zh: 该机构收集了嫌疑人网络的情报。

e.en: She gave an {intelligent} answer during the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试中给出了一个聪明的回答。

e.en: Modern phones use {intelligent} assistants like Siri.
e.zh: 现代手机使用像Siri这样的智能助手。

e.en: The app {intelligently} sorts your photos by location.
e.zh: 这款应用能智能地按位置整理你的照片。

e.en: She spoke {intelligently} about climate change at the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议上就气候变化作了精彩发言。

e.en: The local {intelligentsia} gathered at the bookshop weekly.
e.zh: 当地的知识阶层每周都在书店聚会。

e.en: The reform was supported by Russia's liberal {intelligentsia}.
e.zh: 这项改革得到了俄罗斯自由派知识阶层的支持。

e.en: Background noise reduced the {intelligibility} of the recording.
e.zh: 背景噪音降低了录音的清晰度。

e.en: Engineers tested the speaker's {intelligibility} across distances.
e.zh: 工程师测试了扬声器在不同距离下的清晰度。

e.en: His accent was barely {intelligible} over the phone.
e.zh: 他的口音在电话里几乎听不清。

e.en: Please make the instructions {intelligible} to beginners.
e.zh: 请把说明写得让新手也能看懂。

e.en: She spoke slowly and {intelligibly} for the audience.
e.zh: 她为观众放慢语速,清楚地讲话。

e.en: The drunk man could no longer answer {intelligibly}.
e.zh: 那个醉汉已经无法清楚地回答了。

e.en: His {intemperance} at parties cost him his job.
e.zh: 他在派对上的放纵让他丢了工作。

e.en: The pastor warned against {intemperance} in food and drink.
e.zh: 牧师告诫人们不要在饮食上放纵。

e.en: He sent an {intemperate} email and regretted it later.
e.zh: 他发了一封措辞激烈的邮件,后来很后悔。

e.en: Her {intemperate} remarks angered the entire committee.
e.zh: 她过激的言论激怒了整个委员会。

e.en: I {intend} to finish this project by Friday.
e.zh: 我打算在周五前完成这个项目。

e.en: They {intend} to launch the app next month.
e.zh: 他们计划下个月发布这款应用。

e.en: The opera {intendant} announced next season's program.
e.zh: 歌剧院总监宣布了下个演出季的节目。

e.en: The royal {intendant} managed the king's finances.
e.zh: 皇家总管负责管理国王的财务。

e.en: This message was not {intended} for you.
e.zh: 这条消息本不是发给你的。

e.en: The new feature is {intended} for advanced users.
e.zh: 这项新功能是为高级用户设计的。

e.en: She called him {intending} to apologize properly.
e.zh: 她打电话给他,本想好好道歉。

e.en: Many travelers are {intending} to book flights early.
e.zh: 许多旅客打算提早预订机票。

intends.t: v. 打算（第三人称单数）

e.en: The company {intends} to expand into Asia next year.
e.zh: 该公司打算明年向亚洲扩张。

e.en: She {intends} to study computer science abroad.
e.zh: 她打算去国外学习计算机科学。

e.en: The match featured {intense} competition until the final whistle.
e.zh: 这场比赛直到终场哨响都是激烈的较量。

e.en: He felt {intense} pressure before the presentation.
e.zh: 演讲前他感受到巨大的压力。

e.en: She stared {intensely} at the screen for hours.
e.zh: 她全神贯注地盯着屏幕看了好几个小时。

e.en: The chili was {intensely} spicy and made me sweat.
e.zh: 这辣椒辣得我直冒汗。

e.en: The {intensification} of the storm forced flights to cancel.
e.zh: 风暴的加剧迫使航班取消。

e.en: There has been an {intensification} of online debate this week.
e.zh: 本周网上的争论愈演愈烈。

e.en: The rain {intensified} just as we left the house.
e.zh: 我们刚出门,雨就下大了。

e.en: Police {intensified} their search after new clues emerged.
e.zh: 出现新线索后,警方加大了搜查力度。

e.en: The word "very" is a common {intensifier} in English.
e.zh: "very"是英语中常见的强调词。

e.en: This shampoo includes a color {intensifier} for redheads.
e.zh: 这款洗发水含有红发增色剂。

intensifies.t: v. 加剧（第三人称单数）

e.en: The drama {intensifies} in the second half of the show.
e.zh: 剧情在剧集的后半段变得更加紧张。

e.en: Loneliness often {intensifies} during the holidays.
e.zh: 孤独感在假期里往往会加剧。

e.en: Officials plan to {intensify} efforts against online fraud.
e.zh: 官员计划加大打击网络诈骗的力度。

e.en: Caffeine can {intensify} feelings of anxiety in some people.
e.zh: 咖啡因会加重某些人的焦虑感。

e.en: Competition is {intensifying} among streaming platforms.
e.zh: 流媒体平台之间的竞争日趋激烈。

e.en: The wind kept {intensifying} throughout the night.
e.zh: 风一整夜不断加强。

e.en: Logicians distinguish extensional from {intensional} definitions.
e.zh: 逻辑学家区分外延定义和内涵定义。

e.en: The verb creates an {intensional} context for the noun phrase.
e.zh: 该动词为名词短语创造了一个内涵语境。

e.en: The lamp offers three different {intensities} of light.
e.zh: 这盏灯可调节三种不同的亮度。

e.en: Athletes train at varying {intensities} throughout the week.
e.zh: 运动员一周内以不同强度进行训练。

e.en: The {intensity} of the workout left him exhausted.
e.zh: 高强度的训练让他筋疲力尽。

e.en: She spoke with surprising {intensity} about her startup.
e.zh: 她谈起自己的创业项目时充满了热忱。

e.en: He took an {intensive} English course over the summer.
e.zh: 他暑假参加了一门强化英语课程。

e.en: The patient was moved to the {intensive} care unit.
e.zh: 病人被转入重症监护室。

e.en: She studied {intensively} for the bar exam.
e.zh: 她为律师资格考试拼命复习。

e.en: The team has been training {intensively} for months.
e.zh: 球队已经高强度训练了几个月。

intent.t:
n. 意图
adj. 专注的

e.en: Her {intent} was to help, not to criticize.
e.zh: 她的本意是帮忙,不是批评。

e.en: He was {intent} on finishing the marathon despite the pain.
e.zh: 尽管很痛,他还是决心要跑完马拉松。

e.en: I have no {intention} of quitting my job.
e.zh: 我没有辞职的打算。

e.en: She announced her {intention} to run for mayor.
e.zh: 她宣布有意竞选市长。

e.en: The foul looked {intentional} on the replay.
e.zh: 从回放来看,这次犯规像是故意的。

e.en: Her kindness to strangers is always {intentional}.
e.zh: 她对陌生人的善意总是出于本心。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {intentionality} of conscious thought.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论意识思维的意向性。

e.en: There's a clear {intentionality} behind every design choice.
e.zh: 每一个设计选择背后都有明确的目的性。

e.en: He {intentionally} left his phone at home.
e.zh: 他故意把手机留在了家里。

e.en: The director {intentionally} blurred the background.
e.zh: 导演有意让背景虚化。

intentioned.t: adj. 有…意图的（常用于复合词）

e.en: He's well-{intentioned} but often makes things worse.
e.zh: 他出发点是好的,但常常把事情弄得更糟。

e.en: Her ill-{intentioned} comments hurt the whole team.
e.zh: 她不怀好意的评论伤害了整个团队。

e.en: His {intentions} seemed honest at first.
e.zh: 起初他的意图看起来很真诚。

e.en: Please be clear about your {intentions} for this trip.
e.zh: 请说清楚你这次旅行的目的。

e.en: The cat watched the bird {intently} from the window.
e.zh: 那只猫从窗口专注地盯着鸟看。

e.en: She listened {intently} as he explained the plan.
e.zh: 他讲解计划时,她专心地听着。

e.en: For all {intents} and purposes, the project is finished.
e.zh: 实际上,这个项目已经完成了。

e.en: Android apps use {intents} to launch other activities.
e.zh: 安卓应用使用intent来启动其他活动。

inter.t:
v. 埋葬
prefix. 之间（词根）

e.en: The family chose to {inter} him beside his parents.
e.zh: 家人决定将他葬在父母身旁。

e.en: Soldiers helped {inter} the fallen with full honors.
e.zh: 士兵们以最高礼仪安葬阵亡者。

e.en: Children learn to {interact} through cooperative play.
e.zh: 孩子们通过合作游戏学会与他人互动。

e.en: Users can {interact} with the chatbot in real time.
e.zh: 用户可以实时与聊天机器人互动。

e.en: She {interacted} warmly with every customer in the shop.
e.zh: 她热情地与店里的每位顾客交流。

e.en: The two medications {interacted} and caused side effects.
e.zh: 两种药物相互作用,引发了副作用。

e.en: He enjoys {interacting} with fans on livestreams.
e.zh: 他喜欢在直播中与粉丝互动。

e.en: These chemicals are {interacting} in unexpected ways.
e.zh: 这些化学物质正以意想不到的方式相互作用。

e.en: Every {interaction} with customers shapes brand loyalty.
e.zh: 与顾客的每次互动都会塑造品牌忠诚度。

e.en: The drug {interaction} can be dangerous for elderly patients.
e.zh: 这种药物相互作用对老年患者可能很危险。

e.en: Researchers studied the {interactional} patterns of online groups.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了网络群组的互动模式。

e.en: The therapy focuses on {interactional} dynamics within families.
e.zh: 这种疗法专注于家庭内部的互动关系。

e.en: Symbolic {interactionism} explains how meaning emerges in conversation.
e.zh: 符号互动论解释了意义如何在对话中产生。

e.en: His sociology class covered {interactionism} in detail.
e.zh: 他的社会学课详细讲解了互动论。

e.en: The professor took an {interactionist} view of identity formation.
e.zh: 教授以互动论的观点看待身份形成。

e.en: An {interactionist} approach values everyday social encounters.
e.zh: 互动论方法重视日常的社会接触。

e.en: Most {interactions} on the app happen through short videos.
e.zh: 该应用上的大多数互动都通过短视频进行。

e.en: Doctors check for harmful drug {interactions} before prescribing.
e.zh: 医生开药前会检查是否有有害的药物相互作用。

e.en: The museum has an {interactive} exhibit where kids can touch everything.
e.zh: 博物馆有一个互动展区，孩子们可以随便触摸。

e.en: This app offers an {interactive} tutorial for new users.
e.zh: 这款应用为新用户提供互动式教程。

e.en: You can edit the chart {interactively} by dragging its points.
e.zh: 你可以通过拖动节点来交互式地编辑图表。

e.en: The script runs {interactively} and asks for your input.
e.zh: 该脚本以交互方式运行，会询问你的输入。

interacts.t: v. 互动（第三人称单数）

e.en: This medication {interacts} badly with alcohol.
e.zh: 这种药物与酒精会产生不良反应。

e.en: She {interacts} well with customers and coworkers.
e.zh: 她与客户和同事都相处得很好。

interagency.t: adj. 跨机构的；部门间的

e.en: The {interagency} task force investigates cross-border crimes.
e.zh: 这个跨机构特别工作组负责调查跨境犯罪。

e.en: Better {interagency} cooperation could prevent such failures.
e.zh: 加强机构间的合作可以避免此类失误。

insults.t:
n. 侮辱
v. 侮辱，辱骂

e.en: The post was full of personal {insults}.
e.zh: 那条帖子满是人身侮辱。

e.en: She {insults} anyone who disagrees with her online.
e.zh: 网上谁不同意她，她就骂谁。

insuperable.t: adj. 难以克服的，无法逾越的

e.en: The team faced {insuperable} odds in the final.
e.zh: 决赛中球队面对难以逾越的劣势。

e.en: Funding turned out to be an {insuperable} barrier.
e.zh: 资金最终成了无法跨越的障碍。

insupportable.t: adj. 无法忍受的；无根据的

e.en: The summer heat became {insupportable} without air conditioning.
e.zh: 没空调的夏天热得让人受不了。

e.en: His behavior at work was simply {insupportable}.
e.zh: 他在公司的行为实在让人无法容忍。

e.en: Older homes are sometimes harder to make {insurable}.
e.zh: 老房子有时候比较难买到保险。

e.en: The doctor confirmed he was still {insurable}.
e.zh: 医生确认他仍可投保。

e.en: My car {insurance} renewal went up again.
e.zh: 我的车险续保又涨价了。

e.en: Always keep a backup as {insurance} against data loss.
e.zh: 留个备份，以防数据丢失。

e.en: The clinic accepts most major health {insurances}.
e.zh: 这家诊所接受大多数主流医保。

e.en: Comparing different {insurances} can save you money.
e.zh: 对比不同的保险方案能省不少钱。

e.en: It costs more to {insure} a sports car.
e.zh: 给跑车上保险费用更高。

e.en: You should {insure} your laptop before traveling.
e.zh: 出行前最好给笔记本电脑买个保险。

insured.t:
adj. 已投保的
n. 被保险人

e.en: Make sure the package is fully {insured}.
e.zh: 确保包裹买了全额保险。

e.en: Only the {insured} driver can file the claim.
e.zh: 只有投保的司机才能申请理赔。

e.en: My {insurer} denied the claim without explanation.
e.zh: 我的保险公司没说明理由就拒赔了。

e.en: Switching {insurer} saved her hundreds a year.
e.zh: 换了保险公司她每年省下好几百。

e.en: A small {insurgence} broke out in the northern province.
e.zh: 北部省份爆发了小规模的反叛。

e.en: The government quickly suppressed the {insurgence}.
e.zh: 政府迅速镇压了这场叛乱。

e.en: The {insurgency} has lasted nearly a decade.
e.zh: 这场叛乱已经持续了将近十年。

e.en: Troops were deployed to contain the rural {insurgency}.
e.zh: 军队被派去遏制农村地区的叛乱。

insurgent.t:
n. 叛乱分子
adj. 起义的

e.en: An {insurgent} group claimed responsibility for the attack.
e.zh: 一个反叛组织声称对袭击负责。

e.en: The {insurgent} candidate beat the establishment favorite.
e.zh: 这位挑战者击败了建制派的热门人选。

insurmountable.t: adj. 无法克服的，不可逾越的

e.en: With teamwork, the deadline seemed less {insurmountable}.
e.zh: 靠团队合作，截止日期看上去没那么不可逾越了。

e.en: She faced {insurmountable} debt after the lawsuit.
e.zh: 那场官司后她背上了无法偿还的债务。

e.en: Several leaders were arrested after the failed {insurrection}.
e.zh: 起义失败后几名首领被捕。

e.en: The {insurrection} on January 6 shocked the country.
e.zh: 1月6日的暴动震惊了全国。

e.en: Police monitored the {insurrectionary} group online.
e.zh: 警方在网上监控这个煽动叛乱的团体。

e.en: His speech was labeled {insurrectionary} by critics.
e.zh: 批评者把他的演讲定性为煽动叛乱。

e.en: The court charged him as an {insurrectionist}.
e.zh: 法庭以叛乱分子的罪名起诉了他。

e.en: {Insurrectionist} forums were taken offline last week.
e.zh: 上周一些煽动叛乱的论坛被下架了。

e.en: Declare the variable as an {int} before using it.
e.zh: 使用前先把这个变量声明为整型。

e.en: This function returns an {int}, not a string.
e.zh: 这个函数返回的是整型，不是字符串。

intact.t: adj. 完整无损的，未受影响的

e.en: The package arrived completely {intact} after shipping.
e.zh: 包裹运到时完好无损。

e.en: Her reputation remained {intact} despite the rumors.
e.zh: 尽管有传言，她的名声依然没受影响。

intactness.t: n. 完整性，未受损状态

e.en: Researchers verified the {intactness} of the ancient tomb.
e.zh: 研究人员确认这座古墓保存完整。

e.en: The seal's {intactness} proves the file wasn't opened.
e.zh: 封口完整说明文件没被打开过。

e.en: The ring features a tiny {intaglio} of a lion.
e.zh: 戒指上刻有一只小狮子的凹雕图案。

e.en: Museums often display ancient {intaglio} gems.
e.zh: 博物馆常展出古代的凹雕宝石。

intake.t: n. 摄入量；进气口；招收人数

e.en: Doctors recommend reducing your sugar {intake}.
e.zh: 医生建议减少糖的摄入量。

e.en: The university's freshman {intake} doubled this year.
e.zh: 今年这所大学的新生招生人数翻倍了。

intakes.t: n. 摄入量（intake 的复数）

e.en: Daily calorie {intakes} vary by age and activity.
e.zh: 每日热量摄入因年龄和运动量而异。

e.en: The hospital schedules patient {intakes} every morning.
e.zh: 医院每天上午安排病人入院登记。

e.en: The {intangibility} of services makes them hard to price.
e.zh: 服务的无形性让它很难定价。

e.en: Brand value's {intangibility} complicates accounting.
e.zh: 品牌价值的无形性让会计处理变得复杂。

intangible.t: adj. 无形的，难以捉摸的

e.en: Trust is an {intangible} but vital part of teamwork.
e.zh: 信任是团队合作中无形却关键的一环。

e.en: Software counts as an {intangible} asset on the balance sheet.
e.zh: 软件在资产负债表上算作无形资产。

intangibles.t: n. 无形资产；难以量化的因素

e.en: Coaches value {intangibles} like leadership and grit.
e.zh: 教练看重领导力、毅力这些无形特质。

e.en: Patents are {intangibles} that drive company valuation.
e.zh: 专利属于推动公司估值的无形资产。

intarsia.t: n. 木质镶嵌工艺；嵌花编织

e.en: She knitted a sweater with a colorful {intarsia} pattern.
e.zh: 她织了一件带彩色嵌花图案的毛衣。

e.en: The cabinet doors are decorated with wooden {intarsia}.
e.zh: 柜门上装饰着木制的镶嵌花纹。

e.en: The function only accepts a positive {integer} as input.
e.zh: 这个函数只接受正整数作为输入。

e.en: Round the result to the nearest {integer}.
e.zh: 把结果四舍五入到最接近的整数。

integral.t:
adj. 不可或缺的；完整的
n. 积分

e.en: Feedback is an {integral} part of the design process.
e.zh: 反馈是设计流程中不可或缺的一部分。

e.en: We solved the {integral} using substitution.
e.zh: 我们用换元法算出了这个积分。

e.en: Security is {integrally} built into the platform.
e.zh: 安全机制被完整地内置到平台中。

e.en: Marketing and product are {integrally} linked here.
e.zh: 在这里市场和产品是紧密结合的。

e.en: We need to {integrate} the new API by Friday.
e.zh: 我们得在周五前把新 API 接入。

e.en: Schools should {integrate} mental health into the curriculum.
e.zh: 学校应该把心理健康纳入课程。

e.en: The app has {integrated} payments for one-tap checkout.
e.zh: 这个 app 集成了支付，一键就能下单。

e.en: They built an {integrated} workflow across all teams.
e.zh: 他们打造了贯穿所有团队的一体化工作流。

integrates.t: v. 整合（integrate 第三人称单数）

e.en: Slack {integrates} smoothly with most project tools.
e.zh: Slack 能很顺畅地接入大多数项目工具。

e.en: The watch {integrates} fitness tracking and payments.
e.zh: 这款手表把健身追踪和支付功能整合在一起。

integrating.t: v. 整合（integrate 的现在分词）

e.en: We're currently {integrating} Stripe into the checkout flow.
e.zh: 我们正在把 Stripe 接入结账流程。

e.en: {Integrating} feedback early prevents costly rewrites.
e.zh: 早点把反馈整合进来，能避免代价高昂的重写。

e.en: The Slack {integration} pushes alerts to our channel.
e.zh: Slack 集成会把告警推送到我们的频道。

e.en: Smooth team {integration} took several months.
e.zh: 团队顺利融合花了好几个月。

e.en: He took an {integrationist} approach to the merger.
e.zh: 他对这次合并采取了融合派的做法。

e.en: The senator was a lifelong {integrationist}.
e.zh: 这位参议员一生都是种族融合的支持者。

e.en: Our app supports over fifty third-party {integrations}.
e.zh: 我们的应用支持五十多种第三方集成。

e.en: Setting up Zapier {integrations} saves hours each week.
e.zh: 配置 Zapier 集成每周能省下好几个小时。

e.en: She practices {integrative} medicine combining East and West.
e.zh: 她做的是结合东西方的整合医学。

e.en: The course takes an {integrative} approach to design.
e.zh: 这门课对设计采取整合性的教学方式。

integrator.t: n. 系统集成商；整合者

e.en: They hired a systems {integrator} for the rollout.
e.zh: 他们请了一家系统集成商来上线。

e.en: A good {integrator} ties scattered tools into one workflow.
e.zh: 好的集成方案能把零散的工具串成一个工作流。

integrin.t: n. 整合素（细胞黏附蛋白）

e.en: {Integrin} proteins help cells stick to surrounding tissue.
e.zh: 整合素蛋白帮助细胞黏附到周围组织上。

e.en: Scientists study {integrin} signaling in cancer spread.
e.zh: 科学家在研究整合素信号与癌症扩散的关系。

integrities.t: n. 完整性（integrity 的复数）

e.en: The audit checks the {integrities} of multiple databases.
e.zh: 审计会检查多个数据库的完整性。

e.en: Different {integrities} of stone are used for different builds.
e.zh: 不同强度的石材用于不同的建筑。

e.en: Her {integrity} earned the respect of her colleagues.
e.zh: 她的正直赢得了同事的尊重。

e.en: The script verifies file {integrity} after download.
e.zh: 下载完成后脚本会校验文件的完整性。

e.en: Got any {intel} on the new product launch?
e.zh: 关于新品发布你有什么内部消息吗？

e.en: The agency shared {intel} about the upcoming attack.
e.zh: 该机构分享了即将发生袭击的情报。

intellect.t: n. 智力，理解力；知识分子

e.en: His sharp {intellect} made him a great debater.
e.zh: 他敏锐的头脑让他成为出色的辩手。

e.en: Reading widely sharpens the {intellect}.
e.zh: 广泛阅读能磨练人的智力。

e.en: The conference gathered some of the finest {intellects} in physics.
e.zh: 这场会议汇集了物理学界一些顶尖的头脑。

e.en: Young {intellects} flourish when given real challenges.
e.zh: 给年轻人真正的挑战，他们的才智才能成长。

intellectual.t:
n. 知识分子
adj. 智力的，思想的

e.en: She enjoys {intellectual} conversations over coffee.
e.zh: 她喜欢边喝咖啡边聊一些思想性的话题。

e.en: Protecting {intellectual} property is a top priority.
e.zh: 保护知识产权是头等大事。

intellectualism.t: n. 唯智主义，理智主义

e.en: His writing has been criticized for cold {intellectualism}.
e.zh: 他的作品被批评为过于冷峻的理性主义。

e.en: Anti-{intellectualism} has grown on social media.
e.zh: 反智倾向在社交媒体上越发明显。

intellectualization.t: n. 理智化（处理情感的方式）

e.en: His constant {intellectualization} hides real emotional pain.
e.zh: 他不断的理智化掩盖了真实的情感痛苦。

e.en: Therapists often spot {intellectualization} as a defense mechanism.
e.zh: 治疗师常将理智化视为一种防御机制。

intellectualize.t: v. 使理智化，作纯理性分析

e.en: Don't {intellectualize} every argument with your partner.
e.zh: 别把和伴侣的每次争吵都理性化。

e.en: He tends to {intellectualize} feelings instead of expressing them.
e.zh: 他倾向于把情感理智化,而不是表达出来。

intellectualized.t:
adj. 被理智化的
v. 理智化（过去式）

e.en: She {intellectualized} the breakup to avoid feeling sad.
e.zh: 她把分手理智化,以避免感到难过。

e.en: The film {intellectualized} grief into cold philosophy.
e.zh: 这部电影把悲伤理智化成冷冰冰的哲学。

e.en: The puzzle was {intellectually} satisfying to solve.
e.zh: 解开这道谜题在思想上很有满足感。

e.en: They are {intellectually} curious about everything online.
e.zh: 他们对网上的一切都充满求知欲。

interannual.t: adj. 年际的；年与年之间的

e.en: Scientists study {interannual} variations in rainfall patterns.
e.zh: 科学家研究降雨模式的年际变化。

e.en: The data shows significant {interannual} temperature differences.
e.zh: 数据显示出明显的年际温度差异。

e.en: The simulation models {interatomic} forces in the crystal.
e.zh: 该模拟模拟了晶体中的原子间作用力。

e.en: Heat changes the {interatomic} distances in the metal.
e.zh: 热量会改变金属中原子之间的距离。

e.en: The brain uses {interaural} time differences to locate sounds.
e.zh: 大脑利用双耳时间差来定位声音。

e.en: Headphones simulate {interaural} cues for spatial audio.
e.zh: 耳机通过模拟双耳线索实现空间音效。

interbank.t: adj. 银行同业的；银行间的

e.en: The {interbank} lending rate dropped sharply this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上银行同业拆借利率大幅下降。

e.en: Most {interbank} transfers settle within a few hours.
e.zh: 大多数银行间转账会在几小时内到账。

interbreed.t: v. (不同物种) 杂交；异种交配

e.en: Wolves and dogs sometimes {interbreed} in the wild.
e.zh: 狼和狗在野外有时会杂交。

e.en: Closely related species often {interbreed} to produce hybrids.
e.zh: 亲缘关系近的物种常会杂交产生混血后代。

e.en: Editors {intercalate} extra pages between the original chapters.
e.zh: 编辑在原有章节之间插入了额外的页面。

e.en: Lithium ions {intercalate} into the layered battery material.
e.zh: 锂离子嵌入分层的电池材料中。

intercede.t: v. 代为求情；从中调解

e.en: She tried to {intercede} on her brother's behalf.
e.zh: 她试图为她的弟弟出面求情。

e.en: The teacher had to {intercede} to stop the argument.
e.zh: 老师不得不出面调解以平息争吵。

e.en: Hormones travel through {intercellular} spaces in the tissue.
e.zh: 荷尔蒙在组织的细胞间隙中传递。

e.en: The drug disrupts {intercellular} communication between tumor cells.
e.zh: 该药物会干扰肿瘤细胞之间的胞间通讯。

intercept.t:
v. 拦截；截获
n. 截距

e.en: Fighter jets scrambled to {intercept} the unidentified aircraft.
e.zh: 战斗机紧急起飞拦截那架不明飞机。

e.en: Hackers can {intercept} messages on unsecured Wi-Fi networks.
e.zh: 黑客可以在不安全的 Wi-Fi 上拦截信息。

intercepted.t: adj. 被截获的；被拦截的

e.en: The defender {intercepted} the pass and scored a goal.
e.zh: 后卫断下传球后破门得分。

e.en: Authorities {intercepted} a shipment of illegal weapons yesterday.
e.zh: 当局昨天截获了一批非法武器。

e.en: His last-minute {interception} saved the team from defeat.
e.zh: 他在最后一刻的拦截让球队免于失利。

e.en: Email {interception} is a serious security concern for businesses.
e.zh: 电子邮件被截获是企业面临的严重安全隐患。

e.en: The new {interceptor} can shoot down incoming missiles.
e.zh: 这款新型拦截器可以击落来袭导弹。

e.en: Add an {interceptor} to log every API request automatically.
e.zh: 添加一个拦截器以自动记录每个 API 请求。

e.en: Through her {intercession}, the prisoners were eventually released.
e.zh: 经过她的从中斡旋，囚犯最终获释。

e.en: Many believers ask saints for {intercession} during hard times.
e.zh: 许多信徒在艰难时刻祈求圣徒代祷。

e.en: The diplomat acted as an {intercessor} between the two nations.
e.zh: 这位外交官在两国之间充当调停者。

e.en: She served as a faithful {intercessor} for the community.
e.zh: 她为这个社区担任虔诚的代祷者。

intercessory.t: adj. 代为求情的；代祷的

e.en: The church holds {intercessory} prayers every Wednesday evening.
e.zh: 教堂每周三晚上举行代祷祈祷会。

e.en: He took on an {intercessory} role during the labor dispute.
e.zh: 他在劳资纠纷中扮演了调解的角色。

interchange.t:
n. 交换；立交桥
v. 互换

e.en: Traffic was backed up at the highway {interchange} all morning.
e.zh: 高速公路立交桥处整个上午都在堵车。

e.en: The conference encourages free {interchange} of ideas among researchers.
e.zh: 会议鼓励研究人员之间自由交流想法。

e.en: The {interchangeability} of parts makes repairs much cheaper.
e.zh: 零件的互换性使维修便宜得多。

e.en: Designers value the {interchangeability} of these modular components.
e.zh: 设计师看重这些模块化组件的可互换性。

interchangeable.t: adj. 可互换的；可替换的

e.en: The two terms are essentially {interchangeable} in casual speech.
e.zh: 这两个词在日常口语中基本可以互换使用。

e.en: This camera comes with three {interchangeable} lenses.
e.zh: 这款相机配有三个可更换镜头。

e.en: People often use these words {interchangeably}, though they differ slightly.
e.zh: 人们常把这些词混用，尽管它们略有差别。

e.en: The two batteries can be used {interchangeably} in this device.
e.zh: 这两块电池在该设备中可以互换使用。

intercity.t: adj. 城市之间的；城际的

e.en: The {intercity} train service has been expanded to weekends.
e.zh: 城际列车服务已扩展到周末运营。

e.en: Many commuters rely on {intercity} buses to get to work.
e.zh: 许多上班族依靠城际巴士通勤上班。

e.en: They sailed the {intercoastal} waterway from Florida to Maine.
e.zh: 他们沿沿岸内河水道从佛罗里达航行到缅因。

e.en: The {intercoastal} route avoids the rough open ocean.
e.zh: 这条沿海岸航线避开了汹涌的外海。

intercollegiate.t: adj. 大学之间的；校际的

e.en: She competes in {intercollegiate} swimming championships every spring.
e.zh: 她每年春天都参加大学间的游泳锦标赛。

e.en: The school joined an {intercollegiate} debate league last year.
e.zh: 学校去年加入了一个高校间辩论联盟。

intercom.t: n. 对讲机；内部通话系统

e.en: Press the button on the {intercom} to call the office.
e.zh: 按对讲机上的按钮就能呼叫办公室。

e.en: The principal made an announcement over the school {intercom}.
e.zh: 校长通过学校的广播对讲系统发布了通知。

e.en: {Intercommunal} tensions have grown after the recent elections.
e.zh: 近期选举之后社群之间的紧张关系有所加剧。

e.en: The festival promotes {intercommunal} understanding through shared meals.
e.zh: 这个节日通过共餐促进社群间的相互理解。

e.en: These cables {interconnect} all the servers in the data center.
e.zh: 这些线缆将数据中心的所有服务器相互连接起来。

e.en: Highways {interconnect} the major cities across the region.
e.zh: 高速公路把该地区主要城市互相连接起来。

interconnected.t: adj. 相互连接的；彼此关联的

e.en: Modern economies are deeply {interconnected} through global trade.
e.zh: 现代经济通过全球贸易紧密相连。

e.en: The brain consists of billions of {interconnected} neurons.
e.zh: 大脑由数十亿个相互连接的神经元组成。

e.en: The pandemic revealed the {interconnectedness} of supply chains worldwide.
e.zh: 疫情揭示了全球供应链的相互关联性。

e.en: Buddhism emphasizes the {interconnectedness} of all living things.
e.zh: 佛教强调一切众生之间的相互联系。

e.en: A maze of {interconnecting} tunnels runs beneath the old city.
e.zh: 老城下方有迷宫般相互连通的隧道。

e.en: The hotel rooms have {interconnecting} doors for families.
e.zh: 酒店房间配有连通门，方便家庭入住。

e.en: The {interconnection} between climate and migration is becoming clearer.
e.zh: 气候与移民之间的关联正变得越来越明显。

e.en: Engineers tested every {interconnection} on the circuit board.
e.zh: 工程师测试了电路板上每一处连接点。

e.en: Smart devices rely on seamless {interconnectivity} to work properly.
e.zh: 智能设备依靠无缝互联才能正常工作。

e.en: The new protocol improves {interconnectivity} between different platforms.
e.zh: 新协议提升了不同平台之间的互联互通能力。

e.en: She booked an {intercontinental} flight from Tokyo to Paris.
e.zh: 她订了一张从东京到巴黎的洲际航班。

e.en: The treaty bans testing of {intercontinental} ballistic missiles.
e.zh: 该条约禁止试验洲际弹道导弹。

intercooler.t: n. 中冷器（发动机部件）

e.en: The turbocharged engine uses an {intercooler} to boost efficiency.
e.zh: 这台涡轮增压发动机使用中冷器来提升效率。

e.en: A larger {intercooler} keeps intake temperatures lower under load.
e.zh: 更大的中冷器能在高负荷下保持进气温度更低。

intercorrelation.t: n. 相互关联；交互相关

e.en: Researchers found a strong {intercorrelation} between the two variables.
e.zh: 研究人员发现两个变量之间存在很强的相关性。

e.en: The survey revealed surprising {intercorrelation} among the answers.
e.zh: 问卷调查揭示出各项答案之间令人意外的关联性。

e.en: The runner pulled an {intercostal} muscle during the race.
e.zh: 那名跑者在比赛中拉伤了肋间肌。

e.en: Doctors inserted the needle between the {intercostal} spaces.
e.zh: 医生将针插入肋间隙中。

e.en: Trade fostered cultural {intercourse} between the two ancient civilizations.
e.zh: 贸易促进了两个古代文明之间的文化交流。

e.en: Diplomatic {intercourse} resumed after years of tense silence.
e.zh: 经过多年紧张的沉默之后，外交往来恢复了。

e.en: Farmers practice {intercropping} to improve soil health and yields.
e.zh: 农民通过间作来改善土壤健康并提高产量。

e.en: {Intercropping} corn with beans is a traditional farming method.
e.zh: 玉米与豆类间作是一种传统的耕作方式。

e.en: Studying abroad builds valuable {intercultural} communication skills.
e.zh: 出国留学能培养宝贵的跨文化沟通能力。

e.en: The festival celebrates {intercultural} friendship through music and food.
e.zh: 这个节日通过音乐和美食庆祝跨文化的友谊。

e.en: The film {intercut} flashbacks with present-day scenes.
e.zh: 这部电影把回忆和当下的场景交叉剪辑在一起。

e.en: Editors {intercut} interviews with archival footage for impact.
e.zh: 剪辑师把采访片段与档案影像交错剪辑以增强效果。

e.en: The {interdenominational} service welcomed Christians of every tradition.
e.zh: 这场跨宗派礼拜欢迎各传统的基督徒参加。

e.en: They run an {interdenominational} charity helping homeless families.
e.zh: 他们经营一家跨宗派慈善机构，帮助无家可归的家庭。

e.en: The {interdepartmental} meeting addressed budget cuts across teams.
e.zh: 跨部门会议讨论了各团队的预算削减问题。

e.en: Better {interdepartmental} communication would solve many of our problems.
e.zh: 加强部门间的沟通可以解决我们的很多问题。

interdependence.t: n. 相互依赖；互相依存

e.en: Globalization has increased economic {interdependence} between countries.
e.zh: 全球化加深了各国之间的经济相互依赖。

e.en: The ecosystem demonstrates the {interdependence} of plants and animals.
e.zh: 这个生态系统体现了动植物之间的相互依存关系。

e.en: The team mapped every {interdependency} between the software modules.
e.zh: 团队梳理了软件模块之间的每一项相互依赖关系。

e.en: Climate and agriculture share a deep {interdependency}.
e.zh: 气候和农业之间存在着深刻的相互依存关系。

e.en: The two companies have become highly {interdependent} over time.
e.zh: 两家公司随着时间推移变得高度相互依赖。

e.en: Healthy ecosystems are made up of {interdependent} species.
e.zh: 健康的生态系统由相互依存的物种组成。

interdict.t:
n. 禁令
v. 禁止；拦截

e.en: Coast guard ships {interdict} smugglers before they reach shore.
e.zh: 海岸警卫队的船只在走私者靠岸前进行拦截。

e.en: The court issued an {interdict} banning further demolition work.
e.zh: 法院发出禁令，禁止进一步的拆除工作。

e.en: Drug {interdiction} efforts have intensified along the southern border.
e.zh: 南部边境的毒品拦截行动已经加强。

e.en: Naval {interdiction} stopped the weapons shipment from reaching port.
e.zh: 海军的拦截行动阻止了这批武器抵达港口。

interdisciplinary.t: adj. 跨学科的；多学科的

e.en: Climate research requires an {interdisciplinary} approach across many fields.
e.zh: 气候研究需要跨越多个领域的跨学科方法。

e.en: She enrolled in an {interdisciplinary} program combining biology and computer science.
e.zh: 她报读了一个结合生物学和计算机科学的跨学科项目。

interest.t:
n. 兴趣；利息
v. 使感兴趣

e.en: She showed great {interest} in learning Mandarin.
e.zh: 她对学习普通话表现出浓厚的兴趣。

e.en: The savings account earns 3% {interest} per year.
e.zh: 这个储蓄账户每年有3%的利息。

e.en: Are you {interested} in joining our book club?
e.zh: 你有兴趣加入我们的读书会吗？

e.en: He seemed genuinely {interested} in her research project.
e.zh: 他似乎真的对她的研究项目感兴趣。

e.en: The child watched the magician {interestedly} for an hour.
e.zh: 那孩子兴致勃勃地看了魔术师一个小时。

e.en: She listened {interestedly} as he described his trip to Japan.
e.zh: 她饶有兴趣地听他描述日本之行。

interesting.t: adj. 有趣的；引人入胜的

e.en: That's an {interesting} idea worth exploring further.
e.zh: 这是个有趣的想法，值得进一步探讨。

e.en: The documentary made science feel {interesting} and accessible.
e.zh: 这部纪录片让科学变得有趣又易懂。

interestingly.t: adv. 有趣地；有意思的是

e.en: {Interestingly}, the older version actually ran faster.
e.zh: 有意思的是，旧版本反而跑得更快。

e.en: The data tells the story quite {interestingly} when visualized.
e.zh: 数据可视化后，故事讲得相当生动。

interests.t:
n. 兴趣；利益
v. 使感兴趣

e.en: Her hobbies and {interests} include hiking and photography.
e.zh: 她的爱好和兴趣包括徒步和摄影。

e.en: The new policy serves the {interests} of small businesses.
e.zh: 这项新政策符合小企业的利益。

interface.t:
n. 界面；接口
v. 交互、对接

e.en: The new app has a clean, intuitive {interface}.
e.zh: 这款新应用界面简洁直观。

e.en: This adapter provides an {interface} between the two systems.
e.zh: 这个适配器在两个系统之间提供接口。

e.en: Modern voice {interfaces} let you control devices hands-free.
e.zh: 现代语音接口让你免提控制设备。

e.en: The library {interfaces} smoothly with our existing codebase.
e.zh: 这个库能与我们现有代码顺畅对接。

e.en: Researchers studied the {interfacial} tension between oil and water.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了油水之间的界面张力。

e.en: {Interfacial} bonding determines the strength of the composite material.
e.zh: 界面结合决定了复合材料的强度。

interfacing.t:
v. 对接、交互
n. 接口处理

e.en: Our team is {interfacing} with the client all week.
e.zh: 我们团队这周一直在和客户对接。

e.en: Add some {interfacing} to stiffen the collar before sewing.
e.zh: 在缝制前给领口加些衬布以增强硬挺度。

interfaith.t: adj. 跨宗教的；不同信仰之间的

e.en: The city hosted an {interfaith} dialogue on community values.
e.zh: 该市举办了一场关于社区价值观的跨宗教对话。

e.en: They had a beautiful {interfaith} wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 他们举行了一场美丽的跨宗教婚礼。

e.en: Please don't {interfere} with my work right now.
e.zh: 现在请不要打扰我的工作。

e.en: Loud noises can {interfere} with the baby's sleep.
e.zh: 吵闹声会干扰宝宝的睡眠。

e.en: Bad weather {interfered} with our travel plans.
e.zh: 恶劣天气打乱了我们的旅行计划。

e.en: She never {interfered} in her children's career choices.
e.zh: 她从不干涉孩子们的职业选择。

e.en: The radio signal had too much {interference} to understand.
e.zh: 无线电信号干扰太大，根本听不清。

e.en: We don't appreciate government {interference} in private affairs.
e.zh: 我们不希望政府干涉私人事务。

e.en: Multiple {interferences} disrupted the live broadcast last night.
e.zh: 昨晚多重干扰打断了现场直播。

e.en: Engineers identified several electromagnetic {interferences} in the device.
e.zh: 工程师在设备中发现了几处电磁干扰。

interferes.t: v. 干扰、干涉（第三人称单数）

e.en: Constant phone use {interferes} with quality family time.
e.zh: 频繁使用手机会影响家庭相处的质量。

e.en: Nothing {interferes} with her morning workout routine.
e.zh: 没有什么能打乱她晨练的习惯。

interfering.t:
v. 干扰中
adj. 爱管闲事的

e.en: Stop {interfering} in matters that don't concern you.
e.zh: 别再插手与你无关的事情了。

e.en: The {interfering} neighbor always commented on our garden.
e.zh: 那位爱管闲事的邻居总对我们的花园评头论足。

e.en: The {interferometer} can detect tiny gravitational waves from space.
e.zh: 这台干涉仪能探测来自太空的微弱引力波。

e.en: Scientists use a laser {interferometer} to measure precise distances.
e.zh: 科学家用激光干涉仪精确测量距离。

e.en: The telescope uses {interferometric} techniques for higher resolution.
e.zh: 该望远镜采用干涉测量技术以获得更高分辨率。

e.en: {Interferometric} measurements revealed minute changes in the surface.
e.zh: 干涉测量法揭示了表面的细微变化。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {interferon} to boost her immune response.
e.zh: 医生开了干扰素来增强她的免疫反应。

e.en: {Interferon} therapy has helped many hepatitis patients recover.
e.zh: 干扰素疗法帮助许多肝炎患者康复。

e.en: The movie features an epic {intergalactic} space battle.
e.zh: 这部电影呈现了一场史诗般的星系间太空大战。

e.en: Scientists detected mysterious signals from {intergalactic} space.
e.zh: 科学家在星系际空间探测到神秘信号。

e.en: The community center promotes {intergenerational} friendships through shared activities.
e.zh: 社区中心通过共同活动促进跨代友谊。

e.en: {Intergenerational} wealth gaps continue to widen in many countries.
e.zh: 许多国家的代际财富差距仍在扩大。

e.en: We are currently living in an {interglacial} period.
e.zh: 我们目前正处于一个间冰期。

e.en: Forests expanded rapidly during the warm {interglacial} epoch.
e.zh: 温暖的间冰期里森林迅速扩张。

e.en: The {intergovernmental} panel released its annual climate report.
e.zh: 该政府间委员会发布了年度气候报告。

e.en: Trade disputes are usually resolved through {intergovernmental} negotiations.
e.zh: 贸易争端通常通过政府间谈判解决。

e.en: The workshop aimed to reduce {intergroup} conflict on campus.
e.zh: 该工作坊旨在减少校园内的群体间冲突。

e.en: Researchers study {intergroup} dynamics to understand prejudice.
e.zh: 研究人员通过群体间互动来理解偏见。

interim.t:
adj. 临时的；过渡的
n. 过渡期间

e.en: She was appointed {interim} CEO until a replacement is found.
e.zh: 在找到接任者之前，她被任命为临时首席执行官。

e.en: In the {interim}, please use the old login system.
e.zh: 在此期间，请使用旧的登录系统。

interior.t:
n. 内部；室内
adj. 内部的

e.en: The car's {interior} feels surprisingly luxurious for the price.
e.zh: 这辆车的内饰对于这个价位来说出乎意料地豪华。

e.en: She studied {interior} design at art school.
e.zh: 她在艺术学院学习室内设计。

interiorize.t: v. 内化；使成为内心的一部分

e.en: Children gradually {interiorize} the values of their parents.
e.zh: 孩子们会逐渐内化父母的价值观。

e.en: Therapy helped him {interiorize} a healthier sense of self.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他内化出更健康的自我认知。

e.en: The chamber was decorated {interiorly} with golden mosaics.
e.zh: 这间厅堂内部以金色马赛克装饰。

e.en: She {interiorly} debated whether to accept the offer.
e.zh: 她在心里反复考虑要不要接受这份邀约。

e.en: The magazine showcases stunning home {interiors} from around the world.
e.zh: 这本杂志展示了世界各地令人惊艳的家居内饰。

e.en: He paints quiet {interiors} bathed in afternoon light.
e.zh: 他画的是沐浴在午后阳光中的静谧室内场景。

e.en: May I {interject} a quick question here?
e.zh: 我能在这里插一个简短的问题吗？

e.en: She tried to {interject} but no one was listening.
e.zh: 她想插话，但没人在听。

e.en: "That's not true," he {interjected} firmly.
e.zh: "那不是真的，"他坚定地插话道。

e.en: Mom {interjected} a reminder about dinner plans.
e.zh: 妈妈插话提醒了一下晚餐安排。

e.en: Stop {interjecting} while I'm trying to explain the rules.
e.zh: 我在解释规则的时候，别老打岔。

e.en: He kept {interjecting} jokes throughout the serious meeting.
e.zh: 严肃的会议中他一直在插科打诨。

e.en: "Wow" is a common English {interjection} expressing surprise.
e.zh: "Wow"是一个常见的表示惊讶的英语感叹词。

e.en: Her sudden {interjection} changed the direction of the debate.
e.zh: 她突然的插话改变了辩论的走向。

e.en: The teacher explained common {interjections} like "oh" and "ouch".
e.zh: 老师讲解了"oh"和"ouch"等常见感叹词。

e.en: His speech was punctuated by enthusiastic {interjections} from the crowd.
e.zh: 他的演讲不时被人群热烈的插话打断。

interjects.t: v. 插话（第三人称单数）

e.en: She often {interjects} witty comments during team meetings.
e.zh: 她经常在团队会议中插入机智的评论。

e.en: The narrator occasionally {interjects} personal observations into the story.
e.zh: 叙述者偶尔会在故事中插入个人见解。

e.en: They {interlace} their fingers as they walk along the beach.
e.zh: 他们沿海滩散步时十指相扣。

e.en: The weaver carefully {interlaces} red and gold threads.
e.zh: 织工小心地将红色和金色丝线交织在一起。

interlaced.t: adj. 交织的；隔行扫描的

e.en: The garden path was {interlaced} with climbing roses.
e.zh: 花园小径上交织缠绕着攀爬的玫瑰。

e.en: Old TVs displayed {interlaced} video at 30 frames per second.
e.zh: 老式电视以每秒30帧的隔行扫描方式显示视频。

e.en: Try to {interleave} study sessions with short breaks.
e.zh: 试着在学习时段之间穿插短暂的休息。

e.en: The book {interleaves} two parallel storylines beautifully.
e.zh: 这本书把两条平行的故事线巧妙地交织在一起。

e.en: {Interleukin} levels rise during inflammation in the body.
e.zh: 身体发炎时白细胞介素水平会上升。

e.en: Researchers are testing a new {interleukin} treatment for arthritis.
e.zh: 研究人员正在测试一种治疗关节炎的新型白细胞介素疗法。

e.en: I requested the rare book through {interlibrary} loan.
e.zh: 我通过馆际互借申请了这本珍稀图书。

e.en: Most universities offer {interlibrary} services to their students.
e.zh: 大多数大学都为学生提供馆际互借服务。

e.en: The Bible has {interlinear} translations between the original and English.
e.zh: 这本圣经在原文和英文之间有逐行对照翻译。

e.en: Students used the {interlinear} text to study Greek grammar.
e.zh: 学生们用对照译本学习希腊语语法。

e.en: These two databases {interlink} customer and order information.
e.zh: 这两个数据库将客户和订单信息互相关联。

e.en: Climate and economy {interlink} in unexpected ways.
e.zh: 气候与经济以意想不到的方式相互关联。

e.en: Modern supply chains are deeply {interlinked} across continents.
e.zh: 现代供应链在各大洲之间深度互联。

e.en: All her novels are subtly {interlinked} through recurring characters.
e.zh: 她的所有小说都通过反复出现的角色微妙地相互关联。

e.en: The puzzle pieces {interlock} perfectly to form a picture.
e.zh: 拼图块完美咬合形成一幅图画。

e.en: Safety {interlock} systems prevent the machine from starting accidentally.
e.zh: 安全联锁系统可防止机器意外启动。

e.en: Their fingers {interlocked} as they watched the sunset.
e.zh: 他们看日落时十指紧扣。

e.en: The two issues are deeply {interlocked} and hard to separate.
e.zh: 这两个问题深度交织，难以分开处理。

e.en: The Olympic logo features five {interlocking} colored rings.
e.zh: 奥运标志由五个相互交扣的彩色圆环组成。

e.en: Children love building with {interlocking} plastic bricks.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢用相互嵌扣的塑料积木搭东西。

e.en: My {interlocutor} on the panel raised an excellent point.
e.zh: 小组讨论中我的对话者提出了一个绝妙的观点。

e.en: She proved to be a thoughtful and challenging {interlocutor}.
e.zh: 她证明自己是一位思虑周全且富有挑战性的对话者。

interlocutory.t: adj. 对话的；(法) 中间判决的

e.en: The judge issued an {interlocutory} order pending the final ruling.
e.zh: 在最终裁决前，法官发出了一项中间命令。

e.en: Lawyers filed an {interlocutory} appeal to delay the trial.
e.zh: 律师提出中间上诉以推迟审判。

interlope.t: v. 闯入；干涉他人事务

e.en: Strangers sometimes {interlope} on private family gatherings uninvited.
e.zh: 陌生人有时会不请自来地闯入私人家庭聚会。

e.en: Don't {interlope} where you clearly aren't welcome.
e.zh: 别去那种明显不受欢迎的地方插一脚。

e.en: The villagers treated the journalist as an unwelcome {interloper}.
e.zh: 村民们把那位记者当作不受欢迎的闯入者。

e.en: A clever {interloper} slipped into the private auction.
e.zh: 一个机灵的闯入者溜进了那场私人拍卖会。

e.en: The café offered a quiet {interlude} between back-to-back meetings.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆为连轴的会议提供了片刻安宁的间歇。

e.en: A short musical {interlude} played before the second act.
e.zh: 第二幕开始前播放了一段简短的音乐间奏。

e.en: The film uses dreamy {interludes} to break up the action.
e.zh: 这部电影用如梦的插曲段落来调节紧张的情节。

e.en: Brief comedy {interludes} kept the long ceremony lively.
e.zh: 短小的喜剧穿插让冗长的典礼保持活力。

e.en: {Intermarriage} between the two clans gradually eased old tensions.
e.zh: 两个家族之间的通婚逐渐缓和了旧日的紧张关系。

e.en: Historians study how {intermarriage} reshaped medieval royal alliances.
e.zh: 史学家研究通婚如何重塑了中世纪的王室联盟。

interrogatory.t:
n. 质询书；审问
adj. 疑问的

e.en: The lawyer sent an {interrogatory} to the opposing party last week.
e.zh: 律师上周向对方当事人发出了一份质询书。

e.en: She shot him an {interrogatory} glance across the dinner table.
e.zh: 她隔着餐桌向他投去询问的目光。

interrupt.t:
v. 打断；中断
n. 中断（信号）

e.en: Please don't {interrupt} me while I'm on the phone.
e.zh: 我打电话时请不要打断我。

e.en: A power outage can {interrupt} the entire production line.
e.zh: 一次停电就可能中断整条生产线。

e.en: The meeting was {interrupted} by a sudden fire alarm.
e.zh: 会议被突然响起的火警警报打断了。

e.en: She {interrupted} him politely to ask a quick question.
e.zh: 她礼貌地打断他,问了一个简短的问题。

e.en: My coworker is a chronic {interrupter} during team meetings.
e.zh: 我的同事在团队会议上总爱打断别人。

e.en: The circuit {interrupter} cuts power instantly when it detects a fault.
e.zh: 断路器一检测到故障就立即切断电源。

e.en: The download is {interruptible} and will resume from where it stopped.
e.zh: 下载可中断,会从停止的位置继续。

e.en: Background tasks should be {interruptible} so users can cancel them.
e.zh: 后台任务应当可中断,以便用户取消。

interrupting.t: v. 打断（interrupt 的现在分词）

e.en: Sorry for {interrupting}, but there's an urgent call for you.
e.zh: 抱歉打断一下,有个紧急电话找你。

e.en: The dog kept {interrupting} my video call by barking.
e.zh: 那只狗一直吠叫,打断了我的视频通话。

e.en: She finished her speech without a single {interruption}.
e.zh: 她完成了演讲,没有被打断一次。

e.en: A brief {interruption} in service is expected during the upgrade.
e.zh: 升级期间预计会有短暂的服务中断。

e.en: Frequent {interruptions} make it hard to focus on deep work.
e.zh: 频繁的打扰让人难以专注做深度工作。

e.en: The Wi-Fi has had several {interruptions} this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上Wi-Fi断了好几次。

interrupts.t: v./n. 打断；中断（第三人称/复数）

e.en: He always {interrupts} me before I finish my sentence.
e.zh: 他总是不等我说完就打断我。

e.en: The operating system handles hardware {interrupts} efficiently.
e.zh: 操作系统能高效处理硬件中断。

e.en: Our school won the {interscholastic} debate championship this year.
e.zh: 我们学校今年赢得了校际辩论冠军。

e.en: He plays in several {interscholastic} sports leagues every season.
e.zh: 他每个赛季都参加几个校际体育联赛。

e.en: Two roads {intersect} just outside the small village.
e.zh: 两条路在小村庄外交汇。

e.en: Their interests {intersect} in surprising and creative ways.
e.zh: 他们的兴趣以出人意料的有趣方式交织在一起。

e.en: The hiking trail {intersected} a quiet country road.
e.zh: 那条徒步小径与一条安静的乡间小路相交。

e.en: Her career path {intersected} with mine at a tech conference.
e.zh: 她的职业道路在一次科技大会上与我交汇。

e.en: The two {intersecting} streets form the busiest junction downtown.
e.zh: 这两条相交的街道构成市中心最繁忙的路口。

e.en: The novel explores {intersecting} stories of three immigrant families.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述三个移民家庭交织的故事。

e.en: Turn left at the next {intersection} to reach the museum.
e.zh: 在下一个路口左转就能到博物馆。

e.en: Her work sits at the {intersection} of art and technology.
e.zh: 她的作品处于艺术与科技的交汇处。

e.en: Many city {intersections} now have cameras to catch red-light runners.
e.zh: 许多城市路口现在装了摄像头抓拍闯红灯的人。

e.en: The book examines the {intersections} of race, gender, and class.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了种族、性别与阶级的交叉点。

intersession.t: n. 学期之间的短期课程

e.en: Many students take short courses during the winter {intersession}.
e.zh: 许多学生在冬季学期间会修一些短期课程。

e.en: The campus is quieter during {intersession} between semesters.
e.zh: 学期之间的间歇期里,校园安静许多。

e.en: The clinic offers specialized care for {intersex} children and their families.
e.zh: 该诊所为间性儿童及其家庭提供专门护理。

e.en: Activists are pushing for greater legal recognition of {intersex} people.
e.zh: 活动人士正在推动给予间性者更多法律认可。

intersexual.t: adj. 间性的；两性之间的

e.en: The documentary highlights the experiences of {intersexual} individuals worldwide.
e.zh: 这部纪录片展现了世界各地间性者的经历。

e.en: Researchers study {intersexual} traits in several mammal species.
e.zh: 研究人员在多种哺乳动物中研究间性特征。

interspecific.t: adj. 种间的（不同物种间的）

e.en: Biologists observed {interspecific} cooperation between birds and dolphins.
e.zh: 生物学家观察到鸟类与海豚之间的种间合作。

e.en: {Interspecific} competition often drives evolutionary change in ecosystems.
e.zh: 种间竞争常常推动生态系统的演化变化。

e.en: Try to {intersperse} short walks throughout your workday.
e.zh: 试着在工作日中穿插几次短途散步。

e.en: The chef likes to {intersperse} sweet and savory dishes on the menu.
e.zh: 那位厨师喜欢在菜单上穿插搭配甜咸菜肴。

interspersed.t: adj. 散布其间的；穿插的

e.en: The lecture was {interspersed} with funny personal anecdotes.
e.zh: 讲座中穿插着一些有趣的个人小故事。

e.en: Wildflowers were {interspersed} among the tall grass in the meadow.
e.zh: 草地上高高的草丛中点缀着野花。

intersperses.t: v. 穿插；点缀（第三人称单数）

e.en: The author {intersperses} historical facts throughout her romantic novels.
e.zh: 这位作者在她的爱情小说中穿插了大量历史事实。

e.en: He {intersperses} his speeches with quotes from famous philosophers.
e.zh: 他在演讲中穿插引用著名哲学家的名言。

interspersing.t: v. 穿插；点缀（现在分词）

e.en: She kept the kids engaged by {interspersing} games with the lessons.
e.zh: 她在课程中穿插游戏,让孩子们保持专注。

e.en: The director plays with time by {interspersing} flashbacks throughout the film.
e.zh: 导演通过在片中穿插闪回来玩转时间。

interstate.t:
adj. 州际的
n. 州际公路

e.en: We took the {interstate} to save time on the long drive.
e.zh: 我们走州际公路,为长途驾驶节省时间。

e.en: The new law affects {interstate} commerce across the entire country.
e.zh: 新法律影响全国范围内的州际商业。

e.en: Scientists are designing probes for future {interstellar} missions.
e.zh: 科学家正在为未来的星际任务设计探测器。

e.en: The novel imagines an {interstellar} civilization spanning a thousand worlds.
e.zh: 这部小说想象了一个横跨千个星球的星际文明。

e.en: Tiny moss grew in every {interstice} between the old stones.
e.zh: 每条古老石缝间都长出了小小的青苔。

e.en: He found quiet moments in the {interstice} of a busy schedule.
e.zh: 他在繁忙日程的间隙中找到了片刻宁静。

interstitial.t:
adj. 间隙的
n. 插播广告

e.en: The app shows an {interstitial} ad between game levels.
e.zh: 这款应用在游戏关卡之间会显示插页广告。

e.en: Doctors found fluid in the {interstitial} space of her lungs.
e.zh: 医生发现她的肺间质间隙有积液。

intersubjective.t: adj. 主体间的；交互主观的

e.en: Money has value largely because of {intersubjective} agreement among people.
e.zh: 金钱之所以有价值,主要源于人们之间的主体间共识。

e.en: Therapists pay close attention to {intersubjective} dynamics in sessions.
e.zh: 治疗师在咨询中会密切关注主体间的互动动态。

e.en: Philosophers debate the role of {intersubjectivity} in shared reality.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论主体间性在共享现实中的作用。

e.en: Effective teamwork relies on a strong sense of {intersubjectivity}.
e.zh: 高效的团队合作依赖于强烈的主体间性。

e.en: The poem functions as an {intertext} with several biblical passages.
e.zh: 这首诗与多段圣经文本形成互文关系。

e.en: She analyzed the film as an {intertext} of older war movies.
e.zh: 她将这部电影解读为旧战争片的互文文本。

e.en: The novel is full of {intertextual} references to Shakespeare's plays.
e.zh: 这部小说中充满了对莎士比亚戏剧的互文引用。

e.en: Music videos often rely on {intertextual} jokes that fans recognize.
e.zh: 音乐录影带常常依赖粉丝才能认出的互文笑点。

e.en: {Intertextuality} is a key concept in modern literary theory.
e.zh: 互文性是现代文学理论中的一个核心概念。

e.en: The director uses {intertextuality} to comment on classic Hollywood films.
e.zh: 导演运用互文性来评价经典好莱坞电影。

e.en: Crabs and starfish thrive in the rocky {intertidal} zone.
e.zh: 螃蟹和海星在多岩石的潮间带繁衍生息。

e.en: The class studied {intertidal} life during low tide yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天退潮时,全班观察了潮间带的生物。

e.en: The festival celebrates {intertribal} dance traditions from across the region.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝来自该地区的部落间舞蹈传统。

e.en: Elders worked hard to resolve the {intertribal} land dispute peacefully.
e.zh: 长老们努力和平解决了部落之间的土地争端。

e.en: Their lives {intertwine} in unexpected ways throughout the story.
e.zh: 他们的生活在故事中以意想不到的方式交织在一起。

e.en: Climbing vines slowly {intertwine} around the wooden fence.
e.zh: 攀爬的藤蔓慢慢缠绕在木栅栏上。

intertwined.t: adj. 交织的；紧密相连的

e.en: Their fates have been deeply {intertwined} since childhood.
e.zh: 他们的命运从童年起就紧紧交织在一起。

e.en: Climate change and economic policy are closely {intertwined} issues.
e.zh: 气候变化与经济政策是紧密相连的议题。

e.en: The dancers moved with their arms {intertwining} gracefully overhead.
e.zh: 舞者们手臂在头顶优雅地交织着舞动。

e.en: The novel weaves {intertwining} stories from three different generations.
e.zh: 这部小说编织了来自三代人的交织故事。

e.en: The new {interurban} rail line connects four major cities.
e.zh: 这条新的城际铁路连接了四座大城市。

e.en: {Interurban} buses are cheaper than driving for most commuters.
e.zh: 对多数通勤者来说,城际巴士比开车更便宜。

e.en: Take your medicine at a six-hour {interval} every day.
e.zh: 每天间隔六小时服一次药。

e.en: There was a short {interval} between the two acts of the play.
e.zh: 话剧两幕之间有一段短暂的中场休息。

e.en: The bus arrives at fifteen-minute {intervals} during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段公交车每隔十五分钟一班。

e.en: Runners often train with high-intensity {intervals} to improve speed.
e.zh: 跑者常用高强度间歇训练来提高速度。

e.en: Teachers should {intervene} early when they notice bullying behavior.
e.zh: 老师发现欺凌行为时应当及早介入。

e.en: The central bank may {intervene} to stabilize the falling currency.
e.zh: 央行可能会出手干预,以稳定下跌的货币。

e.en: A passerby quickly {intervened} when he saw the argument escalating.
e.zh: 一位路人见争吵升级,迅速上前阻止。

e.en: The court {intervened} to protect the children's welfare.
e.zh: 法院介入以保障孩子们的福祉。

e.en: The court allowed the nonprofit to join the case as an {intervener}.
e.zh: 法院允许这家非营利组织作为参加人加入此案。

e.en: A skilled {intervener} can defuse most workplace conflicts.
e.zh: 一位熟练的调解者能化解大多数职场冲突。

intervenes.t: v. 干预（第三人称单数）

e.en: The government rarely {intervenes} in private business disputes.
e.zh: 政府很少介入私人商业纠纷。

e.en: She always {intervenes} when her kids start fighting over toys.
e.zh: 她的孩子们抢玩具吵架时,她总会出面调停。

intervening.t: adj. 介于中间的；期间的

e.en: A lot has changed in the {intervening} years since we last met.
e.zh: 我们上次见面后的这些年里发生了很多变化。

e.en: He hesitated about {intervening} in the heated family argument.
e.zh: 他犹豫着是否要介入那场激烈的家庭争吵。

e.en: The environmental group filed as an {intervenor} in the lawsuit.
e.zh: 该环保团体作为诉讼参加人提交了申请。

e.en: An {intervenor} can present evidence that supports neither original party.
e.zh: 参加人可以提交不支持任一原诉方的证据。

e.en: The doctor's quick {intervention} saved the patient's life.
e.zh: 医生及时的干预救了病人一命。

e.en: Friends staged an {intervention} to address his drinking problem.
e.zh: 朋友们组织了一次干预，劝他戒酒。

e.en: She specializes in {interventional} cardiology at the hospital.
e.zh: 她在医院专攻介入性心脏病学。

e.en: The clinic offers several {interventional} pain management procedures.
e.zh: 该诊所提供多种介入性疼痛治疗。

e.en: Critics argue against military {interventionism} in foreign conflicts.
e.zh: 批评者反对在外国冲突中实行军事干预主义。

e.en: His foreign policy openly rejected economic {interventionism}.
e.zh: 他的外交政策公开反对经济干预主义。

interventionist.t:
n. 干预主义者
adj. 主张干预的

e.en: The senator pushed an {interventionist} foreign policy agenda.
e.zh: 那位参议员推行干预主义的外交政策。

e.en: Many economists oppose {interventionist} approaches to free markets.
e.zh: 许多经济学家反对对自由市场采取干预主义做法。

interoperable.t: adj. 可互操作的（系统间）

e.en: These tools are fully {interoperable} with our existing systems.
e.zh: 这些工具与我们现有系统完全兼容互通。

e.en: Make sure the file format is {interoperable} across platforms.
e.zh: 确保文件格式在各平台之间能互通使用。

e.en: {Interorganizational} cooperation sped up the disaster response.
e.zh: 组织间的协作加快了灾害应对的速度。

e.en: The study examined {interorganizational} trust in supply chains.
e.zh: 该研究考察了供应链中组织间的信任关系。

e.en: Opposition members rose to {interpellate} the minister in parliament.
e.zh: 反对党议员起身在议会上向部长提出质询。

e.en: Lawmakers may {interpellate} officials about budget decisions.
e.zh: 议员可以就预算决定向官员提出质询。

e.en: The minister faced a sharp {interpellation} during the session.
e.zh: 部长在会议上遭到了尖锐的质询。

e.en: Her {interpellation} forced the government to clarify its policy.
e.zh: 她的质询迫使政府澄清了相关政策。

e.en: In modern cities, work and home life {interpenetrate} constantly.
e.zh: 在现代城市,工作与家庭生活不断相互渗透。

e.en: The two cultures began to {interpenetrate} after centuries of trade.
e.zh: 两种文化在数百年的贸易后开始相互渗透。

e.en: The novel explores the {interpenetration} of memory and reality.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了记忆与现实的相互渗透。

e.en: There's a deep {interpenetration} of art and technology today.
e.zh: 如今艺术与科技之间存在深度的相互渗透。

interpersonal.t: adj. 人际的；人与人之间的

e.en: Strong {interpersonal} skills matter more than your résumé.
e.zh: 出色的人际交往能力比简历更重要。

e.en: Remote work has reshaped {interpersonal} dynamics at the office.
e.zh: 远程办公重塑了办公室里的人际互动。

interphone.t: n. 内部通话器；对讲机

e.en: The pilot called the cabin crew over the {interphone}.
e.zh: 机长通过内部通话器呼叫了机舱乘务员。

e.en: Press the {interphone} button to speak with the front desk.
e.zh: 按下内线电话按钮即可与前台通话。

e.en: The probe is on an {interplanetary} mission to Jupiter.
e.zh: 这艘探测器正在执行飞往木星的行星际任务。

e.en: Engineers are designing engines for {interplanetary} travel.
e.zh: 工程师们正在设计用于行星际旅行的发动机。

interplay.t:
n. 相互作用；互动
v. 互相影响

e.en: The film captures the subtle {interplay} between light and shadow.
e.zh: 这部电影捕捉了光影之间微妙的相互作用。

e.en: There's a fascinating {interplay} of genes and environment.
e.zh: 基因与环境之间存在着引人入胜的相互作用。

e.en: {Interpol} issued a red notice for the fugitive banker.
e.zh: 国际刑警组织对那名潜逃的银行家发出了红色通缉令。

e.en: Local police are working with {Interpol} on the case.
e.zh: 当地警方正与国际刑警组织合作处理此案。

e.en: The software will {interpolate} missing data points automatically.
e.zh: 该软件会自动对缺失的数据点进行插值处理。

e.en: Editors sometimes {interpolate} comments into the original text.
e.zh: 编辑有时会在原文中插入注释。

e.en: The animator {interpolated} smooth frames between key poses.
e.zh: 动画师在关键姿势之间插入了平滑的过渡帧。

e.en: Scribes {interpolated} passages that aren't in the oldest manuscripts.
e.zh: 抄写员添加了一些最古老手稿中没有的段落。

e.en: Linear {interpolation} gives a quick estimate between two values.
e.zh: 线性插值能在两个数值之间快速给出估算。

e.en: That line looks like a later {interpolation} by an editor.
e.zh: 那一行看起来像是后来编辑添加的内容。

e.en: The judge had to {interpose} to stop the heated argument.
e.zh: 法官不得不出面打断这场激烈的争论。

e.en: She tried to {interpose} a question during the long speech.
e.zh: 她试图在长篇演讲中插话提一个问题。

e.en: The treaty banned the {interposition} of foreign troops in the region.
e.zh: 该条约禁止外国军队介入该地区。

e.en: His timely {interposition} prevented the deal from collapsing.
e.zh: 他及时的介入使这笔交易没有破裂。

e.en: It's hard to {interpret} her silence after the meeting.
e.zh: 很难解读她在会后保持沉默的含义。

e.en: The model can {interpret} handwritten notes with high accuracy.
e.zh: 该模型能高精度地识别手写笔记的内容。

e.en: {Interpretability} research helps us understand how models decide.
e.zh: 可解释性研究帮助我们理解模型是如何做决策的。

e.en: The team prioritizes {interpretability} over raw performance.
e.zh: 团队把可解释性放在原始性能之上。

e.en: We need {interpretable} models for high-stakes medical decisions.
e.zh: 高风险的医疗决策需要可解释的模型。

e.en: The chart should be {interpretable} to non-technical readers.
e.zh: 这张图表应当让非技术读者也能看懂。

e.en: In Peirce's theory, the {interpretant} is what a sign produces in the mind.
e.zh: 在皮尔斯的理论中,解释项是符号在心中产生的意义。

e.en: Each reader generates a different {interpretant} for the poem.
e.zh: 每位读者对这首诗都会产生不同的解释项。

e.en: Her {interpretation} of the song moved the entire audience.
e.zh: 她对这首歌的演绎打动了全场观众。

e.en: There's room for more than one {interpretation} of these data.
e.zh: 这些数据可以有不止一种解读。

interpretations.t: n. 解释（复数）；多种理解

e.en: The poem invites multiple {interpretations} from its readers.
e.zh: 这首诗邀请读者作出多种不同的解读。

e.en: Scholars debate competing {interpretations} of the ancient text.
e.zh: 学者们对这部古籍的不同解读争论不休。

e.en: The museum offers an {interpretative} tour of the ruins.
e.zh: 博物馆为这片遗址提供讲解性的导览。

e.en: Her thesis takes an {interpretative} rather than statistical approach.
e.zh: 她的论文采用了诠释式而非统计式的研究方法。

interpreted.t: v. 解释（过去式）；已翻译

e.en: His silence was {interpreted} as quiet disapproval.
e.zh: 他的沉默被解读为无声的不满。

e.en: She {interpreted} the speech live for the foreign delegates.
e.zh: 她为外国代表们现场口译了那场演讲。

interpreter.t: n. 口译员；解释器（程序）

e.en: A skilled {interpreter} helped the patient explain her symptoms.
e.zh: 一位熟练的口译员帮助病人讲清楚了症状。

e.en: Python's {interpreter} runs your code line by line.
e.zh: Python 的解释器会逐行运行你的代码。

interpreters.t: n. 口译员（复数）；解释器

e.en: Court {interpreters} must translate every word with precision.
e.zh: 法庭口译员必须精准地翻译每一个字。

e.en: Several {interpreters} took turns during the long summit.
e.zh: 在漫长的峰会中,几位口译员轮流上阵。

interpreting.t:
v. 正在解释
n. 口译

e.en: She spent the afternoon {interpreting} for the visiting delegation.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在为来访的代表团做口译。

e.en: {Interpreting} dreams is more art than science.
e.zh: 解读梦境与其说是科学,不如说是艺术。

e.en: The dancers gave an {interpretive} performance of the symphony.
e.zh: 舞者们以诠释性舞蹈演绎了这部交响曲。

e.en: Park rangers lead {interpretive} walks every weekend.
e.zh: 公园管理员每个周末都会带领讲解徒步活动。

e.en: The browser {interprets} HTML and renders the page.
e.zh: 浏览器解析 HTML 并渲染出页面。

e.en: She {interprets} the data in a way no one else has.
e.zh: 她以无人想到的方式解读这些数据。

e.en: The {interquartile} range shows the spread of the middle scores.
e.zh: 四分位距反映了中间分数的离散程度。

e.en: Outliers fall outside 1.5 times the {interquartile} range.
e.zh: 超过四分位距 1.5 倍的数据点被视为异常值。

interracial.t: adj. 跨种族的；不同种族间的

e.en: {Interracial} marriage was once illegal in many states.
e.zh: 跨种族婚姻曾在许多州属于非法。

e.en: The film celebrates an {interracial} friendship across decades.
e.zh: 这部电影歌颂了一段跨越几十年的跨种族友谊。

e.en: The neighborhood has long been {interracially} diverse and friendly.
e.zh: 这个社区长期以来在种族上融合多元、邻里友好。

e.en: They were one of the first couples married {interracially} in town.
e.zh: 他们是镇上最早跨种族结婚的夫妇之一。

e.en: The starfish has small spines along each {interradial} area.
e.zh: 海星的每个间辐区都长有小刺。

e.en: Biologists labeled the {interradial} sections of the jellyfish.
e.zh: 生物学家标记了水母的间辐部分。

e.en: The new railway boosted {interregional} trade significantly.
e.zh: 这条新铁路大大促进了区域间的贸易。

e.en: {Interregional} differences in income remain a challenge.
e.zh: 区域之间的收入差距仍是一大难题。

interregnum.t: n. 空位期；权力过渡期

e.en: During the {interregnum}, parliament effectively ran the country.
e.zh: 在空位期内,议会实际上掌管着国家。

e.en: The brief {interregnum} between CEOs unsettled the staff.
e.zh: 两任 CEO 之间短暂的空缺期让员工感到不安。

e.en: Climate, economy, and migration {interrelate} in complex ways.
e.zh: 气候、经济与移民以复杂的方式相互关联。

e.en: The chapters {interrelate} to build a single argument.
e.zh: 各章相互关联,共同构建出一个完整的论点。

e.en: Sleep, mood, and diet are deeply {interrelated}.
e.zh: 睡眠、情绪与饮食之间存在着紧密的关联。

e.en: The novel's plotlines are tightly {interrelated} from page one.
e.zh: 这部小说的多条情节线从第一页起就紧密交织。

e.en: The talk emphasized the {interrelatedness} of all living things.
e.zh: 演讲强调了一切生命之间的相互关联。

e.en: Ecologists study the {interrelatedness} of species in a habitat.
e.zh: 生态学家研究栖息地中物种之间的相互关联。

e.en: There's a clear {interrelation} between exercise and mood.
e.zh: 运动与情绪之间存在明显的相互关联。

e.en: The book maps the {interrelation} of language and culture.
e.zh: 这本书梳理了语言与文化之间的相互关系。

interrelationship.t: n. 相互关系；彼此联系

e.en: The {interrelationship} between sleep and learning is well documented.
e.zh: 睡眠与学习之间的相互关系已有充分的研究证实。

e.en: She studies the {interrelationship} of trade and diplomacy.
e.zh: 她研究贸易与外交之间的相互关系。

e.en: The city hosted an {interreligious} dialogue on peace.
e.zh: 该市举办了一场关于和平的跨宗教对话。

e.en: {Interreligious} marriages are increasingly common today.
e.zh: 如今跨宗教的婚姻越来越常见。

e.en: Detectives plan to {interrogate} the suspect tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 侦探们计划明天上午审讯这名嫌疑人。

e.en: Good historians {interrogate} their sources rather than trust them.
e.zh: 优秀的历史学家会审视史料,而不是盲目相信。

interrogated.t: v. 审问（过去式）；已查询

e.en: Police {interrogated} the suspect for over six hours.
e.zh: 警方对嫌疑人进行了长达六个多小时的审讯。

e.en: The essay {interrogated} our assumptions about success.
e.zh: 这篇文章对我们关于成功的种种假设提出了质疑。

e.en: Her latest film {interrogates} the meaning of home.
e.zh: 她最新的电影深入探讨了“家”的含义。

e.en: The script {interrogates} a database to fetch user records.
e.zh: 该脚本会查询数据库以获取用户记录。

e.en: The detective spent hours {interrogating} the only witness.
e.zh: 侦探花了几个小时审问唯一的目击者。

e.en: She's {interrogating} her own biases as she writes the book.
e.zh: 她在写这本书的同时也在审视自己的偏见。

e.en: The suspect remained silent throughout the long {interrogation}.
e.zh: 嫌疑人在漫长的审讯中始终保持沉默。

e.en: Her novel offers a sharp {interrogation} of modern parenthood.
e.zh: 她的小说对现代育儿进行了犀利的审视。

e.en: The suspect endured hours of {interrogations} before requesting a lawyer.
e.zh: 嫌疑人在要求律师前经历了数小时的审讯。

e.en: Police {interrogations} must follow strict legal procedures these days.
e.zh: 如今警方审讯必须遵循严格的法律程序。

interrogative.t:
adj. 疑问的
n. 疑问词

e.en: She gave him an {interrogative} look when he walked in late.
e.zh: 他迟到走进来时,她投来质询的目光。

e.en: English {interrogative} sentences usually start with words like who or what.
e.zh: 英语疑问句通常以谁或什么这类词开头。

e.en: He raised his eyebrows {interrogatively} when she mentioned the project.
e.zh: 她提到那个项目时,他疑惑地扬起了眉毛。

e.en: The teacher tilted her head {interrogatively}, waiting for an answer.
e.zh: 老师疑惑地歪着头,等着回答。

e.en: The skilled {interrogator} got a confession within an hour.
e.zh: 那位老练的审讯员一小时内就拿到了口供。

e.en: A military {interrogator} must follow international human rights standards.
e.zh: 军方审讯员必须遵守国际人权标准。

intermarry.t: v. 异族通婚；跨族/跨教通婚

e.en: The two communities began to {intermarry} after decades of separation.
e.zh: 两个社区在隔阂数十年后开始相互通婚。

e.en: Royal families often {intermarry} to secure political alliances.
e.zh: 王室家族常通过通婚来巩固政治联盟。

e.en: Banks act as {intermediaries} between savers and borrowers.
e.zh: 银行充当储户和借款人之间的中介。

e.en: The deal collapsed because the {intermediaries} disagreed on terms.
e.zh: 由于中间人在条款上分歧,交易最终告吹。

intermediary.t:
n. 中介；中间人
adj. 中间的

e.en: She served as an {intermediary} between management and the union.
e.zh: 她在管理层和工会之间充当中间人。

e.en: The app removes the {intermediary} so artists keep more revenue.
e.zh: 这款应用去掉了中间环节,让艺术家保留更多收入。

intermediate.t:
adj. 中级的；中间的
n. 中间体

e.en: The course is aimed at {intermediate} Spanish learners.
e.zh: 这门课程面向中级西班牙语学习者。

e.en: Water is an {intermediate} product in this chemical reaction.
e.zh: 水是这个化学反应中的一种中间产物。

intermediation.t: n. 中介（服务）；居间调解

e.en: Financial {intermediation} channels household savings into business loans.
e.zh: 金融中介将居民储蓄引导为企业贷款。

e.en: Online platforms have reduced the cost of {intermediation}.
e.zh: 在线平台已经降低了中介环节的成本。

e.en: The {interment} took place quietly at a small family cemetery.
e.zh: 葬礼在一个小型家族墓园低调举行。

e.en: Records of the {interment} were lost during the war.
e.zh: 安葬记录在战争期间遗失了。

e.en: The gears {intermesh} smoothly when properly oiled.
e.zh: 齿轮加润滑油后能顺畅咬合。

e.en: Their work schedules {intermesh} surprisingly well most weeks.
e.zh: 他们的工作日程在大多数周里配合得出奇默契。

e.en: The pianist played a tender {intermezzo} between the heavier movements.
e.zh: 钢琴家在沉重的乐章之间演奏了一段温柔的间奏曲。

e.en: Brahms wrote a famous {intermezzo} for solo piano.
e.zh: 勃拉姆斯为独奏钢琴写过一首著名的间奏曲。

interminable.t: adj. 没完没了的；冗长的

e.en: The flight delay led to an {interminable} wait at the gate.
e.zh: 航班延误让登机口前的等待显得没完没了。

e.en: He gave an {interminable} speech that emptied the room.
e.zh: 他作了一场冗长无尽的演讲,把会场都讲空了。

e.en: The meeting dragged on {interminably} past lunchtime.
e.zh: 会议一直拖到午饭过后,没完没了。

e.en: She talked {interminably} about her weekend hike.
e.zh: 她没完没了地讲着自己周末的徒步。

e.en: At the festival, locals and tourists freely {intermingle}.
e.zh: 在节庆中,本地人和游客自由地交融在一起。

e.en: The author lets memory and dream {intermingle} on the page.
e.zh: 作者让记忆与梦境在书页上交织在一起。

intermingled.t: v. 混合在一起（过去式）

e.en: Excitement and fear were {intermingled} as she opened the email.
e.zh: 她打开邮件时,兴奋与恐惧交织在一起。

e.en: Wildflowers {intermingled} with tall grasses across the meadow.
e.zh: 野花与高高的杂草在草甸上交错丛生。

e.en: The neighborhood thrives on the {intermingling} of cultures.
e.zh: 这个街区因多元文化的交融而生机勃勃。

e.en: Sunlight and shadow kept {intermingling} on the forest floor.
e.zh: 阳光与阴影在林间地面上不断交错。

intermission.t: n. 中场休息；幕间休息

e.en: We grabbed snacks during the {intermission} between acts.
e.zh: 我们在两幕之间的中场休息时去买了零食。

e.en: The hockey game has a fifteen-minute {intermission}.
e.zh: 这场冰球比赛有十五分钟的中场休息。

e.en: Long operas usually have two {intermissions} for the audience.
e.zh: 长篇歌剧通常会为观众安排两次中场休息。

e.en: Streaming versions skip the {intermissions} found in theaters.
e.zh: 流媒体版本省略了影院中的那些中场休息。

e.en: Solar power's {intermittency} makes battery storage essential.
e.zh: 太阳能发电的间歇性使储能电池变得不可或缺。

e.en: Engineers tested the sensor for signal {intermittency}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了该传感器信号的间歇性问题。

intermittent.t: adj. 间歇的；断断续续的

e.en: Users reported {intermittent} connection issues throughout the morning.
e.zh: 用户反映整个上午都有间歇性的连接问题。

e.en: The forecast warned of {intermittent} showers all day.
e.zh: 天气预报提醒全天会有阵阵间歇性阵雨。

intermittently.t: adv. 间歇地；断断续续地

e.en: The streaming app keeps freezing {intermittently} on my phone.
e.zh: 这款流媒体应用在我手机上时不时就会卡住。

e.en: Rain fell {intermittently} during the hike.
e.zh: 徒步途中雨断断续续地下着。

e.en: Good designers {intermix} fonts without making the page noisy.
e.zh: 优秀的设计师能混搭字体,又不会让页面显得杂乱。

e.en: Stir gently so the spices {intermix} with the rice.
e.zh: 轻轻搅拌,让香料和米饭充分混合。

e.en: The port handles {intermodal} containers moving between ships and trains.
e.zh: 这个港口处理在船舶与火车之间转运的多式联运集装箱。

e.en: {Intermodal} transport reduces shipping costs across long distances.
e.zh: 多式联运能降低长距离运输的成本。

e.en: Hydrogen bonds are a key type of {intermolecular} force.
e.zh: 氢键是一种重要的分子间作用力。

e.en: Boiling points depend largely on {intermolecular} attractions.
e.zh: 沸点很大程度上取决于分子间的吸引力。

intermountain.t: adj. 山间的；山脉之间的

e.en: Wildfires are spreading across the {intermountain} West this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天,野火正蔓延于美国西部山间地区。

e.en: The {intermountain} region receives surprisingly little annual rainfall.
e.zh: 这片山间地区年降水量出奇地少。

intern.t:
n. 实习生
v. 拘留

e.en: She worked as a summer {intern} at a design studio.
e.zh: 她在一家设计工作室做了一个暑期实习生。

e.en: Each {intern} gets a mentor during their first week.
e.zh: 每位实习生在入职第一周都会被分配一位导师。

e.en: The bug was found during an {internal} code review.
e.zh: 这个漏洞是在一次内部代码评审中发现的。

e.en: She struggled with {internal} doubts before the presentation.
e.zh: 演讲前她内心的疑虑挥之不去。

internalise.t: v. 将…内化；吸收成为自身观念

e.en: Children quickly {internalise} the values they see at home.
e.zh: 孩子会很快把在家中看到的价值观内化于心。

e.en: It took months to {internalise} the new safety protocols.
e.zh: 花了好几个月才把新的安全规程真正内化于心。

internalised.t: v. 内化的（过去式，英式拼写）

e.en: He had {internalised} his coach's advice about staying calm.
e.zh: 他已经把教练关于保持冷静的建议内化于心。

e.en: Many employees have {internalised} the company's mission.
e.zh: 许多员工已把公司的使命内化于心。

e.en: Therapy focused on the {internalization} of harsh childhood criticism.
e.zh: 治疗着重处理童年严厉批评带来的内化影响。

e.en: Language learning depends on the {internalization} of grammar patterns.
e.zh: 语言学习取决于对语法模式的内化吸收。

e.en: Try to {internalize} the feedback rather than just nodding along.
e.zh: 试着把反馈真正内化吸收,而不只是点头附和。

e.en: Athletes {internalize} their training so reactions become automatic.
e.zh: 运动员会把训练内化,使反应变得本能。

e.en: She had {internalized} a fear of public speaking since childhood.
e.zh: 她从小就把对公开演讲的恐惧深植于心。

e.en: The team has {internalized} a culture of constant testing.
e.zh: 团队已经把持续测试的文化内化于日常工作中。

e.en: He is slowly {internalizing} the habits of disciplined writing.
e.zh: 他正在慢慢把自律写作的习惯内化于心。

e.en: Kids often cope by {internalizing} stress rather than expressing it.
e.zh: 孩子常常把压力压在心里,而不是表达出来。

e.en: The decision was made {internally} before any public announcement.
e.zh: 这一决定在对外宣布前已在内部做出。

e.en: She was {internally} furious but kept smiling politely.
e.zh: 她内心怒火中烧,却仍礼貌地保持微笑。

international.t:
adj. 国际的
n. 国际比赛选手

e.en: The startup is expanding into {international} markets next year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司明年将拓展到国际市场。

e.en: She booked an {international} flight to Tokyo last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚订了一张飞东京的国际航班。

e.en: Workers sang the {Internationale} as they marched through the square.
e.zh: 工人们一边唱着《国际歌》,一边走过广场。

e.en: The old anthem known as the {Internationale} still stirs strong feelings.
e.zh: 那首被称作《国际歌》的老歌至今仍能激起强烈情感。

e.en: The team is planning the {internationalisation} of the app for Asian markets.
e.zh: 团队正在筹划这款应用面向亚洲市场的国际化工作。

e.en: Proper {internationalisation} means more than just translating text.
e.zh: 真正的国际化远不只是把文字翻译过来。

internationalise.t: v. 使国际化（英式拼写）

e.en: The company hopes to {internationalise} its brand within five years.
e.zh: 公司希望在五年内将其品牌国际化。

e.en: Universities try to {internationalise} their student bodies.
e.zh: 各大学都努力让学生群体更国际化。

e.en: Her speeches championed peace and a spirit of {internationalism}.
e.zh: 她的演讲倡导和平以及国际主义精神。

e.en: Postwar leaders embraced {internationalism} as a path to stability.
e.zh: 战后领导人把国际主义视为通往稳定的道路。

e.en: He took a strongly {internationalist} stance during the debate.
e.zh: 他在辩论中持鲜明的国际主义立场。

e.en: The senator is known as a committed {internationalist}.
e.zh: 这位参议员以坚定的国际主义者著称。

e.en: Our roadmap prioritizes {internationalization} for the next release.
e.zh: 我们的产品规划把下一版本的国际化作为重点。

e.en: Proper {internationalization} requires designing for multiple scripts and currencies.
e.zh: 完善的国际化需要兼顾多种文字和货币的设计。

e.en: We need to {internationalize} the website before launching in Europe.
e.zh: 在欧洲发布之前,我们需要先把网站国际化。

e.en: The board voted to {internationalize} the brand more aggressively.
e.zh: 董事会投票决定更积极地推进品牌国际化。

e.en: Her novels are read {internationally} in over thirty languages.
e.zh: 她的小说在国际上被译成三十多种语言。

e.en: The company is {internationally} recognized for its design.
e.zh: 这家公司因其设计而享誉国际。

internationals.t: n. 国际比赛；国脚（复数）

e.en: The squad includes several young {internationals} from the under-21 team.
e.zh: 球队里有几位来自21岁以下队的年轻国脚。

e.en: The club fielded six {internationals} in last weekend's match.
e.zh: 上周末的比赛中俱乐部派上了六名国脚。

internecine.t: adj. 内斗的；自相残杀的

e.en: {Internecine} feuds within the party cost them the election.
e.zh: 党内的内讧让他们输掉了选举。

e.en: Years of {internecine} conflict left the small kingdom exhausted.
e.zh: 多年的内部争斗让这个小王国精疲力竭。

e.en: Each {internee} was assigned a barracks and a number.
