e.zh: 每位被拘留者都被分配了营房和编号。

e.en: A former {internee} shared his memories at the museum.
e.zh: 一位曾被关押者在博物馆里讲述了他的回忆。

e.en: The {internet} goes down whenever there's a thunderstorm here.
e.zh: 这里一打雷,网络就会断掉。

e.en: She found the recipe on a random corner of the {internet}.
e.zh: 她在网上一个不起眼的角落里找到了这道食谱。

e.en: He joked that he'd won the {internets} with that meme.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说,他靠那个表情包赢得了整个互联网。

e.en: The whole {internets} seemed to be talking about the finale.
e.zh: 整个网络似乎都在议论那个大结局。

e.en: My {internist} ordered a full set of blood tests.
e.zh: 我的内科医生开了一整套血液检查。

e.en: She trained as an {internist} before specializing in cardiology.
e.zh: 她先接受了内科医师培训,后来才专攻心脏科。

e.en: The {internment} of civilians during the war remains controversial.
e.zh: 战时对平民的拘禁至今仍存争议。

e.en: Survivors visited the former {internment} camp last summer.
e.zh: 幸存者去年夏天重访了昔日的拘留营。

internode.t: n. 节间（植物茎节之间）

e.en: The plant's long {internode} indicates rapid stem growth.
e.zh: 这株植物的节间较长,说明茎部生长迅速。

e.en: Botanists measure each {internode} to track development.
e.zh: 植物学家测量每个节间以追踪发育情况。

e.en: She landed a summer {internship} at a tech startup.
e.zh: 她在一家科技初创公司拿到了暑期实习。

e.en: My {internship} taught me more than any textbook could.
e.zh: 那段实习教会我的比任何教科书都多。

e.en: {Interoperability} between apps is key for smooth workflows.
e.zh: 应用之间的互操作性是顺畅工作流的关键。

e.en: The new standard improves {interoperability} across devices.
e.zh: 新标准提升了不同设备间的互操作性。

interventions.t: n. 干预；介入（intervention 的复数）

e.en: Early {interventions} can dramatically improve a child's development.
e.zh: 早期干预能显著改善孩子的发展。

e.en: The agency reviewed all military {interventions} of the past decade.
e.zh: 该机构回顾了过去十年的所有军事干预行动。

e.en: He suffered a slipped {intervertebral} disc from heavy lifting.
e.zh: 他因搬重物造成椎间盘突出。

e.en: The MRI revealed damage to the {intervertebral} discs.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示椎间盘受损。

interview.t:
n. 面试；采访
v. 面试；采访

e.en: I have a job {interview} on Friday morning.
e.zh: 我周五上午有一场工作面试。

e.en: The reporter requested an {interview} with the CEO.
e.zh: 记者请求采访这位首席执行官。

e.en: She {interviewed} ten candidates before making a decision.
e.zh: 她面试了十位候选人才做出决定。

e.en: The journalist {interviewed} survivors of the earthquake.
e.zh: 记者采访了地震的幸存者。

e.en: The {interviewee} answered every question with confidence.
e.zh: 受访者自信地回答了每一个问题。

e.en: Each {interviewee} received a follow-up email afterward.
e.zh: 每位受访者随后都收到了一封跟进邮件。

e.en: The {interviewees} waited nervously in the lobby.
e.zh: 受访者们在大堂里紧张地等候。

e.en: Most {interviewees} mentioned remote work as a top priority.
e.zh: 大多数受访者把远程办公列为首要考量。

e.en: The {interviewer} smiled and offered me a glass of water.
e.zh: 面试官微笑着递给我一杯水。

e.en: A skilled {interviewer} knows how to make guests relax.
e.zh: 优秀的采访者懂得让嘉宾放松下来。

e.en: Two {interviewers} took turns asking technical questions.
e.zh: 两位面试官轮流提技术问题。

e.en: The {interviewers} compared notes after each candidate left.
e.zh: 每位应聘者离开后，面试官们都会交换意见。

e.en: We are {interviewing} candidates for the design role this week.
e.zh: 本周我们正在面试设计岗位的候选人。

e.en: She enjoys {interviewing} musicians for her podcast.
e.zh: 她喜欢为播客采访音乐人。

interviews.t:
n. 面试；采访（复数）
v. 面试（第三人称）

e.en: He scheduled three {interviews} for next Tuesday.
e.zh: 他在下周二安排了三场面试。

e.en: The book includes {interviews} with twenty famous authors.
e.zh: 这本书收录了对二十位著名作家的访谈。

interwar.t: adj. 两次世界大战之间的

e.en: The novel captures life in Berlin during the {interwar} years.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了两次大战之间柏林的生活。

e.en: {Interwar} Europe saw rapid political and cultural change.
e.zh: 两次世界大战之间的欧洲经历了剧烈的政治文化变化。

e.en: The author likes to {interweave} fact and fiction in her novels.
e.zh: 这位作者喜欢在小说中将事实与虚构交织在一起。

e.en: Good documentaries {interweave} multiple personal stories.
e.zh: 优秀的纪录片会把多条个人故事交织起来。

e.en: The director {interweaved} three timelines into one story.
e.zh: 导演将三条时间线交织成一个故事。

e.en: She {interweaved} humor and tragedy throughout the play.
e.zh: 她在整部戏剧中将幽默与悲剧交织在一起。

interweaves.t: v. 交织（第三人称单数）

e.en: The film {interweaves} memory, dream, and reality seamlessly.
e.zh: 这部电影将记忆、梦境和现实无缝交织在一起。

e.en: Her music {interweaves} jazz and traditional folk styles.
e.zh: 她的音乐把爵士与传统民谣风格交织起来。

e.en: The novel's {interweaving} of plots keeps readers hooked.
e.zh: 小说情节的交织让读者欲罢不能。

e.en: She is {interweaving} interviews with archival footage.
e.zh: 她正在把采访与档案影像交织在一起。

e.en: The poet {interwove} love and loss in every verse.
e.zh: 诗人将爱与失去交织在每一节诗中。

e.en: He {interwove} personal anecdotes into his lecture.
e.zh: 他在演讲中穿插了一些个人趣事。

e.en: Their lives have been deeply {interwoven} for decades.
e.zh: 他们的生活几十年来紧密交织在一起。

e.en: Politics and religion are tightly {interwoven} in that region.
e.zh: 在那个地区，政治与宗教紧密交织。

intestacy.t: n. 未立遗嘱而身故的状态

e.en: Laws of {intestacy} decide who inherits when there's no will.
e.zh: 无遗嘱继承法决定无遗嘱时由谁来继承。

e.en: His sudden death raised difficult questions of {intestacy}.
e.zh: 他的突然离世引出了无遗嘱继承的棘手问题。

e.en: He died {intestate}, leaving his family in legal limbo.
e.zh: 他未立遗嘱便去世了，家人陷入法律困境。

e.en: When someone dies {intestate}, state law divides the estate.
e.zh: 如果有人未立遗嘱便去世，州法律会分配遗产。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed an {intestinal} infection from contaminated water.
e.zh: 医生诊断为受污染水引起的肠道感染。

e.en: Probiotics support healthy {intestinal} bacteria.
e.zh: 益生菌有助于维持健康的肠道菌群。

e.en: The small {intestine} absorbs most nutrients from food.
e.zh: 小肠负责吸收食物中的大部分营养。

e.en: Surgeons removed a tumor from his large {intestine}.
e.zh: 外科医生从他的大肠中切除了一个肿瘤。

e.en: The first {intifada} began in late 1987.
e.zh: 第一次巴勒斯坦大起义始于1987年底。

e.en: Journalists documented daily life during the {intifada}.
e.zh: 记者记录了起义期间的日常生活。

e.en: True {intimacy} takes years of trust to build.
e.zh: 真正的亲密需要多年的信任来建立。

e.en: The cafe has a warm {intimacy} that regulars love.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有种温馨亲切的氛围，常客们都很喜欢。

intimate.t:
adj. 亲密的；私密的
v. 暗示

e.en: They had an {intimate} dinner to celebrate the anniversary.
e.zh: 他们举办了一顿温馨私密的晚餐庆祝周年。

e.en: She shared {intimate} details of her childhood with the therapist.
e.zh: 她向治疗师分享了童年的私密细节。

e.en: He knows the city {intimately} after living there for years.
e.zh: 在那座城市住了多年，他对它了如指掌。

e.en: The two issues are {intimately} connected.
e.zh: 这两个问题密切相关。

e.en: There was no {intimation} that he planned to resign.
e.zh: 完全没有任何迹象表明他打算辞职。

e.en: Her smile gave the first {intimation} of good news.
e.zh: 她的微笑透露出好消息的第一丝暗示。

e.en: Don't let the bigger players {intimidate} you on the field.
e.zh: 别让场上更高大的对手吓倒你。

e.en: He used his loud voice to {intimidate} junior staff.
e.zh: 他用大嗓门来吓唬下属。

intimidated.t:
adj. 感到害怕的
v. 恐吓（过去式）

e.en: I felt {intimidated} walking into the boardroom alone.
e.zh: 独自走进会议室时，我感到很怯场。

e.en: She refused to be {intimidated} by the online trolls.
e.zh: 她拒绝被网络喷子吓倒。

intimidating.t: adj. 令人胆怯的；吓人的

e.en: Public speaking can be {intimidating} for beginners.
e.zh: 对初学者来说，公开演讲可能很令人发怵。

e.en: He has an {intimidating} stare that silences the room.
e.zh: 他那令人生畏的目光能让整个房间安静下来。

e.en: The exam was {intimidatingly} long and detailed.
e.zh: 那场考试长得令人发怵，而且非常细致。

e.en: He stood {intimidatingly} close during the argument.
e.zh: 争吵时他逼近站着，让人感到压迫。

e.en: The witness reported {intimidation} from the defendant's friends.
e.zh: 证人举报受到被告朋友的恐吓。

e.en: The coach won't tolerate {intimidation} between teammates.
e.zh: 教练绝不容忍队友之间的恐吓行为。

e.en: He earned a reputation as a courtroom {intimidator}.
e.zh: 他在法庭上以咄咄逼人著称。

e.en: The boxer was known as a fearsome {intimidator}.
e.zh: 那位拳击手以令人胆寒的气势闻名。

e.en: The judge condemned the gang's {intimidatory} tactics.
e.zh: 法官谴责了帮派的恐吓手段。

e.en: Police removed the {intimidatory} banners outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 警方撤下了法院门外那些带有恐吓意味的横幅。

into.t:
prep. 进入；到……里
prep. 对……很感兴趣

e.en: She poured the milk {into} a tall glass.
e.zh: 她把牛奶倒进一个高玻璃杯里。

e.en: My little brother is really {into} dinosaurs lately.
e.zh: 我弟弟最近特别迷恐龙。

e.en: The summer heat in the attic became {intolerable}.
e.zh: 阁楼里的夏日酷热变得让人无法忍受。

e.en: Working under such pressure was simply {intolerable}.
e.zh: 在那样的压力下工作实在让人受不了。

e.en: The meeting dragged on {intolerably} for three hours.
e.zh: 会议拖拖拉拉地开了三个小时，令人难以忍受。

e.en: The room was {intolerably} hot without air conditioning.
e.zh: 没有空调，房间热得让人受不了。

intolerance.t: n. 不容忍；（食物）不耐受

e.en: She has a mild lactose {intolerance} and avoids milk.
e.zh: 她有轻度乳糖不耐受，所以不喝牛奶。

e.en: Schools are working to reduce religious {intolerance}.
e.zh: 学校正在努力减少宗教上的偏狭与不宽容。

intolerant.t: adj. 不容忍的；不耐受的

e.en: Many adults are {intolerant} of dairy products.
e.zh: 许多成年人对乳制品不耐受。

e.en: He grew up in a community {intolerant} of dissent.
e.zh: 他在一个不容异见的社区长大。

e.en: Her rising {intonation} made the statement sound like a question.
e.zh: 她上扬的语调让这句话听起来像是在提问。

e.en: Mandarin tones rely on precise {intonation}.
e.zh: 普通话的声调依赖于精准的语调。

intone.t: v. 吟诵；以平稳语调念

e.en: The monks {intone} their prayers at sunrise.
e.zh: 僧侣们在日出时吟诵经文。

e.en: He began to {intone} the names of the fallen soldiers.
e.zh: 他开始低声诵读阵亡士兵的名字。

intoxicant.t: n. 使人醉的饮品或药物

e.en: Alcohol is the most widely used {intoxicant} worldwide.
e.zh: 酒精是全世界使用最广泛的麻醉品。

e.en: The festival banned every kind of {intoxicant}.
e.zh: 该节庆禁止任何种类的致醉物品。

e.en: A single glass of wine can {intoxicate} her quickly.
e.zh: 一杯红酒就能很快让她醉。

e.en: Power can {intoxicate} even the most humble leader.
e.zh: 权力能让最谦逊的领导者也冲昏头脑。

e.en: The driver was clearly {intoxicated} when stopped by police.
e.zh: 司机被警察拦下时显然醉酒了。

e.en: She felt {intoxicated} by the success of her first novel.
e.zh: 她为自己第一部小说的成功而陶醉。

intoxicating.t: adj. 使人沉醉的；醉人的

e.en: The smell of fresh jasmine was absolutely {intoxicating}.
e.zh: 新鲜茉莉花的香气令人陶醉。

e.en: Sudden fame can be a dangerously {intoxicating} experience.
e.zh: 突如其来的名声会是一种危险的迷醉体验。

e.en: He was charged with driving under {intoxication}.
e.zh: 他被指控酒后驾车。

e.en: The poet wrote about the sweet {intoxication} of first love.
e.zh: 诗人写下了初恋甜蜜的迷醉。

intra.t: prep. 在……内部（前缀/拉丁用法）

e.en: The team scheduled an {intra}-department meeting for Friday.
e.zh: 团队安排了一次部门内部会议在周五举行。

e.en: Doctors administered the medicine {intra}-venously.
e.zh: 医生通过静脉内给药。

e.en: The virus replicates inside {intracellular} compartments of host cells.
e.zh: 该病毒在宿主细胞的细胞内区室中复制。

e.en: Researchers measured {intracellular} calcium levels during the experiment.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了实验过程中的细胞内钙水平。

e.en: We sailed the {intracoastal} waterway from Florida to Georgia.
e.zh: 我们沿沿海内河水道从佛罗里达航行到佐治亚。

e.en: The {intracoastal} route shelters boats from rough ocean waves.
e.zh: 沿岸内航道能让船只避开汹涌的海浪。

e.en: The scan revealed dangerously high {intracranial} pressure after the accident.
e.zh: 扫描显示事故后颅内压异常升高。

e.en: Surgeons removed an {intracranial} tumor through a small opening.
e.zh: 外科医生通过一个小切口切除了颅内肿瘤。

e.en: The {intractability} of the conflict frustrated every mediator involved.
e.zh: 这场冲突的棘手程度让每位调解者都束手无策。

e.en: Economists debated the {intractability} of long-term inflation.
e.zh: 经济学家讨论了长期通胀的难解性。

intractable.t:
adj. 棘手的；难解决的
adj. 倔强的

e.en: Climate change remains an {intractable} problem for global leaders.
e.zh: 气候变化仍是全球领导人难以解决的问题。

e.en: The patient suffered from {intractable} chronic back pain.
e.zh: 这位病人饱受顽固性慢性背痛的折磨。

e.en: The clinic offers {intracytoplasmic} sperm injection for infertility treatment.
e.zh: 该诊所提供卵胞浆内单精子注射用于不孕治疗。

e.en: Scientists observed {intracytoplasmic} inclusions in the infected cells.
e.zh: 科学家在受感染细胞中观察到细胞质内包涵体。

e.en: The biopsy showed signs of {intraepithelial} neoplasia in early stages.
e.zh: 活检显示早期上皮内瘤变的迹象。

e.en: Doctors monitor {intraepithelial} lesions closely to prevent progression.
e.zh: 医生密切监测上皮内病变以防止恶化。

e.en: An {intragastric} balloon helped the patient lose significant weight.
e.zh: 胃内球囊帮助这位患者大幅减重。

e.en: The drug was delivered via {intragastric} tube during recovery.
e.zh: 康复期间药物通过胃内管给药。

e.en: The catheter measures {intraluminal} pressure inside the blood vessel.
e.zh: 导管测量血管腔内压力。

e.en: An {intraluminal} stent kept the artery open after surgery.
e.zh: 腔内支架在手术后保持动脉畅通。

intramural.t: adj. 校内的；机构内部的

e.en: He plays in the campus {intramural} basketball league every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都参加校内篮球联赛。

e.en: The university hosts several {intramural} sports tournaments each semester.
e.zh: 该大学每学期举办多场校内体育比赛。

intramuscular.t: adj. 肌肉注射的；肌内的

e.en: The nurse gave him an {intramuscular} injection in the arm.
e.zh: 护士在他手臂上打了一针肌肉注射。

e.en: Most flu vaccines are administered through {intramuscular} routes.
e.zh: 大多数流感疫苗通过肌肉注射方式接种。

e.en: The medication should be administered {intramuscularly} every six hours.
e.zh: 该药物应每六小时肌肉注射一次。

e.en: Doctors injected the antibiotic {intramuscularly} to speed absorption.
e.zh: 医生通过肌肉注射给药以加快吸收。

intranasal.t: adj. 鼻内的；经鼻给药的

e.en: The new {intranasal} flu vaccine is popular with children.
e.zh: 新型鼻喷流感疫苗在儿童中很受欢迎。

e.en: She uses an {intranasal} spray to relieve seasonal allergies.
e.zh: 她使用鼻喷剂缓解季节性过敏。

intranet.t: n. 企业内网；内部局域网

e.en: Employees access company policies through the corporate {intranet}.
e.zh: 员工通过公司内部网访问公司政策。

e.en: The {intranet} portal hosts training videos and HR forms.
e.zh: 内联网门户存放着培训视频和人事表格。

e.en: His {intransigence} during negotiations doomed any chance of compromise.
e.zh: 他在谈判中的不妥协让任何妥协的可能都化为泡影。

e.en: The party's {intransigence} on tax reform frustrated voters.
e.zh: 该党在税改问题上的固执让选民感到沮丧。

e.en: The {intransigent} senator refused to budge on the bill.
e.zh: 那位顽固的参议员在该议案上拒不让步。

e.en: Both sides remained {intransigent} despite weeks of mediation.
e.zh: 尽管经过数周调解,双方仍然各不相让。

e.en: The verb "sleep" is {intransitive} and takes no direct object.
e.zh: 动词"sleep"是不及物动词,不带直接宾语。

e.en: Students often confuse transitive and {intransitive} verb forms.
e.zh: 学生经常混淆及物动词和不及物动词的形式。

e.en: The surgeon implanted an {intraocular} lens during cataract surgery.
e.zh: 外科医生在白内障手术中植入了人工晶状体。

e.en: High {intraocular} pressure can lead to glaucoma if untreated.
e.zh: 眼内压过高若不治疗可能引发青光眼。

e.en: The team used {intraoperative} imaging to guide the brain surgery.
e.zh: 团队使用术中成像指导这次脑部手术。

e.en: {Intraoperative} monitoring helps surgeons avoid damaging critical nerves.
e.zh: 术中监测帮助外科医生避免损伤关键神经。

e.en: The dentist took {intraoral} photos to document the cavities.
e.zh: 牙医拍摄了口内照片来记录蛀牙情况。

e.en: An {intraoral} scanner replaces traditional dental impression molds.
e.zh: 口内扫描仪取代了传统的牙科取模方式。

e.en: The {intraparty} feud weakened the candidate before the election.
e.zh: 党内纷争在选举前削弱了这位候选人。

e.en: Sharp {intraparty} disagreements emerged over the budget proposal.
e.zh: 在预算提案上党内出现了尖锐分歧。

intrapersonal.t: adj. 个人内心的；自我的

e.en: Journaling builds {intrapersonal} awareness and emotional self-understanding.
e.zh: 写日记能培养内省意识和对情绪的自我理解。

e.en: Meditation strengthens {intrapersonal} skills like self-reflection and patience.
e.zh: 冥想能增强自省和耐心等内省能力。

e.en: The therapist explored {intrapsychic} conflicts driving his anxiety.
e.zh: 治疗师探讨了引发他焦虑的内心冲突。

e.en: Freud's theory focuses heavily on {intrapsychic} processes and drives.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德的理论着重于精神内部的过程与驱力。

e.en: Sociologists study {intraracial} differences in income and education.
e.zh: 社会学家研究种族内部在收入和教育方面的差异。

e.en: The book examines {intraracial} dynamics within immigrant communities.
e.zh: 本书审视了移民社区内部的种族内部互动。

e.en: Biologists observed {intraspecific} competition among wolves for territory.
e.zh: 生物学家观察到狼群为争夺领地而进行的种内竞争。

e.en: {Intraspecific} variation makes some salmon larger than others.
e.zh: 种内变异使某些鲑鱼比其他鲑鱼体型更大。

e.en: The professor analyzed {intratextual} references within the novel itself.
e.zh: 教授分析了小说内部的文本互引。

e.en: Her essay focused on {intratextual} patterns of imagery and symbolism.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于文本内部的意象与象征模式。

e.en: Many women choose an {intrauterine} device for long-term contraception.
e.zh: 许多女性选择宫内节育器作为长期避孕方式。

e.en: The doctor monitored {intrauterine} growth throughout the pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生在整个孕期监测宫内生长情况。

e.en: Doctors inserted an {intravascular} catheter to deliver medication directly.
e.zh: 医生插入血管内导管以直接输送药物。

e.en: {Intravascular} ultrasound provides detailed images of artery walls.
e.zh: 血管内超声能提供动脉壁的详细图像。

intravenous.t: adj. 静脉注射的；静脉内的

e.en: The patient received {intravenous} fluids after becoming severely dehydrated.
e.zh: 病人在严重脱水后接受了静脉输液。

e.en: Antibiotics worked faster when delivered through an {intravenous} drip.
e.zh: 通过静脉滴注给药时,抗生素见效更快。

e.en: The medication must be administered {intravenously} for fastest effect.
e.zh: 该药物必须通过静脉注射以获得最快效果。

e.en: She received chemotherapy drugs {intravenously} every three weeks.
e.zh: 她每三周通过静脉注射接受化疗药物。

intrepid.t: adj. 勇敢的；无所畏惧的

e.en: An {intrepid} reporter uncovered the corruption scandal at city hall.
e.zh: 一位无畏的记者揭露了市政厅的腐败丑闻。

e.en: The {intrepid} hikers crossed the glacier despite the storm.
e.zh: 勇敢的徒步者们冒着风暴穿越了冰川。

intricacy.t: n. 错综复杂；复杂细节

e.en: The {intricacy} of the watch's mechanism amazed every collector.
e.zh: 这块手表机芯的精密复杂让每位收藏家都惊叹。

e.en: She admired the {intricacy} of the embroidered silk gown.
e.zh: 她欣赏那件丝绸刺绣礼服的精致繁复。

intricate.t: adj. 复杂精细的；错综的

e.en: The artist carved an {intricate} pattern into the wooden panel.
e.zh: 这位艺术家在木板上雕刻出复杂精美的图案。

e.en: Tax law involves {intricate} rules that confuse most people.
e.zh: 税法涉及错综复杂的规定,让大多数人感到困惑。

intricately.t: adv. 错综复杂地；精细地

e.en: The temple walls are {intricately} decorated with mythological scenes.
e.zh: 寺庙的墙壁上精雕细刻着神话场景。

e.en: His career is {intricately} linked to the company's success.
e.zh: 他的事业与公司的成功错综地联系在一起。

intrigue.t:
v. 引起好奇
n. 阴谋；密谋

e.en: The novel is full of palace {intrigue} and political betrayal.
e.zh: 这部小说充满了宫廷阴谋和政治背叛。

e.en: Old maps and lost cities {intrigue} her endlessly.
e.zh: 古老的地图和失落的城市让她着迷不已。

e.en: I was {intrigued} by the mysterious package on my doorstep.
e.zh: 门口那个神秘的包裹让我感到好奇。

e.en: Investors seemed {intrigued} by the startup's unusual business model.
e.zh: 投资者似乎对这家初创公司不寻常的商业模式很感兴趣。

e.en: The court was full of flatterers and clever {intriguer} types.
e.zh: 宫廷里满是阿谀奉承者和精明的阴谋家。

e.en: History remembers him as a ruthless political {intriguer}.
e.zh: 历史将他记为一个冷酷无情的政治阴谋家。

intriguing.t: adj. 引人入胜的；耐人寻味的

e.en: She raised an {intriguing} question during the team meeting.
e.zh: 她在团队会议上提出了一个引人深思的问题。

e.en: The documentary explores an {intriguing} theory about ancient civilizations.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了一个关于古代文明的有趣理论。

e.en: {Intriguingly}, the data showed an unexpected drop after midnight.
e.zh: 耐人寻味的是,数据在午夜后出现了意外下降。

e.en: The film ends {intriguingly} without revealing the killer's identity.
e.zh: 影片以未揭示凶手身份的方式耐人寻味地收尾。

e.en: Honesty has {intrinsic} value beyond any practical benefit.
e.zh: 诚实本身就有其内在价值,超越任何实际利益。

e.en: Curiosity is an {intrinsic} part of being a good scientist.
e.zh: 好奇心是成为优秀科学家的内在要素。

e.en: Some tasks are {intrinsically} rewarding regardless of external recognition.
e.zh: 有些任务本身就有回报感,与外部认可无关。

e.en: Music and emotion are {intrinsically} linked in human experience.
e.zh: 音乐与情感在人类体验中本质上紧密相连。

intro.t: n. 简介；前奏（introduction 缩写）

e.en: Skip the {intro} and jump straight to the tutorial.
e.zh: 跳过开头介绍,直接进入教程部分。

e.en: The song's guitar {intro} became instantly recognizable on radio.
e.zh: 这首歌的吉他前奏在电台一播出就让人立刻能认出来。

e.en: Let me {introduce} you to my new business partner.
e.zh: 让我把你介绍给我新的商业伙伴。

e.en: The company plans to {introduce} a new product next quarter.
e.zh: 公司计划下个季度推出一款新产品。

introduced.t: v. introduce 的过去式；已引入

e.en: She {introduced} herself to everyone at the networking event.
e.zh: 她在社交活动上向每个人作了自我介绍。

e.en: Apple {introduced} a redesigned interface at the developer conference.
e.zh: 苹果在开发者大会上推出了重新设计的界面。

introduces.t: v. introduce 的第三人称单数

e.en: The host {introduces} each guest before the panel begins.
e.zh: 主持人在小组讨论开始前介绍每位嘉宾。

e.en: Chapter one {introduces} the main characters and the setting.
e.zh: 第一章介绍了主要人物和故事背景。

introducing.t: v. introduce 的现在分词；正在引入

e.en: The teacher is {introducing} fractions to her third-grade class.
e.zh: 老师正在向她的三年级学生介绍分数概念。

e.en: Netflix is {introducing} a cheaper ad-supported subscription tier.
e.zh: 奈飞正在推出一个更便宜的含广告订阅档位。

e.en: The book's {introduction} explains why the topic matters today.
e.zh: 这本书的引言解释了为何该主题在今天具有重要意义。

e.en: His {introduction} to programming came through a free online course.
e.zh: 他对编程的初次接触来自一门免费在线课程。

introductions.t: n. introduction 的复数；引言；介绍

e.en: The host made {introductions} before everyone sat down to dinner.
e.zh: 主人在大家坐下用餐前作了介绍。

e.en: Quick {introductions} at networking events rarely lead to real connections.
e.zh: 社交活动上的简短介绍很少能促成真正的联系。

e.en: The {introductory} chapter covers the basics of machine learning.
e.zh: 导言章节涵盖了机器学习的基础知识。

e.en: New customers receive an {introductory} discount on their first order.
e.zh: 新顾客首次下单可享受入门优惠折扣。

introject.t: v. (心理)内射；将外部观念内化

e.en: Children often {introject} the values of their parents unconsciously.
e.zh: 儿童常常无意识地内化父母的价值观。

e.en: In therapy, she examined a harsh {introject} from her childhood.
e.zh: 在治疗中,她审视了一个来自童年的严苛内摄客体。

e.en: Therapists discuss {introjection} as absorbing others' values unconsciously.
e.zh: 治疗师讨论内摄，即无意识地吸收他人的价值观。

e.en: Her harsh self-criticism reflected the {introjection} of her father's voice.
e.zh: 她严厉的自我批评反映了对父亲声音的内摄。

e.en: Each {intron} is removed before the messenger RNA is translated.
e.zh: 每个内含子在信使RNA翻译之前都会被去除。

e.en: Scientists discovered an unusually long {intron} in this gene.
e.zh: 科学家在这个基因中发现了一个异常长的内含子。

e.en: Long walks alone often lead to deep {introspection}.
e.zh: 独自长时间散步常常会引发深刻的自我反省。

e.en: Python supports runtime {introspection} of objects and their attributes.
e.zh: Python 支持在运行时对对象及其属性进行内省。

introspective.t: adj. 善于自省的；内观的

e.en: His new album is more {introspective} than his earlier work.
e.zh: 他的新专辑比早期作品更加内省。

e.en: She became {introspective} after the breakup.
e.zh: 分手后她变得很爱自我反省。

e.en: {Introversion} is often confused with shyness, but they differ.
e.zh: 内向常被误认为是害羞，但两者其实不同。

e.en: His {introversion} made large parties exhausting for him.
e.zh: 他的内向让大型聚会对他来说很消耗精力。

e.en: As an {introvert}, she recharges by spending time alone.
e.zh: 作为一个内向者，她靠独处来恢复精力。

e.en: Many great writers are {introvert} types who observe quietly.
e.zh: 许多伟大的作家都是默默观察的内向型人。

e.en: He's {introverted} but warms up once you know him.
e.zh: 他比较内向，但熟了之后就会变得热络起来。

e.en: The {introverted} child preferred reading to playing outside.
e.zh: 那个内向的孩子更喜欢看书而不是在外面玩。

e.en: I don't want to {intrude} on your family time.
e.zh: 我不想打扰你们的家庭时间。

e.en: Notifications constantly {intrude} into our daily focus.
e.zh: 通知不断地打扰我们日常的专注力。

e.en: A stranger {intruded} on the meeting and demanded answers.
e.zh: 一个陌生人闯入会议要求得到答复。

e.en: Work emails {intruded} on her vacation again.
e.zh: 工作邮件又一次打扰了她的假期。

e.en: The dog barked loudly when an {intruder} entered the yard.
e.zh: 当有入侵者进入院子时，狗大声地叫了起来。

e.en: Security cameras caught the {intruder} climbing the fence.
e.zh: 监控摄像头拍到了那个入侵者翻越围栏。

e.en: The alarm system alerts homeowners about possible {intruders}.
e.zh: 警报系统会提醒屋主有可能出现的入侵者。

e.en: Geese aggressively chase {intruders} away from their nests.
e.zh: 鹅会凶猛地把入侵者从巢穴附近赶走。

intrudes.t: v. 闯入、打扰（第三人称单数）

e.en: Traffic noise constantly {intrudes} into the quiet apartment.
e.zh: 交通噪音不断地侵入这间安静的公寓。

e.en: He never {intrudes} on conversations without being invited.
e.zh: 未经邀请，他从不打断别人的对话。

e.en: Sorry for {intruding}, but the meeting starts in five minutes.
e.zh: 抱歉打扰一下，会议五分钟后就要开始了。

e.en: Reporters were {intruding} on the family's private grief.
e.zh: 记者们在打扰这家人私下的悲痛。

e.en: The hackers' {intrusion} compromised millions of user accounts.
e.zh: 黑客的入侵导致数百万用户账号泄露。

e.en: She viewed the question as an {intrusion} into her privacy.
e.zh: 她认为这个问题是对她隐私的侵犯。

e.en: The firewall blocks most network {intrusions} automatically.
e.zh: 防火墙会自动拦截大多数网络入侵。

e.en: He resented the constant {intrusions} into his personal life.
e.zh: 他厌恶不断有人侵入他的私人生活。

e.en: Targeted ads can feel {intrusive} and a bit creepy.
e.zh: 定向广告会让人觉得很侵扰，还有点令人不安。

e.en: The reporter's questions became increasingly {intrusive}.
e.zh: 那位记者的问题变得越来越具有侵扰性。

e.en: Users complained about the {intrusiveness} of the new pop-up ads.
e.zh: 用户抱怨新弹窗广告的侵扰性太强。

e.en: The app's {intrusiveness} pushed many people to uninstall it.
e.zh: 这款应用的过度侵扰促使很多人卸载了它。

e.en: Doctors had to {intubate} the patient to help him breathe.
e.zh: 医生不得不为这位病人插管以帮助他呼吸。

e.en: Paramedics are trained to {intubate} in emergencies.
e.zh: 急救人员都接受过紧急情况下气管插管的训练。

e.en: The patient required {intubation} after the severe accident.
e.zh: 严重事故后这位病人需要进行气管插管。

e.en: Emergency {intubation} saved his life in the ambulance.
e.zh: 在救护车上紧急插管救了他的命。

e.en: Good designers can {intuit} what users actually need.
e.zh: 优秀的设计师能够直觉地把握用户真正的需求。

e.en: She could {intuit} his mood the moment he walked in.
e.zh: 他一走进来，她就能凭直觉感受到他的情绪。

intuited.t: v. 凭直觉感知（过去式）

e.en: She {intuited} the answer before reading the full question.
e.zh: 她还没读完整道题就凭直觉得出了答案。

e.en: He {intuited} that something was wrong from her tone.
e.zh: 他从她的语气中直觉地感到有些不对劲。

e.en: She has a knack for {intuiting} people's true motives.
e.zh: 她很擅长直觉地看穿别人的真实动机。

e.en: {Intuiting} the market shift, he sold his stocks early.
e.zh: 凭直觉感知市场转向，他提前卖掉了股票。

e.en: Trust your {intuition} when something feels off.
e.zh: 当感觉不对劲时，要相信你的直觉。

e.en: Her {intuition} about the candidate turned out to be right.
e.zh: 她对那位候选人的直觉后来证明是对的。

e.en: Our moral {intuitions} often shape political opinions.
e.zh: 我们的道德直觉常常会塑造政治观点。

e.en: Experienced doctors rely on clinical {intuitions} as well as data.
e.zh: 经验丰富的医生既依靠数据，也依靠临床直觉。

intuitive.t: adj. 直观的；符合直觉的

e.en: The new app has a clean and {intuitive} interface.
e.zh: 这款新应用的界面简洁而直观。

e.en: She has an {intuitive} understanding of how children think.
e.zh: 她对孩子的思维方式有一种直觉式的理解。

e.en: Users can {intuitively} navigate the menu without instructions.
e.zh: 用户无需说明就能直觉地浏览菜单。

e.en: He {intuitively} knew which path was the right one.
e.zh: 他凭直觉就知道哪条路才是对的。

intuits.t: v. 凭直觉感知（第三人称单数）

e.en: A great therapist {intuits} what a client cannot say.
e.zh: 优秀的治疗师能直觉地察觉来访者说不出口的话。

e.en: The algorithm {intuits} user preferences from past clicks.
e.zh: 该算法能根据过去的点击直觉地推断用户的喜好。

e.en: The fireproof paint forms an {intumescence} when heated.
e.zh: 这种防火漆受热时会形成膨胀层。

e.en: Doctors observed an unusual {intumescence} near the wound.
e.zh: 医生在伤口附近观察到了异常的肿胀。

inuit.t: n. 因纽特人（北极原住民）

e.en: The {Inuit} have lived in the Arctic for thousands of years.
e.zh: 因纽特人已经在北极生活了数千年。

e.en: Traditional {Inuit} clothing is designed for extreme cold.
e.zh: 传统的因纽特服装是为极寒环境设计的。

inulin.t: n. 菊粉（一种膳食纤维）

e.en: Chicory root is a popular source of dietary {inulin}.
e.zh: 菊苣根是膳食菊粉的常见来源。

e.en: {Inulin} is added to many products as a prebiotic fiber.
e.zh: 许多产品中都加入菊粉作为益生元纤维。

e.en: Heavy rains often {inundate} the low-lying neighborhoods.
e.zh: 暴雨经常会淹没那些地势低洼的街区。

e.en: Fans {inundate} the singer with messages after every show.
e.zh: 每场演出后粉丝都会用大量信息淹没那位歌手。

inundated.t: v. 淹没、应接不暇（过去式）

e.en: The customer service team was {inundated} with complaints.
e.zh: 客服团队被大量投诉淹没了。

e.en: The river {inundated} the entire valley after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，河水淹没了整个山谷。

e.en: The {inundation} damaged thousands of homes along the coast.
e.zh: 那场洪涝摧毁了沿海数千户人家的房屋。

e.en: Email filters help manage the daily {inundation} of messages.
e.zh: 邮件过滤器有助于应对每天大量涌入的邮件。

inure.t: v. 使习惯（于不快之事）

e.en: Years on the job {inure} nurses to difficult sights.
e.zh: 多年的工作让护士对艰难的场面变得习以为常。

e.en: Cold morning runs {inure} you to harsh winter weather.
e.zh: 清晨在寒冷中跑步能让你逐渐适应严寒的冬天。

e.en: Soldiers become {inured} to the sounds of gunfire.
e.zh: 士兵们逐渐对枪声变得习以为常。

e.en: She had grown {inured} to her boss's constant criticism.
e.zh: 她已经对老板不停的批评变得麻木了。

e.en: Tourists {invade} the small town every summer.
e.zh: 游客每年夏天都会大量涌入这座小镇。

e.en: The army planned to {invade} the coastal region at dawn.
e.zh: 军队计划在黎明时分入侵沿海地区。

e.en: Ants {invaded} the kitchen after we left food out.
e.zh: 我们把食物留在外面后，蚂蚁就侵入了厨房。

e.en: Roman legions {invaded} Britain nearly two thousand years ago.
e.zh: 罗马军团在将近两千年前入侵了不列颠。

e.en: The villagers fought bravely against every {invader}.
e.zh: 村民们勇敢地抵抗每一个入侵者。

e.en: Kudzu is an aggressive plant {invader} in the southern states.
e.zh: 葛藤是美国南部各州一种侵略性极强的入侵植物。

invades.t: v. 入侵（第三人称单数）

e.en: Loud music {invades} the apartment from upstairs every night.
e.zh: 每晚楼上的吵闹音乐都会侵入这间公寓。

e.en: The fungus {invades} the plant's roots and slowly kills it.
e.zh: 这种真菌会侵入植物的根部并慢慢使其枯死。

e.en: Wild boars are {invading} suburban gardens in search of food.
e.zh: 野猪正在闯入郊区的花园寻找食物。

e.en: The {invading} forces met fierce local resistance.
e.zh: 入侵的部队遭到了当地激烈的抵抗。

invalid.t:
adj. 无效的；不成立的
n. 病弱者

e.en: Your password was marked as {invalid}, please try again.
e.zh: 你的密码被标记为无效，请再试一次。

e.en: The contract is {invalid} without both parties' signatures.
e.zh: 没有双方签字的合同是无效的。

e.en: A single counterexample can {invalidate} the entire theory.
e.zh: 一个反例就足以推翻整个理论。

e.en: Tampering with the device will {invalidate} the warranty.
e.zh: 擅自改动设备将会使保修失效。

e.en: The court ordered the {invalidation} of the unfair contract.
e.zh: 法院下令宣告这份不公平合同无效。

e.en: Constant {invalidation} of her feelings damaged the relationship.
e.zh: 对她感受的不断否定损害了这段关系。

e.en: The lawyer argued the {invalidity} of the original will.
e.zh: 律师主张那份原始遗嘱无效。

e.en: Researchers proved the {invalidity} of the earlier study's conclusions.
e.zh: 研究人员证明了早期研究结论的无效性。

e.en: Her advice during the project was absolutely {invaluable}.
e.zh: 她在项目期间提供的建议非常宝贵。

e.en: Local guides are {invaluable} when you visit a new country.
e.zh: 当你前往一个陌生国家时，当地向导是无可替代的。

e.en: His morning coffee is an {invariable} part of the routine.
e.zh: 早晨的咖啡是他日常中雷打不动的一部分。

e.en: The teacher's {invariable} kindness made students feel safe.
e.zh: 老师始终如一的善意让学生们感到安心。

e.en: He {invariably} forgets his umbrella on rainy days.
e.zh: 下雨天他总是忘带伞。

e.en: Cheap flights {invariably} come with hidden fees.
e.zh: 廉价机票总是会伴随着各种隐藏费用。

e.en: Physicists value the {invariance} of natural laws across the universe.
e.zh: 物理学家重视自然定律在整个宇宙中的不变性。

e.en: Translation {invariance} is a key property in image recognition.
e.zh: 平移不变性是图像识别中的一个关键特性。

invariant.t:
adj. 不变的
n. 不变量

e.en: The loop preserves an important {invariant} on every iteration.
e.zh: 这个循环在每次迭代中都保持着一个重要的不变量。

e.en: Speed of light is {invariant} for all observers.
e.zh: 光速对所有观察者来说都是恒定不变的。

e.en: Reading her diary felt like an {invasion} of privacy.
e.zh: 读她的日记感觉像是侵犯了隐私。

e.en: The {invasion} began before dawn on a cold morning.
e.zh: 那场入侵在一个寒冷的清晨黎明前开始。

e.en: History books document many {invasions} of the empire.
e.zh: 历史书记载了帝国遭受的多次入侵。

e.en: The garden suffers from frequent {invasions} of rabbits.
e.zh: 花园经常遭到兔子的入侵。

invasive.t: adj. 侵入性的；(物种) 入侵的

e.en: This plant is highly {invasive} and crowds out natives.
e.zh: 这种植物极具入侵性,会挤占本地物种。

e.en: Doctors prefer less {invasive} surgical procedures when possible.
e.zh: 医生尽量选择创伤较小的手术方式。

e.en: The {invasiveness} of the test made patients uncomfortable.
e.zh: 该检查的侵入性让病人感到不适。

e.en: Scientists study the {invasiveness} of the foreign weed.
e.zh: 科学家研究这种外来杂草的入侵能力。

e.en: The senator hurled {invective} at his political opponents.
e.zh: 这位参议员对政敌大肆谩骂。

e.en: Her speech was full of bitter {invective}.
e.zh: 她的演讲充满了尖刻的辱骂。

e.en: Critics {inveigh} against the new tax policy daily.
e.zh: 评论员每天都在猛烈抨击新的税收政策。

e.en: He likes to {inveigh} against modern social media.
e.zh: 他喜欢痛斥当今的社交媒体。

e.en: Salesmen tried to {inveigle} her into buying insurance.
e.zh: 推销员设法诱骗她购买保险。

e.en: He managed to {inveigle} an invitation to the party.
e.zh: 他设法骗到了一张派对的邀请。

invent.t:
v. 发明；创造
v. 捏造（借口等）

e.en: Engineers {invent} new gadgets to solve everyday problems.
e.zh: 工程师们发明各种小玩意来解决日常问题。

e.en: Kids love to {invent} stories about imaginary friends.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢编关于幻想朋友的故事。

invented.t:
v. 发明（invent 的过去式）
adj. 虚构的

e.en: Edison {invented} the practical light bulb in 1879.
e.zh: 爱迪生于1879年发明了实用的电灯泡。

e.en: She {invented} an excuse to leave the meeting early.
e.zh: 她编了个借口提早离开了会议。

inventing.t: v. 发明（invent 的进行式）

e.en: He spends his weekends {inventing} useful kitchen tools.
e.zh: 他周末都在发明实用的厨房工具。

e.en: Stop {inventing} excuses and just finish the report.
e.zh: 别再找借口了,把报告写完。

invention.t:
n. 发明；发明物
n. 捏造

e.en: The smartphone is a remarkable {invention} of our era.
e.zh: 智能手机是我们这个时代了不起的发明。

e.en: Her story about traffic was pure {invention}.
e.zh: 她关于堵车的说法纯属虚构。

e.en: Many of his {inventions} changed how we live today.
e.zh: 他的许多发明改变了我们今天的生活方式。

e.en: The museum displays {inventions} from the industrial revolution.
e.zh: 博物馆展示了工业革命时期的发明。

inventive.t: adj. 有创造力的；善于发明的

e.en: She came up with an {inventive} solution to the bug.
e.zh: 她想出了一个有创意的方法来解决这个漏洞。

e.en: Children are naturally {inventive} when given free time.
e.zh: 孩子们在自由时间里天生就富有创造力。

e.en: The chef {inventively} combines local and Asian ingredients.
e.zh: 这位厨师创造性地融合本地与亚洲食材。

e.en: She {inventively} repurposed old jars as plant pots.
e.zh: 她巧妙地把旧罐子改造成花盆。

e.en: His {inventiveness} earned him several engineering awards.
e.zh: 他的创造力为他赢得了多个工程奖项。

e.en: The puzzle requires real {inventiveness} to solve.
e.zh: 这道谜题需要真正的创造力才能解开。

e.en: The {inventor} of the vaccine became world famous overnight.
e.zh: 疫苗的发明者一夜之间举世闻名。

e.en: She is the {inventor} behind a popular kitchen gadget.
e.zh: 她是一款热门厨房小工具的发明者。

e.en: Young {inventors} showcased their projects at the science fair.
e.zh: 年轻的发明者们在科学展上展示了他们的作品。

e.en: Many {inventors} struggled financially before achieving success.
e.zh: 许多发明家在成功之前都经济拮据。

inventory.t:
n. 库存；存货清单
v. 清点库存

e.en: The store does an {inventory} count every Sunday night.
e.zh: 这家店每周日晚上盘点库存。

e.en: We need to restock our {inventory} before the holidays.
e.zh: 我们得在节假日前补充库存。

invents.t: v. 发明（invent 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He constantly {invents} new excuses for being late.
e.zh: 他总是不停地编造迟到的新借口。

e.en: That lab {invents} cutting-edge medical devices each year.
e.zh: 那家实验室每年都会发明尖端医疗设备。

invercargill.t: n. 因弗卡吉尔（新西兰城市）

e.en: {Invercargill} is the southernmost city in New Zealand.
e.zh: 因弗卡吉尔是新西兰最南端的城市。

e.en: We drove from Queenstown to {Invercargill} in three hours.
e.zh: 我们从皇后镇开车到因弗卡吉尔用了三小时。

inverclyde.t: n. 因弗克莱德（苏格兰行政区）

e.en: {Inverclyde} is a council area on Scotland's west coast.
e.zh: 因弗克莱德是苏格兰西海岸的一个区。

e.en: Many shipyards once operated along the {Inverclyde} coastline.
e.zh: 过去因弗克莱德沿岸有许多造船厂。

invergordon.t: n. 因弗戈登（苏格兰港口）

e.en: {Invergordon} is a Scottish port known for its distillery.
e.zh: 因弗戈登是苏格兰一个以蒸馏厂闻名的港口。

e.en: Cruise ships frequently dock at {Invergordon} in summer.
e.zh: 夏季有许多游轮停靠在因弗戈登。

inverness.t: n. 因弗内斯（苏格兰城市）

e.en: {Inverness} is often called the capital of the Highlands.
e.zh: 因弗内斯常被称为苏格兰高地的首府。

e.en: Tourists visit {Inverness} to see Loch Ness nearby.
e.zh: 游客前往因弗内斯参观附近的尼斯湖。

inverse.t:
adj. 相反的；倒转的
n. 反面；倒数

e.en: Price and demand often have an {inverse} relationship.
e.zh: 价格和需求通常呈反比关系。

e.en: Multiplication is the {inverse} operation of division.
e.zh: 乘法是除法的逆运算。

e.en: Stress and sleep quality are {inversely} related.
e.zh: 压力与睡眠质量呈反比关系。

e.en: Air pressure changes {inversely} with altitude.
e.zh: 气压随海拔升高而反向变化。

inversion.t:
n. 倒置；反转
n. 倒装（语法）

e.en: A temperature {inversion} trapped smog over the city.
e.zh: 逆温层把烟雾困在了城市上空。

e.en: The sentence uses an {inversion} for poetic effect.
e.zh: 这个句子用了倒装来营造诗意效果。

e.en: {Invert} the cake onto a cooling rack carefully.
e.zh: 小心地把蛋糕倒扣到冷却架上。

e.en: You can {invert} the colors in the photo editor.
e.zh: 你可以在图片编辑器里把颜色反相。

invertebrate.t:
n. 无脊椎动物
adj. 无脊椎的

e.en: An octopus is the most intelligent known {invertebrate}.
e.zh: 章鱼是已知最聪明的无脊椎动物。

e.en: Most species on Earth are actually {invertebrate} animals.
e.zh: 地球上大多数物种其实都是无脊椎动物。

e.en: She {inverted} the bottle to drain the last drops.
e.zh: 她把瓶子倒过来,把最后几滴倒出来。

e.en: The yield curve has {inverted}, signaling a possible recession.
e.zh: 收益率曲线已经倒挂,可能预示着经济衰退。

e.en: The solar panels feed power through an {inverter}.
e.zh: 太阳能板通过逆变器输出电力。

e.en: A faulty {inverter} can damage your home appliances.
e.zh: 逆变器故障可能会损坏家用电器。

inverting.t: v. 使倒置（invert 的进行式）

e.en: {Inverting} the image revealed a hidden message.
e.zh: 把图像反转后显示出了一条隐藏信息。

e.en: He fixed the bug by {inverting} the boolean check.
e.zh: 他通过取反布尔判断修复了这个漏洞。

invest.t:
v. 投资
v. 投入（时间、精力）

e.en: Many people {invest} in index funds for retirement.
e.zh: 许多人投资指数基金为退休做准备。

e.en: Good parents {invest} time in their children's education.
e.zh: 好父母会在孩子的教育上投入时间。

invested.t: v. 投资（invest 的过去式）

e.en: She {invested} her savings in a small coffee shop.
e.zh: 她把积蓄投资到一家小咖啡馆里。

e.en: He is deeply {invested} in the team's success.
e.zh: 他非常关心这支团队的成功。

e.en: Police will {investigate} the cause of the accident.
e.zh: 警方将调查这起事故的原因。

e.en: Let's {investigate} why the server crashed last night.
e.zh: 我们来查一下服务器昨晚为什么宕机。

investigated.t: v. 调查（investigate 的过去式）

e.en: Detectives {investigated} the case for over six months.
e.zh: 侦探们对此案调查了六个多月。

e.en: The team {investigated} several possible causes of the bug.
e.zh: 团队调查了导致这个漏洞的几种可能原因。

investigates.t: v. 调查（第三人称单数）

e.en: This podcast {investigates} unsolved mysteries from the 1980s.
e.zh: 这个播客调查上世纪八十年代的未解之谜。

e.en: The agency {investigates} financial fraud across the country.
e.zh: 该机构调查全国范围内的金融诈骗案件。

investigating.t: v. 调查（investigate 的进行式）

e.en: Officials are {investigating} reports of contaminated water.
e.zh: 官员们正在调查水质污染的报告。

e.en: She is {investigating} a strange noise in the basement.
e.zh: 她正在查地下室里传来的奇怪声响。

e.en: The {investigation} into the data breach is ongoing.
e.zh: 对此次数据泄露的调查仍在进行中。

e.en: Their {investigation} revealed serious safety violations at the factory.
e.zh: 他们的调查揭露了工厂严重的安全违规问题。

e.en: Patients can join trials of {investigational} cancer drugs.
e.zh: 患者可以参加在研抗癌药物的试验。

e.en: The clinic offers an {investigational} treatment for migraines.
e.zh: 该诊所提供一种试验性的偏头痛疗法。

e.en: Several {investigations} are looking into the company's accounting.
e.zh: 多项调查正在审查这家公司的财务账目。

e.en: Independent {investigations} confirmed the journalist's findings.
e.zh: 独立调查证实了这位记者的发现。

e.en: She won an award for her {investigative} journalism.
e.zh: 她凭借调查性新闻报道获得了奖项。

e.en: The newspaper has a strong {investigative} reporting team.
e.zh: 这家报社有一支强大的调查报道团队。

e.en: The lead {investigator} questioned witnesses for hours.
e.zh: 首席调查员对证人盘问了数小时。

e.en: A private {investigator} was hired to find the missing teen.
e.zh: 家属雇了一名私家侦探寻找失踪的少年。

e.en: Federal {investigators} are reviewing thousands of emails.
e.zh: 联邦调查人员正在审阅数千封电子邮件。

e.en: Crash {investigators} arrived at the scene within hours.
e.zh: 事故调查人员在数小时内赶到了现场。

e.en: The committee has broad {investigatory} powers under the law.
e.zh: 该委员会依法拥有广泛的调查权。

e.en: Police followed standard {investigatory} procedures throughout the case.
e.zh: 警方在整个案件中遵循了标准调查程序。

investing.t:
v. 投资（invest 的进行式）
n. 投资行为

e.en: {Investing} early in life can build long-term wealth.
e.zh: 年轻时开始投资有助于积累长期财富。

e.en: The company is {investing} heavily in renewable energy.
e.zh: 该公司正大力投资可再生能源。

investiture.t: n. 授职典礼；就职仪式

e.en: The new bishop's {investiture} took place at the cathedral.
e.zh: 新主教的就职典礼在大教堂举行。

e.en: Crowds gathered to witness the prince's {investiture}.
e.zh: 人群聚集观看王子的授封仪式。

e.en: Real estate is often considered a safe long-term {investment}.
e.zh: 房地产通常被视为一种安全的长期投资。

e.en: Learning a new language requires significant {investment} of time.
e.zh: 学习一门新语言需要投入大量时间。

e.en: Her {investments} have grown steadily over the past decade.
e.zh: 她的投资在过去十年里稳步增长。

e.en: Diversify your {investments} to reduce overall risk.
e.zh: 分散你的投资以降低整体风险。

e.en: Every {investor} should understand basic risk management.
e.zh: 每个投资者都应该了解基本的风险管理。

e.en: A wealthy {investor} agreed to fund the startup.
e.zh: 一位富有的投资人同意为这家初创公司提供资金。

e.en: Early {investors} in the startup made huge returns.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的早期投资者获得了丰厚回报。

e.en: Nervous {investors} sold off shares after the announcement.
e.zh: 消息发布后,紧张的投资者纷纷抛售股票。

invests.t: v. 投资（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {invests} a portion of every paycheck in stocks.
e.zh: 她每次发薪都会拿出一部分投资股票。

e.en: The foundation {invests} heavily in girls' education programs.
e.zh: 该基金会大力投资女孩教育项目。

inveterate.t: adj. 根深蒂固的；积习难改的

e.en: He is an {inveterate} liar who never tells the truth.
e.zh: 他是个积习难改的骗子，从不说实话。

e.en: She remains an {inveterate} fan of classical music.
e.zh: 她始终是古典音乐的铁杆爱好者。

invidious.t: adj. 招人反感的；易招嫉的

e.en: Comparing the two artists puts me in an {invidious} position.
e.zh: 比较这两位艺术家让我处于一个招人反感的位置。

e.en: The boss made an {invidious} distinction between full-time and part-time staff.
e.zh: 老板对全职和兼职员工做出了不公平的区别对待。

e.en: The report {invidiously} compared her work to her colleague's.
e.zh: 报告令人不快地将她的工作与同事的进行比较。

e.en: He spoke {invidiously} about his rival's recent promotion.
e.zh: 他对对手最近的升职说了些招人反感的话。

e.en: Two teachers will {invigilate} the final exam tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 明天上午将有两位老师监考期末考试。

e.en: She was paid extra to {invigilate} the entrance test.
e.zh: 她因监考入学考试而获得额外报酬。

invigorate.t: v. 使充满活力；使精神焕发

e.en: A cold shower can {invigorate} you on a hot day.
e.zh: 在炎热的日子里，洗个冷水澡能让人精神焕发。

e.en: New leadership might {invigorate} the struggling startup.
e.zh: 新的领导层或许能为这家陷入困境的初创公司注入活力。

invigorated.t:
adj. 精神焕发的
v. invigorate 的过去式

e.en: She felt {invigorated} after her morning run in the park.
e.zh: 她在公园晨跑后感到精神百倍。

e.en: The team was {invigorated} by their unexpected victory.
e.zh: 这支队伍因意外的胜利而充满干劲。

invigorating.t: adj. 令人振奋的；提神的

e.en: The mountain air was cold and {invigorating}.
e.zh: 山间的空气清冷而提神。

e.en: We had an {invigorating} discussion about the project's future.
e.zh: 我们就项目的未来进行了一场令人振奋的讨论。

e.en: The champion's aura of {invincibility} finally faded last night.
e.zh: 这位冠军不可战胜的光环昨晚终于褪去。

e.en: Teenagers often have a false sense of {invincibility}.
e.zh: 青少年常有一种错误的无敌感。

invincible.t: adj. 无敌的；不可战胜的

e.en: After ten straight wins, the team seemed {invincible}.
e.zh: 连胜十场后，这支球队看起来不可战胜。

e.en: No fortress is truly {invincible} given enough time.
e.zh: 只要时间足够，没有哪座堡垒是真正攻不破的。

inviolability.t: n. 不可侵犯性；神圣不可侵犯

e.en: The constitution guarantees the {inviolability} of personal privacy.
e.zh: 宪法保障个人隐私不受侵犯。

e.en: Diplomats rely on the {inviolability} of their embassies.
e.zh: 外交官依赖于使馆不可侵犯的地位。

inviolable.t: adj. 不可侵犯的；神圣的

e.en: Freedom of speech is considered an {inviolable} right.
e.zh: 言论自由被视为不可侵犯的权利。

e.en: She made an {inviolable} promise to keep his secret.
e.zh: 她做出了一个绝不能违背的承诺，要为他保守秘密。

inviolate.t: adj. 未受侵犯的；完整无损的

e.en: The ancient tomb remained {inviolate} for over a thousand years.
e.zh: 这座古墓一千多年来始终未被扰动。

e.en: He kept his principles {inviolate} despite intense pressure.
e.zh: 尽管承受巨大压力，他仍坚守自己的原则不被破坏。

e.en: The cloak's {invisibility} feature is just a movie fantasy.
e.zh: 那件斗篷的隐身功能只是电影里的幻想。

e.en: She wrote about the social {invisibility} of older women.
e.zh: 她撰文谈到年长女性在社会中被忽视的处境。

e.en: Carbon monoxide is an {invisible} but deadly gas.
e.zh: 一氧化碳是一种看不见却致命的气体。

e.en: As an intern, she often felt {invisible} in meetings.
e.zh: 作为实习生，她在会议上常感到被无视。

e.en: The app runs {invisibly} in the background while you work.
e.zh: 这款应用会在你工作时悄无声息地在后台运行。

e.en: Tiny cracks spread {invisibly} through the old foundation.
e.zh: 细小的裂缝在旧地基中悄然蔓延。

e.en: I received an {invitation} to her wedding next month.
e.zh: 我收到了她下个月婚礼的邀请。

e.en: Leaving the door unlocked is an {invitation} to thieves.
e.zh: 门不锁就是在引贼上门。

invitational.t:
adj. 邀请赛的
n. 邀请赛

e.en: Only top players compete in this annual {invitational} tournament.
e.zh: 只有顶尖选手才能参加这项年度邀请赛。

e.en: She won the golf {invitational} for the third time.
e.zh: 她第三次赢得了这场高尔夫邀请赛。

e.en: We sent {invitations} to fifty guests for the housewarming.
e.zh: 我们给五十位宾客寄出了乔迁派对的请柬。

e.en: Her startup received {invitations} from several venture capital firms.
e.zh: 她的初创公司收到了几家风险投资公司的邀约。

invite.t:
v. 邀请
n. 邀请（口语）

e.en: Let's {invite} the new neighbors over for dinner.
e.zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。

e.en: I just got an {invite} to the beta launch.
e.zh: 我刚收到内测发布的邀请。

invited.t:
adj. 受邀的
v. invite 的过去式

e.en: She {invited} her whole team to the celebration.
e.zh: 她邀请了整个团队参加庆祝活动。

e.en: Only {invited} guests can access the private channel.
e.zh: 只有受邀的嘉宾才能访问该私人频道。

invitee.t: n. 受邀者；被邀请的人

e.en: Each {invitee} must confirm attendance by Friday.
e.zh: 每位受邀者须在周五前确认出席。

e.en: The wedding planner emailed every {invitee} a digital card.
e.zh: 婚礼策划师给每位受邀人发送了电子请柬。

invites.t:
v. 邀请（第三人称单数）
n. 邀请（复数）

e.en: The company {invites} feedback from all its customers.
e.zh: 公司欢迎所有客户提出反馈。

e.en: I sent out the party {invites} this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我把派对邀请函发了出去。

e.en: The warm bakery had an {inviting} smell of fresh bread.
e.zh: 温暖的面包店里飘着诱人的新鲜面包香气。

e.en: Her smile was open and {inviting}.
e.zh: 她的笑容真诚而亲切。

e.en: The pool sparkled {invitingly} in the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 游泳池在午后阳光下波光粼粼，令人想跳进去。

e.en: She smiled {invitingly} and gestured to the empty seat.
e.zh: 她热情地一笑，指了指那个空座位。

invocation.t:
n. 调用（函数、程序）
n. 祈祷；祈求

e.en: The ceremony began with a brief {invocation} for peace.
e.zh: 仪式以一段简短的祈祷和平开场。

e.en: Each function {invocation} adds a frame to the call stack.
e.zh: 每次函数调用都会向调用栈增加一帧。

invoice.t:
n. 发票；账单
v. 开发票

e.en: Please pay the {invoice} within thirty days of receipt.
e.zh: 请在收到发票后三十天内付款。

e.en: I'll {invoice} you for the consulting hours next week.
e.zh: 我下周会就咨询工时给你开发票。

invoiced.t:
adj. 已开票的
v. invoice 的过去式

e.en: The supplier {invoiced} us for last month's deliveries.
e.zh: 供应商已就上个月的送货向我们开了发票。

e.en: All work must be {invoiced} by the end of the quarter.
e.zh: 所有工作须在季度末前开具发票。

invoices.t:
n. 发票（复数）
v. 开发票

e.en: She processes hundreds of {invoices} every week.
e.zh: 她每周要处理几百张发票。

e.en: Unpaid {invoices} are hurting our cash flow this quarter.
e.zh: 未付的发票正影响着我们这个季度的现金流。

invoicing.t:
n. 开票；开发票
v. invoice 的现在分词

e.en: Our new software automates {invoicing} for small businesses.
e.zh: 我们的新软件为小企业自动处理开票。

e.en: He's responsible for {invoicing} clients at the end of each project.
e.zh: 他负责在每个项目结束时向客户开具发票。

invoke.t:
v. 调用（方法、接口）
v. 援引；求助于

e.en: You can {invoke} the function with optional parameters.
e.zh: 你可以用可选参数调用这个函数。

e.en: The lawyer plans to {invoke} the Fifth Amendment.
e.zh: 律师打算援引宪法第五修正案。

invoked.t:
adj. 被调用的
v. invoke 的过去式

e.en: The president {invoked} emergency powers to address the crisis.
e.zh: 总统援引紧急权力以应对危机。

e.en: This callback is {invoked} whenever the data changes.
e.zh: 每当数据发生变化，这个回调就会被调用。

invokes.t: v. 调用（第三人称单数）

e.en: The script {invokes} a remote API on each request.
e.zh: 该脚本在每次请求时都会调用一个远程 API。

e.en: Her speech {invokes} the spirit of past civil rights leaders.
e.zh: 她的演讲唤起了过去民权领袖们的精神。

invoking.t: v. 调用（现在分词）；援引

e.en: He defended the policy by {invoking} national security concerns.
e.zh: 他以国家安全为由为这项政策辩护。

e.en: {Invoking} this method without arguments throws an error.
e.zh: 不带参数调用此方法会抛出错误。

involuntarily.t: adv. 不由自主地；无意地

e.en: She {involuntarily} flinched at the sudden loud noise.
e.zh: 突如其来的巨响让她不由自主地缩了一下。

e.en: Many workers were {involuntarily} reassigned after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后许多员工被非自愿地调岗。

involuntary.t: adj. 非自愿的；不由自主的

e.en: Blinking is an {involuntary} reflex you cannot fully control.
e.zh: 眨眼是一种你无法完全控制的不自主反射。

e.en: The layoffs led to many {involuntary} career changes.
e.zh: 这次裁员导致许多人被迫转行。

involution.t:
n. 内卷
n. 复杂化；退化

e.en: Chinese students often complain about academic {involution}.
e.zh: 中国学生常常抱怨学业上的内卷。

e.en: The plot's {involution} made the novel hard to follow.
e.zh: 情节的错综复杂让这部小说很难跟上。

e.en: The new role will {involve} a lot of travel.
e.zh: 这个新职位需要经常出差。

e.en: Try to {involve} every team member in the decision.
e.zh: 尽量让每位团队成员都参与到决策中来。

involved.t:
adj. 相关的；复杂的
v. involve 的过去式

e.en: Three departments are {involved} in this project.
e.zh: 这个项目涉及三个部门。

e.en: The recipe is more {involved} than it looks.
e.zh: 这道菜的做法比看起来要复杂得多。

e.en: His {involvement} in the scandal cost him the job.
e.zh: 他卷入这场丑闻让他丢了工作。

e.en: Parental {involvement} is key to a child's success at school.
e.zh: 父母的参与是孩子在学校取得成功的关键。

e.en: She listed her past community {involvements} on the application.
e.zh: 她在申请表上列出了过去参与的社区活动。

e.en: His many business {involvements} kept him traveling constantly.
e.zh: 他参与的众多生意让他不停地奔波。

involves.t: v. 涉及（第三人称单数）

e.en: The job {involves} writing reports and meeting clients.
e.zh: 这份工作包括写报告和会见客户。

e.en: Cooking this dish {involves} marinating the meat overnight.
e.zh: 做这道菜需要把肉腌一整晚。

involving.t:
v. 涉及（现在分词）
prep. 关于

e.en: Police are investigating an accident {involving} three vehicles.
e.zh: 警方正在调查一起涉及三辆车的事故。

e.en: She enjoys projects {involving} both design and coding.
e.zh: 她喜欢同时涉及设计和编程的项目。

e.en: No system can claim total {invulnerability} to cyberattacks.
e.zh: 没有任何系统能宣称对网络攻击完全免疫。

e.en: The hero's {invulnerability} is broken by a single weakness.
e.zh: 这位英雄的刀枪不入因一个弱点而被打破。

invulnerable.t: adj. 无懈可击的；不会受伤的

e.en: He acted as if he were {invulnerable} to criticism.
e.zh: 他表现得仿佛对批评毫不在意。

e.en: No software is completely {invulnerable} to bugs.
e.zh: 没有任何软件是完全没有漏洞的。

inward.t:
adj. 向内的；内心的
adv. 向内

e.en: The door swings {inward} when you push the handle.
e.zh: 按下把手时，门会向内打开。

e.en: Meditation encourages an {inward} focus on the breath.
e.zh: 冥想鼓励将注意力向内集中在呼吸上。

e.en: She smiled politely but groaned {inwardly} at the joke.
e.zh: 她礼貌地笑了笑，心里却对那个笑话暗暗叫苦。

e.en: He remained calm outside, though {inwardly} he was furious.
e.zh: 他外表平静，内心却怒火中烧。

e.en: Her poetry is celebrated for its emotional {inwardness}.
e.zh: 她的诗歌因其情感上的内省而备受赞誉。

e.en: The film explores the quiet {inwardness} of grief.
e.zh: 这部电影探索了悲伤中那份安静的内心世界。

e.en: The petals curl {inwards} as the flower closes for night.
e.zh: 花朵在夜里合拢时，花瓣会向内卷起。

e.en: After the failure, the team turned {inwards} to reflect.
e.zh: 失败之后，团队转而向内反思自己。

ioc.t: n. 控制反转（Inversion of Control）

e.en: The {IOC} announced the host city for the 2032 Olympics.
e.zh: 国际奥委会宣布了2032年奥运会的主办城市。

e.en: Spring uses {IOC} to manage object dependencies automatically.
e.zh: Spring 使用控制反转来自动管理对象之间的依赖关系。

e.en: The chemistry teacher wrote {IOD} as shorthand for iodine compounds.
e.zh: 化学老师把 IOD 作为碘化合物的缩写写在黑板上。

e.en: Each lab sample was labeled with an {IOD} code for tracking.
e.zh: 每份实验样品都标有用于追踪的 IOD 编码。

e.en: Potassium {iodide} tablets are stockpiled for nuclear emergencies.
e.zh: 碘化钾药片被储备用于核事故应急。

e.en: The lab technician carefully measured the silver {iodide} solution.
e.zh: 实验员小心地量取了碘化银溶液。

e.en: The nurse applied {iodine} to clean the wound.
e.zh: 护士涂上碘酒来清洁伤口。

e.en: Seaweed is naturally rich in {iodine} and minerals.
e.zh: 海带天然富含碘和矿物质。

e.en: Most table salt sold today is {iodized} for health.
e.zh: 如今出售的大多数食盐为了健康都加了碘。

e.en: Switching to {iodized} salt helped prevent thyroid problems.
e.zh: 改用加碘盐有助于预防甲状腺疾病。

iom.t: n. 国际移民组织（International Organization for Migration）

e.en: The {IOM} helps coordinate global migration and refugee programs.
e.zh: 国际移民组织协助协调全球移民和难民项目。

e.en: She works as a field officer for the {IOM}.
e.zh: 她在国际移民组织担任外勤官员。

e.en: A sodium {ion} carries a single positive charge.
e.zh: 钠离子带一个正电荷。

e.en: Lithium-{ion} batteries power most modern smartphones.
e.zh: 锂离子电池为大多数现代智能手机供电。

e.en: The tiny island of {Iona} attracts pilgrims every summer.
e.zh: 小小的爱奥那岛每年夏天都吸引朝圣者前来。

e.en: {Iona} Abbey is one of Scotland's oldest Christian sites.
e.zh: 爱奥那修道院是苏格兰最古老的基督教遗址之一。

ionian.t:
adj. 爱奥尼亚的
n. 爱奥尼亚人

e.en: We sailed across the {Ionian} Sea toward Corfu.
e.zh: 我们乘船穿越爱奥尼亚海驶向科孚岛。

e.en: Ancient {Ionian} philosophers laid the foundations of Western thought.
e.zh: 古代爱奥尼亚的哲学家奠定了西方思想的基础。

ionic.t:
adj. 离子的
adj. 爱奥尼亚式的（建筑）

e.en: Salt forms an {ionic} bond between sodium and chlorine.
e.zh: 盐在钠和氯之间形成离子键。

e.en: The temple features tall columns in the {Ionic} style.
e.zh: 这座神庙以爱奥尼柱式的高大立柱为特色。

ionise.t: v. 使电离（ionize 的英式拼写）

e.en: X-rays can {ionise} atoms in living tissue.
e.zh: X 射线能使活体组织中的原子电离。

e.en: The device uses lasers to {ionise} the gas sample.
e.zh: 该装置使用激光使气体样本电离。

e.en: The air becomes {ionised} during a thunderstorm.
e.zh: 雷暴期间空气会发生电离。

e.en: Scientists studied the {ionised} particles inside the chamber.
e.zh: 科学家研究了腔体内的电离粒子。

e.en: {Ionization} energy measures how tightly electrons are held.
e.zh: 电离能用来衡量电子被束缚的紧密程度。

e.en: Smoke detectors often rely on {ionization} chambers.
e.zh: 烟雾报警器通常依靠电离室来工作。

e.en: Strong UV light can {ionize} atoms in the upper atmosphere.
e.zh: 强紫外线能使高层大气中的原子电离。

e.en: The instrument uses heat to {ionize} the metal sample.
e.zh: 该仪器利用热量使金属样品电离。

e.en: The sun's surface is full of hot, {ionized} gas.
e.zh: 太阳表面充满了高温的电离气体。

e.en: He drinks {ionized} water, claiming it boosts energy.
e.zh: 他喝离子水,声称这能提升精力。

ionizing.t: adj. 电离的（如电离辐射）

e.en: Lead aprons protect patients from {ionizing} radiation during X-rays.
e.zh: 铅围裙在 X 光检查时保护患者免受电离辐射。

e.en: Workers near reactors wear badges that detect {ionizing} radiation.
e.zh: 反应堆附近的工人佩戴探测电离辐射的徽章。

e.en: Radio waves bounce off the {ionosphere} to reach distant cities.
e.zh: 无线电波借助电离层反射来传到遥远的城市。

e.en: Solar storms can disturb the {ionosphere} and disrupt GPS.
e.zh: 太阳风暴会扰动电离层并影响 GPS。

iota.t:
n. 极小量；一丁点
n. 希腊字母 Ι/ι

e.en: He didn't show one {iota} of remorse afterward.
e.zh: 事后他没有表现出一丝悔意。

e.en: Her opinion hasn't changed an {iota} since yesterday.
e.zh: 她的看法从昨天到现在一点都没变。

iou.t: n. 借据；欠条（I owe you）

e.en: He scribbled an {IOU} on a napkin for twenty bucks.
e.zh: 他在餐巾纸上潦草地写了一张二十块的欠条。

e.en: The startup paid contractors with {IOUs} during the cash crunch.
e.zh: 创业公司在资金紧张时用欠条支付承包商。

e.en: Candidates always campaign hard in {Iowa} before the primaries.
e.zh: 候选人总是在初选前在爱荷华州大力造势。

e.en: Endless cornfields stretched across rural {Iowa}.
e.zh: 无尽的玉米田铺满了爱荷华州的乡村。

e.en: Modern operating systems rely heavily on {IPC} between processes.
e.zh: 现代操作系统在很大程度上依赖进程间通信。

e.en: We used shared memory for fast {IPC} in the app.
e.zh: 我们在应用中使用共享内存以实现快速进程间通信。

ipcc.t: n. 政府间气候变化专门委员会

e.en: The {IPCC} released a sobering report on rising sea levels.
e.zh: 政府间气候变化专门委员会发布了关于海平面上升的严峻报告。

e.en: Scientists worldwide contribute to {IPCC} climate assessments.
e.zh: 全球科学家共同参与 IPCC 的气候评估。

e.en: Doctors no longer recommend {ipecac} syrup to induce vomiting.
e.zh: 医生不再推荐使用吐根糖浆来催吐。

e.en: The pharmacy stopped stocking {ipecac} years ago.
e.zh: 药店多年前就不再备有吐根制剂了。

e.en: She just upgraded to the latest {iPhone} last week.
e.zh: 她上周刚换了最新款 iPhone。

e.en: My {iPhone} battery dies way too quickly these days.
e.zh: 我的 iPhone 电池最近掉电太快了。

ipo.t: n. 首次公开募股（Initial Public Offering）

e.en: The startup is preparing for an {IPO} next spring.
e.zh: 这家创业公司正在为明年春天的 IPO 做准备。

e.en: Early employees became wealthy after the company's successful {IPO}.
e.zh: 公司成功上市后,早期员工都变得富有。

ipod.t: n. 苹果便携音乐播放器

e.en: I still have my old {iPod} loaded with classic albums.
e.zh: 我还留着那台装满经典专辑的旧 iPod。

e.en: Apple finally discontinued the {iPod} after two decades.
e.zh: 苹果在二十年后终于停产了 iPod。

ipsative.t: adj. 自比式的（心理测评，相对自身评分）

e.en: Personality tests often use {ipsative} scoring to force tradeoffs.
e.zh: 人格测试常用自比式计分法来强制选择取舍。

e.en: An {ipsative} measure compares traits within the same person.
e.zh: 自比式测量是在同一个人内部比较各项特质。

e.en: The pain radiated to the {ipsilateral} shoulder and arm.
e.zh: 疼痛放射到同侧的肩膀和手臂。

e.en: Surgeons noted swelling on the {ipsilateral} side of the injury.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到伤处同侧出现肿胀。

ipswich.t: n. 伊普斯维奇（英国城市）

e.en: The train to {Ipswich} departs from platform six.
e.zh: 开往伊普斯威奇的列车从六号站台发车。

e.en: {Ipswich} is one of England's oldest market towns.
e.zh: 伊普斯威奇是英格兰最古老的集镇之一。

ira.t:
n. 爱尔兰共和军
n. 个人退休账户（美国）

e.en: She maxes out her {IRA} contributions every year.
e.zh: 她每年都把个人退休账户的供款额度交满。

e.en: The {IRA} declared a ceasefire in the late nineties.
e.zh: 爱尔兰共和军在九十年代末宣布停火。

e.en: Tensions between {Iran} and the West dominated the news.
e.zh: 伊朗与西方之间的紧张关系成为新闻头条。

e.en: Persian poetry has flourished in {Iran} for over a thousand years.
e.zh: 波斯诗歌在伊朗已繁荣了一千多年。

irangate.t: n. 伊朗门事件（里根时期政治丑闻）

e.en: {Irangate} damaged Reagan's reputation during his second term.
e.zh: 伊朗门事件在里根第二任期内损害了他的声誉。

e.en: Historians still debate the full scope of {Irangate}.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在争论伊朗门的全部内幕。

iranian.t:
adj. 伊朗的
n. 伊朗人

e.en: My neighbor cooks amazing {Iranian} stews on weekends.
e.zh: 我邻居周末会做非常美味的伊朗炖菜。

e.en: The {Iranian} delegation arrived for nuclear talks in Vienna.
e.zh: 伊朗代表团抵达维也纳参加核谈判。

e.en: Reconstruction in {Iraq} continued long after the war ended.
e.zh: 伊拉克战后的重建工作在战争结束后仍持续了很久。

e.en: Ancient Mesopotamia covered much of present-day {Iraq}.
e.zh: 古代美索不达米亚涵盖了今天伊拉克的大部分地区。

iraqi.t:
adj. 伊拉克的
n. 伊拉克人

e.en: The {Iraqi} restaurant downtown serves wonderful lamb kebabs.
e.zh: 市中心那家伊拉克餐厅的羊肉串非常好吃。

e.en: {Iraqi} forces retook the city after months of fighting.
e.zh: 伊拉克部队在数月战斗后重新夺回了这座城市。

e.en: Many investors hold both Roth and traditional {IRAs}.
e.zh: 许多投资者同时持有罗斯和传统两种个人退休账户。

e.en: Financial advisors often recommend opening {IRAs} early in your career.
e.zh: 理财顾问通常建议在职业生涯早期就开设退休账户。

e.en: His {irascibility} made the office walk on eggshells.
e.zh: 他的暴躁脾气让整个办公室都得小心翼翼。

e.en: Age seemed to soften the old man's famous {irascibility}.
e.zh: 岁月似乎软化了这位老人出了名的火爆脾气。

e.en: The {irascible} chef yelled at everyone in the kitchen.
e.zh: 那位暴躁的主厨对厨房里的每个人大吼大叫。

e.en: Don't disturb grandpa before coffee — he's {irascible} in the morning.
e.zh: 喝咖啡前别打扰爷爷,他早上脾气很大。

e.en: {Irate} customers flooded the support line after the outage.
e.zh: 宕机之后,愤怒的客户把客服热线打爆了。

e.en: She wrote an {irate} email to the airline about lost luggage.
e.zh: 她为丢失的行李给航空公司写了一封措辞激烈的邮件。

e.en: He slammed the phone down {irately} after the argument.
e.zh: 争吵后他怒气冲冲地把电话摔下。

e.en: The driver honked {irately} at the slow truck ahead.
e.zh: 司机愤怒地朝前面那辆慢卡车按喇叭。

irb.t: n. 机构审查委员会（Institutional Review Board）

e.en: The study cannot start until the {IRB} approves the protocol.
e.zh: 在伦理审查委员会批准方案之前,这项研究不能开始。

e.en: Researchers must submit any changes to the {IRB} for review.
e.zh: 研究人员必须将任何变更提交伦理审查委员会审议。

irc.t: n. 互联网中继聊天（Internet Relay Chat）

e.en: Old-school developers still chat on {IRC} channels today.
e.zh: 老派开发者至今仍在 IRC 频道上聊天。

e.en: We coordinated the open-source release over an {IRC} room.
e.zh: 我们通过一个 IRC 房间协调了这次开源发布。

e.en: The new tax policy drew the {ire} of small businesses.
e.zh: 新税收政策招致了小企业的强烈不满。

e.en: His careless comment provoked the {ire} of fans online.
e.zh: 他随意的一句话激起了网上粉丝的怒火。

e.en: We're flying to {Ireland} to explore the western coast.
e.zh: 我们要飞往爱尔兰去游览西海岸。

e.en: {Ireland} has produced an extraordinary number of great writers.
e.zh: 爱尔兰诞生了数量惊人的伟大作家。

irian.t: n. 伊里安（新几内亚地区）

e.en: {Irian} Jaya was renamed Papua in the early 2000s.
e.zh: 伊里安查亚在 2000 年代初更名为巴布亚。

e.en: The expedition trekked through dense {Irian} rainforest for weeks.
e.zh: 探险队在茂密的伊里安雨林里跋涉了数周。

e.en: The butterfly's wings shimmered with brilliant blue {iridescence}.
e.zh: 那只蝴蝶的翅膀闪烁着夺目的蓝色虹彩。

e.en: Soap bubbles display a delicate {iridescence} in sunlight.
e.zh: 肥皂泡在阳光下呈现出细腻的虹彩。

iridescent.t: adj. 虹彩的；闪着彩虹色的

e.en: The peacock spread its {iridescent} tail feathers proudly.
e.zh: 孔雀骄傲地展开它五彩斑斓的尾羽。

e.en: She wore an {iridescent} dress that shifted colors as she moved.
e.zh: 她穿了一条随动作变换颜色的虹彩连衣裙。

e.en: A thin layer of {iridium} marks the dinosaur extinction event.
e.zh: 一层薄薄的铱标志着恐龙灭绝事件。

e.en: Spark plug tips are often coated with {iridium} for durability.
e.zh: 火花塞尖端常涂有铱以提高耐用性。

iris.t:
n. 鸢尾花
n. （眼睛的）虹膜

e.en: The doctor shone a light to examine my {iris}.
e.zh: 医生用灯光照射来检查我的虹膜。

e.en: Purple {iris} flowers bloomed all along the garden path.
e.zh: 紫色的鸢尾花沿着花园小径盛开。

irish.t:
adj. 爱尔兰的
n. 爱尔兰人；爱尔兰语

e.en: My grandfather spoke fluent {Irish} until the day he died.
e.zh: 我祖父直到去世那天都能讲流利的爱尔兰语。

e.en: We grabbed pints at a cozy {Irish} pub downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心一家温馨的爱尔兰酒吧喝了几杯。

e.en: The {Irishman} told stories that had everyone laughing.
e.zh: 那位爱尔兰人讲的故事让大家笑个不停。

e.en: An elderly {Irishman} played fiddle on the street corner.
e.zh: 一位年长的爱尔兰人在街角拉小提琴。

e.en: The {Irishwoman} sang an old Gaelic ballad beautifully.
e.zh: 那位爱尔兰女子优美地唱了一首古老的盖尔语民谣。

e.en: An {Irishwoman} from Galway opened the new bakery.
e.zh: 一位来自戈尔韦的爱尔兰女子开了这家新面包店。

irked.t:
adj. 感到恼怒的
v. irk 的过去式

irksome.t: adj. 令人厌烦的，讨厌的

irkutsk.t: n. 伊尔库茨克（俄罗斯城市）

iron.t:
n. 铁；熨斗
v. 熨烫（衣物）

ironclad.t: adj. 坚不可摧的，铁证如山的

e.en: The contract has an {ironclad} clause protecting both parties.
e.zh: 这份合同有一条铁定的条款保护双方。

e.en: She gave an {ironclad} guarantee that the package would arrive.
e.zh: 她做出绝对可靠的保证,包裹一定会送到。

ironed.t:
adj. 熨过的
v. iron 的过去式

e.en: He {ironed} his shirt before the interview.
e.zh: 他面试前把衬衫熨好了。

e.en: The team {ironed} out the bugs in the new app.
e.zh: 团队解决了新应用中的漏洞。

ironic.t: adj. 讽刺的，具有讽刺意味的

e.en: It's {ironic} that the fire station burned down.
e.zh: 消防站被烧毁,真是讽刺。

e.en: Her tone was {ironic} when she praised his cooking.
e.zh: 她夸他厨艺时的语气带着讽刺。

e.en: He gave an {ironical} smile at the obvious lie.
e.zh: 面对那明显的谎言,他露出讽刺的微笑。

e.en: The novel offers an {ironical} view of modern life.
e.zh: 这部小说以反讽的视角看待现代生活。

ironically.t: adv. 讽刺地，具有讽刺意味地

e.en: {Ironically}, the safety inspector slipped on the wet floor.
e.zh: 讽刺的是,安全检查员在湿地板上滑倒了。

e.en: She smiled {ironically} when he claimed to be punctual.
e.zh: 他声称自己守时,她讽刺地笑了笑。

e.en: He spent Sunday morning {ironing} a pile of shirts.
e.zh: 他周日早上熨了一堆衬衫。

e.en: The {ironing} board is in the closet by the door.
e.zh: 熨衣板就在门边的柜子里。

ironings.t: n. 待熨的衣物（ironing 的复数）

e.en: She finished the week's {ironings} before lunch.
e.zh: 她午饭前熨完了一周的衣物。

e.en: A basket of {ironings} sat by the laundry room.
e.zh: 一篮待熨的衣物放在洗衣房旁。

e.en: The author is a sharp {ironist} of suburban life.
e.zh: 这位作家是郊区生活的尖锐讽刺者。

e.en: As an {ironist}, she rarely says what she means directly.
e.zh: 作为一个反讽者,她很少直白表达本意。

e.en: He trained for two years to finish the {ironman} race.
e.zh: 他训练了两年才完成铁人三项赛。

e.en: Completing an {ironman} requires swimming, cycling, and running.
e.zh: 完成一场铁人赛需要游泳、骑车和跑步。

e.en: The wealthy {ironmaster} owned three foundries in the valley.
e.zh: 那位富有的铁厂主在山谷里拥有三家铸造厂。

e.en: His grandfather worked as an {ironmaster} during the industrial era.
e.zh: 他祖父在工业时代当过铁厂厂主。

e.en: The local {ironmonger} sells nails, hammers, and garden tools.
e.zh: 本地的五金商出售钉子、锤子和园艺工具。

e.en: She bought a new lock at the {ironmonger} on the corner.
e.zh: 她在街角的五金店买了一把新锁。

e.en: The shop stocks {ironmongery} for builders and homeowners.
e.zh: 这家店为建筑商和业主备有各种五金用品。

e.en: He ordered brass {ironmongery} for the antique door.
e.zh: 他为那扇古董门订购了黄铜五金件。

e.en: She {ironned} the tablecloth before the dinner party.
e.zh: 她在晚宴前把桌布熨平了。

e.en: He {ironned} his uniform every Sunday evening.
e.zh: 他每周日晚上都熨自己的制服。

e.en: She was {ironning} clothes while listening to a podcast.
e.zh: 她一边听播客一边熨衣服。

e.en: The {ironning} took longer than she expected.
e.zh: 熨衣服花的时间比她预期的要长。

irons.t:
n. 铁器；镣铐
v. iron 的第三人称单数

e.en: He has several {irons} in the fire this quarter.
e.zh: 这个季度他同时在做好几件事。

e.en: She {irons} her work shirts every Sunday night.
e.zh: 她每周日晚上熨工作衬衫。

e.en: The old general earned the nickname {ironside} for his toughness.
e.zh: 那位老将军因其强硬作风被昵称为铁汉。

e.en: The novel's hero is an {ironside} who never backs down.
e.zh: 小说中的主人公是个从不退缩的硬汉。

e.en: The hills here are rich in {ironstone} deposits.
e.zh: 这一带的山中富含铁矿石矿藏。

e.en: She collects vintage {ironstone} dishes from estate sales.
e.zh: 她从遗产拍卖中收集老式铁石瓷盘。

e.en: The handle is carved from dense {ironwood}.
e.zh: 手柄是用坚硬的铁木雕成的。

e.en: {Ironwood} trees can survive in harsh desert conditions.
e.zh: 铁木树能在严酷的沙漠环境中存活。

e.en: The bridge is famous for its delicate Victorian {ironwork}.
e.zh: 这座桥以精致的维多利亚式铁艺闻名。

e.en: Decorative {ironwork} surrounds the courtyard fountain.
e.zh: 装饰性的铁艺围绕着庭院里的喷泉。

e.en: The {ironworker} climbed the steel beam without hesitation.
e.zh: 那位铁工毫不犹豫地爬上了钢梁。

e.en: His father was a union {ironworker} for thirty years.
e.zh: 他父亲做了三十年的工会铁工。

e.en: The {irony} is that the critic loved the sequel.
e.zh: 讽刺的是,那位影评人居然喜欢续集。

e.en: She speaks with a dry sense of {irony}.
e.zh: 她说话带着一种冷淡的反讽感。

iroquoian.t:
adj. 易洛魁族的
n. 易洛魁语族

e.en: Mohawk is part of the {iroquoian} language family.
e.zh: 莫霍克语属于易洛魁语系。

e.en: Researchers study {iroquoian} oral traditions across the region.
e.zh: 研究人员研究该地区的易洛魁口述传统。

iroquois.t: n. 易洛魁人（北美原住民）

e.en: The {iroquois} formed a powerful confederacy in the northeast.
e.zh: 易洛魁人在东北部组建了强大的联盟。

e.en: The museum features {iroquois} beadwork and pottery.
e.zh: 博物馆展出易洛魁人的串珠和陶器。

e.en: Doctors {irradiate} tumors to slow their growth.
e.zh: 医生用放射线照射肿瘤以减缓其生长。

e.en: Some food producers {irradiate} produce to kill bacteria.
e.zh: 有些食品厂商用辐射处理农产品以杀菌。

e.en: The {irradiated} samples were sealed in lead containers.
e.zh: 经辐射处理的样本被密封在铅容器中。

e.en: Sunlight {irradiated} the entire valley by mid-morning.
e.zh: 上午时分,阳光照亮了整个山谷。

e.en: Food {irradiation} extends shelf life by killing pathogens.
e.zh: 食品辐照通过杀灭病原体来延长保质期。

e.en: The patient underwent {irradiation} as part of cancer treatment.
e.zh: 该患者接受了放射治疗作为癌症治疗的一部分。

e.en: His distrust of banks proved {irradicable}.
e.zh: 他对银行的不信任根深蒂固,无法消除。

e.en: The stain on the carpet seemed {irradicable}.
e.zh: 地毯上的污渍似乎无法去除。

e.en: She has an {irrational} fear of small spaces.
e.zh: 她对狭小空间有一种非理性的恐惧。

e.en: His decision to quit seemed completely {irrational}.
e.zh: 他辞职的决定看起来完全不理智。

e.en: Behavioral economists study the {irrationality} of consumer choices.
e.zh: 行为经济学家研究消费者选择中的非理性现象。

e.en: There's a strange {irrationality} in panic buying.
e.zh: 恐慌性抢购中存在一种奇怪的非理性。

irrationally.t: adv. 非理性地，不合理地

e.en: He reacted {irrationally} to the minor criticism.
e.zh: 他对那点小批评反应过激,毫无理性。

e.en: Markets sometimes behave {irrationally} during a crisis.
e.zh: 市场在危机中有时表现得非理性。

irreconcilable.t: adj. 不可调和的，无法和解的

e.en: They divorced citing {irreconcilable} differences.
e.zh: 他们以无法调和的分歧为由离婚了。

e.en: The two accounts of the event are {irreconcilable}.
e.zh: 对这件事的两种说法无法相互吻合。

irrecoverable.t: adj. 无法挽回的，不能追回的

e.en: The deleted files turned out to be {irrecoverable}.
e.zh: 那些被删除的文件最终无法恢复。

e.en: The bank wrote off the loan as {irrecoverable}.
e.zh: 银行将该笔贷款作为无法收回的坏账核销。

irredeemable.t: adj. 无可救药的；不可赎回的

e.en: He's not an {irredeemable} villain, just badly misguided.
e.zh: 他不是无可救药的恶人,只是被严重误导了。

e.en: The voucher is non-transferable and {irredeemable} for cash.
e.zh: 该券不可转让,也不能兑换现金。

e.en: The party's platform leans heavily on {irredentism}.
e.zh: 该党的纲领严重依赖于民族统一主义。

e.en: Border tensions rose due to lingering {irredentism}.
e.zh: 由于持续的民族统一主义,边境紧张局势加剧。

e.en: The {irredentist} movement demanded the return of lost territory.
e.zh: 民族统一主义运动要求归还失去的领土。

e.en: He gave a fiery {irredentist} speech to the crowd.
e.zh: 他向人群发表了一场激昂的民族统一主义演讲。

irreducible.t: adj. 不可简化的；不可约的

e.en: Privacy is an {irreducible} part of human dignity.
e.zh: 隐私是人类尊严中不可削减的一部分。

e.en: The equation can be simplified to an {irreducible} form.
e.zh: 这个方程可以化简为不可再约的形式。

e.en: The problem is {irreducibly} complex and resists easy answers.
e.zh: 这个问题极其复杂,无法简化,难有简单答案。

e.en: Each person's experience is {irreducibly} their own.
e.zh: 每个人的经历都是独一无二、不可化约的。

irrefutable.t: adj. 无可辩驳的，不容置疑的

e.en: The DNA evidence was {irrefutable} in court.
e.zh: 那份DNA证据在法庭上无可辩驳。

e.en: She presented {irrefutable} proof of the company's misconduct.
e.zh: 她提出了公司不当行为的确凿证据。

irritating.t: adj. 恼人的；令人烦躁的

e.en: That ad jingle is incredibly {irritating} after the third time.
e.zh: 那段广告歌听三遍以后简直烦死人。

e.en: The smoke was {irritating} to everyone's eyes and throat.
e.zh: 烟雾刺激着每个人的眼睛和喉咙。

e.en: The website loads {irritatingly} slowly on mobile data.
e.zh: 这个网站在移动数据下加载得慢得让人抓狂。

e.en: He was {irritatingly} confident about an answer that turned out wrong.
e.zh: 他对一个最终错误的答案表现得自信得让人恼火。

irritation.t:
n. 烦躁；恼怒
n. (皮肤) 刺激发炎

e.en: You could hear the {irritation} in her voice on the call.
e.zh: 在通话中你能听出她语气里的不耐烦。

e.en: Apply cream to reduce skin {irritation} after shaving.
e.zh: 剃须后涂抹乳霜可以减轻皮肤刺激。

e.en: Small daily {irritations} can add up to real stress over time.
e.zh: 日常的小烦恼日积月累会变成真正的压力。

e.en: The new lotion soothes minor skin {irritations} quickly.
e.zh: 这款新乳液能快速舒缓轻微的皮肤刺激。

e.en: The sudden {irruption} of fans onto the field stopped the match.
e.zh: 球迷突然冲进场内，比赛被迫中断。

e.en: Birdwatchers reported an unusual winter {irruption} of snowy owls.
e.zh: 观鸟者报告今冬雪鸮异常大量南迁。

irs.t: n. 美国国税局（Internal Revenue Service）

e.en: The {IRS} sent me a letter about my tax return last week.
e.zh: 上周国税局给我寄了一封关于我报税的信。

e.en: You can pay your taxes directly on the {IRS} website.
e.zh: 你可以直接在美国国税局的网站上缴税。

e.en: She moved to {Irvine} for a tech job last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天搬到尔湾从事科技工作。

e.en: The University of California, {Irvine} has a strong research program.
e.zh: 加州大学尔湾分校有很强的研究项目。

e.en: Washington {Irving} wrote the famous story Rip Van Winkle.
e.zh: 华盛顿·欧文写了著名的《瑞普·凡·温克尔》。

e.en: My friend {Irving} runs a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 我朋友欧文在市中心经营一家小面包店。

isa.t: n. 个人储蓄账户（英国 Individual Savings Account）

e.en: She opened a cash {ISA} to save tax-free.
e.zh: 她开了一个现金个人储蓄账户来免税储蓄。

e.en: The bank offers a stocks and shares {ISA} option.
e.zh: 该银行提供股票型个人储蓄账户的选项。

e.en: The {Isay} river flows through parts of eastern Russia.
e.zh: 伊赛河流经俄罗斯东部部分地区。

e.en: Dave {Isay} founded the StoryCorps oral history project.
e.zh: 戴夫·伊塞创办了口述历史项目StoryCorps。

e.en: Every published book has a unique {ISBN} for tracking.
e.zh: 每本出版的书都有唯一的国际标准书号用于追踪。

e.en: Please enter the {ISBN} to find the textbook online.
e.zh: 请输入国际标准书号在网上查找该教科书。

e.en: The patient suffered {ischaemia} due to a blocked artery.
e.zh: 该病人因动脉阻塞而出现缺血症状。

e.en: Cardiac {ischaemia} can lead to chest pain and heart attack.
e.zh: 心肌缺血可能导致胸痛和心脏病发作。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed {ischemia} after reviewing the ECG results.
e.zh: 医生在查看心电图后诊断为缺血。

e.en: Brain {ischemia} requires immediate emergency treatment.
e.zh: 脑缺血需要立即进行紧急治疗。

e.en: He recovered slowly from an {ischemic} stroke last year.
e.zh: 他从去年的缺血性中风中慢慢康复。

e.en: {Ischemic} heart disease is a leading cause of death globally.
e.zh: 缺血性心脏病是全球主要的死亡原因之一。

e.en: The doctor examined the {ischial} tuberosity for signs of injury.
e.zh: 医生检查了坐骨结节有无受伤迹象。

e.en: Cyclists often develop pain in the {ischial} area.
e.zh: 骑自行车的人常会在坐骨部位出现疼痛。

e.en: The {ischium} is one of three bones forming the pelvis.
e.zh: 坐骨是构成骨盆的三块骨头之一。

e.en: She fractured her {ischium} after falling off the horse.
e.zh: 她从马上摔下后骨折了坐骨。

e.en: Many offices once relied on {ISDN} lines for calls.
e.zh: 许多办公室曾经依靠综合业务数字网线路通话。

e.en: Broadband eventually replaced the older {ISDN} technology.
e.zh: 宽带最终取代了较旧的综合业务数字网技术。

e.en: The {Ise} Grand Shrine is one of Japan's holiest sites.
e.zh: 伊势神宫是日本最神圣的场所之一。

e.en: Tourists travel to {Ise} to experience traditional Shinto culture.
e.zh: 游客前往伊势体验传统的神道文化。

ish.t: suf. 略带…的；有点…的（后缀）

e.en: Let's meet at six-{ish} for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚六点左右见吃晚饭吧。

e.en: The shirt is blue-{ish}, more like teal really.
e.zh: 那件衬衫偏蓝色,其实更像青绿色。

e.en: Call me {Ishmael} is the famous opening line of Moby Dick.
e.zh: 叫我以实玛利是《白鲸》著名的开篇。

e.en: In the Bible, {Ishmael} was the son of Abraham and Hagar.
e.zh: 在圣经中,以实玛利是亚伯拉罕和夏甲的儿子。

e.en: Brewers traditionally use {isinglass} to clarify their beer.
e.zh: 酿酒师传统上用鱼胶来澄清啤酒。

e.en: The old lantern had panels made of {isinglass}.
e.zh: 那盏旧灯笼的面板是用鱼胶片制成的。

isis.t:
n. 伊希斯（埃及女神）
n. ISIS（极端组织伊斯兰国）

e.en: The Egyptian goddess {Isis} was worshipped across the ancient world.
e.zh: 埃及女神伊西斯曾在整个古代世界受到崇拜。

e.en: The river {Isis} is what locals call the Thames at Oxford.
e.zh: 伊希斯河是当地人对牛津段泰晤士河的称呼。

e.en: They named their daughter {Isla} after a Scottish river.
e.zh: 他们给女儿取名艾拉,源自一条苏格兰河流。

e.en: {Isla} is a popular baby name in the UK.
e.zh: 艾拉是英国非常流行的女婴名字。

e.en: {Islam} is one of the world's major religions.
e.zh: 伊斯兰教是世界主要宗教之一。

e.en: He converted to {Islam} after years of study.
e.zh: 他经过多年学习后皈依了伊斯兰教。

islamabad.t: n. 伊斯兰堡（巴基斯坦首都）

e.en: {Islamabad} is the modern capital city of Pakistan.
e.zh: 伊斯兰堡是巴基斯坦的现代首都。

e.en: We flew to {Islamabad} for a diplomatic conference.
e.zh: 我们飞往伊斯兰堡参加一场外交会议。

e.en: The museum displays beautiful {Islamic} art and calligraphy.
e.zh: 该博物馆展出精美的伊斯兰艺术与书法作品。

e.en: She studies {Islamic} law at a London university.
e.zh: 她在伦敦一所大学学习伊斯兰法律。

islamist.t:
n. 伊斯兰主义者
adj. 伊斯兰主义的

e.en: The {Islamist} party won several seats in parliament.
e.zh: 伊斯兰主义政党在议会中赢得了多个席位。

e.en: Analysts debated the rise of {Islamist} movements in the region.
e.zh: 分析人士讨论了该地区伊斯兰主义运动的兴起。

e.en: The country experienced rapid {Islamization} during the 1980s.
e.zh: 该国在1980年代经历了快速的伊斯兰化。

e.en: Scholars debate the long-term effects of {Islamization} policies.
e.zh: 学者们讨论伊斯兰化政策的长期影响。

island.t:
n. 岛屿
n. (厨房等) 中岛台

e.en: We spent a week on a tropical {island} last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天在一个热带岛屿上度过了一周。

e.en: The kitchen has a large marble {island} for cooking.
e.zh: 厨房里有一个大理石的中央料理台用来做饭。

e.en: Every {islander} knows where the best fishing spots are.
e.zh: 每个岛民都知道最好的钓鱼地点在哪里。

e.en: As an {islander}, she grew up swimming in the sea.
e.zh: 作为岛民,她从小就在海里游泳长大。

e.en: The {islanders} celebrated the harvest with a traditional feast.
e.zh: 岛民们用一场传统盛宴庆祝丰收。

e.en: Local {islanders} protested against the new airport project.
e.zh: 当地岛民抗议新机场项目。

e.en: The Hawaiian {islands} attract millions of tourists each year.
e.zh: 夏威夷群岛每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: There are thousands of small {islands} in Indonesia.
e.zh: 印度尼西亚有数千个小岛屿。

islay.t: n. 艾雷岛（苏格兰岛屿）

e.en: {Islay} whisky is famous for its smoky, peaty flavor.
e.zh: 艾雷岛威士忌以其烟熏泥煤味而闻名。

e.en: We took a ferry to the Scottish island of {Islay}.
e.zh: 我们乘渡轮前往苏格兰的艾雷岛。

e.en: The Emerald {Isle} is a poetic name for Ireland.
e.zh: 翡翠岛是爱尔兰的诗意别称。

e.en: They sailed to a remote {isle} for their honeymoon.
e.zh: 他们航行到一个偏远的小岛度蜜月。

e.en: The British {Isles} include England, Scotland, Wales, and Ireland.
e.zh: 不列颠群岛包括英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和爱尔兰。

e.en: Many seabirds nest on the rocky {isles} off the coast.
e.zh: 许多海鸟在沿海的岩石小岛上筑巢。

islet.t:
n. 小岛
n. (胰) 胰岛

e.en: A tiny {islet} appeared at low tide near the beach.
e.zh: 退潮时,海滩附近出现了一座小岛。

e.en: Pancreatic {islet} cells produce insulin in the body.
e.zh: 胰岛细胞在体内产生胰岛素。

islington.t: n. 伊斯灵顿（伦敦地名）

e.en: He bought a small flat in {Islington} last year.
e.zh: 他去年在伊斯灵顿买了一套小公寓。

e.en: {Islington} is a trendy borough in north London.
e.zh: 伊斯灵顿是伦敦北部一个时尚的区。

e.en: The flight landed at {Islip} airport on Long Island.
e.zh: 航班降落在长岛的伊斯利普机场。

e.en: {Islip} is a quiet town in Suffolk County, New York.
e.zh: 伊斯利普是纽约州萨福克县的一个安静小镇。

e.en: Critics dismissed the movement as just another empty {ism}.
e.zh: 评论家认为这个运动不过是另一个空洞的主义。

e.en: Every political {ism} promises to solve society's problems.
e.zh: 每一种政治主义都承诺要解决社会的问题。

italicised.t: v. 使用斜体（英式拼写）

e.en: The quoted passages are {italicised} for clarity.
e.zh: 为清楚起见，引用的段落用了斜体。

e.en: She {italicised} every keyword in her thesis.
e.zh: 她把论文中的每个关键词都设为了斜体。

italicises.t: v. 使用斜体（英式拼写）

e.en: The style guide {italicises} titles of full-length works.
e.zh: 该体例规定将完整作品的标题设为斜体。

e.en: Word automatically {italicises} text between asterisks.
e.zh: Word 会自动把星号之间的文字变成斜体。

italicising.t: v. 使用斜体（英式拼写）

e.en: He spent the afternoon {italicising} every Latin phrase.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在把每个拉丁短语改成斜体。

e.en: {Italicising} foreign terms helps readers spot them quickly.
e.zh: 把外来词设为斜体能帮读者快速注意到它们。

italicize.t: v. 使用斜体；以斜体显示

e.en: You should {italicize} the title of the novel in your essay.
e.zh: 在文章中应当把小说的标题设为斜体。

e.en: Press Ctrl+I to {italicize} the selected text.
e.zh: 按 Ctrl+I 可以把选中的文字变成斜体。

italicized.t:
v. 使用斜体
adj. 斜体的

e.en: The {italicized} words indicate emphasis in the passage.
e.zh: 段落中斜体的词用以表示强调。

e.en: She {italicized} the foreign phrases throughout the chapter.
e.zh: 她把这一章里所有外来短语都改成了斜体。

e.en: The editor consistently {italicizes} the names of journals.
e.zh: 编辑一贯把期刊名称设为斜体。

e.en: Markdown {italicizes} text wrapped in single asterisks.
e.zh: Markdown 会把单个星号包裹的文本显示为斜体。

e.en: She's {italicizing} every Latin term in the document.
e.zh: 她正在把文档中所有拉丁术语改为斜体。

e.en: {Italicizing} song titles is a common style choice.
e.zh: 将歌曲名设为斜体是一种常见的排版做法。

e.en: Book titles should appear in {italics} according to MLA style.
e.zh: 按 MLA 体例，书名应使用斜体。

e.en: He emphasized the warning by putting it in {italics}.
e.zh: 他把警告语设为斜体以示强调。

e.en: We're flying to {Italy} for our honeymoon next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月将飞去意大利度蜜月。

e.en: {Italy} is famous for its food, fashion, and ancient ruins.
e.zh: 意大利以美食、时尚和古迹闻名于世。

itc.t: (罕用) 缩写，多指国际贸易中心等

e.en: {ITC} Limited is one of India's largest conglomerates.
e.zh: ITC 集团是印度最大的综合企业之一。

e.en: He bought shares in {ITC} after reading the annual report.
e.zh: 读完年报后，他买入了 ITC 的股票。

itch.t:
n. 痒；渴望
v. 发痒

e.en: My back has an {itch} I just can't reach.
e.zh: 我后背有个地方痒，怎么也够不到。

e.en: Mosquito bites always {itch} more at night.
e.zh: 蚊子叮咬总是夜里更痒。

e.en: The wool sweater {itched} all afternoon at the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时那件羊毛衫痒了我一下午。

e.en: His fingers {itched} to grab the controller and play.
e.zh: 他手指发痒，想抓起手柄玩一会儿。

itches.t:
v. 发痒
n. 痒（复数）

e.en: This rash {itches} more whenever I sweat.
e.zh: 我一出汗，这片疹子就更痒。

e.en: He has a few familiar {itches} he can never quite scratch.
e.zh: 他有几处熟悉的痒处，怎么也挠不到位。

e.en: The cream quickly relieved the {itchiness} on her arm.
e.zh: 药膏很快缓解了她手臂上的瘙痒。

e.en: Pollen often causes {itchiness} in the eyes during spring.
e.zh: 花粉常在春季引起眼睛发痒。

itching.t:
v. 发痒
adj. 渴望的

e.en: My legs have been {itching} since I walked through the grass.
e.zh: 自从穿过草地后，我的腿就一直在痒。

e.en: She's {itching} to start her new job on Monday.
e.zh: 她迫不及待地想周一开始新工作。

e.en: This new sweater is really {itchy} around the neck.
e.zh: 这件新毛衣领口处特别扎人发痒。

e.en: Dry winter air leaves my skin {itchy} and flaky.
e.zh: 冬天干燥的空气让我的皮肤又痒又起皮。

item.t: n. 项目；条目；一件（商品）

e.en: Please add this {item} to my shopping cart.
e.zh: 请把这件商品加到我的购物车里。

e.en: The next agenda {item} concerns the budget proposal.
e.zh: 下一个议程要点是关于预算提案的。

itemise.t: v. 逐项列出（英式拼写）

e.en: Could you {itemise} the costs in the invoice, please?
e.zh: 麻烦你把发票里的费用逐项列出。

e.en: The accountant will {itemise} every expense for the audit.
e.zh: 会计将为审计逐项列明每笔开销。

itemised.t:
v. 逐项列出
adj. 分项的

e.en: She requested an {itemised} bill from the hotel.
e.zh: 她向酒店索要了一份逐项明细的账单。

e.en: The receipt should be fully {itemised} for tax purposes.
e.zh: 收据须逐项列明，以便报税。

itemize.t: v. 逐项列出；分条列明

e.en: You can {itemize} deductions instead of taking the standard one.
e.zh: 你可以逐项申报抵扣，而不是采用标准抵扣。

e.en: Please {itemize} every charge on the final invoice.
e.zh: 请在最终发票上逐项列出每笔费用。

itemized.t:
adj. 分项的
v. 逐项列出

e.en: The lawyer sent an {itemized} list of billable hours.
e.zh: 律师寄来一份按项目列出的计费工时清单。

e.en: She {itemized} her business expenses for the tax return.
e.zh: 她为报税逐项列出了业务开支。

e.en: Please add three {items} to your shopping cart.
e.zh: 请把三件商品加入你的购物车。

e.en: The agenda has several {items} we need to discuss.
e.zh: 议程上有几个事项我们需要讨论。

e.en: We {iterate} on the design based on user feedback.
e.zh: 我们根据用户反馈不断改进设计。

e.en: The loop will {iterate} through every entry in the list.
e.zh: 循环会遍历列表中的每一项。

e.en: The team {iterated} on the prototype five times this month.
e.zh: 团队这个月对原型迭代了五次。

e.en: She {iterated} through the array to find duplicates.
e.zh: 她遍历数组以找出重复项。

iteration.t: n. 迭代；一次循环版本

e.en: This {iteration} of the app fixes the login bug.
e.zh: 这一版应用修复了登录问题。

e.en: Each {iteration} of the loop processes one record.
e.zh: 循环每次迭代处理一条记录。

e.en: We use an {iterative} approach to product development.
e.zh: 我们采用迭代式的产品开发方法。

e.en: The {iterative} algorithm converges after ten steps.
e.zh: 该迭代算法在十步后收敛。

e.en: The model improves {iteratively} as more data arrives.
e.zh: 随着数据增加,模型逐步迭代改进。

e.en: We refined the design {iteratively} with the client.
e.zh: 我们与客户反复迭代,完善了设计。

ith.t: adj. 第 i 个的（数学索引）

e.en: Return the {ith} element of the array.
e.zh: 返回数组中第 i 个元素。

e.en: The formula computes the {ith} term in the sequence.
e.zh: 该公式用于计算序列中的第 i 项。

e.en: Odysseus longed to return home to {Ithaca}.
e.zh: 奥德修斯渴望回到家乡伊萨卡。

e.en: Cornell University is located in {Ithaca}, New York.
e.zh: 康奈尔大学位于纽约州伊萨卡。

e.en: He worked as an {itinerant} preacher across the countryside.
e.zh: 他在乡间各地担任巡回传教士。

e.en: The {itinerant} musician played in a different town each night.
e.zh: 那位流浪音乐人每晚在不同的城镇演出。

itineraries.t: n. 行程；旅行路线（复数）

e.en: The travel agent prepared detailed {itineraries} for each guest.
e.zh: 旅行代理为每位客人准备了详细的行程单。

e.en: Their European {itineraries} included Paris, Rome, and Berlin.
e.zh: 他们的欧洲行程包含巴黎、罗马和柏林。

e.en: Please email me the full {itinerary} before Friday.
e.zh: 请在周五前把完整行程发到我邮箱。

e.en: Our {itinerary} includes a stop in Kyoto for two days.
e.zh: 我们的行程包括在京都停留两天。

itn.t: n. 英国独立电视新闻公司

e.en: {ITN} broadcasts the evening news across the United Kingdom.
e.zh: ITN 在英国各地播报晚间新闻。

e.en: She landed her first reporting job at {ITN}.
e.zh: 她在 ITN 找到了第一份记者工作。

e.en: Touchscreens often use {ITO} as a transparent conductive coating.
e.zh: 触摸屏常用 ITO 作为透明导电涂层。

e.en: Mr. {Ito} chairs the company's board in Tokyo.
e.zh: 伊藤先生在东京担任公司董事长。

e.en: The cat licked {its} paws after the meal.
e.zh: 那只猫吃完饭后舔了舔自己的爪子。

e.en: The company changed {its} logo last year.
e.zh: 公司去年更换了它的标志。

e.en: The door closed {itself} when the wind picked up.
e.zh: 风大起来时,门自己关上了。

e.en: The problem will not solve {itself} without action.
e.zh: 问题不采取行动是不会自行解决的。

itt.t: n. 国际电话电报公司

e.en: {ITT} was once one of America's largest conglomerates.
e.zh: ITT 曾是美国最大的综合企业集团之一。

e.en: He spent twenty years working at {ITT} as an engineer.
e.zh: 他在 ITT 当工程师工作了二十年。

e.en: The drama airs on {ITV} every Sunday evening.
e.zh: 这部电视剧每周日晚上在 ITV 播出。

e.en: {ITV} is a major commercial broadcaster in Britain.
e.zh: ITV 是英国主要的商业广播电视公司。
