iucn.t: n. 世界自然保护联盟

e.en: The {IUCN} updated its red list of endangered species.
e.zh: 世界自然保护联盟更新了濒危物种红色名录。

e.en: Conservation groups rely on {IUCN} data for policy decisions.
e.zh: 保护组织依据 IUCN 数据做出政策决定。

e.en: She decided an {IUD} was the best contraception option.
e.zh: 她决定使用宫内节育器作为避孕方式。

e.en: The doctor explained how the {IUD} prevents pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生解释了宫内节育器如何避孕。

ivanhoe.t: n. 艾凡赫（小说名/人名）

e.en: Walter Scott's {Ivanhoe} remains a classic of historical fiction.
e.zh: 司各特的《艾凡赫》至今仍是历史小说经典。

e.en: We read {Ivanhoe} in our medieval literature class.
e.zh: 我们在中世纪文学课上读了《艾凡赫》。

ivf.t: n. 体外受精；试管婴儿

e.en: The couple finally conceived through {IVF} after years of trying.
e.zh: 那对夫妻在尝试多年后终于通过试管婴儿怀孕。

e.en: {IVF} treatments have become more affordable in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来试管婴儿治疗变得更加平价。

ivorian.t:
adj. 科特迪瓦的
n. 科特迪瓦人

e.en: The {Ivorian} football team qualified for the World Cup.
e.zh: 科特迪瓦国家足球队晋级了世界杯。

e.en: She enjoys cooking traditional {Ivorian} dishes on weekends.
e.zh: 她喜欢周末做传统的科特迪瓦菜。

iso.t:
n. 国际标准化组织（缩写）
n. 感光度（相机）

e.en: The factory passed its annual {ISO} quality audit.
e.zh: 工厂通过了年度国际标准化组织质量审核。

e.en: Photographers adjust the {ISO} setting for low-light shots.
e.zh: 摄影师在弱光拍摄时调整感光度设置。

e.en: Many lighters use {isobutane} as a clean-burning fuel.
e.zh: 许多打火机使用异丁烷作为清洁燃料。

e.en: {Isobutane} is commonly found in portable camping stoves.
e.zh: 异丁烷常用于便携式露营炉。

e.en: Soybeans are a rich source of {isoflavone} compounds.
e.zh: 大豆是异黄酮化合物的丰富来源。

e.en: Studies suggest {isoflavone} intake may benefit bone health.
e.zh: 研究表明摄入异黄酮可能有益于骨骼健康。

isoform.t: n. 同工型；异构体（蛋白质）

e.en: This protein has several {isoform} variants in human tissue.
e.zh: 这种蛋白质在人体组织中有多种异构体变体。

e.en: Researchers identified a new {isoform} of the enzyme.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了该酶的一种新异构体。

isolate.t:
v. 隔离；分离
n. 分离物

e.en: Doctors had to {isolate} the patient to prevent infection.
e.zh: 医生不得不隔离这位病人以防止感染。

e.en: Scientists managed to {isolate} the gene responsible for the disease.
e.zh: 科学家成功分离出导致该疾病的基因。

e.en: The cabin felt {isolated} during the heavy snowstorm.
e.zh: 在大暴雪中,那间小屋显得格外与世隔绝。

e.en: This was an {isolated} incident, not part of a pattern.
e.zh: 这是一起孤立事件,并非某种模式的一部分。

isolates.t:
v. 隔离（isolate 第三人称单数）
n. 分离物（复数）

e.en: Quarantine {isolates} infected patients from the general population.
e.zh: 检疫将受感染者与普通民众隔离开来。

e.en: The lab analyzed several bacterial {isolates} from the sample.
e.zh: 实验室分析了样本中分离出的几种细菌。

isolating.t:
v. 正在隔离
adj. 使孤立的

e.en: Working from home can be {isolating} without regular contact.
e.zh: 在家工作如果缺乏日常联系会让人感到孤立。

e.en: They are {isolating} the variable to test their hypothesis.
e.zh: 他们正在分离这个变量以测试他们的假设。

e.en: Long periods of {isolation} can affect mental health.
e.zh: 长时间的孤立会影响心理健康。

e.en: The patient remained in {isolation} for two weeks.
e.zh: 病人保持隔离状态两周。

e.en: Critics warned against a return to {isolationism} in foreign policy.
e.zh: 批评者警告外交政策不应回到孤立主义。

e.en: {Isolationism} dominated American thinking before World War II.
e.zh: 二战前孤立主义主导着美国人的思想。

isolationist.t:
n. 孤立主义者
adj. 孤立主义的

e.en: The senator pushed an {isolationist} agenda during his campaign.
e.zh: 该参议员在竞选期间推行孤立主义议程。

e.en: Many voters supported the candidate's {isolationist} foreign policy.
e.zh: 许多选民支持这位候选人的孤立主义外交政策。

e.en: Repeated {isolations} during the pandemic took an emotional toll.
e.zh: 疫情期间反复的隔离造成了情感上的负担。

e.en: The lab performed multiple {isolations} of the same compound.
e.zh: 实验室对同一化合物进行了多次分离。

e.en: The technician installed a new {isolator} switch on the panel.
e.zh: 技术员在面板上安装了一个新的隔离开关。

e.en: A vibration {isolator} keeps the equipment running smoothly.
e.zh: 减震隔离器使设备平稳运行。

e.en: Tristan and {Isolde} is a tragic love story from medieval legend.
e.zh: 《特里斯坦与伊索尔德》是一个中世纪传说中的悲剧爱情故事。

e.en: Wagner composed a famous opera about {Isolde}.
e.zh: 瓦格纳创作了一部关于伊索尔德的著名歌剧。

e.en: The premature baby was placed in an {isolette} for warmth.
e.zh: 早产婴儿被放进保温箱保暖。

e.en: Nurses monitored the infant's breathing inside the {isolette}.
e.zh: 护士们在保温箱里监测婴儿的呼吸。

e.en: Glucose and fructose are each an {isomer} of the other.
e.zh: 葡萄糖和果糖互为同分异构体。

e.en: Chemists discovered a new {isomer} with unusual properties.
e.zh: 化学家发现了一种具有不寻常特性的新异构体。

isometric.t: adj. 等距的（如等距视角）

e.en: The game uses an {isometric} view for its 3D graphics.
e.zh: 该游戏采用等距视角呈现其3D画面。

e.en: He does {isometric} exercises to build core strength.
e.zh: 他做等长运动来增强核心力量。

e.en: She does {isometrics} every morning to build core strength.
e.zh: 她每天早上做等长收缩训练来增强核心力量。

e.en: The trainer recommended {isometrics} for rehabbing the injured knee.
e.zh: 教练建议用等长训练来康复受伤的膝盖。

e.en: The two graphs are {isomorphic} despite looking different.
e.zh: 这两个图看似不同，其实是同构的。

e.en: Next.js supports {isomorphic} rendering on both server and client.
e.zh: Next.js 支持服务端和客户端同构渲染。

e.en: The proof established an {isomorphism} between the two groups.
e.zh: 该证明确立了两个群之间的同构关系。

e.en: Category theory studies {isomorphism} as a key structural concept.
e.zh: 范畴论将同构视为核心的结构概念。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {isoniazid} to treat her tuberculosis.
e.zh: 医生开了异烟肼来治疗她的结核病。

e.en: Long-term {isoniazid} use can cause liver damage in some patients.
e.zh: 长期服用异烟肼可能导致部分患者肝损伤。

e.en: Clean the screen with a little {isopropyl} alcohol.
e.zh: 用一点异丙醇擦拭屏幕。

e.en: The lab uses {isopropyl} alcohol to disinfect surfaces.
e.zh: 实验室用异丙醇给台面消毒。

e.en: Runners often drink {isotonic} sports drinks during long races.
e.zh: 长跑选手常在比赛中喝等渗运动饮料。

e.en: Saline solution is {isotonic} with human blood.
e.zh: 生理盐水与人体血液是等渗的。

e.en: Carbon-14 is a radioactive {isotope} used for dating fossils.
e.zh: 碳-14 是用于测定化石年代的放射性同位素。

e.en: Each {isotope} has the same protons but different neutrons.
e.zh: 每种同位素质子数相同，中子数却不同。

e.en: Scientists analyzed the {isotopic} composition of the meteorite.
e.zh: 科学家分析了那块陨石的同位素组成。

e.en: {Isotopic} ratios can reveal where ancient pottery was made.
e.zh: 同位素比值能揭示古陶器的产地。

e.en: Glass is {isotropic} because its properties are the same in every direction.
e.zh: 玻璃在各个方向上性质相同，因此是各向同性的。

e.en: The model assumes an {isotropic} universe at large scales.
e.zh: 该模型假设宇宙在大尺度上是各向同性的。

e.en: She traveled to {Israel} last summer to visit Jerusalem.
e.zh: 她去年夏天去以色列参观了耶路撒冷。

e.en: {Israel} has a thriving tech startup scene.
e.zh: 以色列拥有蓬勃发展的科技创业生态。

israeli.t:
adj. 以色列的
n. 以色列人

e.en: He works for an {Israeli} cybersecurity company.
e.zh: 他在一家以色列网络安全公司工作。

e.en: {Israeli} cuisine blends Middle Eastern and Mediterranean flavors.
e.zh: 以色列菜融合了中东和地中海风味。

e.en: The story describes how an ancient {Israelite} crossed the desert.
e.zh: 故事讲述了一位古以色列人穿越沙漠的经历。

e.en: Moses led the {Israelite} people out of Egypt.
e.zh: 摩西带领以色列民众走出埃及。

e.en: Astronauts on the {ISS} conduct experiments in microgravity.
e.zh: 国际空间站上的宇航员在微重力下进行实验。

e.en: You can sometimes see the {ISS} pass overhead at night.
e.zh: 夜里有时能看到国际空间站从头顶飞过。

e.en: The bank announced the {issuance} of new green bonds.
e.zh: 银行宣布发行新的绿色债券。

e.en: Passport {issuance} has been delayed due to high demand.
e.zh: 由于需求量大，护照发放出现延迟。

issue.t:
n. 问题；议题；期号
v. 发布；发行

e.en: There's a small {issue} with the login page on mobile.
e.zh: 移动端登录页面有个小问题。

e.en: The latest {issue} of the magazine features AI startups.
e.zh: 杂志最新一期专题报道了人工智能创业公司。

e.en: The court {issued} a temporary restraining order yesterday.
e.zh: 法院昨天发出了一项临时禁制令。

e.en: She {issued} a public apology after the controversy.
e.zh: 风波之后，她发表了公开道歉。

e.en: Contact your card {issuer} if you spot a fraudulent charge.
e.zh: 如果发现可疑扣款，请联系发卡机构。

e.en: The bond {issuer} promised quarterly interest payments.
e.zh: 债券发行方承诺按季度支付利息。

issues.t:
n. 问题（复数）
v. 发布（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new update fixed several long-standing {issues}.
e.zh: 新版本修复了几个长期存在的问题。

e.en: She {issues} weekly reports to the entire team.
e.zh: 她每周向全团队发布报告。

e.en: The agency is {issuing} new visas starting next Monday.
e.zh: 该机构将从下周一开始签发新的签证。

e.en: The bank stopped {issuing} paper statements last year.
e.zh: 银行去年起不再发送纸质对账单。

ist.t: 后缀. 表人（如 artist）；伊斯兰标准时间

e.en: The meeting starts at 9 AM {IST}, which is late night for me.
e.zh: 会议在印度标准时间上午九点开始，对我来说是深夜。

e.en: Please convert the deadline from {IST} to your local time.
e.zh: 请把截止时间从印度标准时间转换成你的当地时间。

istanbul.t: n. 伊斯坦布尔（土耳其城市）

e.en: We spent a week exploring the markets of {Istanbul}.
e.zh: 我们花了一周时间逛遍伊斯坦布尔的市集。

e.en: {Istanbul} straddles two continents across the Bosphorus.
e.zh: 伊斯坦布尔横跨博斯普鲁斯海峡两岸的两块大陆。

e.en: The Panama Canal cuts across a narrow {isthmus}.
e.zh: 巴拿马运河横穿一条狭窄的地峡。

e.en: An {isthmus} of land connects the peninsula to the mainland.
e.zh: 一条地峡把半岛与大陆连接起来。

isuzu.t: n. 五十铃（日本汽车品牌）

e.en: He drives an old {Isuzu} pickup truck on the farm.
e.zh: 他在农场里开一辆老式五十铃皮卡。

e.en: {Isuzu} is known for its durable diesel engines.
e.zh: 五十铃以耐用的柴油发动机闻名。

ita.t: n. 预计到达时间（缩写）

e.en: The flight is operated by {ITA} Airways from Rome.
e.zh: 该航班由从罗马起飞的意大利航空运营。

e.en: She booked a one-way ticket on {ITA} to Milan.
e.zh: 她订了一张飞往米兰的意大利航空单程票。

e.en: The poster simply read "Viva {Italia}" in bold red letters.
e.zh: 海报上只用粗红字写着"意大利万岁"。

e.en: The team will represent {Italia} at the World Cup.
e.zh: 该队将代表意大利出战世界杯。

italian.t:
adj. 意大利的
n. 意大利人；意大利语

e.en: She's learning {Italian} so she can travel through Tuscany.
e.zh: 她在学意大利语，以便游览托斯卡纳。

e.en: This little {Italian} restaurant makes the best carbonara.
e.zh: 这家小意大利餐厅做的奶油培根面最棒。

e.en: The mansion features an {Italianate} facade with tall windows.
e.zh: 这座宅邸有意大利风格的外立面和高大窗户。

e.en: Many Victorian villas were built in an {Italianate} style.
e.zh: 许多维多利亚式别墅采用了意式建筑风格。

italic.t:
adj. 斜体的
n. 斜体字

e.en: Use {italic} text to emphasize the book title.
e.zh: 用斜体来强调书名。

e.en: The footnotes are set in a small {italic} font.
e.zh: 脚注采用小号斜体字。

e.en: Please {italicise} all foreign words in the manuscript.
e.zh: 请把稿件里所有外文单词改成斜体。

e.en: Editors usually {italicise} ship names in news articles.
e.zh: 编辑通常把新闻里的船名设为斜体。

e.en: The pianist gracefully tickled the {ivories} all evening.
e.zh: 钢琴家整晚优雅地弹奏着琴键。

e.en: Antique {ivories} can no longer be sold legally.
e.zh: 古董象牙制品已不能合法买卖。

ivory.t:
n. 象牙
adj. 象牙色的

e.en: The trade in elephant {ivory} is banned worldwide.
e.zh: 全球范围内已禁止象牙贸易。

e.en: She wore a beautiful {ivory} silk dress to the wedding.
e.zh: 她穿着一件漂亮的象牙白丝绸裙参加婚礼。

e.en: Thick green {ivy} climbs up the old brick wall.
e.zh: 茂密的常春藤爬满了那堵旧砖墙。

e.en: He dreams of attending an {Ivy} League university.
e.zh: 他梦想就读一所常春藤盟校。

iwan.t: n. 伊万（伊斯兰建筑中的拱顶大厅）

e.en: The mosque's grand {iwan} faces the central courtyard.
e.zh: 清真寺宏伟的伊万门正对着中央庭院。

e.en: Tourists admired the tiled {iwan} of the ancient palace.
e.zh: 游客欣赏着古代宫殿那座瓷砖装饰的伊万门。

iwc.t: n. 万国表（瑞士钟表品牌）

e.en: He bought a vintage {IWC} watch at the auction.
e.zh: 他在拍卖会上买了一只老款 IWC 腕表。

e.en: {IWC} watches are crafted in Schaffhausen, Switzerland.
e.zh: IWC 腕表在瑞士沙夫豪森制造。

e.en: Bright red {ixora} blooms attract butterflies in the garden.
e.zh: 鲜红的龙船花在花园里引来蝴蝶。

e.en: She planted {ixora} along the front walkway.
e.zh: 她沿着前庭小径种下了龙船花。

izmir.t: n. 伊兹密尔（土耳其城市）

e.en: {Izmir} is a major port city on Turkey's Aegean coast.
e.zh: 伊兹密尔是土耳其爱琴海岸的重要港口城市。

e.en: We caught an early ferry from {Izmir} to the islands.
e.zh: 我们从伊兹密尔搭乘清晨的渡轮去岛上。

e.en: {Izvestia} was once the official newspaper of the Soviet government.
e.zh: 《消息报》曾是苏联政府的官方报纸。

e.en: Historians often cite {Izvestia} when studying Soviet politics.
e.zh: 研究苏联政治的历史学家常引用《消息报》。

irrefutably.t: adv. 无可辩驳地；确凿地

e.en: The data {irrefutably} shows a rise in temperatures.
e.zh: 数据确凿地表明气温正在上升。

e.en: Surveillance footage {irrefutably} placed him at the scene.
e.zh: 监控录像无可辩驳地证明他在现场。

irregardless.t: adv. 不管；无论如何（regardless 的非标准用法）

e.en: He insisted on going, {irregardless} of the warnings.
e.zh: 不管那些警告,他都坚持要去。

e.en: She finished the project, {irregardless} of the tight deadline.
e.zh: 不管截止日期多紧,她都完成了项目。

irregular.t:
adj. 不规则的；不规律的
n. 不合格品

e.en: His heartbeat was slightly {irregular} after the run.
e.zh: 跑步后他的心跳略有不规则。

e.en: The verb has an {irregular} past tense form.
e.zh: 这个动词的过去式是不规则的。

irregularity.t: n. 不规则；不合规；违规行为

e.en: Auditors found a small {irregularity} in the accounts.
e.zh: 审计员在账目中发现了一处小的违规之处。

e.en: Any {irregularity} in your heartbeat should be checked.
e.zh: 心跳的任何不规则都应该检查一下。

irregularly.t: adv. 不规则地；无规律地

e.en: The newsletter is published {irregularly} throughout the year.
e.zh: 这份通讯全年不定期发行。

e.en: His breathing came {irregularly} after the long climb.
e.zh: 长途攀登后,他的呼吸变得不规律。

e.en: The witness's comments faded into {irrelevance} during the trial.
e.zh: 那位证人的话在庭审中变得无关紧要。

e.en: Critics worry the magazine is sliding into {irrelevance}.
e.zh: 评论人士担心这本杂志正逐渐失去影响力。

irrelevancies.t: n. 不相关的事物（irrelevancy 的复数）

e.en: The report was full of {irrelevancies} that distracted from the main point.
e.zh: 这份报告充满了与主题无关的内容，分散了重点。

e.en: Skip the {irrelevancies} and tell me what actually happened.
e.zh: 别说那些无关紧要的事，告诉我到底发生了什么。

irrelevancy.t: n. 不相关；无关紧要的事

e.en: His comment was dismissed as a complete {irrelevancy}.
e.zh: 他的评论被当作完全无关的废话而被忽略。

e.en: The lawyer pointed out the {irrelevancy} of that piece of evidence.
e.zh: 律师指出那项证据与案件毫无关联。

e.en: Your age is {irrelevant} to whether you can do this job.
e.zh: 你的年龄与你能否胜任这份工作毫无关系。

e.en: The judge ruled the question {irrelevant} to the case.
e.zh: 法官裁定这个问题与本案无关。

e.en: He kept talking {irrelevantly} about his vacation during the meeting.
e.zh: 他在会议上不断离题地聊他的假期。

e.en: She {irrelevantly} mentioned the weather while we discussed the budget.
e.zh: 我们讨论预算时，她却莫名其妙地提起了天气。

irreligion.t: n. 无宗教信仰；不信教

e.en: Surveys show that {irreligion} is rising among young adults in many countries.
e.zh: 调查显示，许多国家年轻人中的无宗教信仰现象正在上升。

e.en: He was raised in a household that openly embraced {irreligion}.
e.zh: 他在一个公开信奉无宗教立场的家庭中长大。

irreligious.t: adj. 不信教的；亵渎宗教的

e.en: She comes from an {irreligious} family but respects her friends' beliefs.
e.zh: 她来自一个无宗教信仰的家庭，但尊重朋友们的信仰。

e.en: The novel was banned for its {irreligious} themes.
e.zh: 这本小说因其反宗教主题而遭禁。

irremediable.t: adj. 无法补救的；无法挽回的

e.en: The damage to the old painting was sadly {irremediable}.
e.zh: 那幅古画的损坏遗憾地无法挽回。

e.en: Their friendship suffered an {irremediable} blow after the betrayal.
e.zh: 那次背叛之后，他们的友谊遭受了无法弥补的打击。

irremediably.t: adv. 无可挽回地；无法补救地

e.en: The hard drive was {irremediably} corrupted by the virus.
e.zh: 硬盘被病毒彻底损坏，无法修复。

e.en: Their reputations were {irremediably} damaged by the scandal.
e.zh: 他们的名誉因丑闻而无可挽回地受损。

irreparable.t: adj. 无法弥补的；不可修复的

e.en: The leak caused {irreparable} damage to the antique books.
e.zh: 漏水对那些古董书造成了无法修复的损坏。

e.en: His harsh words did {irreparable} harm to their relationship.
e.zh: 他刻薄的话对他们的关系造成了无法弥补的伤害。

irreparably.t: adv. 无法弥补地；无可挽回地

e.en: The flood {irreparably} damaged the basement archives.
e.zh: 洪水无可挽回地损毁了地下室的档案。

e.en: Trust between them was {irreparably} broken after the lie.
e.zh: 那个谎言之后，他们之间的信任无可挽回地破裂了。

irreplaceable.t: adj. 不可替代的；无可取代的

e.en: Grandma's handwritten recipes are absolutely {irreplaceable} to our family.
e.zh: 奶奶手写的食谱对我们家来说是无可替代的。

e.en: A good mentor is {irreplaceable} early in your career.
e.zh: 在职业生涯初期，一位好导师是无可替代的。

irrepressible.t: adj. 抑制不住的；难以压抑的

e.en: The toddler had an {irrepressible} curiosity about everything around her.
e.zh: 这个小孩对周围的一切都有抑制不住的好奇心。

e.en: His {irrepressible} laughter filled the entire room.
e.zh: 他抑制不住的笑声充满了整个房间。

e.en: She remained {irrepressibly} cheerful even on the rainiest days.
e.zh: 即使在最阴雨的日子里，她依然抑制不住地开朗。

e.en: The kids chattered {irrepressibly} throughout the entire car ride.
e.zh: 一路上孩子们都按捺不住地叽叽喳喳。

irreproachable.t: adj. 无可指责的；无可挑剔的

e.en: Her conduct at work has always been {irreproachable}.
e.zh: 她在工作中的表现一向无可指责。

e.en: The chef has an {irreproachable} reputation for food safety.
e.zh: 这位厨师在食品安全方面享有无可挑剔的声誉。

irresistible.t: adj. 无法抗拒的；极有吸引力的

e.en: The smell of fresh bread is absolutely {irresistible}.
e.zh: 刚出炉面包的香味简直让人无法抗拒。

e.en: She felt an {irresistible} urge to check her phone.
e.zh: 她感到一种无法抗拒的冲动想看手机。

e.en: The dessert menu was {irresistibly} tempting after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后那份甜点菜单令人无法抗拒。

e.en: His smile was {irresistibly} charming to everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他的微笑让屋里每个人都无法抗拒地着迷。

irresolute.t: adj. 优柔寡断的；犹豫不决的

e.en: He stood {irresolute} at the door, unsure whether to knock.
e.zh: 他犹豫不决地站在门口，不知该不该敲门。

e.en: An {irresolute} leader can lose the team's confidence quickly.
e.zh: 优柔寡断的领导很容易失去团队的信任。

irresolution.t: n. 优柔寡断；犹豫不决

e.en: His {irresolution} cost the company a major business opportunity.
e.zh: 他的优柔寡断让公司错失了一个重大商机。

e.en: After hours of {irresolution}, she finally clicked the buy button.
e.zh: 犹豫了好几个小时后，她终于点了购买按钮。

irresolvable.t: adj. 无法解决的；不能分解的

e.en: They had {irresolvable} differences and decided to part ways.
e.zh: 他们之间有无法调和的分歧，决定分道扬镳。

e.en: The dispute over the border seemed {irresolvable} for decades.
e.zh: 那场边界争端几十年来似乎都无法解决。

irrespective.t: adj. 不考虑的（常用 irrespective of：不论）

e.en: Everyone pays the same fee {irrespective} of their age.
e.zh: 无论年龄大小，每个人交的费用都一样。

e.en: The rule applies to all employees, {irrespective} of position.
e.zh: 无论职位高低，这条规则适用于所有员工。

irresponsibility.t: n. 不负责任；无责任感

e.en: Leaving the gate open shows real {irresponsibility} as a pet owner.
e.zh: 不关大门表明作为宠物主人极不负责任。

e.en: His financial {irresponsibility} eventually caught up with him.
e.zh: 他在财务上的不负责任最终让他自食其果。

e.en: It would be {irresponsible} to drive after drinking that much.
e.zh: 喝了这么多酒还开车是非常不负责任的。

e.en: Posting unverified rumors online is deeply {irresponsible}.
e.zh: 在网上发布未经核实的谣言是极不负责任的。

e.en: Some influencers behave {irresponsibly} when promoting financial products.
e.zh: 一些网红在推广金融产品时表现得很不负责任。

e.en: He spent his savings {irresponsibly} on impulse purchases.
e.zh: 他不负责任地把存款都花在了冲动消费上。

irretrievable.t: adj. 无法挽回的；不可恢复的

e.en: Once you delete those files, the data may be {irretrievable}.
e.zh: 一旦你删除这些文件，数据可能就再也找不回来了。

e.en: The marriage had reached an {irretrievable} breakdown.
e.zh: 这段婚姻已经走到了无法挽回的破裂地步。

e.en: My old photos were {irretrievably} lost when the phone died.
e.zh: 手机坏掉时，我的旧照片就再也找不回来了。

e.en: Their friendship was {irretrievably} damaged by the public argument.
e.zh: 那场公开争吵让他们的友谊无可挽回地受损。

e.en: The comedian's {irreverence} toward authority made the show popular.
e.zh: 这位喜剧演员对权威的不敬让节目大受欢迎。

e.en: Her playful {irreverence} kept the team meetings entertaining.
e.zh: 她那种俏皮的不羁让团队会议变得有趣起来。

e.en: The show is famous for its {irreverent} take on politics.
e.zh: 这个节目以对政治不敬的吐槽风格而闻名。

e.en: His {irreverent} jokes shocked the more conservative guests.
e.zh: 他那些不敬的笑话让较保守的客人感到震惊。

e.en: She spoke {irreverently} about the company's most sacred traditions.
e.zh: 她对公司最神圣的传统也敢出言不敬。

e.en: The students laughed {irreverently} during the formal ceremony.
e.zh: 学生们在正式典礼上不敬地笑出了声。

irreversibility.t: n. 不可逆性；不可挽回性

e.en: The {irreversibility} of climate change worries many scientists.
e.zh: 气候变化的不可逆转性令许多科学家担忧。

e.en: Patients should understand the {irreversibility} of this surgery.
e.zh: 患者应当了解这种手术的不可逆性。

irreversible.t: adj. 不可逆的；无法撤销的

e.en: Without treatment, the nerve damage can become {irreversible}.
e.zh: 如果不治疗，神经损伤可能变得不可逆。

e.en: Deleting your account is an {irreversible} action.
e.zh: 删除账号是一项无法撤销的操作。

irreversibly.t: adv. 不可逆地；无法挽回地

e.en: The pandemic {irreversibly} changed how we work and shop.
e.zh: 这场疫情不可逆转地改变了我们工作和购物的方式。

e.en: Plastic pollution has {irreversibly} altered marine ecosystems.
e.zh: 塑料污染已经不可逆地改变了海洋生态系统。

irrevocable.t: adj. 不可撤销的；不可更改的

e.en: Once signed, the contract is legally {irrevocable}.
e.zh: 合同一旦签署，在法律上便不可撤销。

e.en: She made an {irrevocable} decision to move abroad.
e.zh: 她做出了一个不可更改的决定，要搬到国外去。

irrevocably.t: adv. 不可撤销地；无法挽回地

e.en: My view of the city was {irrevocably} changed after living there.
e.zh: 在那座城市住过之后，我对它的看法彻底改变了。

e.en: The leak {irrevocably} damaged the company's reputation.
e.zh: 这次泄密对公司声誉造成了无法挽回的损害。

e.en: Farmers use sprinklers to {irrigate} their fields during dry months.
e.zh: 农民们在旱季用喷灌设备给田地浇水。

e.en: The nurse will {irrigate} the wound to remove debris.
e.zh: 护士会用水冲洗伤口以清除碎屑。

irrigated.t:
v. 灌溉（过去式/过去分词）
adj. 已灌溉的

e.en: The {irrigated} farmland produces three crops a year.
e.zh: 这片有灌溉系统的农田一年能产三季作物。

e.en: They {irrigated} the orchard early this morning.
e.zh: 他们今天一大早就给果园浇了水。

e.en: Modern {irrigation} systems can save up to half the water used.
e.zh: 现代灌溉系统可以节省多达一半的用水。

e.en: Drip {irrigation} delivers water directly to plant roots.
e.zh: 滴灌将水直接输送到植物的根部。

e.en: The farmer installed a new {irrigator} to cover the entire field.
e.zh: 农民安装了一台新的灌溉机以覆盖整片田地。

e.en: A nasal {irrigator} can help relieve sinus congestion.
e.zh: 鼻腔冲洗器有助于缓解鼻窦充血。

e.en: Lack of sleep often causes {irritability} the next day.
e.zh: 睡眠不足常常导致第二天容易烦躁。

e.en: The medication's side effects include mild {irritability}.
e.zh: 这种药的副作用包括轻微的易怒。

e.en: I get {irritable} when I haven't had my morning coffee.
e.zh: 早上没喝咖啡我就会变得烦躁。

e.en: The baby was {irritable} all afternoon because of teething.
e.zh: 宝宝因为长牙整个下午都很烦躁。

e.en: He answered {irritably} when I asked the same question twice.
e.zh: 我重复问了同一个问题，他不耐烦地回答。

e.en: She tapped her foot {irritably} while waiting in line.
e.zh: 她排队时烦躁地用脚轻轻打着拍子。

irritant.t:
n. 刺激物；令人烦恼的事
adj. 刺激性的

e.en: The slow Wi-Fi has become a daily {irritant} at the office.
e.zh: 龟速Wi-Fi已经成了办公室里每天都让人烦的事。

e.en: Pollen is a common {irritant} for people with allergies.
e.zh: 花粉是过敏人群常见的刺激物。

irritate.t: v. 激怒；使烦躁；刺激（皮肤）

e.en: Loud notifications really {irritate} me during meetings.
e.zh: 开会时响亮的通知声真的让我很烦。

e.en: Harsh soaps can {irritate} sensitive skin.
e.zh: 刺激性强的肥皂会让敏感肌肤感到不适。

e.en: She got {irritated} when the app kept crashing.
e.zh: 应用一直崩溃，她很恼火。

e.en: My eyes feel {irritated} after staring at the screen all day.
e.zh: 盯着屏幕看了一整天，我的眼睛感到很不舒服。

irritates.t: v. 激怒；刺激（irritate 的第三人称单数）

e.en: It really {irritates} me when people don't reply to messages.
e.zh: 别人不回消息真的让我很恼火。

e.en: The wool sweater {irritates} my skin every time I wear it.
e.zh: 每次穿这件羊毛衫都会刺激我的皮肤。

indemnified.t: vt. 赔偿, 补偿, 保护, 保障\n[经] 赔偿

interbred.t: v. (使)异种交配, (使)混种, (使)杂种繁殖

intermarried.t: vi. 通婚, 近亲结婚

inventoried.t: n. 详细目录, 存货清单\nvt. 列入详细目录, 清点存货\n[计] 存货清单

irks.t: vt. 使厌倦, 使苦恼

irking.t: vt. 使厌倦, 使苦恼

e.en: The bridge used an {i-bar} in its old truss design.
e.zh: 这座桥的旧桁架设计中使用了工字形杆。

e.en: Workers replaced the cracked {i-bar} during repairs.
e.zh: 维修时，工人更换了开裂的工字形杆。

e.en: The catalog lists an {i-type} connector for narrow frames.
e.zh: 目录列出了一种适合窄框架的I型连接件。

e.en: Engineers chose an {i-type} beam for the support.
e.zh: 工程师选择了工字型梁作为支撑。

e.en: She practices {iaido} at the dojo twice a week.
e.zh: 她每周两次在道场练习居合道。

e.en: In {iaido}, the draw and cut are carefully controlled.
e.zh: 在居合道中，拔刀和斩击都受到严格控制。

iatrophysicist.t: 医物理学家；医学物理学者

e.en: The {iatrophysicist} measured how heat affected the patient's tissues.
e.zh: 这位医物理学家测量了热量对患者组织的影响。

e.en: In old medical debates, an {iatrophysicist} might explain disease through mechanics.
e.zh: 在早期医学争论中，医物理学者可能会用力学解释疾病。

iatrophysics.t: 医物理学；医学物理理论

e.en: Her thesis traced the history of {iatrophysics} in Europe.
e.zh: 她的论文梳理了医物理学在欧洲的发展史。

e.en: Early {iatrophysics} tried to explain the body as a machine.
e.zh: 早期医物理学试图把人体解释成一台机器。

iatrotechnics.t: 医疗技术；医术操作方法

e.en: The manual described ancient {iatrotechnics} for treating wounds.
e.zh: 这本手册描述了古代治疗伤口的医疗技术。

e.en: Modern surgery depends on precise {iatrotechnics} and careful training.
e.zh: 现代外科依赖精确的医术操作和严格训练。

iberite.t: 伊比利亚矿物；伊比利亚岩石

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {iberite} from an old collection.
e.zh: 地质学家认出这个样本是旧收藏中的伊比利亚矿物。

e.en: A thin vein of {iberite} crossed the darker stone.
e.zh: 一条细细的伊比利亚岩石脉穿过较深色的石头。

e.en: Several {ibices} stood on the cliff at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，几只野山羊站在悬崖上。

e.en: The guide pointed out {ibices} moving across the snow.
e.zh: 向导指出有几只羱羊正穿过雪地。

e.en: The footnote used {ibidem} to refer to the same source.
e.zh: 脚注用同上来指代同一个来源。

e.en: In older scholarship, {ibidem} often appears after repeated citations.
e.zh: 在较旧的学术著作中，重复引用后常会出现同上。

e.en: Researchers studied {ibogaine} as a possible treatment for addiction.
e.zh: 研究人员把伊博格碱作为成瘾治疗的可能方案来研究。

e.en: The use of {ibogaine} can carry serious medical risks.
e.zh: 使用伊博格碱可能带来严重的医疗风险。

e.en: The lab measured {ibotenate} levels in the mushroom extract.
e.zh: 实验室测量了蘑菇提取物中的鹅膏蕈氨酸盐含量。

e.en: Scientists used {ibotenate} to study specific brain lesions.
e.zh: 科学家用鹅膏蕈氨酸盐研究特定的脑损伤。

icaroscope.t: 日光照相仪；早期光学仪器

e.en: The museum displayed an {icaroscope} beside other optical devices.
e.zh: 博物馆把一台日光照相仪和其他光学装置放在一起展出。

e.en: An {icaroscope} helped demonstrate the action of sunlight on treated paper.
e.zh: 日光照相仪有助于展示阳光对处理过的纸张的作用。

e.en: She planted her {ice-axe} firmly in the slope.
e.zh: 她把冰镐牢牢插进斜坡。

e.en: Every climber carried an {ice-axe} during the glacier crossing.
e.zh: 穿越冰川时，每名登山者都带着一把冰斧。

e.en: They placed an {ice-block} under the fish to keep it cold.
e.zh: 他们在鱼下面放了一块冰，好让它保持低温。

e.en: The child pushed the {ice-block} across the frozen yard.
e.zh: 孩子把那块大冰推过结冰的院子。

e.en: She wore an {ice-blue} scarf with her gray coat.
e.zh: 她穿着灰色外套，围了一条冰蓝色围巾。

e.en: The room was painted a cool {ice-blue}.
e.zh: 房间被刷成了冷冷的冰蓝色。

e.en: The ship remained {ice-bound} for three weeks.
e.zh: 那艘船被冰封住，停了三个星期。

e.en: They crossed the {ice-bound} lake at dawn.
e.zh: 他们在黎明时穿过结冰封冻的湖面。

e.en: An {ice-breaker} opened a route through the frozen harbor.
e.zh: 一艘破冰船在冰封的港口开出航道。

e.en: The teacher used a game as an {ice-breaker}.
e.zh: 老师用一个游戏作为暖场活动。

e.en: The waiter brought an {ice-bucket} for the champagne.
e.zh: 服务员拿来一个冰桶给香槟降温。

e.en: She filled the {ice-bucket} before the guests arrived.
e.zh: 客人到来前，她把冰桶装满了冰。

e.en: The polar {ice-caps} are shrinking each year.
e.zh: 极地冰盖每年都在缩小。

e.en: Scientists study ancient air trapped in {ice-caps}.
e.zh: 科学家研究冰盖中封存的古老空气。

e.en: He handed me an {ice-cold} bottle of water.
e.zh: 他递给我一瓶冰冷的水。

e.en: Her reply was {ice-cold} and formal.
e.zh: 她的回答冷冰冰的，而且很正式。

e.en: The {ice-covered} road was dangerous after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后，那条覆冰的道路很危险。

e.en: They photographed the {ice-covered} branches in the park.
e.zh: 他们拍下公园里结满冰的树枝。

e.en: Put one {ice-cube} in the glass.
e.zh: 往杯子里放一块冰。

e.en: The {ice-cube} melted quickly in the tea.
e.zh: 那块冰在茶里很快融化了。

e.en: Climbers avoided the unstable {ice-fall} above the glacier.
e.zh: 登山者避开了冰川上方不稳定的冰瀑。

e.en: A sudden {ice-fall} blocked the mountain path.
e.zh: 突如其来的冰崩堵住了山路。

e.en: The expedition crossed a vast {ice-field}.
e.zh: 探险队穿过了一片辽阔的冰原。

e.en: Storms often sweep across the northern {ice-field}.
e.zh: 暴风雪常常横扫北部冰原。

e.en: A seal rested on a drifting {ice-floe}.
e.zh: 一只海豹趴在漂流的浮冰上休息。

e.en: The boat turned away from the large {ice-floe}.
e.zh: 小船避开了那块巨大的浮冰。

e.en: The port stays {ice-free} throughout the winter.
e.zh: 这个港口整个冬天都不结冰。

e.en: Researchers need an {ice-free} path to the station.
e.zh: 研究人员需要一条无冰通道到达站点。

e.en: Locals record {ice-out} on the lake every spring.
e.zh: 当地人每年春天都会记录湖冰完全融化的日期。

e.en: Fishing improves soon after {ice-out}.
e.zh: 湖冰融尽后不久，钓鱼情况会好转。

e.en: Hold an {ice-pack} against your swollen ankle.
e.zh: 把冰袋敷在肿起来的脚踝上。

e.en: The ship moved slowly through the {ice-pack}.
e.zh: 船在大片浮冰群中缓慢前行。

e.en: He used an {ice-pick} to break the frozen block.
e.zh: 他用碎冰锥敲开那块冻冰。

e.en: The old bar kept an {ice-pick} beside the sink.
e.zh: 那家老酒吧把一把碎冰锥放在水槽旁。

e.en: Greenland's {ice-sheet} contains enormous amounts of frozen water.
e.zh: 格陵兰的大陆冰盖含有巨量冻结的水。

e.en: Warming oceans can weaken an {ice-sheet} from below.
e.zh: 变暖的海水会从下方削弱冰盖。

e.en: One {ice-skate} had a loose blade.
e.zh: 一只滑冰鞋的冰刀松了。

e.en: Children {ice-skate} on the pond after school.
e.zh: 孩子们放学后在池塘上滑冰。

e.en: We {ice-skated} on the lake last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天我们在湖上滑过冰。

e.en: She {ice-skated} beautifully during the school show.
e.zh: 她在学校表演中滑冰滑得很漂亮。

e.en: He bought new {ice-skates} for the lesson.
e.zh: 他为这堂课买了新的滑冰鞋。

e.en: Her {ice-skates} were hanging by the door.
e.zh: 她的滑冰鞋挂在门边。

e.en: We went {ice-skating} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后我们去滑冰了。

e.en: {Ice-skating} requires balance and strong ankles.
e.zh: 滑冰需要平衡感和有力的脚踝。

e.en: Fill the {ice-tray} with water and freeze it.
e.zh: 把制冰格装满水，然后放进冰箱冷冻。

e.en: The plastic {ice-tray} cracked in the freezer.
e.zh: 塑料制冰格在冷冻室里裂开了。

e.en: Mammoths lived during the last {iceage}.
e.zh: 猛犸象生活在上一个冰河时代。

e.en: The film imagines animals surviving an {iceage}.
e.zh: 这部电影想象动物在冰河时代中求生。

e.en: The children threw an {iceball} across the yard.
e.zh: 孩子们把一个冰雪球扔过院子。

e.en: A hard {iceball} formed inside the freezer bag.
e.zh: 冷冻袋里形成了一个硬冰球。

e.en: Sailors saw {iceblink} glowing above the horizon.
e.zh: 水手们看见地平线上方泛着冰原反光。

e.en: The faint {iceblink} warned them of sea ice ahead.
e.zh: 微弱的冰原反光提醒他们前方有海冰。

e.en: They placed an {iceblock} under the fish crate.
e.zh: 他们在鱼箱下面放了一大块冰。

e.en: The sculpture began as a clear {iceblock}.
e.zh: 这座雕塑最初是一块透明的大冰块。

e.en: The old {iceboat} skimmed across the frozen lake.
e.zh: 那艘旧冰上帆船掠过结冰的湖面。

e.en: An {iceboat} cleared a narrow channel for the ferry.
e.zh: 一艘破冰船为渡轮清出一条狭窄航道。

e.en: The village was {icebound} for most of January.
e.zh: 这个村庄一月大部分时间都被冰封住。

e.en: Several ships remained {icebound} near the harbor.
e.zh: 几艘船仍被困在港口附近的冰中。

e.en: The spring thaw caused an {icejam} under the bridge.
e.zh: 春季解冻在桥下形成了冰塞。

e.en: Crews dynamited the {icejam} before it flooded the town.
e.zh: 工作人员在冰堵淹没小镇前用炸药清除它。

e.en: Drivers tested their control during the winter {icekhana}.
e.zh: 车手们在冬季冰上汽车技巧赛中检验操控能力。

e.en: The club held an {icekhana} on the frozen airfield.
e.zh: 俱乐部在结冰的机场跑道上举办了一场冰上汽车技巧赛。

e.en: The harbor stays {iceless} even in mild winters.
e.zh: 即使在温和的冬天，这个港口也保持无冰。

e.en: She ordered an {iceless} lemonade after the hike.
e.zh: 徒步之后，她点了一杯不加冰的柠檬水。

e.en: A sudden {icequake} rattled the research camp at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时一场突发冰震震动了研究营地。

e.en: Scientists recorded the {icequake} as the glacier cracked.
e.zh: 冰川开裂时，科学家记录下了这次冰震。

e.en: The baker used an {icer} to finish the cupcakes.
e.zh: 烘焙师用裱花器给纸杯蛋糕做最后装饰。

e.en: The coach warned the {icer} after another long clearance.
e.zh: 又一次远射解围后，教练警告了这名把球打成死球的队员。

e.en: The children met at the {icerink} after school.
e.zh: 孩子们放学后在溜冰场见面。

e.en: Workers resurfaced the {icerink} before the hockey match.
e.zh: 冰球比赛前，工作人员重新整修了冰场表面。

e.en: The photographer captured a blue {icescape} at sunrise.
e.zh: 摄影师在日出时拍下了一片蓝色冰雪景观。

e.en: Their tents looked tiny in the endless {icescape}.
e.zh: 在无边的冰原景色中，他们的帐篷显得很小。

e.en: We bought tickets for the holiday {iceshow}.
e.zh: 我们买了节日冰上表演的门票。

e.en: The {iceshow} mixed figure skating with live music.
e.zh: 这场花滑秀把花样滑冰和现场音乐结合起来。

e.en: Fill the {icetray} before putting it in the freezer.
e.zh: 把制冰盒放进冷冻室前先装满水。

e.en: One cracked {icetray} leaked water onto the shelf.
e.zh: 一个裂了的冰格把水漏到了架子上。

e.en: An {ichneumon} darted through the grass near the ruins.
e.zh: 一只獴从遗迹旁的草丛中飞快穿过。

e.en: The {ichneumon} lays its eggs inside another insect.
e.zh: 这种姬蜂会把卵产在另一种昆虫体内。

e.en: The museum displayed an {ichnite} from a Jurassic shoreline.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块来自侏罗纪海岸的足迹化石。

e.en: A clear {ichnite} helped identify the animal's movement.
e.zh: 一个清晰的遗迹化石帮助判断了那种动物的行动方式。

e.en: The sandstone belongs to a shallow-marine {ichnofacies}.
e.zh: 这层砂岩属于浅海环境的遗迹相。

e.en: Geologists used the {ichnofacies} to infer ancient water depth.
e.zh: 地质学家利用生痕相推断古代水深。

e.en: A burrow-shaped {ichnofossil} crossed the slab of rock.
e.zh: 一条洞穴状遗迹化石横穿这块岩板。

e.en: The {ichnofossil} recorded behavior rather than body parts.
e.zh: 这件生痕化石记录的是行为，而不是身体部位。

ichnographic.t: 足迹描绘的；遗迹记录的

e.en: The report included an {ichnographic} map of the dinosaur tracks.
e.zh: 报告附有一张描绘恐龙足迹的平面图。

e.en: Her {ichnographic} notes showed each burrow in careful detail.
e.zh: 她的遗迹记录笔记细致标出了每个洞穴。

e.en: He studied {ichnography} to interpret fossil tracks.
e.zh: 他研究足迹学来解读化石足迹。

e.en: The architect used {ichnography} in its older sense of ground-plan drawing.
e.zh: 这位建筑师按其旧义使用ichnography，指平面图绘制。

e.en: The collector found an {ichnolite} in the quarry wall.
e.zh: 收藏者在采石场岩壁中发现了一块足迹化石。

e.en: Each {ichnolite} preserved the outline of a small reptile's foot.
e.zh: 每个脚印化石都保存着小型爬行动物脚的轮廓。

e.en: The team published an {ichnological} study of the cave floor.
e.zh: 团队发表了一项关于洞穴地面的遗迹学研究。

e.en: Her {ichnological} evidence supported a new migration theory.
e.zh: 她的足迹学证据支持了一种新的迁徙理论。

e.en: {Ichnology} examines tracks, burrows, and other traces of life.
e.zh: 遗迹学研究足迹、洞穴以及其他生命痕迹。

e.en: He turned to {ichnology} when bones were too rare to study.
e.zh: 当骨骼化石太少无法研究时，他转向了足迹学。

e.en: The old medical text described {ichoremia} after severe infection.
e.zh: 这本旧医学书描述了严重感染后的脓毒血症。

e.en: Doctors once used {ichoremia} for poisoned blood from pus.
e.zh: 医生过去用ichoremia指脓液导致的血液中毒。

e.en: The wound gave off an {ichorous} discharge.
e.zh: 伤口流出了腐液样的分泌物。

e.en: An {ichorous} smell lingered in the untreated bandage.
e.zh: 未经处理的绷带上残留着一股脓水般的气味。

e.en: Her {ichthyophobia} made the aquarium visit difficult.
e.zh: 她的鱼类恐惧症让水族馆之行变得很难受。

e.en: He sought therapy for severe {ichthyophobia}.
e.zh: 他因严重怕鱼而去接受治疗。

e.en: The doctor suspected {ichthyosarcotoxism} after the seafood meal.
e.zh: 吃完海鲜后，医生怀疑是鱼肉中毒。

e.en: Several tourists developed {ichthyosarcotoxism} on the island.
e.zh: 几名游客在岛上出现了鱼肉中毒症状。

e.en: Fossils of {ichthyosauri} were found in the cliff.
e.zh: 悬崖里发现了鱼龙类动物的化石。

e.en: The museum displayed several ancient {ichthyosauri}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几具古老的鱼龙类动物。

e.en: The skull had clear {ichthyosaurian} features.
e.zh: 这块头骨具有明显的鱼龙类特征。

e.en: She studied an {ichthyosaurian} from the Jurassic period.
e.zh: 她研究了一种侏罗纪时期的鱼龙。

e.en: An {ichthyosaurus} looked like a dolphin-like reptile.
e.zh: 鱼龙看起来像一种类似海豚的爬行动物。

e.en: The child drew an {ichthyosaurus} in science class.
e.zh: 孩子在科学课上画了一只鱼龙。

e.en: The patient was born with {ichthyosis}.
e.zh: 这名患者天生患有鱼鳞病。

e.en: Moisturizers can ease mild {ichthyosis}.
e.zh: 保湿霜可以缓解轻度鱼鳞病。

e.en: The doctor noted {ichthyotic} skin on his legs.
e.zh: 医生注意到他腿部有鱼鳞病样皮肤。

e.en: She used cream for the {ichthyotic} patches.
e.zh: 她给那些鳞屑状斑块涂了药膏。

e.en: The outbreak was diagnosed as {ichthyotoxism}.
e.zh: 这次集体发病被诊断为鱼毒中毒。

e.en: Improperly prepared fish can cause {ichthyotoxism}.
e.zh: 处理不当的鱼可能导致鱼毒中毒。

e.en: January brought the {iciest} roads of the year.
e.zh: 一月带来了全年最冰冷的道路。

e.en: She gave him the {iciest} smile imaginable.
e.zh: 她给了他一个冷淡到极点的微笑。

e.en: An {icker} of barley lay on the table.
e.zh: 桌上放着一穗大麦。

e.en: The old poem mentions every tiny {icker}.
e.zh: 那首古诗提到了每一粒细小的谷物。

e.en: That was the {ickiest} smell in the kitchen.
e.zh: 那是厨房里最恶心的气味。

e.en: He avoided the {ickiest} chores after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他避开了最讨厌的杂活。

e.en: The soup's {ickiness} came from its sour smell.
e.zh: 这汤的恶心感来自它发酸的气味。

e.en: She laughed at the movie's deliberate {ickiness}.
e.zh: 她被电影刻意制造的恶心效果逗笑了。

e.en: Look at that {ickle} kitten sleeping there.
e.zh: 看那只小小的猫咪在那儿睡觉。

e.en: He used an {ickle} voice to sound cute.
e.zh: 他用可怜巴巴的小嗓音装可爱。

e.en: Dirty dishes give me the {icks}.
e.zh: 脏盘子会让我觉得很恶心。

e.en: Her rude jokes gave him the {icks}.
e.zh: 她粗鲁的笑话让他很反感。

e.en: The church preserved several {iconal} paintings.
e.zh: 教堂保存了几幅圣像画。

e.en: The interface uses an {iconal} design language.
e.zh: 这个界面采用图标化的设计语言。

e.en: The actor was {iconically} dressed in black.
e.zh: 那位演员穿着一身黑，形象极具标志性。

e.en: The sign represents danger {iconically}.
e.zh: 这个标志以图像方式表示危险。

e.en: The song gained {iconicity} over several decades.
e.zh: 这首歌经过几十年获得了标志性地位。

e.en: Linguists study {iconicity} in sign languages.
e.zh: 语言学家研究手语中的图像相似性。

e.en: Fans tend to {iconify} successful athletes.
e.zh: 粉丝往往会把成功运动员偶像化。

e.en: The app can {iconify} open windows automatically.
e.zh: 这个应用可以自动把打开的窗口图标化。

e.en: The media helped {iconize} the young singer.
e.zh: 媒体帮助把这位年轻歌手塑造成偶像。

e.en: Click here to {iconize} the document window.
e.zh: 点击这里可将文档窗口图标化。

e.en: She argued {iconoclastically} against the old theory.
e.zh: 她以反传统的方式反驳了旧理论。

e.en: The artist worked {iconoclastically} within religious themes.
e.zh: 这位艺术家在宗教主题中以破除偶像的方式创作。

e.en: The monk was known as an {iconodule}.
e.zh: 这位修士以圣像崇敬者闻名。

e.en: An {iconodule} defended images in worship.
e.zh: 一名圣像崇敬者为礼拜中使用圣像辩护。

e.en: The chapel kept an ancient {iconograph}.
e.zh: 小教堂保存着一幅古老圣像。

e.en: The report included an {iconograph} of the artifact.
e.zh: 报告中包含了这件文物的图像记录。

e.en: The {iconographer} restored the faded saint's face.
e.zh: 圣像画家修复了褪色的圣人面容。

e.en: An {iconographer} analyzed symbols in the mural.
e.zh: 一位图像研究者分析了壁画中的象征符号。

iconolater.t: 偶像崇拜者；圣像崇拜者

e.en: Critics called him an {iconolater} of celebrity culture.
e.zh: 批评者称他是名人文化的偶像崇拜者。

e.en: The historian described the ruler as an {iconolater}.
e.zh: 历史学家把这位统治者描述为圣像崇拜者。

e.en: Each {iamb} has an unstressed syllable followed by a stressed one.
e.zh: 每个抑扬格音步都由一个非重读音节后接一个重读音节组成。

e.en: The poet used an {iamb} to give the line a rising rhythm.
e.zh: 诗人用了一个抑扬格音步，让这一行有上扬的节奏。

e.en: The verse is built from five {iambi} in each line.
e.zh: 这首诗每行由五个抑扬格音步构成。

e.en: Classical critics counted the {iambi} carefully.
e.zh: 古典评论家会仔细数出这些抑扬格音步。

e.en: The line moves {iambically} from weak beat to strong beat.
e.zh: 这一行按抑扬格从弱拍推进到强拍。

e.en: She read the passage {iambically} to show its meter.
e.zh: 她按抑扬格朗读这段文字，以显示它的格律。

e.en: An {iambus} is common in English poetry.
e.zh: 抑扬格音步在英语诗歌中很常见。

e.en: He marked each {iambus} above the line of verse.
e.zh: 他在诗行上方标出了每个抑扬格音步。

e.en: The teacher asked us to identify the {iambuses} in the poem.
e.zh: 老师让我们找出诗中的抑扬格音步。

e.en: Too many perfect {iambuses} can make a line sound mechanical.
e.zh: 过多整齐的抑扬格音步会让诗句听起来机械。

e.en: The shell had an {ianthine} sheen in the afternoon light.
e.zh: 那只贝壳在午后光线下泛着紫罗兰色的光泽。

e.en: She described the rare flower as {ianthine} rather than simply purple.
e.zh: 她把那朵稀有的花称为紫罗兰色，而不只是说成紫色。

e.en: The mycologist noted an {ianthinosporous} pattern under the microscope.
e.zh: 真菌学家在显微镜下注意到一种具紫色孢子的形态。

e.en: An {ianthinosporous} fungus may leave a violet spore print.
e.zh: 具紫色孢子的真菌可能留下紫色孢印。

e.en: The agronomist used {iarovization} to make the wheat flower earlier.
e.zh: 农学家采用春化处理让小麦更早开花。

e.en: Early Soviet farming promoted {iarovization} as a way to improve yields.
e.zh: 早期苏联农业曾推广春化处理，认为它能提高产量。

e.en: They tried to {iarovize} the seeds before planting them.
e.zh: 他们试图在播种前对种子进行春化处理。

e.en: Farmers can {iarovize} certain grains by exposing them to cold.
e.zh: 农民可以通过低温处理来使某些谷物春化。

e.en: The suffix {iate} appears in words connected with healing.
e.zh: 后缀iate出现在与治疗有关的词中。

e.en: Students met {iate} only while studying old medical terminology.
e.zh: 学生只是在学习旧医学术语时才遇到iate这个后缀。

e.en: The old manuscript used {iateria} to mean the art of healing.
e.zh: 那份古手稿用iateria表示治疗的技艺。

e.en: He found {iateria} listed among obsolete medical terms.
e.zh: 他发现iateria被列在废弃的医学术语中。

e.en: Ancient writers treated {iatraliptics} as a branch of medicine.
e.zh: 古代作者把按摩疗法视为医学的一个分支。

e.en: The lecture mentioned {iatraliptics} when discussing historical therapies.
e.zh: 讲座讨论历史疗法时提到了按摩疗法。

e.en: The scholar traced the {iatric} roots of the old term.
e.zh: 那位学者追溯了这个旧词的医学词根。

e.en: Several {iatric} compounds survive in technical vocabulary.
e.zh: 一些与医学有关的复合词仍保留在专业词汇中。

e.en: The book preserves several {iatrical} expressions from early medicine.
e.zh: 这本书保留了早期医学中的几个治疗相关表达。

e.en: Her paper examined the {iatrical} language of Renaissance physicians.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了文艺复兴时期医生使用的医学语言。

e.en: Paracelsus helped shape {iatrochemistry} in early modern Europe.
e.zh: 帕拉塞尔苏斯推动了近代早期欧洲医化学的形成。

e.en: The course linked {iatrochemistry} with the history of pharmacology.
e.zh: 这门课把医化学与药理学史联系起来。

e.en: The report examined the {iatrogenesis} of the patient's complications.
e.zh: 报告研究了患者并发症的医源性发生。

e.en: Modern safety systems aim to reduce {iatrogenesis} in hospitals.
e.zh: 现代安全制度旨在减少医院中的医源性损害。

e.en: The infection was {iatrogenically} introduced during the procedure.
e.zh: 感染是在手术过程中由医疗操作造成的。

e.en: Some symptoms may arise {iatrogenically} after unnecessary treatment.
e.zh: 有些症状可能在不必要的治疗后由医疗行为引起。

e.en: He studied {iatrology} through ancient Greek medical texts.
e.zh: 他通过古希腊医学文献研究治疗学。

e.en: The word {iatrology} is now mostly historical or scholarly.
e.zh: iatrology这个词如今多用于历史或学术语境。

e.en: The inscription referred to an {iatron} near the temple.
e.zh: 碑文提到神庙附近有一处治疗场所。

e.en: In older Greek usage, an {iatron} could mean a place for healing.
e.zh: 在较早的希腊用法中，iatron可以指治病的地方。

iconolatrous.t: 崇拜圣像的；偶像崇拜的

e.en: The monk defended an {iconolatrous} form of worship.
e.zh: 那位修士为一种崇拜圣像的礼拜方式辩护。

e.en: Critics called the movement {iconolatrous} and dangerous.
e.zh: 批评者称这场运动带有偶像崇拜色彩且很危险。

e.en: The council condemned {iconolatry} in public worship.
e.zh: 该会议谴责公共礼拜中的圣像崇拜。

e.en: His fans' {iconolatry} made criticism almost impossible.
e.zh: 粉丝对他的偶像崇拜让批评几乎不可能出现。

e.en: Her essay offered an {iconological} reading of the mural.
e.zh: 她的论文从图像学角度解读了那幅壁画。

e.en: The curator noted several {iconological} links to Byzantine art.
e.zh: 策展人指出它与拜占庭艺术有几处图像学联系。

e.en: He studies {iconology} in Renaissance paintings.
e.zh: 他研究文艺复兴绘画中的图像学。

e.en: The film's {iconology} borrows from religious art.
e.zh: 这部电影的图像象征借鉴了宗教艺术。

iconomachy.t: 反圣像斗争；破坏偶像运动

e.en: The lecture traced {iconomachy} in medieval churches.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了中世纪教会中的反圣像斗争。

e.en: Modern {iconomachy} can target political symbols too.
e.zh: 现代的破坏偶像运动也可能针对政治象征。

iconomatic.t: 图像式的；以图像表达的

e.en: The designer preferred an {iconomatic} interface for children.
e.zh: 设计师更喜欢给儿童使用图像式界面。

e.en: His notes used an {iconomatic} shorthand of arrows and faces.
e.zh: 他的笔记用箭头和表情组成的图像式速记。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {iconometer} before the test.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了像度计。

e.en: An old {iconometer} sat beside the optical instruments.
e.zh: 一台旧图像测量仪放在光学仪器旁边。

iconophile.t: 圣像爱好者；图像崇敬者

e.en: As an {iconophile}, she collected painted saints.
e.zh: 作为圣像爱好者，她收藏了绘有圣徒的画像。

e.en: The essay contrasts the iconoclast with the {iconophile}.
e.zh: 这篇文章把破坏圣像者与图像崇敬者作对比。

iconoscope.t: 光电摄像管；早期电视摄像管

e.en: The museum displayed an early {iconoscope} camera.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台早期光电摄像管摄像机。

e.en: Engineers improved the {iconoscope} for television broadcasting.
e.zh: 工程师改进了用于电视广播的光电摄像管。

e.en: Candles burned before the church's {iconostasis}.
e.zh: 蜡烛在教堂的圣像屏前燃烧。

e.en: The carved {iconostasis} separated the nave from the sanctuary.
e.zh: 雕刻精美的圣像隔壁把中殿与圣所隔开。

e.en: The manual described repairs to the {iconotron}.
e.zh: 手册说明了显像管的维修方法。

e.en: A faulty {iconotron} blurred the experimental display.
e.zh: 故障的电子图像管使实验显示变得模糊。

iconotropy.t: 图像转义；神话图像误解

e.en: The scholar used {iconotropy} to explain the altered myth.
e.zh: 学者用图像转义解释这个被改写的神话。

e.en: In {iconotropy}, an image is reinterpreted as a story.
e.zh: 在图像转义中，图像会被重新解释成故事。

e.en: The lab kept an {iconscope} for checking tiny images.
e.zh: 实验室保留了一台用于检查微小图像的图像观察器。

e.en: She adjusted the {iconscope} until the pattern sharpened.
e.zh: 她调节图像镜，直到图案变得清晰。

e.en: The floor plan forms a regular {icosagon}.
e.zh: 这个平面图构成一个正二十边形。

e.en: Students measured each angle of the {icosagon}.
e.zh: 学生们测量了这个二十边形的每个角。

icosasphere.t: 二十面球；三维网格球体

e.en: The game engine rendered a smooth {icosasphere}.
e.zh: 游戏引擎渲染出一个平滑的二十面球。

e.en: She modeled the planet as an {icosasphere} mesh.
e.zh: 她把这颗行星建模为二十面球网格。

e.en: The sculpture resembles an {icosidodecahedron} made of steel.
e.zh: 这座雕塑像一个钢制的二十十二面体。

e.en: A regular {icosidodecahedron} has triangles and pentagons.
e.zh: 正二十十二面体由三角形和五边形组成。

e.en: The crystal was classified as an {icositetrahedron}.
e.zh: 这块晶体被归类为二十四面体。

e.en: He drew an {icositetrahedron} for the geometry assignment.
e.zh: 他为几何作业画了一个二十四面体。

e.en: Researchers identified a coastal {icotype} of the species.
e.zh: 研究人员确认了该物种的一种沿海生态型。

e.en: The report classified each dwelling by {icotype}.
e.zh: 报告按居住型类型对每处住宅进行分类。

ictal.t: 发作期的；癫痫发作时的

e.en: The doctor recorded the patient's {ictal} symptoms.
e.zh: 医生记录了患者发作期的症状。

e.en: An {ictal} EEG pattern appeared during the seizure.
e.zh: 癫痫发作时出现了发作期脑电图模式。

e.en: The nurse noticed an {icteric} tint in his eyes.
e.zh: 护士注意到他的眼睛有黄疸性的发黄。

e.en: The calf became weak and {icteric} after infection.
e.zh: 小牛感染后变得虚弱并出现黄疸。

e.en: The painter mixed an {icterine} shade for the sky.
e.zh: 画家为天空调出一种黄绿色色调。

e.en: Doctors described the skin as {icterine} in color.
e.zh: 医生描述皮肤呈黄疸色。

e.en: The diagnosis suggested {icteroanemia} after the blood test.
e.zh: 血液检查后，诊断提示为黄疸性贫血。

e.en: Severe {icteroanemia} required urgent veterinary treatment.
e.zh: 严重黄疸性贫血需要紧急兽医治疗。

e.en: The report listed {icterohematuria} among the symptoms.
e.zh: 报告把黄疸性血尿列为症状之一。

e.en: Cattle with {icterohematuria} often need rapid treatment.
e.zh: 出现黄疸性血尿的牛通常需要迅速治疗。

icterohemoglobinuria.t: 黄疸性血红蛋白尿症；伴黄疸血尿

e.en: The veterinarian suspected {icterohemoglobinuria} after the animal's urine turned dark red.
e.zh: 动物的尿液变成深红色后，兽医怀疑是黄疸性血红蛋白尿症。

e.en: Severe {icterohemoglobinuria} can signal rapid destruction of red blood cells.
e.zh: 严重的黄疸性血红蛋白尿症可能提示红细胞正在快速破坏。

e.en: The newborn developed mild {icterus} two days after birth.
e.zh: 这个新生儿出生两天后出现了轻度黄疸。

e.en: Doctors noted {icterus} in the patient's eyes during the examination.
e.zh: 医生检查时注意到患者眼白发黄。

e.en: The nurse used an {ictometer} to estimate the baby's jaundice level.
e.zh: 护士用黄疸计估测婴儿的黄疸程度。

e.en: An old {ictometer} compared skin color against a printed scale.
e.zh: 老式黄疸计会把皮肤颜色与印刷色阶进行比较。

e.en: The conductor marked the {ictus} clearly with a sharp downward beat.
e.zh: 指挥用一个干脆的下拍清楚标出强音。

e.en: Older medical texts sometimes used {ictus} to mean a sudden stroke.
e.zh: 较旧的医学文献有时用ictus表示突发中风。

ictuses.t: 强音的复数；发作的复数

e.en: The poem has several strong {ictuses} in each line.
e.zh: 这首诗每一行都有几个明显的强音。

e.en: The records listed two brief {ictuses} during the patient's illness.
e.zh: 病历记录了患者患病期间两次短暂发作。

e.en: The geologist identified {idaite} in the altered copper ore.
e.zh: 地质学家在蚀变的铜矿石中鉴定出伊达石。

e.en: Tiny grains of {idaite} appeared under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下出现了细小的伊达石颗粒。

e.en: Her early essays have an {ideaistic} tone that prizes concepts over detail.
e.zh: 她早期的文章带有重观念的语气，更看重概念而非细节。

e.en: The design felt too {ideaistic} to solve the practical problem.
e.zh: 这个设计过于理念化，难以解决实际问题。

idealess.t: 没有想法的；缺乏主意的

e.en: After hours of debate, the committee seemed completely {idealess}.
e.zh: 争论数小时后，委员会似乎完全没有主意了。

e.en: He stared at the blank page, tired and {idealess}.
e.zh: 他疲惫又毫无想法地盯着空白页面。

idealities.t: 理想性；理想事物的复数

e.en: The philosopher compared several {idealities} with ordinary experience.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把几种理想性与普通经验作比较。

e.en: Artists often chase {idealities} that daily life cannot provide.
e.zh: 艺术家常常追求日常生活无法提供的理想事物。

e.en: The painting suggests an {ideality} beyond physical beauty.
e.zh: 这幅画暗示了一种超越外在美的理想境界。

e.en: Kant's discussion of space includes the notion of its {ideality}.
e.zh: 康德关于空间的讨论包含空间理想性的概念。

e.en: The agency hired him as an {ideaman} for new campaigns.
e.zh: 这家广告公司聘他做新活动的创意人。

e.en: Every startup needs an {ideaman}, but it also needs careful builders.
e.zh: 每家初创公司都需要有点子的人，也需要细致的执行者。

ideamonger.t: 兜售理念的人；爱出主意者

e.en: The columnist was dismissed as an {ideamonger} with no practical plan.
e.zh: 这位专栏作家被说成只是兜售理念、没有实际计划的人。

e.en: At meetings, she became the team's cheerful {ideamonger}.
e.zh: 开会时，她成了团队里热心出主意的人。

e.en: The team will {ideate} before choosing a final design.
e.zh: 团队会先进行构思，再选择最终设计。

e.en: Patients with depression may {ideate} about self-harm and need support.
e.zh: 抑郁患者可能产生自伤念头，需要支持。

e.en: They {ideated} several features during the workshop.
e.zh: 他们在工作坊中构思了几个功能。

e.en: The report said he had {ideated} about suicide but made no plan.
e.zh: 报告称他曾有过自杀念头，但没有制定计划。

e.en: She {ideates} quickly when the brief is clear.
e.zh: 任务说明清楚时，她能很快构思。

e.en: The clinic asks whether a patient {ideates} about self-harm.
e.zh: 诊所会询问患者是否产生自伤念头。

e.en: We spent the morning {ideating} possible names for the app.
e.zh: 我们上午一直在构思这个应用可能的名字。

e.en: The therapist asked if he was {ideating} about hurting himself.
e.zh: 治疗师问他是否正在产生伤害自己的念头。

e.en: The algebra text calls this element the {idemfactor} of the operation.
e.zh: 这本代数教材把这个元素称为该运算的同一因子。

e.en: A misplaced {idemfactor} changed the result of the proof.
e.zh: 一个位置错误的同一因子改变了证明的结果。

e.en: The contract required the seller to {idemnify} the buyer against claims.
e.zh: 合同要求卖方赔偿买方因索赔遭受的损失。

e.en: Older spelling sometimes used {idemnify} where modern English writes indemnify.
e.zh: 较旧的拼写有时用idemnify，对应现代英语的indemnify。

idempotence.t: 幂等性；重复执行结果不变

e.en: Good API design often relies on {idempotence} for safe retries.
e.zh: 良好的API设计常依靠幂等性来安全重试。

e.en: In mathematics, {idempotence} means applying an operation again changes nothing.
e.zh: 在数学中，幂等性表示再次执行某个运算也不会改变结果。

e.en: The channel played a bright {ident} before the evening news.
e.zh: 频道在晚间新闻前播放了一段醒目的台标短片。

e.en: The security system checks each user's {ident} before granting access.
e.zh: 安保系统在放行前会检查每个用户的识别信息。

e.en: The two treaties were written in {identic} terms.
e.zh: 这两份条约使用了完全相同的措辞。

e.en: Diplomats sent {identic} notes to both governments.
e.zh: 外交官向两国政府发送了内容相同的照会。

e.en: The old report described fatal {ichorrhemia} after the wound became infected.
e.zh: 旧报告称，伤口感染后出现致命的脓毒血症。

e.en: Modern doctors rarely use the term {ichorrhemia} in clinical notes.
e.zh: 现代医生很少在病历中使用“脓毒血症”这个旧称。

e.en: The pharmacist suggested an {ichthammol} ointment for the small boil.
e.zh: 药剂师建议用鱼石脂软膏处理那个小疖子。

e.en: Some traditional skin treatments contain {ichthammol} as a drawing agent.
e.zh: 一些传统皮肤用药含有鱼石脂，用来促使脓液排出。

ichthiamin.t: 鱼胺素；鱼源性胺类物质

e.en: The researcher measured {ichthiamin} levels in spoiled fish samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了变质鱼样本中的鱼胺素含量。

e.en: Older chemical texts sometimes mention {ichthiamin} in discussions of fish decomposition.
e.zh: 较早的化学文献有时会在讨论鱼类腐败时提到鱼胺素。

ichthoform.t: 鱼石仿；旧式肠道收敛药

e.en: The museum label identified {ichthoform} as an obsolete medicinal powder.
e.zh: 博物馆标签说明鱼石仿是一种已过时的药粉。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {ichthoform} for certain intestinal complaints.
e.zh: 医生过去曾开鱼石仿来治疗某些肠道不适。

e.en: The old formulary listed {ichthydin} among dermatological preparations.
e.zh: 旧药典把鱼石定列在皮肤科制剂之中。

e.en: A historian found {ichthydin} advertised in early twentieth-century medical journals.
e.zh: 一位历史学者发现二十世纪初的医学期刊曾刊登鱼石定广告。

e.en: The fossil showed several {ichthyic} features in its fin structure.
e.zh: 这块化石在鳍部结构上显示出若干鱼类特征。

e.en: The poem uses {ichthyic} imagery to evoke life beneath the water.
e.zh: 这首诗用鱼类意象唤起水下生命的感觉。

e.en: The outbreak was diagnosed as {ichthyismus} after villagers ate contaminated fish.
e.zh: 村民食用受污染的鱼后，这次疫情被诊断为鱼中毒。

e.en: Medical dictionaries define {ichthyismus} as poisoning caused by fish.
e.zh: 医学词典把鱼中毒定义为由鱼引起的中毒。

e.en: The diver developed {ichthyoacanthotoxism} after stepping on a venomous spine.
e.zh: 潜水者踩到有毒鱼刺后发生了毒鱼刺中毒。

e.en: Emergency manuals describe {ichthyoacanthotoxism} as a painful marine injury.
e.zh: 急救手册把毒鱼刺中毒描述为一种疼痛的海洋损伤。

e.en: The survey documented the river's {ichthyofauna} before the dam was built.
e.zh: 调查在大坝修建前记录了这条河的鱼类区系。

e.en: Climate change is altering the coastal {ichthyofauna} of the region.
e.zh: 气候变化正在改变该地区沿海的鱼类群。

e.en: The report compared {ichthyofaunal} diversity across three lakes.
e.zh: 报告比较了三个湖泊的鱼类区系多样性。

e.en: Researchers found clear {ichthyofaunal} differences between the reefs.
e.zh: 研究人员发现这些礁区之间有明显的鱼类区系差异。

ichthyographer.t: 鱼类描述者；鱼类志作者

e.en: The nineteenth-century {ichthyographer} drew each species with careful detail.
e.zh: 这位十九世纪的鱼类志作者细致描绘了每个物种。

e.en: An {ichthyographer} must know both anatomy and scientific illustration.
e.zh: 鱼类描述者必须同时懂解剖学和科学绘图。

e.en: The lecture mentioned {ichthyohemotoxism} as a rare form of fish poisoning.
e.zh: 讲座提到鱼血毒中毒是一种罕见的鱼类中毒。

e.en: Raw handling of certain species may cause {ichthyohemotoxism}.
e.zh: 生处理某些鱼种可能导致鱼血毒中毒。

e.en: The creature had an {ichthyoid} body and large staring eyes.
e.zh: 那种生物身体似鱼，还有一双大而直视的眼睛。

e.en: Artists gave the sea monster an {ichthyoid} profile in the mural.
e.zh: 画家在壁画中把海怪画成鱼状轮廓。

e.en: The cream smelled strongly because it contained {ichthyol}.
e.zh: 这款乳膏气味很重，因为里面含有鱼石脂。

e.en: Older prescriptions used {ichthyol} for inflamed skin conditions.
e.zh: 旧处方曾用鱼石脂治疗发炎性皮肤病。

e.en: The anthropologist studied {ichthyolatry} in ancient river communities.
e.zh: 人类学家研究了古代河流社群中的鱼崇拜。

e.en: Images of sacred carp suggest a local tradition of {ichthyolatry}.
e.zh: 圣鲤图像显示当地可能有拜鱼的传统。

e.en: The quarry yielded a beautifully preserved {ichthyolite}.
e.zh: 采石场出土了一块保存精美的鱼化石。

e.en: Collectors prized the {ichthyolite} for its clear scales and fins.
e.zh: 收藏者珍视这块鱼化石，因为鳞片和鳍都很清晰。

e.en: The team examined an {ichthyolitic} layer in the limestone cliff.
e.zh: 团队检查了石灰岩悬崖中的含鱼化石层。

e.en: An {ichthyolitic} specimen can reveal details of ancient aquatic life.
e.zh: 鱼化石标本能揭示古代水生生命的细节。

e.en: The library keeps several rare {ichthyologic} monographs.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏了几本稀有的鱼类学专著。

e.en: Her {ichthyologic} notes focused on fin structure and habitat.
e.zh: 她的鱼类学笔记重点记录鳍的结构和栖息地。

e.en: The museum expanded its {ichthyological} collection last year.
e.zh: 博物馆去年扩充了鱼类学藏品。

e.en: He presented {ichthyological} evidence for a new species.
e.zh: 他提出了支持新物种的鱼类学证据。

e.en: The specimens were sorted {ichthyologically} before being catalogued.
e.zh: 这些标本在编目之前先按鱼类学方法分类。

e.en: {Ichthyologically}, the two populations belong to separate groups.
e.zh: 从鱼类学角度看，这两个种群属于不同类群。

e.en: She studied {ichthyology} because she loved river ecosystems.
e.zh: 她学习鱼类学，因为她热爱河流生态系统。

e.en: Modern {ichthyology} combines field surveys with genetic analysis.
e.zh: 现代鱼类学结合了野外调查和遗传分析。

e.en: The temple wall showed an {ichthyomorphic} deity with scales.
e.zh: 寺庙墙上画着一位长有鳞片的鱼形神祇。

e.en: Some larvae pass through an {ichthyomorphic} stage before changing shape.
e.zh: 有些幼体在变形前会经历一个鱼状阶段。

e.en: The islander's diet made him a lifelong {ichthyophagist}.
e.zh: 岛民的饮食使他终身以鱼为主要食物。

e.en: An {ichthyophagist} may know many ways to preserve fish.
e.zh: 食鱼者可能懂得许多保存鱼类的方法。

e.en: The bird is mainly {ichthyophagous} during the breeding season.
e.zh: 这种鸟在繁殖季主要以鱼为食。

e.en: Several {ichthyophagous} tribes lived along the coast.
e.zh: 几个食鱼部落曾生活在海岸沿线。

e.en: The study examined {ichthyophagy} among coastal communities.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了沿海社群的食鱼习性。

e.en: In bears, seasonal {ichthyophagy} increases during salmon runs.
e.zh: 在熊类中，鲑鱼洄游季的食鱼行为会增加。

e.en: The form asked for official {identification} before entry.
e.zh: 表格要求入场前出示官方身份证明。

e.en: Early {identification} of the problem saved time.
e.zh: 及早识别问题节省了时间。

e.en: The lab tested a new {identometer} for document checks.
e.zh: 实验室测试了一台用于文件核验的新型身份识别仪。

e.en: An old {identometer} stood beside the archive desk.
e.zh: 一台老式鉴别计放在档案桌旁。

e.en: The prefix {ideo} appears in words about ideas.
e.zh: 前缀ideo出现在与思想有关的词中。

e.en: Her notes grouped each {ideo} element by meaning.
e.zh: 她的笔记按意义归类每个观念成分。

e.en: The scholar compared several {ideogramic} writing systems.
e.zh: 这位学者比较了几种表意文字系统。

e.en: A simple {ideogramic} mark can represent a whole idea.
e.zh: 一个简单的表意符号可以代表一个完整概念。

e.en: The inscription uses an {ideogrammatic} sign for the sun.
e.zh: 铭文用一个表意符号表示太阳。

e.en: Chinese characters are often discussed as {ideogrammatic} forms.
e.zh: 汉字常被作为表意形式来讨论。

e.en: The tablet contains several {ideogrammic} symbols.
e.zh: 这块泥板上有几个表意符号。

e.en: Her article explains the {ideogrammic} value of the mark.
e.zh: 她的文章解释了这个符号的表意价值。

e.en: The museum displayed an {ideographical} script from antiquity.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一种古代的表意文字。

e.en: He analyzed the {ideographical} nature of the symbols.
e.zh: 他分析了这些符号的表意性质。

e.en: The concept is shown {ideographically} rather than phonetically.
e.zh: 这个概念是以表意方式而不是以表音方式呈现的。

e.en: Some signs function {ideographically} in the old script.
e.zh: 旧文字中的一些符号起表意作用。

e.en: Ancient {ideography} often mixed pictures with abstract signs.
e.zh: 古代表意文字常把图画和抽象符号混在一起。

e.en: The course includes a lecture on {ideography}.
e.zh: 这门课包括一讲关于表意文字体系的内容。

e.en: The speech had a strong {ideologic} tone.
e.zh: 这篇演讲带有强烈的意识形态色彩。

e.en: They disagreed over the plan's {ideologic} assumptions.
e.zh: 他们对该计划的意识形态假设意见不一。

ideologism.t: 意识形态用语；观念主义

e.en: The essay criticizes empty {ideologism} in political slogans.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评政治口号中空洞的意识形态用语。

e.en: His theory slipped into rigid {ideologism}.
e.zh: 他的理论滑向了僵化的观念主义。

e.en: The party tried to {ideologize} every school subject.
e.zh: 该党试图把每门学校课程都意识形态化。

e.en: Critics say the film does not {ideologize} the conflict.
e.zh: 批评者说这部电影并没有把冲突意识形态化。

e.en: The experiment studied the {ideomotor} effect in volunteers.
e.zh: 这项实验研究了志愿者身上的观念运动效应。

e.en: Small {ideomotor} movements can happen without awareness.
e.zh: 细小的观念运动动作可能在无意识中发生。

e.en: The linguist recorded an {ideophone} used for sudden silence.
e.zh: 语言学家记录了一个表示突然安静的拟声表意词。

e.en: In that language, each {ideophone} feels vivid and dramatic.
e.zh: 在那种语言中，每个拟声表意词都显得生动而富有戏剧性。

e.en: The occult text described {ideoplasty} as thought shaping matter.
e.zh: 这本神秘学文本把意念塑形描述为思想塑造物质。

e.en: Modern psychology rarely uses the term {ideoplasty}.
e.zh: 现代心理学很少使用意念塑形这个术语。

e.en: Breeders designed an {ideotype} for high-yield rice.
e.zh: 育种者设计了一种高产水稻的理想株型。

e.en: The model served as an {ideotype} for urban planning.
e.zh: 这个模型被用作城市规划的理想型。

e.en: The prefix {idio} means one's own or private.
e.zh: 前缀idio表示自己的或个人的意思。

e.en: Several medical terms use {idio} for a distinct condition.
e.zh: 一些医学术语用idio表示一种独特的状况。

e.en: The paper defines {idioadaptation} as adjustment by an individual organism.
e.zh: 论文把个体适应定义为单个生物体的调适。

e.en: Rapid {idioadaptation} helped the animal survive the cold.
e.zh: 快速的个体适应帮助这种动物熬过寒冷。

e.en: The rare term {idioblapsis} appears in older medical writing.
e.zh: idioblapsis这个罕见术语见于较早的医学著作。

e.en: Doctors once used {idioblapsis} for damage from internal causes.
e.zh: 医生曾用自发性损害指由内部原因造成的损伤。

e.en: The report described an {idioblaptic} injury without outside trauma.
e.zh: 报告描述了一处没有外部创伤的自发性损伤。

e.en: Older clinicians debated the {idioblaptic} nature of the lesion.
e.zh: 早期临床医生曾争论该病灶是否属于自发损害。

e.en: The mineral showed an {idiochromatic} color caused by its own elements.
e.zh: 这种矿物呈现由自身元素造成的本色。

e.en: Gemologists distinguish {idiochromatic} stones from impurity-colored ones.
e.zh: 宝石学家区分自身着色的宝石和由杂质致色的宝石。

e.en: The doctor noted several {idiosyncrasies} in the patient's reactions.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人反应中的几种特异体质表现。

e.en: Her small {idiosyncrasies} made the diary charming.
e.zh: 她那些小小的个人癖性让日记很有魅力。

e.en: The herb caused illness because of his {idiocrasy}.
e.zh: 由于他的特异体质，这种草药让他生病了。

e.en: Every artist has an {idiocrasy} that shapes the work.
e.zh: 每位艺术家都有塑造其作品的个人特性。

idiocratic.t: 特异体质的；个人特性的

e.en: The medicine produced an {idiocratic} reaction in one patient.
e.zh: 这种药在一名病人身上引发了特异体质反应。

e.en: His {idiocratic} style made the essay hard to imitate.
e.zh: 他独具个人特性的风格使这篇文章难以模仿。

e.en: The critic saw celebrity {idolism} everywhere in the campaign.
e.zh: 评论家认为这场宣传中到处都是名人崇拜。

e.en: His {idolism} made honest discussion almost impossible.
e.zh: 他的盲目崇拜让坦诚讨论几乎不可能。

e.en: Bacon called such errors an {idolum} of the mind.
e.zh: 培根把这类错误称为心智中的幻象。

e.en: The old theory became an {idolum} no one dared question.
e.zh: 那套旧理论成了无人敢质疑的谬误观念。

e.en: The committee sought an {idoneous} person for the post.
e.zh: 委员会想为这个职位寻找合适的人选。

e.en: This is hardly an {idoneous} moment to raise taxes.
e.zh: 现在绝不是提高税收的恰当时机。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {idrialite} from the old mine.
e.zh: 这份样品含有来自旧矿井的少量伊德里亚沥青矿物。

e.en: Nineteenth-century chemists studied {idrialite} as a mineral wax.
e.zh: 十九世纪的化学家曾把伊德里亚沥青矿物作为矿物蜡来研究。

e.en: The physician described the rare condition as {idromania}.
e.zh: 医生把这种罕见状况描述为强烈出汗欲。

e.en: Old medical texts sometimes mention {idromania} among nervous disorders.
e.zh: 旧医学文献有时把出汗狂列在神经性疾病中。

e.en: Excessive {idrosis} can leave the patient dehydrated.
e.zh: 过度出汗可能使患者脱水。

e.en: The drug appeared to reduce {idrosis} during the fever.
e.zh: 这种药似乎减少了发热期间的汗液分泌。

e.en: The poem is a brief {idyl} of rural life.
e.zh: 这首诗是一首描写乡村生活的短小田园诗。

e.en: Their summer by the lake felt like an {idyl}.
e.zh: 他们在湖边度过的夏天像一幅恬静景象。

e.en: The young {idylist} wrote lovingly about shepherds and fields.
e.zh: 这位年轻的田园诗作者深情描写牧羊人和田野。

e.en: As an {idylist}, she preferred quiet landscapes to heroic battles.
e.zh: 作为田园诗作者，她更喜欢宁静风景而非英雄战斗。

e.en: The {idyllist} turned village gossip into gentle verse.
e.zh: 这位田园诗作者把村里的闲谈写成温和的诗句。

e.en: Critics called him an {idyllist} rather than an epic poet.
e.zh: 评论家称他为田园诗作者，而不是史诗诗人。

e.en: The novelist tends to {idyllize} childhood in the countryside.
e.zh: 这位小说家往往把乡村童年理想化。

e.en: They tried to {idyllize} factory life for the brochure.
e.zh: 他们试图在宣传册中把工厂生活描写得像田园诗。

e.en: The teacher wrote an {if-then} statement on the board.
e.zh: 老师在黑板上写了一个如果那么语句。

e.en: Children learn {if-then} reasoning through simple experiments.
e.zh: 孩子们通过简单实验学习如果那么式推理。

e.en: The program uses an {if-then-else} block to choose a message.
e.zh: 这个程序用如果则否则结构来选择一条消息。

e.en: Beginners often nest one {if-then-else} statement inside another.
e.zh: 初学者常把一个如果则否则语句嵌在另一个里面。

e.en: The C file uses {ifdef} to enable debugging code.
e.zh: 这个 C 文件用条件编译指令启用调试代码。

e.en: Remove the unused {ifdef} before merging the patch.
e.zh: 合并补丁前先删除那个未使用的条件编译指令。

e.en: The script uses {ifelse} logic to handle missing values.
e.zh: 这个脚本用如果否则逻辑处理缺失值。

e.en: In R, {ifelse} can transform a whole vector at once.
e.zh: 在 R 语言中，ifelse 可以一次转换整个向量。

e.en: The plan's {iffiness} made investors hesitate.
e.zh: 这个计划的不确定性让投资者犹豫了。

e.en: She noticed some {iffiness} in his explanation.
e.zh: 她注意到他的解释里有些可疑之处。

e.en: The weather looks {iffish}, so bring a coat.
e.zh: 天气看起来不太确定，所以带件外套吧。

e.en: His excuse sounded {iffish} to everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他的借口让屋里每个人都觉得可疑。

e.en: His {idiocratical} style made the essay hard to imitate.
e.zh: 他独特的风格让这篇文章很难被模仿。

e.en: The critic noted an {idiocratical} turn of phrase in every chapter.
e.zh: 评论家注意到每章都有个人特有的措辞。

idiocratically.t: 以独特方式；个人特有地

e.en: She solved the problem {idiocratically}, ignoring the standard method.
e.zh: 她用自己独特的方式解决了问题，没有采用标准方法。

e.en: The poet writes {idiocratically} even when using familiar forms.
e.zh: 这位诗人即使用常见形式写作，也带着个人特有的风格。

e.en: The old report used {idioctonia} for what doctors now call suicide.
e.zh: 那份旧报告用idioctonia指现在医生所说的自杀。

e.en: In the glossary, {idioctonia} was listed as a rare medical term.
e.zh: 在词汇表中，idioctonia被列为罕见医学术语。

idioelectric.t: 自身发电的；特有电性的

e.en: The mineral showed an {idioelectric} response under pressure.
e.zh: 这种矿物在压力下表现出自身发电的反应。

e.en: Researchers described the tissue as {idioelectric} rather than merely conductive.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种组织描述为具有特有电性，而不只是导电。

e.en: The geologist mapped an {idiogeosyncline} near the ancient margin.
e.zh: 地质学家在古老边缘附近绘出了一个独立地槽。

e.en: An {idiogeosyncline} may develop apart from the main tectonic belt.
e.zh: 独立地槽可能在主要构造带之外形成。

e.en: The twins' {idioglossia} puzzled their parents for months.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎的私语让父母困惑了好几个月。

e.en: Some cases of {idioglossia} disappear when children enter school.
e.zh: 有些自创语言现象会在孩子入学后消失。

e.en: The lab prepared an {idiogram} from the patient's chromosomes.
e.zh: 实验室根据患者的染色体制作了一张染色体图。

e.en: An {idiogram} helps compare chromosome size and banding patterns.
e.zh: 染色体图有助于比较染色体大小和带型。

e.en: The scholar treated the mark as an {idiograph} of the scribe.
e.zh: 学者把这个记号视为抄写员的个人符号。

e.en: Each artist developed an {idiograph} that appeared in small corners.
e.zh: 每位艺术家都形成了会出现在小角落里的特有标记。

e.en: The detective noticed an {idiolectal} spelling error in both letters.
e.zh: 侦探注意到两封信里都有同一种个人语言习惯造成的拼写错误。

e.en: Her {idiolectal} rhythms survived even in formal speeches.
e.zh: 即使在正式演讲中，她个人化的语言节奏仍然保留着。

e.en: The novelist's favorite {idiologism} soon entered his fans' vocabulary.
e.zh: 这位小说家最爱的独创表达很快进入了粉丝的词汇。

e.en: A private {idiologism} can confuse readers outside the family.
e.zh: 家庭内部的个人用语可能让外人读者感到困惑。

e.en: The teacher preferred a more {idiomatical} translation of the sentence.
e.zh: 老师更喜欢这句话更地道的译法。

e.en: His prose was accurate but not always {idiomatical}.
e.zh: 他的散文很准确，但并不总是符合惯用表达。

e.en: The editor improved the {idiomaticity} of the translated dialogue.
e.zh: 编辑提高了译文对白的地道程度。

e.en: Learners often judge {idiomaticity} by listening to native speakers.
e.zh: 学习者常通过听母语者说话来判断表达的惯用性。

e.en: The thin section contained several {idiomorphic} crystals.
e.zh: 这张薄片中含有几颗自形晶体。

e.en: An {idiomorphic} mineral preserves its own crystal shape while forming.
e.zh: 自形矿物在形成时保留了自身的晶体形态。

e.en: The rock displayed {idiomorphous} grains under the microscope.
e.zh: 这块岩石在显微镜下显示出自形颗粒。

e.en: Botanists described the cell cluster as {idiomorphous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这个细胞团描述为形态独特。

e.en: The patient showed an {idiomuscular} contraction after the tap.
e.zh: 轻敲之后，患者出现了肌肉自身的收缩。

e.en: An {idiomuscular} response does not require direct nerve stimulation.
e.zh: 肌原性反应不需要直接刺激神经。

e.en: The swelling appeared {idiopathically}, with no clear infection.
e.zh: 肿胀原因不明地出现了，没有明显感染。

e.en: Some patients develop symptoms {idiopathically} despite normal test results.
e.zh: 有些患者即使检查结果正常，也会特发性地出现症状。

e.en: The clinic studied several rare {idiopathies} in children.
e.zh: 这家诊所研究了几种儿童罕见的特发病。

e.en: Older textbooks grouped many unexplained illnesses as {idiopathies}.
e.zh: 旧教材把许多原因不明的疾病归为特发病。

e.en: The diagnosis was {idiopathy} because no cause could be found.
e.zh: 由于找不到病因，诊断结果是特发病。

e.en: Doctors use {idiopathy} cautiously when evidence remains limited.
e.zh: 在证据仍有限时，医生会谨慎使用特发病这个说法。

e.en: The philosopher used {idiophanism} to describe a thing's self-revelation.
e.zh: 这位哲学家用idiophanism描述事物的自我显现。

e.en: In that theory, {idiophanism} marks what is uniquely shown.
e.zh: 在那套理论中，idiophanism指独特显现出来的东西。

e.en: The compound entered an {idiophase} at low temperature.
e.zh: 这种化合物在低温下进入了特有相。

e.en: Biologists used {idiophase} for a distinct stage in development.
e.zh: 生物学家用idiophase指发育中的一个独特阶段。

idiophone.t: 体鸣乐器；自身发声乐器

e.en: A bell is an {idiophone} because its body vibrates to make sound.
e.zh: 钟是一种体鸣乐器，因为它靠自身振动发声。

e.en: The museum displayed an African {idiophone} made from wood.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件木制非洲体鸣乐器。

e.en: Early biologists believed {idioplasm} carried inherited traits.
e.zh: 早期生物学家认为遗传质携带遗传性状。

e.en: The term {idioplasm} belongs mostly to the history of genetics.
e.zh: idioplasm这个术语主要属于遗传学史。

e.en: The paper discussed {idioplasmatic} changes across generations.
e.zh: 论文讨论了跨世代的遗传质变化。

e.en: His {idioplasmatic} theory was later replaced by modern genetics.
e.zh: 他的种质理论后来被现代遗传学取代。

e.en: The author proposed an {idioplasmic} basis for inheritance.
e.zh: 作者提出遗传有一种遗传质基础。

e.en: Few scientists still use the term {idioplasmic} in current biology.
e.zh: 如今的生物学中很少有科学家仍使用idioplasmic这个词。

e.en: The flashes were attributed to an {idioretinal} process.
e.zh: 这些闪光被归因于视网膜自身的过程。

e.en: An {idioretinal} sensation can occur without external light.
e.zh: 没有外部光线时，也可能出现视网膜自身产生的感觉。

idiorrhythmic.t: 按个人节律生活的；自律的

e.en: The monks followed an {idiorrhythmic} pattern of prayer and work.
e.zh: 这些修士按各自节律安排祈祷和劳作。

e.en: Her studio kept an {idiorrhythmic} schedule, open only when she felt ready.
e.zh: 她的工作室作息很随性，只在她觉得合适时开放。

idiorrhythmism.t: 个人节律制；自律生活方式

e.en: The monastery allowed {idiorrhythmism} rather than a common daily routine.
e.zh: 这座修道院允许个人节律制，而不是统一作息。

e.en: Modern freelancers sometimes romanticize {idiorrhythmism} as total freedom.
e.zh: 现代自由职业者有时把自律式生活浪漫化为完全自由。

e.en: The community's {idiorrhythmy} made shared meals difficult to organize.
e.zh: 这个群体各自作息，使集体用餐很难安排。

e.en: She valued the {idiorrhythmy} of remote work after years in offices.
e.zh: 多年坐班后，她很珍惜远程工作的个人节律。

e.en: The researcher described the cell structure as an {idiosome}.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种细胞结构称为特异体。

e.en: In older biology texts, {idiosome} may refer to a distinct cellular body.
e.zh: 在较早的生物学文本中，特异体可指一种独立的细胞体。

idiostatic.t: 特定状态的；个体静态的

e.en: The paper proposed an {idiostatic} model for the unusual reaction.
e.zh: 论文为这种异常反应提出了一个特定状态模型。

e.en: An {idiostatic} description ignores how the system changes over time.
e.zh: 静态的个体描述会忽略系统随时间的变化。

e.en: His spelling of {idiosyncracy} is an old variant of idiosyncrasy.
e.zh: 他写的这个词形是 idiosyncrasy 的旧式变体。

e.en: The doctor noted a drug {idiosyncracy} in the patient's record.
e.zh: 医生在病历中记录了患者对药物的特异反应。

e.en: The archaic word {idiotcy} appears in a few nineteenth-century texts.
e.zh: 这个古旧词出现在少数十九世纪文本中。

e.en: He denounced the policy as sheer {idiotcy}.
e.zh: 他斥责这项政策纯属愚蠢。

e.en: Some animals were once described as {idiothermal} in older zoology.
e.zh: 在早期动物学中，有些动物曾被描述为自身恒温。

e.en: The lecture contrasted {idiothermal} organisms with those dependent on external heat.
e.zh: 讲座把自身产热的生物同依赖外界热量的生物作了对比。

e.en: Birds are {idiothermous} because they regulate body heat internally.
e.zh: 鸟类能在体内调节体温，因此属于自身恒温。

e.en: The old term {idiothermous} has largely disappeared from modern textbooks.
e.zh: 这个旧术语在现代教材中已基本不见。

e.en: The essay mocked the {idiotism} of blind obedience.
e.zh: 这篇文章嘲讽了盲从的愚蠢。

e.en: Older medical writers sometimes used {idiotism} for severe mental disability.
e.zh: 早期医学作者有时用这个词指严重智力障碍。

e.en: He feared that endless propaganda would {idiotize} the public.
e.zh: 他担心无休止的宣传会使公众变得愚钝。

e.en: The satirist claimed television could {idiotize} an entire generation.
e.zh: 这位讽刺作家声称电视可能让整整一代人变蠢。

e.en: The obsolete term {idiotoxin} appears in early immunology papers.
e.zh: 这个过时术语出现在早期免疫学论文中。

e.en: They suspected an {idiotoxin} produced within the diseased tissue.
e.zh: 他们怀疑病变组织内部产生了一种自体毒素。

idiotroph.t: 专性营养型；特需营养生物

e.en: The mutant strain behaved as an {idiotroph} under laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 这个突变菌株在实验条件下表现为特需营养型。

e.en: An {idiotroph} may require a compound that ordinary strains can synthesize.
e.zh: 特需营养生物可能需要普通菌株能自行合成的化合物。

idiotropic.t: 特异趋向的；个体取向的

e.en: The author used {idiotropic} to describe a response unique to one organism.
e.zh: 作者用这个词描述某个生物独有的反应。

e.en: His argument had an {idiotropic} focus on private experience.
e.zh: 他的论证偏重个人经验，带有个体取向。

e.en: Each antibody clone can display a distinct {idiotype}.
e.zh: 每个抗体克隆都可能呈现不同的独特型。

e.en: The lab measured the {idiotype} to track the immune response.
e.zh: 实验室测定抗体独特型来追踪免疫反应。

e.en: The fused term {idiotypicantigen} usually means idiotypic antigen.
e.zh: 这个连写词通常指独特型抗原。

e.en: An {idiotypicantigen} can help identify a specific antibody population.
e.zh: 独特型抗原可帮助识别特定的抗体群。

e.en: The anatomist labeled the region an {idiozona} in his diagram.
e.zh: 解剖学家在图中把该区域标为特异带。

e.en: In rare technical use, {idiozona} denotes a distinct zone of tissue.
e.zh: 在罕见的专业用法中，这个词表示组织中的独立分区。

e.en: The chemist identified {iditol} among the reduced sugar products.
e.zh: 化学家在还原糖产物中鉴定出艾杜糖醇。

e.en: Pure {iditol} is mainly discussed in carbohydrate chemistry.
e.zh: 纯艾杜糖醇主要见于碳水化合物化学讨论中。

e.en: The poem treats {idlesse} as a tempting but dangerous comfort.
e.zh: 这首诗把闲散写成诱人却危险的安逸。

e.en: In Spenser's spelling, {idlesse} carries a deliberately archaic flavor.
e.zh: 在斯宾塞的拼写中，这个词带有刻意的古风。

idlest.t: 最懒散的；最无所事事的

e.en: He was the {idlest} student in the class that term.
e.zh: 那学期他是班里最懒散的学生。

e.en: Even her {idlest} afternoon produced a page of notes.
e.zh: 即使在她最闲散的下午，她也写出了一页笔记。

e.en: She served hot {idli} with coconut chutney for breakfast.
e.zh: 她早餐端上热腾腾的印度蒸米糕，配椰子酸辣酱。

e.en: The batter for {idli} ferments overnight before steaming.
e.zh: 做印度蒸米糕的米糊要先发酵一夜再蒸。

e.en: The collector bought a green {idocrase} from the mineral fair.
e.zh: 收藏者在矿物展上买了一块绿色符山石。

e.en: Geologists also call {idocrase} vesuvianite.
e.zh: 地质学家也把符山石称为 vesuvianite。

idola.t: 幻象；错误观念；偶像复数

e.en: Bacon warned that {idola} could distort human reasoning.
e.zh: 培根警告说，各种幻象会扭曲人的推理。

e.en: The museum label used {idola} as the Latin plural of idolum.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把 idola 用作 idolum 的拉丁复数。

idolatress.t: 女偶像崇拜者；盲目崇拜的女子

e.en: The old sermon condemned the queen as an {idolatress}.
e.zh: 那篇旧布道把女王斥为女偶像崇拜者。

e.en: In the novel, an {idolatress} of fashion sacrifices comfort for appearance.
e.zh: 小说中，一个盲目崇拜时尚的女子为了外表牺牲舒适。

e.en: The betrayal revealed his {ignobility}.
e.zh: 这次背叛暴露了他的卑劣本性。

e.en: She refused to answer {ignobility} with cruelty.
e.zh: 她不愿用残忍来回应卑劣行为。

e.en: He acted {ignobly} when pressure mounted.
e.zh: 压力增大时，他的行为很不光彩。

e.en: The victory was won {ignobly} through lies.
e.zh: 这场胜利是靠谎言卑劣地赢来的。

e.en: The delay is {ignorable} for most users.
e.zh: 对大多数用户来说，这点延迟可以忽略。

e.en: Not every rude comment is {ignorable}.
e.zh: 并不是每句无礼评论都可以不理会。

e.en: The museum displayed an {iguanodon} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具禽龙骨架。

e.en: Children learned how the {iguanodon} walked.
e.zh: 孩子们了解了禽龙是怎样行走的。

e.en: The fossil showed {iguanodont} teeth.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出类似禽龙的牙齿。

e.en: Scientists compared several {iguanodont} dinosaurs.
e.zh: 科学家比较了几种禽龙类恐龙。

e.en: The creature had an {iguanoid} head.
e.zh: 这种生物长着一个像鬣蜥的头。

e.en: Researchers described the lizard as {iguanoid}.
e.zh: 研究人员把这只蜥蜴描述为鬣蜥状。

e.en: Pilgrims enter {ihram} before the rites.
e.zh: 朝觐者在仪式前进入受戒状态。

e.en: He wore the white {ihram} garments.
e.zh: 他穿着白色的朝觐戒衣。

e.en: The video loads inside an {iframe} on the page.
e.zh: 视频会在页面里的内嵌框架中加载。

e.en: Some sites block content from being shown in an {iframe}.
e.zh: 有些网站会阻止内容显示在内嵌网页框架中。

e.en: The geologist identified the dark sample as {igelite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这块深色样品鉴定为一种天然沥青矿物。

e.en: Old mineral catalogues sometimes list {igelite} among bituminous substances.
e.zh: 旧矿物目录有时把igelite列在含沥青物质中。

e.en: He nodded and said, "{ight}, I'll meet you there."
e.zh: 他点点头说：“行吧，我在那里见你。”

e.en: Everything looked {ight} after the quick repair.
e.zh: 快速修好之后，一切看起来还可以。

e.en: The museum label described the black mineral as {iglite}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把这种黑色矿物描述为iglite。

e.en: Samples of {iglite} are rarely mentioned outside specialist mineral books.
e.zh: 除专业矿物书外，iglite样品很少被提到。

e.en: A thin section of {igloite} was examined under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察了一片igloite薄片。

e.en: Collectors value {igloite} because it occurs in very few deposits.
e.zh: 收藏者看重igloite，因为它只出现在极少数矿床中。

e.en: The hunters built an {iglu} from hard blocks of snow.
e.zh: 猎人们用坚硬的雪块搭了一座冰屋。

e.en: In older travel books, {iglu} is sometimes used instead of igloo.
e.zh: 在较早的旅行书中，iglu有时用来代替igloo。

e.en: The new specimen contained tiny crystals of {ignatieffite}.
e.zh: 这个新标本含有细小的ignatieffite晶体。

e.en: Only specialist papers usually discuss {ignatieffite} in detail.
e.zh: 通常只有专业论文会详细讨论ignatieffite这种矿物。

e.en: The metal became {ignescent} in the furnace.
e.zh: 金属在炉中变得灼热发光。

e.en: An {ignescent} coal glowed under the ash.
e.zh: 一块开始发亮的煤在灰烬下闪着红光。

e.en: The cliff was made of pale {ignimbrite}.
e.zh: 这面峭壁由浅色的火山灰流凝灰岩构成。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {ignimbrite} left by the ancient eruption.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了古代喷发留下的火山灰流凝灰岩分布图。

e.en: The report described the {ignisation} of the gas mixture.
e.zh: 报告描述了这团混合气体的引燃过程。

e.en: Careful control of {ignisation} is vital in the test chamber.
e.zh: 在测试舱内，谨慎控制点燃过程至关重要。

e.en: The lab measured the {ignitability} of the new coating.
e.zh: 实验室测量了这种新涂层的可点燃性。

e.en: Low {ignitability} makes the material safer near heat sources.
e.zh: 较低的易燃性使这种材料在热源附近更安全。

e.en: Keep {ignitable} liquids away from open flames.
e.zh: 请让易燃液体远离明火。

e.en: The dust becomes {ignitable} when it hangs in the air.
e.zh: 这些粉尘悬浮在空气中时会变得可被点燃。

e.en: The old manual called the vapor {ignitible}.
e.zh: 旧手册把这种蒸气称为可点燃的。

e.en: Any {ignitible} material must be stored in a marked cabinet.
e.zh: 任何易燃材料都必须存放在有标识的柜子里。

e.en: Engineers tested the {ignitionability} of the fuel blend.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种混合燃料的可点燃性。

e.en: Moisture can reduce the {ignitionability} of fine powder.
e.zh: 水分会降低细粉末的点火能力。

e.en: A faulty {ignitor} stopped the furnace from starting.
e.zh: 点火器故障导致炉子无法启动。

e.en: The rocket uses an electric {ignitor} to light the motor.
e.zh: 这枚火箭使用电点火器来点燃发动机。

e.en: The old power supply used an {ignitron} for rectification.
e.zh: 这台旧电源使用汞弧整流管进行整流。

e.en: Technicians replaced the aging {ignitron} with solid-state equipment.
e.zh: 技术人员用固态设备替换了老化的汞弧整流管。

e.en: She studies {ikebana} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 她每周六早上学习日本插花艺术。

e.en: The lobby displayed a simple {ikebana} arrangement.
e.zh: 大厅里摆着一件简洁的花道作品。

e.en: The collector labeled the tiny crystal as {ikunolite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这枚小晶体标为伊库诺石。

e.en: A trace of {ikunolite} appeared in the ore sample.
e.zh: 矿石样本中出现了少量伊库诺石。

e.en: The perfume contains sweet {ilang-ilang} oil.
e.zh: 这款香水含有甜润的依兰精油。

e.en: They planted {ilang-ilang} trees near the house.
e.zh: 他们在房子附近种了依兰树。

e.en: The doctor suspected {ileitis} after the scan.
e.zh: 扫描后，医生怀疑他患有回肠炎。

e.en: Chronic {ileitis} can cause abdominal pain.
e.zh: 慢性回肠炎可能引起腹痛。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {ileocecal} valve carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了回盲瓣。

e.en: Inflammation spread around the {ileocecal} region.
e.zh: 炎症扩散到回肠与盲肠区域周围。

e.en: The patient recovered slowly after {ileocecostomy}.
e.zh: 患者在回盲肠造口术后恢复缓慢。

e.en: The textbook describes {ileocecostomy} as a rare procedure.
e.zh: 教材把回盲肠造口术描述为一种少见手术。

e.en: Imaging showed swelling near the {ileocolic} artery.
e.zh: 影像显示回结肠动脉附近有肿胀。

e.en: The report mentioned an {ileocolic} anastomosis.
e.zh: 报告提到了一处回肠结肠吻合。

e.en: Tests confirmed severe {ileocolitis} in the patient.
e.zh: 检查确认患者患有严重回肠结肠炎。

e.en: Crohn's disease may present as {ileocolitis}.
e.zh: 克罗恩病可能表现为回肠结肠炎。

e.en: Older medical texts sometimes call typhoid {ileotyphus}.
e.zh: 旧医学文献有时把伤寒称为肠伤寒。

e.en: The term {ileotyphus} is now rarely used.
e.zh: 回肠伤寒这个术语如今很少使用。

e.en: The X-ray suggested a possible {ileus}.
e.zh: X光片提示可能存在肠梗阻。

e.en: After surgery, he developed paralytic {ileus}.
e.zh: 手术后，他出现了麻痹性肠梗阻。

e.en: The garden hedge was made of {ilex}.
e.zh: 花园里的树篱由冬青构成。

e.en: Some species of {ilex} produce bright red berries.
e.zh: 有些冬青属植物会结出鲜红的浆果。

e.en: The fracture affected both {ilia}.
e.zh: 骨折影响了两侧髂骨。

e.en: The diagram labels the {ilia} clearly.
e.zh: 图示清楚标出了两块髂骨。

e.en: Researchers isolated {ilicin} from holly leaves.
e.zh: 研究人员从冬青叶中分离出冬青苦素。

e.en: The paper discussed the bitter taste of {ilicin}.
e.zh: 论文讨论了冬青苦素的苦味。

e.en: The lei was woven with yellow {ilima}.
e.zh: 这串花环是用黄色伊利马花编成的。

e.en: {Ilima} grows well in sunny coastal areas.
e.zh: 伊利马花在阳光充足的海岸地区长得很好。

e.en: The therapist palpated the {iliocostalis} during the exam.
e.zh: 治疗师在检查时触诊了髂肋肌。

e.en: Tightness in the {iliocostalis} can affect posture.
e.zh: 髂肋肌紧张会影响姿势。

e.en: Some bottom-feeding fish are described as {iliophagous}.
e.zh: 一些底栖鱼类被描述为以淤泥为食。

e.en: The study focused on {iliophagous} species in the lagoon.
e.zh: 这项研究关注泻湖中食泥的物种。

e.en: Running uphill can strain the {iliopsoas}.
e.zh: 上坡跑可能拉伤髂腰肌。

e.en: The scan showed inflammation around the {iliopsoas}.
e.zh: 扫描显示髂腰肌周围有炎症。

e.en: The old engine was {ill-adapted} to mountain roads.
e.zh: 这台旧发动机不适合山路。

e.en: Some imported plants are {ill-adapted} to the local climate.
e.zh: 一些引进植物不适应当地气候。

e.en: It was an {ill-advised} attempt to save money.
e.zh: 那是一次为省钱而做的不明智尝试。

e.en: Her {ill-advised} remarks angered several colleagues.
e.zh: 她欠考虑的言论惹恼了几位同事。

e.en: He {ill-advisedly} ignored the lawyer's warning.
e.zh: 他不明智地无视了律师的警告。

e.en: The company {ill-advisedly} raised prices during the crisis.
e.zh: 公司在危机期间鲁莽地提高了价格。

e.en: A few {ill-affected} neighbors opposed the plan.
e.zh: 少数心怀不满的邻居反对这个计划。

e.en: The guard watched the {ill-affected} crowd carefully.
e.zh: 卫兵小心地盯着那群不友好的人。

e.en: The shelf held an {ill-assorted} collection of books.
e.zh: 架子上放着一堆杂乱不搭的书。

e.en: They made an {ill-assorted} pair at the dinner.
e.zh: 他们在晚宴上显得很不相称。

e.en: She felt {ill-at-ease} among the strangers.
e.zh: 她在陌生人中间感到不自在。

e.en: His stiff smile showed he was {ill-at-ease}.
e.zh: 他僵硬的笑容说明他局促不安。

e.en: The report described widespread {ill-being} after the disaster.
e.zh: 报告描述了灾后普遍的痛苦状态。

e.en: Long isolation can deepen a person's {ill-being}.
e.zh: 长期孤立会加重一个人的身心不适。

e.en: An {ill-boding} silence filled the room.
e.zh: 房间里弥漫着一种不祥的寂静。

e.en: Dark clouds gave the morning an {ill-boding} mood.
e.zh: 乌云让这个早晨显得凶兆隐隐。

e.en: It was {ill-bred} to interrupt the speaker.
e.zh: 打断发言者是很没教养的。

e.en: The host ignored his {ill-bred} joke.
e.zh: 主人没有理会他粗鲁的玩笑。

e.en: His loud complaints showed clear {ill-breeding}.
e.zh: 他大声抱怨，明显显出缺乏教养。

e.en: She mistook honesty for {ill-breeding}.
e.zh: 她把坦率误当成了粗俗无礼。

ill-chosen.t: 选择不当的；措辞失当的

e.en: The speech ended with an {ill-chosen} joke.
e.zh: 演讲以一个不合时宜的笑话结尾。

e.en: An {ill-chosen} color made the room feel smaller.
e.zh: 选错的颜色让房间显得更小。

ill-come.t: 不受欢迎的；来得不巧的

e.en: The news was {ill-come} during the celebration.
e.zh: 这个消息在庆祝时传来，很不受欢迎。

e.en: His visit felt {ill-come} after their argument.
e.zh: 他们争吵之后，他的来访显得很不合时宜。

ill-concealed.t: 掩饰不住的；隐藏不好的

e.en: She gave him an {ill-concealed} look of anger.
e.zh: 她看他的眼神明显掩饰不住怒气。

e.en: There was {ill-concealed} excitement in his voice.
e.zh: 他的声音里藏不住兴奋。

ill-conceived.t: 构想拙劣的；计划不周的

e.en: The policy was widely criticized as {ill-conceived}.
e.zh: 这项政策被广泛批评为构想拙劣。

e.en: Their {ill-conceived} shortcut created bigger problems.
e.zh: 他们考虑不周的捷径造成了更大的问题。

e.en: The {ill-conditioned} horse kicked at the gate.
e.zh: 那匹脾气坏的马朝门踢去。

e.en: They crossed the desert in an {ill-conditioned} truck.
e.zh: 他们开着一辆状况不佳的卡车穿越沙漠。

e.en: His {ill-considered} reply damaged the negotiations.
e.zh: 他轻率的答复损害了谈判。

e.en: The rule was an {ill-considered} reaction to one complaint.
e.zh: 这条规定是对一次投诉的欠考虑反应。

e.en: The project failed because its goals were {ill-defined}.
e.zh: 项目失败是因为目标界定不清。

e.en: Doctors noticed an {ill-defined} shadow on the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描图上注意到一片边界模糊的阴影。
