e.en: The committee seemed {ill-disposed} toward the proposal.
e.zh: 委员会似乎对这个提案抱有敌意。

e.en: He was not {ill-disposed} to helping old friends.
e.zh: 他并不反感帮助老朋友。

ill-educated.t: 教育不足的；缺乏学识的

e.en: The article mocked voters as {ill-educated}.
e.zh: 那篇文章嘲笑选民缺乏教育。

e.en: An {ill-educated} manager may still have sound judgment.
e.zh: 受教育不多的经理也可能有稳健判断。

e.en: The medicine caused no obvious {ill-effect}.
e.zh: 这种药没有造成明显的不良影响。

e.en: Late payments had an {ill-effect} on morale.
e.zh: 拖延付款对士气产生了坏影响。

ill-equipped.t: 装备不足的；准备不足的

e.en: The clinic was {ill-equipped} for a major outbreak.
e.zh: 这家诊所无力应对大规模疫情。

e.en: He felt {ill-equipped} to lead the team.
e.zh: 他觉得自己还没准备好领导团队。

ill-famed.t: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的

e.en: They avoided the {ill-famed} inn by the river.
e.zh: 他们避开了河边那家声名狼藉的旅店。

e.en: The prison was {ill-famed} for its harsh conditions.
e.zh: 这座监狱因条件恶劣而臭名昭著。

ill-fated.t: 命运多舛的；注定失败的

e.en: The {ill-fated} expedition never reached the summit.
e.zh: 那次命运多舛的探险从未到达山顶。

e.en: Their {ill-fated} merger collapsed within a year.
e.zh: 他们注定失败的合并不到一年就瓦解了。

e.en: The tale describes an {ill-favored} old king.
e.zh: 故事描写了一位相貌丑陋的老国王。

e.en: He disliked the {ill-favored} building near the station.
e.zh: 他不喜欢车站附近那栋难看的建筑。

e.en: The portrait made him look {ill-favoured} and severe.
e.zh: 这幅画像让他显得丑陋又严厉。

e.en: They restored the {ill-favoured} house with great care.
e.zh: 他们细心修复了那座难看的房子。

e.en: The {ill-fed} children looked tired and pale.
e.zh: 那些营养不良的孩子看起来又累又苍白。

e.en: An {ill-fed} horse cannot pull a heavy cart.
e.zh: 吃不饱的马拉不动沉重的车。

e.en: There was clear {ill-feeling} between the two neighbors.
e.zh: 两个邻居之间明显有怨气。

e.en: The dispute left lasting {ill-feeling} in the office.
e.zh: 这场争执在办公室里留下了长期的不满。

e.en: He was {ill-fitted} for such delicate work.
e.zh: 他并不适合做这种精细的工作。

e.en: The old door was {ill-fitted} to its frame.
e.zh: 那扇旧门和门框装得不合。

e.en: He wore an {ill-fitting} suit to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿了一套不合身的西装去面试。

e.en: Her role felt {ill-fitting} in the new team.
e.zh: 她在新团队里的角色显得不太合适。

e.en: The sentence was {ill-formed} and hard to parse.
e.zh: 这个句子结构不当，很难分析。

e.en: The puppy had an {ill-formed} front leg.
e.zh: 那只小狗有一条发育畸形的前腿。

e.en: After years of {ill-fortune}, the family finally recovered.
e.zh: 经历多年厄运后，这家人终于缓过来了。

e.en: She blamed her losses on {ill-fortune}.
e.zh: 她把自己的损失归咎于运气不好。

e.en: The accusation was {ill-founded} and unfair.
e.zh: 这项指控毫无根据，也不公平。

e.en: Their fears proved {ill-founded} after the inspection.
e.zh: 检查之后证明他们的担心没有根据。

ill-gotten.t: 非法得来的；不义之财的

e.en: He hid his {ill-gotten} money abroad.
e.zh: 他把非法得来的钱藏在国外。

e.en: The charity refused the {ill-gotten} donation.
e.zh: 那家慈善机构拒收这笔来路不正的捐款。

e.en: His morning {ill-humor} upset the whole household.
e.zh: 他早上的坏脾气让全家都不舒服。

e.en: She answered with unusual {ill-humor}.
e.zh: 她回答时带着少见的不悦。

e.en: The {ill-humored} clerk refused to help us.
e.zh: 那个脾气不好的店员拒绝帮我们。

e.en: He sounded {ill-humored} after the long delay.
e.zh: 长时间延误后，他听起来很不高兴。

e.en: The {ill-humoured} driver shouted at everyone.
e.zh: 那个坏脾气的司机冲所有人喊叫。

e.en: She became {ill-humoured} when the meeting dragged on.
e.zh: 会议拖得太久时，她变得很不高兴。

ill-informed.t: 了解不足的；消息不灵通的

e.en: His {ill-informed} comments angered the experts.
e.zh: 他那些缺乏了解的评论惹恼了专家。

e.en: Voters should not be left {ill-informed}.
e.zh: 不应该让选民在信息不足的情况下作判断。

e.en: It was an {ill-judged} joke at a serious meeting.
e.zh: 在严肃会议上讲那个笑话很欠考虑。

e.en: Her {ill-judged} reply made the conflict worse.
e.zh: 她失当的回复让冲突更加严重。

e.en: His {ill-kempt} hair suggested a sleepless night.
e.zh: 他凌乱的头发表明他一夜没睡好。

e.en: The room looked {ill-kempt} after weeks of neglect.
e.zh: 几个星期没人打理后，房间显得很邋遢。

ill-looking.t: 面色不佳的；样子可疑的

e.en: The {ill-looking} child needed a doctor immediately.
e.zh: 那个面色不佳的孩子需要马上看医生。

e.en: An {ill-looking} stain spread across the wall.
e.zh: 一块看起来不妙的污渍在墙上蔓延开来。

e.en: The {ill-mannered} guest interrupted every conversation.
e.zh: 那个没礼貌的客人打断了每一场谈话。

e.en: It is {ill-mannered} to laugh at a stranger.
e.zh: 嘲笑陌生人是很粗鲁的行为。

e.en: The two players were {ill-matched} from the start.
e.zh: 这两名选手从一开始就实力不相称。

e.en: Their {ill-matched} furniture made the room feel chaotic.
e.zh: 他们那些搭配不当的家具让房间显得很杂乱。

e.en: His {ill-natured} remark spoiled the celebration.
e.zh: 他那句刻薄的话破坏了庆祝气氛。

e.en: The story features an {ill-natured} old landlord.
e.zh: 这个故事里有一个心地不好的老房东。

e.en: She laughed {ill-naturedly} at his mistake.
e.zh: 她恶意地嘲笑他的错误。

e.en: He {ill-naturedly} refused to share the credit.
e.zh: 他刻薄地拒绝与别人分享功劳。

e.en: The villagers saw the eclipse as an {ill-omen}.
e.zh: 村民们把日食看作不祥之兆。

e.en: For the crew, the broken compass was an {ill-omen}.
e.zh: 对船员来说，坏掉的指南针是个凶兆。

e.en: They began their {ill-omened} journey before dawn.
e.zh: 他们在黎明前开始了那趟不祥的旅程。

e.en: An {ill-omened} silence filled the courtroom.
e.zh: 一种不祥的沉默笼罩了法庭。

ill-prepared.t: 准备不足的；无力应对的

e.en: The team was {ill-prepared} for the sudden crisis.
e.zh: 团队对这场突发危机准备不足。

e.en: New teachers often feel {ill-prepared} for classroom conflict.
e.zh: 新教师常觉得自己无力应对课堂冲突。

e.en: The cabinet held an {ill-sorted} collection of tools.
e.zh: 柜子里放着一堆杂乱不协调的工具。

e.en: They were an {ill-sorted} group of allies.
e.zh: 他们是一群很不协调的盟友。

e.en: He regretted his {ill-spent} youth.
e.zh: 他后悔自己虚度了青春。

e.en: The grant was {ill-spent} on unnecessary equipment.
e.zh: 那笔拨款被不当地花在了不必要的设备上。

e.en: Their {ill-starred} marriage ended within a year.
e.zh: 他们那段不幸的婚姻不到一年就结束了。

e.en: The {ill-starred} expedition never reached the summit.
e.zh: 那次倒霉的探险始终没有登上山顶。

ill-suited.t: 不合适的；不相称的；不适任的

e.en: The heavy boots were {ill-suited} to the long summer hike.
e.zh: 那双笨重的靴子不适合这次漫长的夏季徒步。

e.en: He was {ill-suited} for a job requiring constant diplomacy.
e.zh: 这份工作需要经常讲究外交手腕，他并不适任。

e.en: The {ill-tempered} driver shouted at everyone in traffic.
e.zh: 那个脾气暴躁的司机在车流中对所有人喊叫。

e.en: An {ill-tempered} debate soon replaced the polite discussion.
e.zh: 礼貌的讨论很快变成了一场火药味很重的争论。

e.en: She answered {ill-temperedly} when the question was repeated.
e.zh: 问题被重复时，她很不耐烦地作了回答。

e.en: The manager {ill-temperedly} dismissed every suggestion from the team.
e.zh: 经理脾气暴躁地否定了团队提出的每个建议。

ill-timed.t: 时机不当的；不合时宜的

e.en: His joke was {ill-timed} and made the room go silent.
e.zh: 他的笑话说得不是时候，房间里一下子安静了。

e.en: The announcement seemed {ill-timed} during a period of layoffs.
e.zh: 在裁员期间发布这个消息显得很不合时宜。

e.en: The law punishes people who {ill-treat} vulnerable children.
e.zh: 法律会惩罚虐待弱势儿童的人。

e.en: Do not {ill-treat} workers simply because they lack power.
e.zh: 不要因为工人缺少权力就恶劣地对待他们。

ill-treated.t: 遭虐待的；受到恶劣对待的

e.en: The shelter cares for animals that were {ill-treated} by owners.
e.zh: 这家收容所照顾那些被主人虐待过的动物。

e.en: Several employees felt {ill-treated} after the sudden pay cut.
e.zh: 突然降薪之后，几名员工觉得自己受到了不公对待。

e.en: They accused him of {ill-treating} prisoners during the conflict.
e.zh: 他们指控他在冲突期间虐待囚犯。

e.en: The company denied {ill-treating} temporary staff in its warehouses.
e.zh: 公司否认在仓库里恶劣对待临时员工。

e.en: The report documented years of {ill-treatment} in the institution.
e.zh: 报告记录了这家机构多年来的虐待行为。

e.en: Workers complained of {ill-treatment} by several senior managers.
e.zh: 工人们投诉几名高层经理对他们待遇恶劣。

e.en: Anyone who {ill-treats} animals should face serious penalties.
e.zh: 任何虐待动物的人都应受到严厉处罚。

e.en: She leaves any employer who {ill-treats} junior staff.
e.zh: 凡是恶劣对待基层员工的雇主，她都会离开。

e.en: The old diary describes his {ill-usage} at sea.
e.zh: 那本旧日记描述了他在海上遭受的虐待。

e.en: She endured years of {ill-usage} before seeking help.
e.zh: 她忍受了多年恶劣待遇之后才寻求帮助。

e.en: The villagers feared the soldiers would {ill-use} their prisoners.
e.zh: 村民担心士兵会虐待俘虏。

e.en: Do not {ill-use} a public office for private gain.
e.zh: 不要为了私利滥用公职。

e.en: The boy looked hungry and {ill-used} when he arrived.
e.zh: 那男孩到达时看起来又饿又像受过虐待。

e.en: Her trust had been {ill-used} by people she loved.
e.zh: 她的信任被她所爱的人糟蹋了。

e.en: The tyrant {ill-uses} anyone who dares to disagree.
e.zh: 那个暴君会虐待任何敢于反对他的人。

e.en: He {ill-uses} his influence to silence honest critics.
e.zh: 他滥用自己的影响力来压制诚实的批评者。

e.en: They were charged with {ill-using} the servants in their house.
e.zh: 他们被指控在家中虐待仆人。

e.en: The official was condemned for {ill-using} public money.
e.zh: 那名官员因滥用公款而受到谴责。

ill-wisher.t: 怀恶意的人；不怀好意者

e.en: Every public figure attracts at least one {ill-wisher}.
e.zh: 每个公众人物都会招来至少一个心怀恶意的人。

e.en: The letter was clearly written by an {ill-wisher}.
e.zh: 这封信显然是一个不怀好意的人写的。

e.en: The doctor noted unusual {illacrimation} during the eye exam.
e.zh: 医生在眼部检查中注意到异常流泪。

e.en: Poets once used {illacrimation} to suggest restrained grief.
e.zh: 诗人过去会用这个词来暗示克制的悲伤落泪。

illation.t: 推论；由前提得出的结论

e.en: His {illation} did not follow from the evidence provided.
e.zh: 他得出的推论并不能从所提供的证据中推出。

e.en: The philosopher questioned each {illation} in the argument.
e.zh: 哲学家质疑了论证中的每一个推论。

e.en: The word has an {illative} force in this sentence.
e.zh: 这个词在这个句子中具有表示推断的作用。

e.en: Her argument depends on an {illative} link between cause and duty.
e.zh: 她的论证依赖于原因与责任之间的推论联系。

illatively.t: 以推论方式；表示推断地

e.en: He moved {illatively} from one premise to the next.
e.zh: 他以推论的方式从一个前提推进到下一个前提。

e.en: The particle functions {illatively} in that older grammar.
e.zh: 在那种较早的语法中，这个小品词表示推断。

illaudable.t: 不值得称赞的；应受责备的

e.en: The judge called the scheme {illaudable} and deeply dishonest.
e.zh: 法官称这个计划不值得称赞，而且非常不诚实。

e.en: Such {illaudable} conduct damaged the charity's reputation.
e.zh: 这种应受责备的行为损害了慈善机构的声誉。

illaudably.t: 不值得称赞地；可责备地

e.en: He acted {illaudably} when he hid the missing funds.
e.zh: 他隐瞒失踪款项的行为很可责备。

e.en: The officials {illaudably} ignored warnings from local residents.
e.zh: 那些官员不值得称赞地无视了当地居民的警告。

e.en: The bill would {illegalise} several forms of online gambling.
e.zh: 这项法案将把几种网络赌博形式定为非法。

e.en: Campaigners urged parliament to {illegalise} the trade immediately.
e.zh: 活动人士敦促议会立即宣布这种交易为非法。

e.en: The {illegalization} of the practice changed the whole industry.
e.zh: 这种做法被定为非法后，整个行业都发生了变化。

e.en: They debated the {illegalization} of private ownership of the material.
e.zh: 他们辩论是否应将私人持有这种材料定为违法。

e.en: The new law will {illegalize} sales to minors.
e.zh: 新法律将把向未成年人销售的行为定为非法。

e.en: Some cities moved to {illegalize} the use of certain chemicals.
e.zh: 一些城市采取行动，准备禁止使用某些化学品。

illegalized.t: 已被定为非法的；被禁止的

e.en: The substance was {illegalized} after several fatal accidents.
e.zh: 在发生数起致命事故后，这种物质被定为非法。

e.en: Their once-common business model has now been {illegalized}.
e.zh: 他们曾经常见的商业模式如今已被禁止。

e.en: The geologist found {illuvium} beneath the sandy layer.
e.zh: 地质学家在沙层下面发现了淋积土。

e.en: Water movement can leave minerals concentrated in {illuvium}.
e.zh: 水流移动会使矿物集中留在淋积沉积物中。

e.en: The old {illywhacker} sold worthless charms to tourists.
e.zh: 那个老骗子把毫无价值的护身符卖给游客。

e.en: He told the story like a born {illywhacker}.
e.zh: 他说起故事来像个天生会吹牛行骗的人。

e.en: The sample contained dark grains of {ilmenite}.
e.zh: 样品中含有深色的钛铁矿颗粒。

e.en: Miners extract titanium from {ilmenite} ore.
e.zh: 矿工从钛铁矿矿石中提取钛。

e.en: The intrusion included a thick body of {ilmenitite}.
e.zh: 这次侵入体中包含一大片厚厚的钛铁矿岩。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {ilmenitite} near the old mine.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了旧矿附近钛铁矿岩的分布图。

e.en: The basalt contains crystals of {ilmenomagnetite}.
e.zh: 这种玄武岩含有钛磁铁矿晶体。

e.en: Magnetic tests revealed abundant {ilmenomagnetite} in the rock.
e.zh: 磁性测试显示岩石中有大量钛磁铁矿。

e.en: The mineral vein showed traces of {ilmenorutite}.
e.zh: 这条矿脉显示出含铁金红石的痕迹。

e.en: Under the microscope, {ilmenorutite} appeared as dark inclusions.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，含铁金红石呈现为深色包裹体。

e.en: The app uses an {image-based} search system.
e.zh: 这个应用使用基于图像的搜索系统。

e.en: Doctors tested a new {image-based} diagnosis method.
e.zh: 医生测试了一种新的基于图像的诊断方法。

image-builder.t: 图像生成工具；映像构建器

e.en: The designer used an {image-builder} to create quick mockups.
e.zh: 设计师用图像生成工具快速制作模型图。

e.en: The server runs an {image-builder} for container deployments.
e.zh: 服务器运行一个用于容器部署的映像构建器。

e.en: The team automated {image-building} for every release.
e.zh: 团队为每次发布自动化了映像构建。

e.en: His campaign focused on careful {image-building}.
e.zh: 他的竞选活动注重精心的形象塑造。

e.en: She installed an {image-converter} for old photo files.
e.zh: 她安装了一个图像转换器来处理旧照片文件。

e.en: This online {image-converter} supports several formats.
e.zh: 这个在线图像转换器支持多种格式。

e.en: The {image-maker} produced posters from text prompts.
e.zh: 这个造像工具根据文字提示生成海报。

e.en: As an {image-maker}, she prefers natural light.
e.zh: 作为图像制作者，她更喜欢自然光。

e.en: The upload failed because of {image-rejection} rules.
e.zh: 上传因图像拒收规则而失败。

e.en: The receiver needs better {image-rejection} performance.
e.zh: 这台接收机需要更好的镜像抑制性能。

e.en: The article felt {imageless} without photographs or diagrams.
e.zh: 没有照片或图表，这篇文章显得缺少图像。

e.en: Her fear was vague and almost {imageless}.
e.zh: 她的恐惧很模糊，几乎没有具体形象。

imagemaker.t: 图像制作者；形象打造者

e.en: The {imagemaker} adjusted the lighting before the shoot.
e.zh: 图像制作者在拍摄前调整了灯光。

e.en: A skilled {imagemaker} can change public perception.
e.zh: 熟练的形象打造者能改变公众看法。

imageplumbicon.t: 圣像破坏者；反偶像崇拜者

e.en: The medieval {imageplumbicon} opposed painted religious icons.
e.zh: 这位中世纪的圣像破坏者反对绘制宗教圣像。

e.en: Critics called him an {imageplumbicon} for attacking celebrity culture.
e.zh: 批评者因他攻击名人文化而称他为反偶像崇拜者。

e.en: The print shop replaced its old {imagesetters} last year.
e.zh: 印刷店去年更换了旧照排机。

e.en: Experienced {imagesetters} checked the plates before printing.
e.zh: 经验丰富的照排工在印刷前检查了版材。

e.en: A single candle can {illume} the chapel.
e.zh: 一支蜡烛就能照亮小教堂。

e.en: Her essay tried to {illume} an old debate.
e.zh: 她的文章试图阐明一场旧争论。

e.en: The doorway was {illumed} by moonlight.
e.zh: 门口被月光照亮。

e.en: His face {illumed} with sudden understanding.
e.zh: 他忽然明白过来，脸上亮了起来。

e.en: Morning light {illumes} the quiet room.
e.zh: 晨光照亮了安静的房间。

e.en: The poem {illumes} grief without explaining it.
e.zh: 这首诗不作解释，却把悲伤写得清楚。

e.en: The path is {illuminable} with small lamps.
e.zh: 这条小路可以用小灯照亮。

e.en: Even the obscure point is {illuminable} by evidence.
e.zh: 即使这个晦涩之处也能由证据阐明。

e.en: The engineer measured the {illuminance} on the desk.
e.zh: 工程师测量了桌面上的照度。

e.en: Low {illuminance} made reading uncomfortable.
e.zh: 照度太低，让阅读变得不舒服。

e.en: The lab used a standard {illuminant} for color tests.
e.zh: 实验室用标准光源进行颜色测试。

e.en: Gas was once a common household {illuminant}.
e.zh: 煤气曾经是常见的家庭照明光源。

e.en: The sample was compared under {illuminant-c}.
e.zh: 样品在C标准光源下进行比较。

e.en: Older color charts often specify {illuminant-c}.
e.zh: 旧版色卡常常指定使用C标准光源。

e.en: The pamphlet called its readers the {illuminata}.
e.zh: 那本小册子把读者称作受启迪者。

e.en: Some historians link the term {illuminata} to mystical societies.
e.zh: 一些历史学家把illuminata一词同神秘团体联系起来。

e.en: Her comment was brief but {illuminative}.
e.zh: 她的评论很简短，却很有启发性。

e.en: The device has an {illuminative} function for night work.
e.zh: 这台设备有供夜间工作使用的照明功能。

e.en: The sunrise was {illuming} the valley.
e.zh: 日出正照亮山谷。

e.en: His lecture kept {illuming} the harder passages.
e.zh: 他的讲座不断把较难的段落讲明白。

illuminism.t: 光照主义；神秘启蒙思想

e.en: The book traces {illuminism} in eighteenth-century Europe.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了十八世纪欧洲的光照主义。

e.en: Critics dismissed his beliefs as vague {illuminism}.
e.zh: 批评者把他的信念斥为含糊的神秘启蒙思想。

illuminist.t: 光照派信徒；启蒙主义者

e.en: He wrote as an {illuminist} rather than a scientist.
e.zh: 他的写作更像光照派信徒，而不是科学家。

e.en: The artist was called an {illuminist} for his radiant scenes.
e.zh: 这位画家因画面光感强烈而被称为重光色的画家。

e.en: The essay mocked his {illuministic} language.
e.zh: 那篇文章嘲笑他带有光照派色彩的语言。

e.en: They collected {illuministic} writings from the period.
e.zh: 他们收集了那个时期的神秘启蒙著作。

e.en: She checked the room with an {illuminometer}.
e.zh: 她用照度计检查了房间。

e.en: The {illuminometer} showed that the screen was too dim.
e.zh: 测光仪显示屏幕太暗。

e.en: The prisoner complained of {illusage} by the guards.
e.zh: 囚犯抱怨受到看守的虐待。

e.en: Such {illusage} of workers caused public anger.
e.zh: 这种恶劣对待工人的做法引发了公愤。

e.en: She faced the verdict with {illusionless} calm.
e.zh: 她清醒而平静地面对判决。

e.en: His {illusionless} view of politics sounded bleak.
e.zh: 他对政治毫无幻想的看法听起来很冷峻。

e.en: The desert lake shimmered {illusorily} in the heat.
e.zh: 沙漠中的湖影在热气中虚幻地闪动。

e.en: The plan seemed {illusorily} simple at first.
e.zh: 这个计划起初看似简单，其实只是错觉。

e.en: The poem praises an {illust} line of kings.
e.zh: 这首诗赞颂一支显赫的王族。

e.en: He sought an {illust} name in scholarship.
e.zh: 他想在学术界赢得显赫名声。

e.en: The chart served an {illustrational} purpose.
e.zh: 这张图表起到说明作用。

e.en: Her {illustrational} style suited children's books.
e.zh: 她的插图风格很适合儿童读物。

e.en: The caption calls the diagram an {illustraton}.
e.zh: 图注把这张示意图误写成illustraton。

e.en: Editors corrected {illustraton} to illustration before printing.
e.zh: 编辑在印刷前把illustraton改成了illustration。

e.en: Clay collected in the {illuvial} horizon.
e.zh: 黏土聚集在淀积层中。

e.en: The soil profile showed clear {illuvial} deposits.
e.zh: 土壤剖面显示出明显的淀积沉积物。

e.en: Fine particles can {illuviate} into lower soil layers.
e.zh: 细小颗粒会淀积到较低的土层中。

e.en: Water helped {illuviate} clay beneath the surface.
e.zh: 水促使黏土在地表下方淀积。

illuviated.t: 已淀积的；经淀积形成的

e.en: The sample contained {illuviated} clay.
e.zh: 样本中含有已淀积的黏土。

e.en: A dark {illuviated} band marked the subsoil.
e.zh: 一条深色的淀积带标出了底土层。

e.en: The lecture explained {illuviation} in forest soils.
e.zh: 讲座解释了森林土壤中的淀积作用。

e.en: Clay {illuviation} changed the texture of the subsoil.
e.zh: 黏土淀积改变了底土的质地。

e.en: The new ordinance {illegalizes} dumping waste in the river.
e.zh: 新条例把向河里倾倒废物定为违法。

e.en: Critics say the bill {illegalizes} ordinary protest tactics.
e.zh: 批评者说该法案把普通抗议手段也列为非法。

e.en: The council is {illegalizing} sales of the chemical.
e.zh: 委员会正把这种化学品的销售定为非法。

e.en: They opposed {illegalizing} behavior that caused no harm.
e.zh: 他们反对把没有造成伤害的行为非法化。

illegibly.t: 字迹难辨地；无法读清地

e.en: The doctor wrote the dosage {illegibly} on the form.
e.zh: 医生在表格上把剂量写得难以辨认。

e.en: Her name was scribbled {illegibly} at the bottom.
e.zh: 她的名字潦草地写在底部，几乎看不清。

e.en: The old record used {illegimate} as a spelling of illegitimate.
e.zh: 那份旧记录把 illegitimate 拼作了 illegimate。

e.en: Editors marked {illegimate} as an obsolete misspelling.
e.zh: 编辑把 illegimate 标为过时的误拼形式。

e.en: The regime feared the {illegitimation} of its authority.
e.zh: 该政权害怕自身权威被剥夺正当性。

e.en: Public scandals led to the party's gradual {illegitimation}.
e.zh: 一连串丑闻使该党逐渐失去合法性。

e.en: The athlete's {illeism} made the interview sound strange.
e.zh: 那名运动员用第三人称称呼自己，让采访听起来很奇怪。

e.en: Children sometimes use {illeism} before mastering pronouns.
e.zh: 孩子在掌握代词前有时会用第三人称说自己。

e.en: The poem contrasts wealth with the workers' {illfare}.
e.zh: 这首诗把财富与工人的苦难生活作对比。

e.en: He wrote bitterly about rural {illfare} after the harvest failed.
e.zh: 收成失败后，他痛切地描写了农村的困苦。

e.en: The surgeon examined the patient's {illia} before the operation.
e.zh: 手术前，外科医生检查了病人的髂骨部位。

e.en: Pain near the {illia} can come from several causes.
e.zh: 髂骨附近的疼痛可能由多种原因引起。

e.en: The essay traces the rise of political {illiberalism}.
e.zh: 这篇文章追溯了政治上反自由主义的兴起。

e.en: His {illiberalism} showed in his distrust of open debate.
e.zh: 他对公开辩论的不信任体现了他的狭隘保守。

e.en: Her {illiberality} toward dissent surprised her students.
e.zh: 她对异议的不宽容让学生们感到惊讶。

e.en: The host's {illiberality} made guests feel unwelcome.
e.zh: 主人的吝啬让客人觉得不受欢迎。

e.en: The philosopher argued for the {illimitability} of human desire.
e.zh: 这位哲学家主张人的欲望具有无限性。

e.en: The poem celebrates the {illimitability} of imagination.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美想象力的无边无际。

e.en: The plains seemed to stretch {illimitably} beyond the town.
e.zh: 平原似乎在小镇之外无边无际地延伸。

e.en: She believed knowledge could grow {illimitably}.
e.zh: 她相信知识可以无限增长。

e.en: The mystic wrote about the soul's {illimitation}.
e.zh: 这位神秘主义者写到灵魂的无限性。

e.en: Modern technology gives an impression of {illimitation}.
e.zh: 现代技术给人一种没有界限的感觉。

e.en: Scientists once proposed {illinium} as a new element.
e.zh: 科学家曾提出 illinium 是一种新元素。

e.en: The name {illinium} was later abandoned in chemistry.
e.zh: illinium 这个名称后来在化学中被弃用。

e.en: The clay sample contained a high proportion of {illite}.
e.zh: 这份黏土样本含有很高比例的伊利石。

e.en: Geologists identified {illite} in the sediment layer.
e.zh: 地质学家在沉积层中鉴定出伊利石。

e.en: The columnist mocked the cultural {illiterati} of the city.
e.zh: 这位专栏作家嘲讽了城里的文化无知者。

e.en: He feared that poor schools would create more {illiterati}.
e.zh: 他担心糟糕的学校会造成更多文盲。

e.en: The critic dismissed the pamphlet as {illiterature}.
e.zh: 评论家把这本小册子斥为低劣文字。

e.en: Online forums can turn rumor into polished {illiterature}.
e.zh: 网络论坛可能把谣言包装成看似精致的劣质文字。

illocal.t: 非局部的；无特定地点的

e.en: The theory describes an {illocal} relation between events.
e.zh: 该理论描述了事件之间一种非局部的关系。

e.en: His argument treats power as {illocal} and diffuse.
e.zh: 他的论证把权力视为无固定地点且分散的东西。

e.en: Quantum {illocality} troubled many early physicists.
e.zh: 量子非局部性曾困扰许多早期物理学家。

e.en: The essay links digital culture with a sense of {illocality}.
e.zh: 这篇文章把数字文化与一种无地点感联系起来。

e.en: A promise is an {illocution} performed through speech.
e.zh: 承诺是一种通过言语完成的施为行为。

e.en: The professor explained the {illocution} behind the question.
e.zh: 教授解释了这个问题背后的言语行为。

e.en: The plan collapsed under its own {illogic}.
e.zh: 这个计划因自身逻辑不通而失败。

e.en: She calmly exposed the {illogic} of his excuse.
e.zh: 她冷静地指出了他借口中的荒谬之处。

e.en: Ruskin used {illth} to describe wealth that harms society.
e.zh: 罗斯金用 illth 来指损害社会的财富。

e.en: The factory created profit for owners but {illth} for the town.
e.zh: 工厂给老板带来利润，却给城镇带来社会弊病。

e.en: The magician tried to {illude} the audience with mirrors.
e.zh: 魔术师试图用镜子欺骗观众的感官。

e.en: Fine words can {illude} voters during a crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间，漂亮话可能会迷惑选民。

e.en: Researchers studied {illudin} as a toxic fungal compound.
e.zh: 研究人员把伊鲁丁作为一种有毒真菌化合物来研究。

e.en: A derivative of {illudin} was tested for cancer treatment.
e.zh: 一种伊鲁丁衍生物曾被测试用于癌症治疗。

e.en: Every {imaginabale} excuse had already been used.
e.zh: 每一个能想得到的借口都已经用过了。

e.en: The design covered every {imaginabale} failure mode.
e.zh: 这个设计涵盖了所有可以设想的故障情况。

e.en: The plan could {imaginably} succeed with more funding.
e.zh: 如果有更多资金，这个计划可以想象是会成功的。

e.en: No one could {imaginably} finish the work tonight.
e.zh: 今晚恐怕没有人能完成这项工作。

e.en: She {imaginarily} placed herself on a distant island.
e.zh: 她在想象中把自己置身于一座遥远的岛上。

e.en: The line was drawn {imaginarily} across the map.
e.zh: 那条线是在地图上虚构地划出来的。

e.en: The story's {imaginariness} is part of its charm.
e.zh: 这个故事的虚构性质正是它的魅力之一。

e.en: Children rarely question the {imaginariness} of such worlds.
e.zh: 孩子们很少质疑这类世界的想象性。

e.en: The exercise develops {imaginational} flexibility in young writers.
e.zh: 这项练习能培养年轻作者在想象方面的灵活性。

e.en: Her {imaginational} world was richer than reality.
e.zh: 她的想象世界比现实更加丰富。

imagineers.t: 创意工程师；想象工程师

e.en: The {imagineers} built a ride that felt alive.
e.zh: 这些创意工程师打造了一项仿佛有生命的游乐设施。

e.en: Good {imagineers} mix storytelling with practical design.
e.zh: 优秀的想象工程师会把叙事和实用设计结合起来。

e.en: {Imagism} favored sharp images over decorative language.
e.zh: 意象派更重视鲜明意象，而不是华丽辞藻。

e.en: She studied {imagism} in a modern poetry course.
e.zh: 她在现代诗课程中学习了意象主义。

imagist.t: 意象派诗人；意象主义者

e.en: The {imagist} poem used one clear visual moment.
e.zh: 这首意象派诗只用了一个清晰的视觉瞬间。

e.en: Pound was an important {imagist} in early modern poetry.
e.zh: 庞德是早期现代诗中重要的意象主义者。

imagistically.t: 以意象派方式；重意象地

e.en: The scene is written {imagistically}, with almost no explanation.
e.zh: 这个场景以意象派方式写成，几乎没有解释。

e.en: She described the city {imagistically} through light and sound.
e.zh: 她通过光线和声音，以重意象的方式描写这座城市。

e.en: The debate concerned the authority of the {imamate}.
e.zh: 这场争论涉及伊玛目职位的权威。

e.en: The old {imamate} controlled several mountain villages.
e.zh: 旧时的伊玛目国控制着几个山村。

e.en: His {iman} shaped his daily choices.
e.zh: 他的伊斯兰信仰影响着每天的选择。

e.en: The sermon urged believers to strengthen their {iman}.
e.zh: 讲道鼓励信徒加强自己的信念。

imaret.t: 奥斯曼施粥所；慈善厨房

e.en: The mosque complex included an {imaret} for travelers.
e.zh: 这座清真寺建筑群里有一处为旅人服务的施粥所。

e.en: Food was served daily at the old {imaret}.
e.zh: 那座旧慈善厨房每天都会供应食物。

e.en: The {imaum} led the evening prayer.
e.zh: 伊玛目带领大家做晚间礼拜。

e.en: Villagers asked the {imaum} to settle the dispute.
e.zh: 村民请清真寺领拜人来调解这场纠纷。

e.en: Ancient priests would {imbalm} the body carefully.
e.zh: 古代祭司会仔细给遗体做防腐处理。

e.en: The poem seems to {imbalm} a lost summer.
e.zh: 这首诗仿佛把逝去的夏天保存了下来。

e.en: The soldiers began to {imbark} before dawn.
e.zh: 士兵们在黎明前开始登船。

e.en: She chose to {imbark} on a difficult reform.
e.zh: 她决定着手推进一项艰难的改革。

e.en: A cool {imbat} reached the town by afternoon.
e.zh: 下午时分，一阵凉爽的海风吹到了镇上。

e.en: Sailors waited for the {imbat} before leaving harbor.
e.zh: 水手们等着日间海风起来后再离港。

e.en: Seed swelling begins with {imbibition} of water.
e.zh: 种子膨胀始于对水分的吸收。

e.en: The scientist measured {imbibition} in the porous rock.
e.zh: 科学家测量了多孔岩石中的吸液作用。

e.en: Repeated insults can {imbitter} even a patient person.
e.zh: 反复的侮辱甚至会让有耐心的人心生怨恨。

e.en: The defeat did not {imbitter} her spirit.
e.zh: 那次失败并没有让她的心变得痛苦怨恨。

e.en: He sounded {imbittered} after years of rejection.
e.zh: 多年遭到拒绝后，他听起来满怀怨恨。

e.en: The medicine had an {imbittered} taste after storage.
e.zh: 这种药存放后带上了苦味。

e.en: Poverty became the great {imbitterer} of his youth.
e.zh: 贫困成了使他青年时代充满怨恨的主要原因。

e.en: The herb acts as an {imbitterer} in the mixture.
e.zh: 这种草药在混合物中起到增加苦味的作用。

e.en: The trial was an {imbittering} experience for everyone.
e.zh: 那场审判对所有人来说都是令人怨恨的经历。

e.en: Overboiling the leaves is {imbittering} the tea.
e.zh: 把茶叶煮得过久正在使茶变苦。

e.en: Years of neglect led to deep {imbitterment}.
e.zh: 多年的忽视造成了深深的怨恨。

e.en: The memoir records the slow {imbitterment} of a hopeful man.
e.zh: 这本回忆录记录了一个满怀希望的人如何慢慢变得痛苦怨恨。

e.en: The mayor called an {imbizo} to hear residents' concerns.
e.zh: 市长召开公众会议，听取居民的关切。

e.en: At the {imbizo}, elders spoke before the officials replied.
e.zh: 在社区集会上，长者先发言，官员随后回应。

e.en: The statue seems to {imbody} civic courage.
e.zh: 这座雕像似乎体现了公民勇气。

e.en: The ritual was meant to {imbody} the spirit of renewal.
e.zh: 这个仪式旨在使复兴的精神具象化。

e.en: Her success seemed to {imbolden} the whole team.
e.zh: 她的成功似乎让整个团队都更有胆量。

e.en: The quiet support did {imbolden} him to speak.
e.zh: 那份默默的支持确实鼓励他开口发言。

e.en: She longed to {imbosom} the child again.
e.zh: 她渴望再次把孩子拥入怀中。

e.en: The valley seemed to {imbosom} the little village.
e.zh: 山谷仿佛把这个小村庄环抱其中。

e.en: The cottage lay {imbosomed} among dark pines.
e.zh: 那座小屋坐落在深色松林的环抱中。

e.en: The baby slept {imbosomed} in her arms.
e.zh: 婴儿被她抱在怀里安睡。

e.en: The mother was {imbosoming} her tired son.
e.zh: 母亲正把疲惫的儿子搂在怀里。

e.en: Mist was {imbosoming} the hills at dawn.
e.zh: 拂晓时雾气正把群山包裹起来。

imbower.t: 以树荫遮蔽；安置林荫中

e.en: Old elms {imbower} the narrow lane.
e.zh: 古老的榆树给那条窄巷罩上浓荫。

e.en: They hoped to {imbower} the shrine with roses.
e.zh: 他们希望用玫瑰把神龛围在花荫里。

e.en: The judge warned that {imbracery} would void the trial.
e.zh: 法官警告说，贿赂陪审员会使审判无效。

e.en: He was charged with {imbracery} after contacting jurors.
e.zh: 他接触陪审员后被控行贿干预审判。

e.en: The museum displayed an {imbrex} from a Roman roof.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块来自罗马屋顶的弧形瓦。

e.en: Each {imbrex} covered the seam between flat tiles.
e.zh: 每块弧形瓦都覆盖在平瓦之间的接缝上。

e.en: The shell has an {imbricative} pattern of plates.
e.zh: 这只贝壳有一层层鳞片般重叠的纹理。

e.en: Botanists noted the flower's {imbricative} bracts.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这朵花重叠排列的苞片。

e.en: Autumn winds {imbrown} the edges of the leaves.
e.zh: 秋风把叶子的边缘染成褐色。

e.en: Smoke began to {imbrown} the kitchen ceiling.
e.zh: 烟雾开始把厨房天花板熏成棕色。

e.en: The old tale says he would {imbrue} his hands in blood.
e.zh: 那个古老传说说他会让双手沾满鲜血。

e.en: Rain seemed to {imbrue} the cloth with color.
e.zh: 雨水似乎把布料浸染出了颜色。

e.en: His sleeve was {imbrued} with dark red stains.
e.zh: 他的袖子被深红色污迹浸染了。

e.en: The sword lay {imbrued} after the battle.
e.zh: 战斗结束后，那把剑仍沾满血迹。

e.en: The poem describes the {imbruement} of white silk.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了白绸被浸染的过程。

e.en: They spoke grimly of the sword's {imbruement}.
e.zh: 他们神情沉重地谈到那把剑沾血之事。

e.en: The dye {imbrues} the wool with a deep blue.
e.zh: 染料把羊毛浸成了深蓝色。

e.en: Violence {imbrues} the legend from beginning to end.
e.zh: 暴力从头到尾都浸透了这个传说。

e.en: He imagined the rain {imbruing} the pale stone.
e.zh: 他想象雨水正浸染着那块浅色石头。

e.en: The scene shows a blade {imbruing} the floor.
e.zh: 这一幕显示刀刃上的血正染到地板上。

e.en: Cruel habits can {imbrute} a gentle mind.
e.zh: 残酷的习惯会使温和的心灵变得野蛮。

e.en: The tyrant tried to {imbrute} his soldiers.
e.zh: 暴君试图把士兵训练得像野兽一样残忍。

e.en: The prisoner seemed {imbruted} by years of abuse.
e.zh: 多年虐待似乎使这个囚犯变得粗野麻木。

e.en: They feared an {imbruted} society without mercy.
e.zh: 他们害怕一个失去怜悯、变得野蛮的社会。

e.en: The essay attacks the {imbrutement} caused by war.
e.zh: 这篇文章抨击战争造成的野蛮化。

e.en: He saw drunken cruelty as a kind of {imbrutement}.
e.zh: 他把醉后的残忍看作一种兽性化。

e.en: The regime was {imbruting} its young recruits.
e.zh: 那个政权正在把年轻新兵变得残忍野蛮。

e.en: He feared the work was {imbruting} his character.
e.zh: 他担心这份工作正在使自己的性格粗野化。

e.en: The cabinet was made of polished {imbuia}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用抛光的巴西胡桃木做成的。

e.en: Carpenters value {imbuia} for its rich grain.
e.zh: 木匠看重巴西胡桃木丰富的木纹。

e.en: The clerk promised to {imburse} the travel costs.
e.zh: 办事员承诺会支付这笔差旅费用。

e.en: He paused to {imburse} the coins carefully.
e.zh: 他停下来，小心地把硬币装进口袋。

e.en: The contract required prompt {imbursement} of expenses.
e.zh: 合同要求及时支付各项费用。

e.en: The old account mentions the {imbursement} of silver.
e.zh: 那本旧账簿提到把银币收入钱袋。

e.en: The diver found an {imersal} branch below the surface.
e.zh: 潜水员在水面下发现了一根浸没的树枝。

e.en: Some {imersal} plants survive long floods.
e.zh: 有些沉水植物能挺过长期洪水。

e.en: The chemist identified an {imid} in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中鉴定出一种酰亚胺。

e.en: An {imid} group can affect the compound's stability.
e.zh: 酰亚胺基会影响该化合物的稳定性。

e.en: Farmers used {imidacloprid} to control aphids on the crop.
e.zh: 农民使用吡虫啉来防治作物上的蚜虫。

e.en: Some studies link {imidacloprid} to risks for bees.
e.zh: 一些研究认为吡虫啉可能给蜜蜂带来风险。

e.en: The molecule contains an {imidazole} ring.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个咪唑环。

e.en: Histidine has an {imidazole} side chain.
e.zh: 组氨酸带有一个咪唑侧链。

e.en: The drug acts on {imidazoline} receptors in the brain.
e.zh: 这种药物作用于大脑中的咪唑啉受体。

e.en: Chemists synthesized a new {imidazoline} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的咪唑啉衍生物。

e.en: The compound has an {imidazolyl} group attached to the chain.
e.zh: 该化合物的链上连接着一个咪唑基。

e.en: Researchers tested several {imidazolyl} analogues for activity.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了几种咪唑基类似物的活性。

e.en: The polymer contains an {imide} linkage.
e.zh: 这种聚合物含有酰亚胺键。

e.en: An {imide} can form from certain dicarboxylic acids.
e.zh: 某些二羧酸可以生成酰亚胺。

e.en: The catalyst includes an {imido} ligand.
e.zh: 这种催化剂含有一个亚氨基配体。

e.en: They observed an {imido} intermediate during the reaction.
e.zh: 他们在反应过程中观察到一种亚氨基中间体。

e.en: The {imidochloride} reacted quickly with water.
e.zh: 这种亚胺酰氯与水迅速反应。

e.en: She prepared an {imidochloride} from the corresponding amide.
e.zh: 她由相应的酰胺制备了亚胺酰氯。

e.en: Older papers sometimes call imidazole {iminazole}.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时把咪唑称为iminazole。

e.en: The label used the obsolete term {iminazole}.
e.zh: 标签上使用了已经过时的“iminazole”一词。

e.en: The aldehyde formed an {imine} with the amine.
e.zh: 这种醛与胺形成了亚胺。

e.en: An {imine} bond can be reduced to an amine.
e.zh: 亚胺键可以被还原成胺。

e.en: The structure includes an {imino} group.
e.zh: 这个结构中含有一个亚氨基。

e.en: The {imino} form was less stable in solution.
e.zh: 这种亚氨基形式在溶液中较不稳定。

e.en: The paper described {imino-urea} as a reactive intermediate.
e.zh: 论文把亚氨基脲描述为一种活泼的中间体。

e.en: They compared {imino-urea} with ordinary urea.
e.zh: 他们将亚氨基脲与普通尿素进行了比较。

e.en: {Iminourea} appears in some older chemical texts.
e.zh: 亚氨基脲见于一些较早的化学文献。

e.en: The reaction may pass through an {iminourea} intermediate.
e.zh: 该反应可能经过一个亚氨基脲中间体。

e.en: The manuscript used {imit} as an old spelling of imitate.
e.zh: 手稿中用imit作为imitate的旧拼法。

e.en: He marked {imit} as an obsolete form in the glossary.
e.zh: 他在词汇表中把imit标为废旧形式。

e.en: The design's {imitability} worried the company.
e.zh: 这种设计容易被模仿，让公司感到担忧。

e.en: A signature style reduces easy {imitability}.
e.zh: 鲜明的个人风格会降低被轻易模仿的可能。

e.en: Her technique is clear but not easily {imitable}.
e.zh: 她的技巧很清楚，但并不容易模仿。

e.en: The recipe is simple and highly {imitable}.
e.zh: 这个食谱简单，非常容易仿制。

e.en: Critics discussed the {imitableness} of his plain style.
e.zh: 评论家讨论了他朴素风格的可模仿性。

e.en: The product's {imitableness} made patents important.
e.zh: 产品的可仿制性使专利变得重要。

e.en: The {imitant} copied every gesture on stage.
e.zh: 这个模仿者复制了舞台上的每个手势。

e.en: They rejected the {imitant} material as inferior.
e.zh: 他们认为这种仿制材料质量较差而拒绝使用。

e.en: Children often learn through {imitational} play.
e.zh: 儿童常常通过模仿性游戏来学习。

e.en: The poem has an {imitational} quality without being a copy.
e.zh: 这首诗带有模仿性质，但并非照搬。

e.en: The room's {immaculacy} impressed every visitor.
e.zh: 房间的一尘不染给每位访客留下了深刻印象。

e.en: She admired the moral {immaculacy} of the tale's heroine.
e.zh: 她钦佩故事女主人公道德上的纯洁无瑕。

e.en: The lecture traced the history of {immaculatism}.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了圣母无染观的历史。

e.en: Debates over {immaculatism} shaped later doctrine.
e.zh: 围绕无原罪说的争论影响了后来的教义。

e.en: The alloy proved {immalleable} under normal pressure.
e.zh: 这种合金在常压下被证明不可锻。

e.en: His views were almost {immalleable} after years of habit.
e.zh: 多年习惯之后，他的观点几乎难以改变。

e.en: The poet described an {immane} beast in the cave.
e.zh: 诗人描写了洞穴里一头凶暴巨兽。

e.en: They faced an {immane} task after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，他们面临一项极其艰巨的任务。

e.en: The essay examines divine {immanency} in nature.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨神性在自然中的内在存在。

e.en: Philosophers debated the {immanency} of meaning in art.
e.zh: 哲学家争论意义是否内在于艺术之中。

e.en: The {immanentist} argued that value arises within experience.
e.zh: 这位内在论者认为价值产生于经验内部。

e.en: Her theology took an {immanentist} direction.
e.zh: 她的神学思想走向了内在论方向。

e.en: The poet tried to {immix} memory with dream.
e.zh: 诗人试图把记忆与梦境混合在一起。

e.en: Do not {immix} the chemicals without guidance.
e.zh: 没有指导时不要把这些化学品掺在一起。

e.en: The dye was {immixed} with warm water.
e.zh: 染料被掺进了温水里。

e.en: Old fears were {immixed} with sudden hope.
e.zh: 旧日的恐惧中又混入了突如其来的希望。

e.en: She {immixes} herbs into the oil.
e.zh: 她把草药掺进油里。

e.en: The novel {immixes} history and fantasy.
e.zh: 这部小说把历史与幻想混合在一起。

e.en: The chef is {immixing} spices carefully.
e.zh: 厨师正在小心地调混香料。

e.en: The essay examines the {immixing} of cultures.
e.zh: 这篇文章考察了文化之间的交融。

e.en: The medicine contained an {immixture} of herbs.
e.zh: 这种药含有多种草药的混合物。

e.en: His speech showed an {immixture} of pride and regret.
e.zh: 他的讲话中夹杂着骄傲和懊悔。

e.en: The fracture required {immobilisation} of the arm.
e.zh: 骨折需要对手臂进行固定。

e.en: Police used barriers for the vehicle's {immobilisation}.
e.zh: 警方用路障使那辆车无法移动。

e.en: The party was accused of political {immobilism}.
e.zh: 该党被指责在政治上抱持停滞主义。

e.en: Economic {immobilism} kept reforms from moving forward.
e.zh: 经济上的不愿变革阻碍了改革推进。

e.en: His {immoderacy} at dinner worried the doctor.
e.zh: 他晚餐时的无节制让医生担心。

e.en: The essay condemns the {immoderacy} of ambition.
e.zh: 这篇文章谴责野心的过度膨胀。

e.en: Financial {immoderation} ruined the young heir.
e.zh: 花钱无度毁了这位年轻继承人。

e.en: The coach warned against {immoderation} in training.
e.zh: 教练提醒训练不要过度。

e.en: The myth describes an {immolator} at the altar.
e.zh: 这个神话描写了一名祭坛前的献祭者。

e.en: Reporters identified the protester as a self-{immolator}.
e.zh: 记者确认那名抗议者是自焚者。

e.en: Nietzsche is often linked with {immoralism}.
e.zh: 尼采常被人与非道德主义联系起来。

e.en: The novel explores {immoralism} without endorsing cruelty.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨反道德论，但并不赞同残酷行为。

immoralist.t: 非道德主义者；反道德论者

e.en: The critic called him an {immoralist}.
e.zh: 评论家称他为非道德主义者。

e.en: An {immoralist} may reject conventional moral rules.
e.zh: 反道德论者可能会拒绝传统道德规则。

e.en: They feared the play would {immoralize} young audiences.
e.zh: 他们担心这出戏会败坏年轻观众的道德。

e.en: Power can {immoralize} leaders who lack restraint.
e.zh: 权力可能使缺乏克制的领导者变得不道德。

e.en: The statue marked the hero's {immortalisation}.
e.zh: 这座雕像标志着那位英雄被永远铭记。

e.en: Digital archives allow the {immortalisation} of fragile manuscripts.
e.zh: 数字档案能让脆弱手稿长久保存下来。

e.en: The film ensured her {immortalization} in popular culture.
e.zh: 这部电影让她在大众文化中永垂不朽。

e.en: Artists often seek {immortalization} through their work.
e.zh: 艺术家常希望通过作品获得不朽。

e.en: She placed an {immortelle} on the grave.
e.zh: 她在墓前放了一朵不凋花。

e.en: The perfumer used {immortelle} for its warm scent.
e.zh: 调香师使用蜡菊来带出温暖香气。

e.en: The wreath was made of yellow {immortelles}.
e.zh: 花环是用黄色蜡菊做成的。

e.en: Dried {immortelles} decorated the old chapel.
e.zh: 干燥的不凋花装饰着那座旧礼拜堂。

immotile.t: 不能运动的；无运动能力的

e.en: The lab found many {immotile} sperm cells.
e.zh: 实验室发现了许多不能运动的精子细胞。

e.en: Some bacteria become {immotile} in cold conditions.
e.zh: 有些细菌在低温环境下会失去运动能力。

e.en: The diagnosis noted severe sperm {immotility}.
e.zh: 诊断记录显示精子严重缺乏运动能力。

e.en: Cell {immotility} can affect how tissue heals.
e.zh: 细胞不能运动会影响组织愈合。

e.en: The table's {immovability} made cleaning difficult.
e.zh: 这张桌子无法移动，清洁起来很困难。

e.en: Her {immovability} during negotiations impressed everyone.
e.zh: 她在谈判中的坚定不移给所有人留下了印象。

immovably.t: 不可移动地；坚定不移地

e.en: The safe was fixed {immovably} to the floor.
e.zh: 保险箱被牢牢固定在地板上，无法移动。

e.en: He stood {immovably} by his decision.
e.zh: 他坚定不移地坚持自己的决定。

immunoadsorbent.t: 免疫吸附剂；免疫吸附的

e.en: The team prepared an {immunoadsorbent} column.
e.zh: 团队制备了一根免疫吸附柱。

e.en: An {immunoadsorbent} material captured the target antibody.
e.zh: 一种免疫吸附材料捕获了目标抗体。

e.en: Only {immunoassayable} hormone levels were reported.
e.zh: 报告中只列出了可用免疫测定检测的激素水平。

e.en: The protein was not {immunoassayable} in diluted serum.
e.zh: 这种蛋白在稀释血清中无法用免疫测定检测。

immunoblast.t: 免疫母细胞；免疫芽细胞

e.en: The biopsy showed a large {immunoblast}.
e.zh: 活检显示有一个较大的免疫母细胞。

e.en: An {immunoblast} can develop after lymphocyte activation.
e.zh: 淋巴细胞被激活后可能形成免疫母细胞。

immunoblot.t: 免疫印迹；免疫印迹检测

e.en: The diagnosis was confirmed by {immunoblot}.
e.zh: 诊断通过免疫印迹检测得到确认。

e.en: Researchers used an {immunoblot} to identify the protein.
e.zh: 研究人员用免疫印迹来识别这种蛋白。

e.en: Her essay takes an {immanentistic} view of divine presence in nature.
e.zh: 她的文章以内在主义视角看待自然中的神圣存在。

e.en: The philosopher rejected a purely {immanentistic} account of morality.
e.zh: 这位哲学家反对把道德完全解释为内在论。

e.en: The poet praised an {immarcescible} crown of glory.
e.zh: 诗人赞美一顶永不凋谢的荣耀之冠。

e.en: Their friendship seemed {immarcescible} despite decades of hardship.
e.zh: 尽管历经数十年艰难，他们的友谊似乎永不衰败。

e.en: The ritual seemed to {immaterialise} the boundary between body and spirit.
e.zh: 这场仪式似乎使身体与精神之间的界限变得无形。

e.en: In the novel, the ghost begins to {immaterialise} at dawn.
e.zh: 在小说中，那个鬼魂在黎明时开始变得无形。

e.en: Berkeley's {immaterialism} denies that matter exists independently of perception.
e.zh: 贝克莱的唯心论否认物质能独立于感知而存在。

e.en: The lecture compared {immaterialism} with more ordinary forms of idealism.
e.zh: 讲座把非物质主义与更常见的唯心主义形式作了比较。

immaterialist.t: 非物质主义者；唯心论者

e.en: An {immaterialist} might argue that objects are collections of ideas.
e.zh: 一位唯心论者可能会主张物体只是观念的集合。

e.en: Her {immaterialist} reading of the poem stressed spirit over substance.
e.zh: 她对这首诗的非物质主义解读强调精神胜过实体。

e.en: The artist tried to {immaterialize} the sculpture through light and shadow.
e.zh: 艺术家试图通过光影让雕塑显得非物质化。

e.en: The figure seemed to {immaterialize} as the mist thickened.
e.zh: 雾气变浓时，那个人影似乎变得无形。

immaterialized.t: 已非物质化的；变无形的

e.en: The image {immaterialized} into a blur of color on the screen.
e.zh: 图像在屏幕上变得无形，只剩一片模糊色彩。

e.en: His theory described labor as {immaterialized} in the digital economy.
e.zh: 他的理论把数字经济中的劳动描述为已非物质化。

e.en: The installation {immaterializes} solid walls with projected light.
e.zh: 这件装置用投影光线让实体墙面显得非物质化。

e.en: In the story, the spirit {immaterializes} whenever anyone approaches.
e.zh: 在故事里，只要有人靠近，那个灵体就会变得无形。

e.en: The architect spoke of {immaterializing} heavy structures with glass.
e.zh: 建筑师谈到用玻璃让沉重结构显得非物质化。

e.en: The apparition was slowly {immaterializing} before the terrified crowd.
e.zh: 那个幻影在惊恐的人群面前慢慢变得无形。

e.en: The {immeasurability} of space troubled early astronomers.
e.zh: 空间的不可测量性曾困扰早期天文学家。

e.en: She wrote about the {immeasurability} of grief after war.
e.zh: 她写到战争之后悲痛的无法衡量。

immedicable.t: 无法医治的；不可补救的

e.en: The old text called the wound {immedicable}.
e.zh: 那部古书称这处伤口无法医治。

e.en: He feared the scandal had caused {immedicable} harm to the institution.
e.zh: 他担心丑闻已给这个机构造成不可补救的伤害。

immedicably.t: 无法医治地；不可补救地

e.en: The patient was described as {immedicably} ill.
e.zh: 病人被描述为病情已无法医治。

e.en: Their trust was {immedicably} damaged by the betrayal.
e.zh: 背叛使他们之间的信任受到不可补救的损害。

e.en: An {immelodious} chant echoed through the empty hall.
e.zh: 一阵不悦耳的吟唱在空大厅里回响。

e.en: The critic dismissed the song as harsh and {immelodious}.
e.zh: 评论家认为这首歌刺耳又不成调。

e.en: The {immensurability} of the universe filled him with awe.
e.zh: 宇宙的无边无际令他心生敬畏。

e.en: Mathematicians debated the {immensurability} of certain ancient ratios.
e.zh: 数学家们讨论某些古代比例的不可测量性。

immensurable.t: 不可测量的；广大无边的

e.en: The desert seemed {immensurable} under the noon sun.
e.zh: 正午阳光下，沙漠显得广大无边。

e.en: They faced an {immensurable} debt of gratitude.
e.zh: 他们背负着难以衡量的感激之情。

e.en: An {immer} called across the cold northern lake.
e.zh: 一只潜鸟在寒冷的北方湖面上鸣叫。

e.en: The guide identified the distant bird as an {immer}.
e.zh: 向导认出远处那只鸟是一只潜鸟。

e.en: The moon seemed to {immerge} into a bank of cloud.
e.zh: 月亮似乎沉入了一片云层之中。

e.en: The diver began to {immerge} beneath the dark surface.
e.zh: 潜水员开始沉入幽暗的水面之下。

e.en: The stone had {immerged} completely beneath the tide.
e.zh: 那块石头已经完全沉入潮水之下。

e.en: His argument {immerged} into a mass of technical detail.
e.zh: 他的论证陷入了一大堆技术细节之中。

e.en: The astronomer recorded the star's {immergence} behind the moon.
e.zh: 天文学家记录了恒星隐没到月亮背后的过程。

e.en: The ritual symbolized an {immergence} into silence and renewal.
e.zh: 这场仪式象征着沉入静默与新生。

e.en: The vessel was {immerging} slowly as water filled the hold.
e.zh: 随着货舱进水，船只正慢慢沉没。

e.en: The planet was {immerging} behind the bright edge of the moon.
e.zh: 那颗行星正隐没在月亮明亮的边缘后。

e.en: The technician adjusted the {immerscope} before examining the slide.
e.zh: 技术员先调整浸没式显微镜，再检查载玻片。

e.en: An old {immerscope} stood unused in the laboratory cabinet.
e.zh: 一台旧浸没式显微镜闲置在实验室柜子里。

e.en: The sensor is fully {immersible} in salt water.
e.zh: 这种传感器可以完全浸入盐水中。

e.en: Use only {immersible} equipment near the tank.
e.zh: 在水箱附近只能使用可浸没的设备。

immersionist.t: 浸礼派信徒；沉浸法支持者

e.en: The {immersionist} insisted that baptism required full bodily immersion.
e.zh: 这位浸礼派信徒坚持洗礼必须全身浸入水中。

e.en: As an {immersionist}, she taught languages entirely through conversation.
e.zh: 作为沉浸法支持者，她完全通过对话来教语言。

e.en: The new rules may {immesh} small firms in costly paperwork.
e.zh: 新规定可能使小公司陷入昂贵的文书手续中。

e.en: The fisherman tried not to {immesh} the net around the rocks.
e.zh: 渔夫尽量不让渔网缠在岩石上。

e.en: The bird was {immeshed} in a torn fishing net.
e.zh: 那只鸟被缠在一张破渔网里。

e.en: She became {immeshed} in a dispute between two departments.
e.zh: 她卷入了两个部门之间的争端。

e.en: The new rules are {immeshing} small firms in paperwork.
e.zh: 新规定正让小公司陷入文书工作的纠缠。

e.en: Her story kept {immeshing} memory with invention.
e.zh: 她的故事不断把记忆和虚构交织在一起。

e.en: The poet described an {immesurable} depth of grief.
e.zh: 诗人描写了一种无法衡量的悲痛深度。

e.en: They faced an {immesurable} distance across the frozen plain.
e.zh: 他们面对着冰原上似乎不可测量的距离。

e.en: His {immethodical} notes made the report hard to follow.
e.zh: 他杂乱无章的笔记让报告很难看懂。

e.en: She worked in an {immethodical} but strangely effective way.
e.zh: 她做事没有条理，却出奇地有效。

e.en: He packed {immethodically}, throwing books beside wet clothes.
e.zh: 他收拾得毫无条理，把书和湿衣服扔在一起。

e.en: The files had been arranged {immethodically} over many years.
e.zh: 这些文件多年来一直被杂乱地摆放着。

e.en: The project suffered from her chronic {immethodicalness}.
e.zh: 这个项目因她长期做事无条理而受影响。

e.en: His apparent {immethodicalness} hid a sharp memory.
e.zh: 他表面上的杂乱无章掩盖了敏锐的记忆力。

e.en: The editor marked several {immetrical} lines in the poem.
e.zh: 编辑标出了诗中几行不合韵律的句子。

e.en: Her song used {immetrical} phrases to create tension.
e.zh: 她的歌用不规则的乐句来制造紧张感。

e.en: The insult reduced him to an {immie} in their eyes.
e.zh: 那句侮辱让他在他们眼里只成了一个所谓移民。

e.en: Some communities have reclaimed {immie} as a joking label.
e.zh: 有些社群把“immie”重新当作玩笑式称呼来使用。

immigrational.t: 移民方面的；有关移民的

e.en: The lawyer explained the {immigrational} consequences of the charge.
e.zh: 律师解释了这项指控在移民方面的后果。

e.en: Their study focused on {immigrational} patterns after the war.
e.zh: 他们的研究关注战后移民模式的变化。

e.en: Each {immigrator} had to register at the port office.
e.zh: 每名移民者都必须在港口办公室登记。

e.en: Biologists tracked the first {immigrator} into the restored habitat.
e.zh: 生物学家追踪了第一个迁入这片恢复栖息地的个体。

e.en: The sirens warned of the storm's {imminency}.
e.zh: 警报声提醒人们风暴即将来临。

e.en: He sensed the {imminency} of a difficult decision.
e.zh: 他感觉到一个艰难决定已经迫在眉睫。

e.en: Do not {immingle} the clean samples with the old ones.
e.zh: 不要把干净样本和旧样本混在一起。

e.en: At dusk, smoke seemed to {immingle} with the mist.
e.zh: 黄昏时，烟雾似乎和薄雾交融在一起。

e.en: The spices {immingled} slowly in the warm oil.
e.zh: 香料在温热的油里慢慢混合。

e.en: Their voices were {immingled} with the sound of rain.
e.zh: 他们的声音和雨声交织在一起。

e.en: The river {immingles} fresh water with the tide.
e.zh: 这条河把淡水和潮水混合在一起。

e.en: The novel {immingles} comedy with sudden grief.
e.zh: 这部小说把喜剧和突如其来的悲伤交融起来。

e.en: The {immingling} of scents filled the narrow kitchen.
e.zh: 各种气味的混合充满了狭小的厨房。

e.en: His essay studies the {immingling} of myth and history.
e.zh: 他的文章研究神话与历史的交融。

e.en: Oil and water show classic {immiscibility} in the jar.
e.zh: 瓶中的油和水表现出典型的不互溶性。

e.en: The chemist measured the {immiscibility} of the two liquids.
e.zh: 化学家测量了这两种液体的不能混合程度。

e.en: Oil is {immiscible} with water under normal conditions.
e.zh: 在正常条件下，油和水是不互溶的。

e.en: The lab separated the two {immiscible} solvents after shaking.
e.zh: 实验室在摇晃后分离了两种不能混合的溶剂。

e.en: The report blamed wage cuts for rural {immiserization}.
e.zh: 报告把农村贫困化归咎于工资削减。

e.en: Economists debated whether trade caused worker {immiserization}.
e.zh: 经济学家争论贸易是否导致工人贫困化。

e.en: Bad policy can {immiserize} families for generations.
e.zh: 糟糕的政策可能使家庭几代人陷入贫困。

e.en: The crisis threatened to {immiserize} whole regions.
e.zh: 这场危机威胁要让整个地区贫困化。

e.en: The engineer monitored the {immission} of gas into the chamber.
e.zh: 工程师监测气体进入腔室的过程。

e.en: Old law books discuss the {immission} of smoke onto neighboring land.
e.zh: 旧法律书讨论烟雾侵入邻近土地的问题。

e.en: The device can {immit} a signal into the circuit.
e.zh: 该装置可以把信号送入电路。

e.en: Ancient writers used the verb {immit} for letting something in.
e.zh: 古代作者用immit这个动词表示让某物进入。

immitigable.t: 不能缓和的；不可减轻的

e.en: They faced an {immitigable} hostility from the old regime.
e.zh: 他们面对旧政权无法缓和的敌意。

e.en: The drought brought {immitigable} suffering to the valley.
e.zh: 旱灾给山谷带来了无法减轻的痛苦。

immitigably.t: 无法缓和地；不可减轻地

e.en: The judge was {immitigably} stern in his final remarks.
e.zh: 法官在最后陈述中严厉得无法缓和。

e.en: The winter pressed {immitigably} on the isolated town.
e.zh: 冬天无情而无法缓解地压在这座孤城上。

e.en: The pump is {immiting} air into the sealed tank.
e.zh: 泵正在把空气送入密封罐中。

e.en: The ritual involved {immiting} incense through a small opening.
e.zh: 这个仪式包括通过小孔送入香烟。

e.en: The technician calculated the circuit's {immittance} at high frequency.
e.zh: 技术员计算了电路在高频下的导纳阻抗值。

e.en: The report recorded the {immittance} of pollutants into the room.
e.zh: 报告记录了污染物进入房间的量。

e.en: The gas was {immitted} through a narrow valve.
e.zh: 气体通过一个狭窄阀门被送入。

e.en: Only a small signal was {immitted} into the test circuit.
e.zh: 只有一个很小的信号被送入测试电路。

e.en: The lab used an {immunochemical} test to detect the protein.
e.zh: 实验室使用免疫化学检测来发现这种蛋白质。

e.en: An {immunochemical} reaction confirmed the presence of antibodies.
e.zh: 一次免疫化学反应证实了抗体的存在。

e.en: The protein was identified {immunochemically} in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 这种蛋白质通过免疫化学方法在组织样本中被鉴定出来。

e.en: Researchers compared the two strains {immunochemically}.
e.zh: 研究人员用免疫化学方法比较了这两种菌株。

e.en: The freezer stores antibodies and other {immunochemicals}.
e.zh: 冰柜里存放着抗体和其他免疫化学试剂。

e.en: Some {immunochemicals} must be handled at low temperatures.
e.zh: 有些免疫化学试剂必须在低温下处理。

e.en: The {immunochemist} developed a faster antibody assay.
e.zh: 这位免疫化学家开发了一种更快的抗体检测法。

e.en: A clinical {immunochemist} reviewed the unusual test result.
e.zh: 一名临床免疫化学家复核了这个异常检测结果。

e.en: She studied {immunochemistry} during her doctoral training.
e.zh: 她在博士训练期间学习了免疫化学。

e.en: Modern {immunochemistry} is essential for many diagnostic tests.
e.zh: 现代免疫化学对许多诊断检测都很重要。

e.en: The vaccine response depends partly on {immunocompetence}.
e.zh: 疫苗反应在一定程度上取决于免疫能力。

e.en: Doctors assessed the patient's {immunocompetence} before surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术前评估了患者的免疫能力。

e.en: Severe {immunocompromise} increases the risk of infection.
e.zh: 严重免疫功能受损会增加感染风险。

e.en: The guidelines include special advice for people with {immunocompromise}.
e.zh: 这些指南为免疫功能受损者提供了特别建议。

e.en: Each {immunocyte} has a specific role in defense.
e.zh: 每个免疫细胞在防御中都有特定作用。

e.en: The drug changed how an {immunocyte} responds to infection.
e.zh: 这种药改变了免疫细胞对感染的反应方式。

e.en: The neurons were labeled {immunocytochemically} before imaging.
e.zh: 成像前，这些神经元用免疫细胞化学方法进行了标记。

e.en: The samples were examined {immunocytochemically} for viral proteins.
e.zh: 这些样本通过免疫细胞化学方法检查病毒蛋白。

e.en: The lab uses {immunocytochemistry} to locate proteins inside cells.
e.zh: 实验室使用免疫细胞化学来定位细胞内的蛋白质。

e.en: Her paper describes an improved {immunocytochemistry} protocol.
e.zh: 她的论文描述了一种改进的免疫细胞化学流程。

e.en: The child was born {immunodeficient} and needed special care.
e.zh: 这个孩子出生时有免疫缺陷，需要特殊护理。

e.en: Doctors monitor {immunodeficient} patients closely during outbreaks.
e.zh: 疫情期间，医生会密切监测免疫缺陷患者。

e.en: Long-term stress may contribute to {immunodepression}.
e.zh: 长期压力可能导致免疫抑制状态。

e.en: The treatment caused temporary {immunodepression} after transplantation.
e.zh: 移植后，这种治疗造成了暂时的免疫抑制状态。

e.en: The clinic relies on {immunodiagnosis} for early detection.
e.zh: 这家诊所依靠免疫诊断进行早期发现。

e.en: Accurate {immunodiagnosis} can distinguish similar infections.
e.zh: 准确的免疫诊断能区分相似的感染。

e.en: The company makes kits for clinical {immunodiagnostics}.
e.zh: 这家公司生产用于临床免疫诊断的试剂盒。

e.en: Rapid {immunodiagnostics} helped doctors choose the right treatment.
e.zh: 快速免疫诊断帮助医生选择了合适的治疗。

e.en: The antigens were compared by {immunodiffusion} in agar gel.
e.zh: 这些抗原通过琼脂凝胶中的免疫扩散法进行比较。

e.en: Older laboratories often used {immunodiffusion} for antibody detection.
e.zh: 较早的实验室常用免疫扩散法检测抗体。

e.en: The serum proteins were analyzed by {immunoelectrophoresis}.
e.zh: 血清蛋白通过免疫电泳进行了分析。

e.en: Doctors ordered {immunoelectrophoresis} to investigate abnormal antibodies.
e.zh: 医生要求做免疫电泳，以调查异常抗体。

e.en: The team recorded the {immunoelectrophoretic} pattern of the sample.
e.zh: 团队记录了该样本的免疫电泳图谱。

e.en: An {immunoelectrophoretic} method separated the antibody complexes.
e.zh: 一种免疫电泳方法分离了抗体复合物。

e.en: The abnormal protein was confirmed {immunoelectrophoretically}.
e.zh: 这种异常蛋白通过免疫电泳得到了确认。

e.en: The fractions were characterized {immunoelectrophoretically} after separation.
e.zh: 分离后，各组分通过免疫电泳进行了表征。

e.en: The adjuvant produced strong {immunoenhancement} in the trial.
e.zh: 这种佐剂在试验中产生了明显的免疫增强作用。

e.en: Researchers studied {immunoenhancement} after repeated vaccination.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了反复接种后的免疫增强作用。

e.en: The cells showed a bright {immunofluorescent} signal.
e.zh: 这些细胞显示出明亮的免疫荧光信号。

e.en: An {immunofluorescent} stain revealed the viral antigen.
e.zh: 免疫荧光染色显示出了病毒抗原。

e.en: The study examined {immunogenesis} after natural infection.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了自然感染后的免疫形成过程。

e.en: Nutrition can influence {immunogenesis} in early childhood.
e.zh: 营养会影响幼儿期的免疫形成过程。

e.en: An {immunogeneticist} explained the family's rare immune disorder.
e.zh: 一位免疫遗传学家解释了这个家族罕见的免疫疾病。

e.en: The hospital hired an {immunogeneticist} for transplant matching.
e.zh: 医院聘请了一名免疫遗传学家负责移植配型。

e.en: She specializes in {immunogenetics} and transplant compatibility.
e.zh: 她专攻免疫遗传学和移植相容性。

e.en: Advances in {immunogenetics} improved donor matching.
e.zh: 免疫遗传学的进展改善了供体匹配。

e.en: The new vaccine was highly {immunogenic} in adults.
e.zh: 这种新疫苗在成年人中很能引发免疫反应。

e.en: Some proteins are more {immunogenic} than others.
e.zh: 有些蛋白质比其他蛋白质更容易引发免疫反应。

e.en: The researchers used {immunogold} labeling in electron microscopy.
e.zh: 研究人员在电子显微镜中使用了免疫金标记法。

e.en: An {immunogold} technique located the protein on the membrane.
e.zh: 一种免疫金技术定位了膜上的这种蛋白质。

e.en: The lab performed {immunohematologic} tests before the transfusion.
e.zh: 输血前，实验室进行了免疫血液学检测。

e.en: Her case required detailed {immunohematologic} evaluation.
e.zh: 她的病例需要详细的免疫血液学评估。

e.en: The patient had an {immunohematological} reaction after transfusion.
e.zh: 患者输血后出现了免疫血液学反应。

e.en: Specialists reviewed the {immunohematological} findings carefully.
e.zh: 专家仔细审查了这些免疫血液学发现。

e.en: An {immunohematologist} confirmed the rare antibody.
e.zh: 一名免疫血液学专家确认了这种罕见抗体。

e.en: The hospital called an {immunohematologist} for advice.
e.zh: 医院请来免疫血液学专家提供建议。

e.en: She studies {immunohematology} at a teaching hospital.
e.zh: 她在一家教学医院研究免疫血液学。

e.en: Modern {immunohematology} improves transfusion safety.
e.zh: 现代免疫血液学提高了输血安全性。

e.en: The diagnosis was supported by {immunohistology}.
e.zh: 诊断得到了免疫组织学结果的支持。

e.en: Researchers used {immunohistology} to locate the protein.
e.zh: 研究人员用免疫组织学方法定位这种蛋白。

immunoneutropenia.t: 免疫性中性粒细胞减少

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with {immunoneutropenia}.
e.zh: 这名婴儿被诊断为免疫性中性粒细胞减少。

e.en: Doctors monitored infections during {immunoneutropenia}.
e.zh: 医生在免疫性中性粒细胞减少期间监测感染情况。

e.en: Severe {immunopancytopenia} can require urgent treatment.
e.zh: 严重的免疫性全血细胞减少可能需要紧急治疗。

e.en: The report described drug-related {immunopancytopenia}.
e.zh: 报告描述了药物相关的免疫性全血细胞减少。

e.en: The study examined {immunopathological} changes in the lungs.
e.zh: 这项研究检查了肺部的免疫病理学变化。

e.en: They proposed an {immunopathological} explanation for the rash.
e.zh: 他们提出了皮疹的免疫病理学解释。

e.en: An {immunopathologist} reviewed the biopsy slides.
e.zh: 一名免疫病理学家复查了活检切片。

e.en: The team consulted an {immunopathologist} about the unusual staining.
e.zh: 团队就异常染色咨询了免疫病理学家。

e.en: The course introduces basic {immunopathology}.
e.zh: 这门课程介绍免疫病理学基础。

e.en: Cancer {immunopathology} is a growing research field.
e.zh: 癌症免疫病理学是一个不断发展的研究领域。

e.en: The cells showed different {immunophenotypes} under analysis.
e.zh: 分析显示这些细胞具有不同的免疫表型。

e.en: Leukemia {immunophenotypes} help guide treatment choices.
e.zh: 白血病免疫表型有助于指导治疗选择。

e.en: The vaccine adjuvant produced strong {immunopotentiation}.
e.zh: 这种疫苗佐剂产生了强烈的免疫增强作用。

e.en: Researchers measured {immunopotentiation} after the booster dose.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了加强针后的免疫增强作用。

immunoprecipitate.t: 免疫沉淀物；使免疫沉淀

e.en: They collected the {immunoprecipitate} for further analysis.
e.zh: 他们收集免疫沉淀物作进一步分析。

e.en: The antibody can {immunoprecipitate} the target protein.
e.zh: 这种抗体能使目标蛋白发生免疫沉淀。

e.en: The protein was {immunoprecipitated} from cell lysates.
e.zh: 该蛋白从细胞裂解液中经免疫沉淀获得。

e.en: They analyzed the {immunoprecipitated} complex by mass spectrometry.
e.zh: 他们用质谱分析了经免疫沉淀的复合物。

immunoprecipitates.t: 免疫沉淀物；使免疫沉淀

e.en: The gel showed several {immunoprecipitates}.
e.zh: 凝胶上显示出几个免疫沉淀物。

e.en: This antibody {immunoprecipitates} the receptor efficiently.
e.zh: 这种抗体能有效使受体发生免疫沉淀。

immunoprecipitating.t: 正在免疫沉淀；免疫沉淀的

e.en: The team is {immunoprecipitating} the protein overnight.
e.zh: 团队正在对该蛋白进行过夜免疫沉淀。

e.en: They used an {immunoprecipitating} antibody in the assay.
e.zh: 他们在实验中使用了免疫沉淀抗体。

e.en: {Immunoprecipitation} revealed a protein interaction.
e.zh: 免疫沉淀法揭示了一种蛋白相互作用。

e.en: The sample was prepared by {immunoprecipitation}.
e.zh: 样本通过免疫沉淀法制备。

e.en: They repeated the {immunoprecipitations} three times.
e.zh: 他们把免疫沉淀实验重复了三次。

e.en: Control {immunoprecipitations} showed no nonspecific binding.
e.zh: 对照免疫沉淀实验未显示非特异性结合。

e.en: Rabies {immunoprophylaxis} must begin quickly after exposure.
e.zh: 暴露后必须尽快开始狂犬病免疫预防。

e.en: The guideline updated recommendations for neonatal {immunoprophylaxis}.
e.zh: 指南更新了新生儿免疫预防建议。

e.en: The hormone level was measured by {immunoradiometry}.
e.zh: 激素水平通过免疫放射测定法测量。

e.en: Older laboratories often used {immunoradiometry} for sensitive assays.
e.zh: 较早的实验室常用免疫放射测定法进行灵敏检测。

e.en: The trial tested {immunoradiotherapy} for advanced cancer.
e.zh: 该试验测试了晚期癌症的免疫放射治疗。

e.en: {Immunoradiotherapy} combines targeted antibodies with radiation.
e.zh: 免疫放射治疗结合了靶向抗体和放射线。

e.en: The test produced a clear {immunoreaction}.
e.zh: 这项检测产生了清晰的免疫反应。

e.en: A weak {immunoreaction} appeared around the tumor cells.
e.zh: 肿瘤细胞周围出现了较弱的免疫反应。

e.en: The tissue was {immunoreactive} for the marker.
e.zh: 该组织对这个标志物呈免疫反应阳性。

e.en: Researchers counted {immunoreactive} neurons in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员统计了样本中的免疫反应阳性神经元。

e.en: Cytokines play a major role in {immunoregulation}.
e.zh: 细胞因子在免疫调节中起重要作用。

e.en: The drug may improve {immunoregulation} in chronic disease.
e.zh: 这种药物可能改善慢性病中的免疫调节。

e.en: The tumor created an {immunorepressive} environment.
e.zh: 肿瘤形成了免疫抑制性的环境。

e.en: Some therapies reduce the {immunorepressive} signals around cancer cells.
e.zh: 一些疗法会减少癌细胞周围的免疫抑制性信号。

immunosedimentation.t: 免疫沉降法；免疫沉淀检测法

e.en: The laboratory used {immunosedimentation} to separate antibody complexes.
e.zh: 实验室用免疫沉降法分离抗体复合物。

e.en: Older papers describe {immunosedimentation} as a diagnostic technique.
e.zh: 较早的论文把免疫沉降法描述为一种诊断技术。

immunosorbent.t: 免疫吸附剂；免疫吸附的

e.en: The test used an {immunosorbent} surface to capture antibodies.
e.zh: 这项检测使用免疫吸附表面来捕获抗体。

e.en: An {immunosorbent} can remove specific proteins from serum.
e.zh: 免疫吸附剂可以从血清中去除特定蛋白。

e.en: The pathologist ordered an {immunostain} for the tumor sample.
e.zh: 病理医生要求对肿瘤样本做免疫染色。

e.en: Technicians {immunostain} the tissue to reveal cancer markers.
e.zh: 技术人员对组织作免疫染色，以显示癌症标志物。

e.en: Some drugs {immunosuppress} patients after organ transplantation.
e.zh: 一些药物会在器官移植后抑制患者的免疫反应。

e.en: High doses of steroids can {immunosuppress} the body quickly.
e.zh: 大剂量类固醇能迅速抑制身体免疫功能。

immunosuppressed.t: 免疫受抑制的；免疫力低下的

e.en: The clinic protects {immunosuppressed} patients from infections.
e.zh: 诊所会保护免疫受抑制的患者免受感染。

e.en: He became {immunosuppressed} after months of chemotherapy.
e.zh: 经过数月化疗后，他的免疫力变得低下。

immunosuppressor.t: 免疫抑制剂；免疫抑制物

e.en: The doctor adjusted the {immunosuppressor} after blood tests.
e.zh: 医生根据血检结果调整了免疫抑制剂。

e.en: Researchers tested a new {immunosuppressor} in transplant patients.
e.zh: 研究人员在移植患者中测试了一种新的免疫抑制剂。

immunosympathectomy.t: 免疫性交感神经切除术

e.en: The experiment used {immunosympathectomy} to study nerve function.
e.zh: 该实验用免疫性交感神经切除术研究神经功能。

e.en: Few clinicians encounter {immunosympathectomy} outside specialized research.
e.zh: 很少有临床医生会在专门研究之外接触免疫性交感神经切除术。

immunotherapeutic.t: 免疫治疗的；免疫疗法用的

e.en: The team developed an {immunotherapeutic} vaccine for melanoma.
e.zh: 团队开发了一种用于黑色素瘤的免疫治疗疫苗。

e.en: Patients responded differently to the {immunotherapeutic} drug.
e.zh: 患者对这种免疫治疗药物的反应各不相同。

e.en: The study examined {immunotolerance} after repeated exposure to the antigen.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了反复接触抗原后的免疫耐受。

e.en: Successful transplants often depend on some degree of {immunotolerance}.
e.zh: 成功的移植往往依赖一定程度的免疫耐受。

e.en: The {immunotoxin} targets cancer cells carrying a specific receptor.
e.zh: 这种免疫毒素会靶向带有特定受体的癌细胞。

e.en: Researchers measured how quickly the {immunotoxin} killed tumor cells.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种免疫毒素杀死肿瘤细胞的速度。

e.en: The legend tells of a monk's {immuration} in the castle wall.
e.zh: 传说中，一名僧侣被封入城堡墙内。

e.en: Her long {immuration} in the attic became a family secret.
e.zh: 她长期被禁闭在阁楼里，成了家族秘密。

e.en: The novel describes the prisoner's {immurement} in a narrow cell.
e.zh: 小说描写了囚犯被禁闭在狭窄牢房中。

e.en: Medieval stories sometimes mention {immurement} as a punishment.
e.zh: 中世纪故事有时提到把人封入墙内作为惩罚。

immusical.t: 不懂音乐的；缺乏乐感的

e.en: He called himself {immusical}, though he loved concerts.
e.zh: 他自称没有乐感，虽然很喜欢听音乐会。

e.en: The critic found the performance strangely {immusical}.
e.zh: 评论家觉得这场演出奇怪地缺乏音乐感。

immutably.t: 不可改变地；永恒不变地

e.en: The rule was {immutably} fixed in the old charter.
e.zh: 这条规则在旧章程中被固定为不可更改。

e.en: She believed the stars were {immutably} arranged above them.
e.zh: 她相信他们头顶的星辰是永恒不变地排列着的。

e.en: Geologists found {impactite} near the ancient crater.
e.zh: 地质学家在古老陨石坑附近发现了陨击岩。

e.en: The glassy {impactite} formed when the meteor struck.
e.zh: 这种玻璃状陨击岩是在流星撞击时形成的。

e.en: The dentist noted an {impactive} angle in the wisdom tooth.
e.zh: 牙医注意到智齿有造成嵌塞的角度。

e.en: Engineers studied the {impactive} force of falling debris.
e.zh: 工程师研究了坠落碎片的撞击力。

e.en: The lab used an {impactometer} to measure helmet resistance.
e.zh: 实验室用冲击计测量头盔的抗冲击性。

e.en: A portable {impactometer} recorded the force of each strike.
e.zh: 一台便携式撞击测量仪记录了每次撞击的力度。

e.en: The poet tried to {impaint} grief in a single image.
e.zh: 诗人试图用一个意象描绘悲伤。

e.en: Old artists would {impaint} gold details on the panel.
e.zh: 旧时画家会在嵌板上画上金色细节。

e.en: The museum described {impalement} as a brutal medieval punishment.
e.zh: 博物馆把钉刺处死描述为残酷的中世纪刑罚。

e.en: The accident caused {impalement} by a metal rod.
e.zh: 这起事故造成了一根金属杆刺穿身体的伤害。

e.en: The mist's {impalpability} made the valley seem unreal.
e.zh: 雾气触摸不到，使山谷显得不真实。

e.en: Critics admired the {impalpability} of her musical mood.
e.zh: 评论家欣赏她音乐情绪中那种难以捉摸的特质。

impalpably.t: 触摸不到地；难以察觉地

e.en: The scent drifted {impalpably} through the quiet room.
e.zh: 香气难以察觉地飘过安静的房间。

e.en: His confidence changed {impalpably} after the first success.
e.zh: 第一次成功后，他的自信在不知不觉中改变了。

e.en: Old medical texts used {impaludism} for malaria.
e.zh: 旧医学文献用impaludism这个词指疟疾。

e.en: The village suffered from {impaludism} during the wet season.
e.zh: 雨季时，这个村庄受到疟疾困扰。

e.en: The theologian rejected {impanation} in his lecture.
e.zh: 这位神学家在讲座中反对圣体面包共在说。

e.en: Medieval debates on {impanation} concerned Christ's presence in bread.
e.zh: 中世纪关于圣体面包共在说的争论涉及基督在面包中的临在。

impanel.t: 选任陪审团成员；列入名单

e.en: The court will {impanel} a jury tomorrow.
e.zh: 法院明天将选任一个陪审团。

e.en: The agency may {impanel} experts for the review.
e.zh: 该机构可能会把专家列入评审名单。

impaneled.t: 已选任陪审团；已列入名单

e.en: A jury was {impaneled} before the trial began.
e.zh: 审判开始前，陪审团已经被选任。

e.en: Several doctors were {impaneled} to advise the board.
e.zh: 几名医生被列入名单，为董事会提供建议。

e.en: The judge began {impaneling} the jury after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后，法官开始选任陪审团。

e.en: The ministry is {impaneling} consultants for the project.
e.zh: 该部正在为项目遴选并列入顾问名单。

impanelled.t: 已选任陪审团；已列入名单

e.en: The jury was {impanelled} under strict court rules.
e.zh: 陪审团按照严格的法庭规则被选任。

e.en: Only approved firms were {impanelled} for the contract.
e.zh: 只有获批的公司被列入该合同的名单。

e.en: The court delayed {impanelling} the jury until Monday.
e.zh: 法院把选任陪审团的时间推迟到周一。

e.en: The council is {impanelling} specialists from several universities.
e.zh: 委员会正在从几所大学遴选专家并列入名单。

e.en: The lawyers watched the {impanelment} of the jury closely.
e.zh: 律师们密切关注陪审团的选任过程。

e.en: The {impanelment} of auditors required formal approval.
e.zh: 审计人员的列名聘用需要正式批准。

e.en: The judge {impanels} a new jury for each case.
e.zh: 法官会为每个案件选任新的陪审团。

e.en: The hospital {impanels} specialists for complex diagnoses.
e.zh: 医院会把专家列入名单，处理复杂诊断。

e.en: The poet described an {impansion} of soul and sky.
e.zh: 诗人描写了灵魂与天空的交融嵌合。

e.en: The theory imagines the {impansion} of parts into one whole.
e.zh: 这一理论设想各部分并入一个整体。

e.en: The manuscript uses {impar} to mean unequal.
e.zh: 这份手稿用impar表示不相等。

e.en: Botanists once described the leaf as {impar} in form.
e.zh: 植物学家曾把这种叶形描述为不成对的。

e.en: The music seemed to {imparadise} the weary travelers.
e.zh: 那音乐仿佛让疲惫的旅人置身天堂。

e.en: Old poets would {imparadise} love in shining images.
e.zh: 旧时诗人会用灿烂意象把爱情写成极乐。

imparadised.t: 如置天堂的；沉浸极乐的

e.en: She felt {imparadised} by the sudden quiet.
e.zh: 突如其来的宁静让她仿佛置身天堂。

e.en: The lovers are {imparadised} in the poem's final lines.
e.zh: 在诗的最后几行中，恋人们沉浸于极乐。

e.en: The sunset was {imparadising} the whole valley.
e.zh: 夕阳让整个山谷仿佛变成天堂。

e.en: His language kept {imparadising} ordinary affection.
e.zh: 他的文字不断把平凡的情感写成极乐。

e.en: The ash tree has {imparipinnate} leaves with a terminal leaflet.
e.zh: 白蜡树有带顶生小叶的奇数羽状复叶。

e.en: A botanist identified the specimen as {imparipinnate}.
e.zh: 一位植物学家认定该标本为奇数羽状复叶。

e.en: The noun is {imparisyllabic} in its Latin forms.
e.zh: 这个名词在拉丁语形态中音节数不等。

e.en: Students found {imparisyllabic} declensions hard to memorize.
e.zh: 学生觉得音节数不等的变格很难记。

e.en: The treaty created an {imparity} between the two powers.
e.zh: 该条约在两个强权之间造成了不平等。

e.en: Critics noted the {imparity} of effort and reward.
e.zh: 批评者指出付出与回报并不相称。

e.en: The lord planned to {impark} the wooded valley.
e.zh: 领主打算把那片林谷围成猎苑。

e.en: Old laws allowed nobles to {impark} common land.
e.zh: 旧法律允许贵族把公地圈入园地。

e.en: The village opposed the {imparkation} of its fields.
e.zh: 村民反对把他们的田地圈作园地。

e.en: Records mention the {imparkation} of a royal forest.
e.zh: 记录提到一片皇家森林被围作猎苑。

imparked.t: 被圈入园地；被围作猎苑

e.en: The deer lived inside the {imparked} estate.
e.zh: 鹿生活在被围起来的庄园里。

e.en: Several farms were {imparked} by the new owner.
e.zh: 几处农场被新主人圈入园地。

e.en: The duke began {imparking} the land after harvest.
e.zh: 收获后，公爵开始把土地圈作园地。

e.en: Historians studied the {imparking} of medieval estates.
e.zh: 历史学家研究中世纪庄园的圈地成园。

e.en: The parties agreed to {imparl} before answering in court.
e.zh: 双方同意在法庭答辩前先行磋商。

e.en: An old defendant might {imparl} to gain more time.
e.zh: 旧时被告可能请求延期答辩以争取时间。

e.en: The judge granted an {imparlance} in the civil case.
e.zh: 法官准许该民事案件延期答辩。

e.en: Their {imparlance} led to a private settlement.
e.zh: 他们的庭外磋商促成了私下和解。

e.en: The ritual involved the {impartance} of secret knowledge.
e.zh: 这项仪式涉及秘密知识的传授。

e.en: Her letter carried the {impartance} of grave news.
e.zh: 她的信传达了一个沉重的消息。

e.en: Teaching requires the {impartation} of more than facts.
e.zh: 教学需要传授的不只是事实。

e.en: The ceremony marked the {impartation} of authority.
e.zh: 这场仪式标志着权力的赋予。

e.en: The judge was known as an {impartialist} in public debates.
e.zh: 这位法官在公共辩论中以主张公正无私著称。

e.en: An {impartialist} may still have private sympathies.
e.zh: 主张公正无私的人仍可能有个人同情。

e.en: The teacher questioned the {impartibility} of moral wisdom.
e.zh: 老师质疑道德智慧是否能够传授。

e.en: Lawyers debated the {impartibility} of the inherited estate.
e.zh: 律师们争论这份继承地产是否可以分给他人。

impartible.t: 不可分割的；不能让与的

e.en: The treaty described the islands as an {impartible} possession of the crown.
e.zh: 条约把这些岛屿称为王室不可分割的财产。

e.en: In that old legal system, the estate was {impartible} and passed to one heir.
e.zh: 在那套旧法律制度下，地产不可分割，只传给一名继承人。

impartibly.t: 不可分割地；不能让与地

e.en: The rights were {impartibly} attached to the title.
e.zh: 这些权利不可分割地附属于该头衔。

e.en: The land was held {impartibly} by the ruling family.
e.zh: 这片土地由统治家族不可分割地持有。

imparticipable.t: 不能共享的；不能参与的

e.en: The mystic called the experience {imparticipable} to ordinary speech.
e.zh: 那位神秘主义者说，这种体验无法由日常语言共同分享。

e.en: For outsiders, the ritual power remained {imparticipable}.
e.zh: 对外人来说，这种仪式力量仍是无法参与的。

e.en: The teacher valued the {impartment} of judgment over mere facts.
e.zh: 这位老师重视传授判断力，而不只是讲事实。

e.en: The letter served as a formal {impartment} of the decision.
e.zh: 这封信正式告知了这一决定。

e.en: Heavy snow caused the {impassability} of the mountain road.
e.zh: 大雪使那条山路无法通行。

e.en: Maps warned travelers about the seasonal {impassability} of the marsh.
e.zh: 地图提醒旅客，这片沼泽在某些季节难以通过。

impassably.t: 无法通行地；难以逾越地

e.en: The road was {impassably} blocked by fallen trees.
e.zh: 道路被倒下的树堵得无法通行。

e.en: The gorge lay {impassably} between the two villages.
e.zh: 峡谷横在两个村庄之间，难以逾越。

impassibility.t: 无动于衷；不受痛苦影响

e.en: His apparent {impassibility} angered the grieving family.
e.zh: 他表面上的无动于衷激怒了悲伤的家人。

e.en: The theologian wrote about divine {impassibility}.
e.zh: 那位神学家论述了神不受痛苦影响的性质。

e.en: She listened {impassibly} as the verdict was read.
e.zh: 宣读判决时，她无动于衷地听着。

e.en: The guard stood {impassibly} at the locked gate.
e.zh: 守卫冷漠地站在锁住的大门旁。

e.en: The speech seemed to {impassion} the whole crowd.
e.zh: 那场演讲似乎让整个人群都充满激情。

e.en: Old songs can still {impassion} veterans at reunions.
e.zh: 老歌在聚会上仍能激起老兵们的热情。

e.en: The young audience was highly {impassionable} that night.
e.zh: 那晚的年轻观众很容易被激起热情。

e.en: He had an {impassionable} nature and reacted strongly to injustice.
e.zh: 他天性容易激动，面对不公反应强烈。

e.en: Her {impassioning} words pushed the volunteers into action.
e.zh: 她激发热情的话语促使志愿者行动起来。

e.en: The film's {impassioning} finale left the audience silent.
e.zh: 影片令人激动的结尾让观众沉默下来。

e.en: The painter studied the {impastation} on the old canvas.
e.zh: 画家研究了旧画布上的厚涂颜料。

e.en: The recipe required careful {impastation} of the flour and oil.
e.zh: 这份食谱要求仔细把面粉和油调成糊状。

e.en: She learned to {impaste} bright color with a palette knife.
e.zh: 她学会了用调色刀厚涂鲜亮的颜色。

e.en: The cook began to {impaste} the nuts with honey.
e.zh: 厨师开始把坚果和蜂蜜调成糊状。

e.en: The {impasted} paint caught the light beautifully.
e.zh: 厚涂的颜料漂亮地映着光。

e.en: The mixture was {impasted} until it became smooth.
e.zh: 混合物被调成糊状，直到变得顺滑。

e.en: The artist spent hours {impasting} the stormy sky.
e.zh: 艺术家花了好几个小时厚涂那片暴风雨的天空。

e.en: Careful {impasting} gave the sauce its dense texture.
e.zh: 细致地调成糊状让酱汁有了浓稠口感。

e.en: The {impavid} captain refused to abandon the ship.
e.zh: 无畏的船长拒绝弃船。

e.en: She gave an {impavid} answer under hostile questioning.
e.zh: 面对敌意盘问，她作出了毫不畏惧的回答。

e.en: His {impavidity} impressed even his enemies.
e.zh: 他的无畏甚至让敌人也印象深刻。

e.en: The witness showed remarkable {impavidity} in court.
e.zh: 证人在法庭上表现出惊人的毫不畏惧。

e.en: He had to {impawn} his watch to pay the debt.
e.zh: 他不得不典当手表来还债。

e.en: The nobleman chose to {impawn} part of his estate.
e.zh: 那位贵族选择抵押部分地产。

e.en: The {impawned} ring remained in the broker's drawer.
e.zh: 那枚已典当的戒指仍放在经纪人的抽屉里。

e.en: His {impawned} land could be redeemed within a year.
e.zh: 他抵押的土地可在一年内赎回。

e.en: She regretted {impawning} the necklace after her fortunes improved.
e.zh: 境况好转后，她后悔典当了那条项链。

e.en: The agreement covered the {impawning} of several valuable paintings.
e.zh: 协议涉及几幅珍贵画作的抵押。

e.en: The fine was {impayable} for a worker on his wages.
e.zh: 以他的工资来说，这笔罚款根本付不起。

e.en: They faced an {impayable} debt after the harvest failed.
e.zh: 收成失败后，他们面临一笔无法偿还的债务。

e.en: Morning dew seemed to {impearl} every blade of grass.
e.zh: 晨露仿佛把每片草叶都点缀成珍珠。

e.en: The jeweler planned to {impearl} the collar by hand.
e.zh: 珠宝匠打算手工用珍珠装饰衣领。

e.en: The spiderweb was {impearled} with drops of rain.
e.zh: 蜘蛛网上缀满了珍珠般的雨滴。

e.en: She wore an {impearled} gown at the ceremony.
e.zh: 她在典礼上穿了一件缀满珍珠的礼服。

impearling.t: 使成珍珠状；用珍珠装饰

e.en: Frost was {impearling} the edges of the leaves.
e.zh: 霜正把叶缘点缀成珍珠般的样子。

e.en: The artisan spent the afternoon {impearling} the silk veil.
e.zh: 工匠整个下午都在用珍珠装饰那条丝质面纱。

e.en: Dew {impearls} the garden before sunrise.
e.zh: 日出前，露水把花园点缀得像珍珠一样。

e.en: The designer {impearls} each sleeve with tiny beads.
e.zh: 设计师用细小珠子装饰每只袖子。

e.en: The {impeccability} of her manners impressed every guest.
e.zh: 她举止无可挑剔，给每位客人都留下了深刻印象。

e.en: Critics praised the {impeccability} of the restoration work.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这项修复工作完美无瑕。

e.en: The theologian wrote about human {impeccance} before the fall.
e.zh: 那位神学家写到堕落以前人类无罪的状态。

e.en: His claimed {impeccance} sounded more like pride than virtue.
e.zh: 他声称自己从不犯罪，听起来更像傲慢而不是美德。

e.en: The doctrine of {impeccancy} troubled several students.
e.zh: 关于不会犯罪的教义让几名学生感到困惑。

e.en: She questioned whether {impeccancy} could belong to any ordinary person.
e.zh: 她质疑普通人是否可能具有不会犯罪的性质。

e.en: The sermon described an {impeccant} soul untouched by sin.
e.zh: 布道描绘了一个未受罪沾染的无罪灵魂。

e.en: He used {impeccant} language that sounded archaic to modern readers.
e.zh: 他使用了“无罪的”这种带古风的说法，现代读者觉得生僻。

e.en: His {impecuniosity} forced him to sell the family piano.
e.zh: 他的贫困迫使他卖掉了家里的钢琴。

e.en: The memoir treats {impecuniosity} with dry humor rather than self-pity.
e.zh: 这本回忆录以冷幽默描写缺钱的处境，而不是自怜。

e.en: The process is slow but not entirely {impedible}.
e.zh: 这个过程很慢，但并非完全不能被阻碍。

e.en: They considered which routes were most {impedible} during a flood.
e.zh: 他们考虑洪水期间哪些路线最容易被阻断。

e.en: Poor lighting was an {impedient} factor in the rescue.
e.zh: 照明不足是救援中的一个阻碍因素。

e.en: The committee removed several {impedient} rules from the process.
e.zh: 委员会从流程中删除了几条妨碍进展的规则。

e.en: The lawyer called the clause {impedimental} to fair negotiation.
e.zh: 律师称该条款对公平谈判具有阻碍性。

e.en: Old software can become {impedimental} when teams need speed.
e.zh: 团队需要速度时，旧软件可能会成为障碍。

impediography.t: 阻碍情况的记录或描述

e.en: The report offered an {impediography} of delays on the railway.
e.zh: 报告记录并描述了铁路延误中的各种阻碍情况。

e.en: Her unusual {impediography} mapped every obstacle to reform.
e.zh: 她那份少见的阻碍情况记录梳理了改革面临的每个障碍。

e.en: The court rejected the {impeditive} restriction on public access.
e.zh: 法院驳回了这项妨碍公众访问的限制。

e.en: Fear can be more {impeditive} than lack of talent.
e.zh: 恐惧有时比缺乏才华更会阻碍人。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {impedometer} before testing the cable.
e.zh: 技术员在测试电缆前校准了阻抗计。

e.en: An {impedometer} can reveal faults hidden inside a circuit.
e.zh: 阻抗计可以发现电路内部隐藏的故障。

e.en: He was seen as an {impedor} of urgent reform.
e.zh: 他被视为紧急改革的阻碍者。

e.en: In the analysis, traffic became the main {impedor} to evacuation.
e.zh: 在分析中，交通成了疏散的主要障碍。

e.en: An {impellent} sense of duty kept her working late.
e.zh: 一种强烈的责任感推动她工作到很晚。

e.en: The speech had an {impellent} force that moved the crowd.
e.zh: 那场演讲有一种推动人行动的力量，打动了人群。

e.en: The {impendence} of war darkened every conversation.
e.zh: 战争的迫近让每次谈话都蒙上阴影。

e.en: She sensed the {impendence} of a difficult decision.
e.zh: 她感觉到一个艰难决定即将到来。

e.en: The storm's {impendency} made the harbor unusually quiet.
e.zh: 暴风雨的临近使港口异常安静。

e.en: Officials debated the {impendency} of the financial crisis.
e.zh: 官员们争论金融危机是否已经迫近。

e.en: They prepared for the {impendent} collapse of the bridge.
e.zh: 他们为大桥即将倒塌做准备。

e.en: A dark cloud hung {impendent} over the valley.
e.zh: 一片乌云悬垂在山谷上方。

e.en: The dense fog seemed to {impenetrate} the whole forest.
e.zh: 浓雾似乎让整片森林都变得无法穿透。

e.en: Ancient walls could {impenetrate} a city against attack.
e.zh: 古老城墙能使城市难以被攻击者进入。

e.en: The armor's {impenetration} amazed the soldiers.
e.zh: 这副铠甲无法被穿透，让士兵们惊讶。

e.en: The poem's {impenetration} frustrated even patient readers.
e.zh: 这首诗难以理解，连有耐心的读者也感到受挫。

e.en: His {impenitence} angered the judge more than the theft.
e.zh: 他毫无悔意，比盗窃本身更让法官愤怒。

e.en: The novel portrays {impenitence} as a kind of spiritual blindness.
e.zh: 小说把顽固不悔描写成一种精神上的盲目。

e.en: Her {impenitency} shocked friends who expected an apology.
e.zh: 她拒不认错，让期待道歉的朋友们震惊。

e.en: The preacher warned against lifelong {impenitency}.
e.zh: 传道人警告人们不要一生顽固不悔。

e.en: The biologist described the chick as {impennate} and helpless.
e.zh: 生物学家把这只雏鸟描述为没有羽毛、无助。

e.en: An {impennate} wing cannot support real flight.
e.zh: 没有羽毛的翅膀无法支撑真正的飞行。

e.en: Older zoologists grouped penguins among the {impennes}.
e.zh: 早期动物学家把企鹅归入所谓无羽鸟类。

e.en: The museum label used {impennes}, an outdated scientific term.
e.zh: 博物馆标签用了impennes这个过时的科学术语。

e.en: The teacher explained the {imperatival} form of the verb.
e.zh: 老师解释了这个动词的祈使形式。

e.en: His note had an {imperatival} tone, not a friendly request.
e.zh: 他的便条带着命令式语气，不像友好的请求。

e.en: The victorious general was hailed as {imperator}.
e.zh: 获胜的将军被欢呼为古罗马统帅。

e.en: Later writers used {imperator} as a title for the emperor.
e.zh: 后来的作者把imperator用作皇帝的称号。

e.en: He entered with an {imperatorial} air of command.
e.zh: 他进来时带着帝王般的指挥气势。

e.en: The inscription praised the ruler's {imperatorial} authority.
e.zh: 铭文赞颂了统治者如统帅般的权威。

imperceivable.t: 无法觉察的；不可感知的

e.en: The change was almost {imperceivable} to the audience.
e.zh: 这个变化对观众来说几乎无法觉察。

e.en: An {imperceivable} tremor passed through the floor.
e.zh: 地板上传来一阵难以感知的轻微震动。

e.en: The device relies on the {imperceptibility} of its signal.
e.zh: 这台设备依赖其信号的不可察觉性。

e.en: Her skill lay in the {imperceptibility} of each adjustment.
e.zh: 她的技巧在于每次调整都让人难以察觉。

e.en: His {imperception} of danger surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他没有察觉到危险，这让所有人都很惊讶。

e.en: The essay examines moral {imperception} in modern life.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨现代生活中的道德感知缺失。

e.en: An {imperceptive} manager may miss early signs of burnout.
e.zh: 缺乏洞察力的经理可能会错过倦怠的早期迹象。

e.en: His review was sharp in style but {imperceptive} in judgment.
e.zh: 他的评论文风犀利，但判断并不敏锐。

e.en: The philosopher described sleep as temporary {impercipience}.
e.zh: 那位哲学家把睡眠描述为暂时的无知觉状态。

e.en: Her {impercipience} toward their suffering seemed deliberate.
e.zh: 她对他们痛苦的麻木似乎是有意的。

e.en: The patient remained {impercipient} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后，病人仍处于无知觉状态。

e.en: He was strangely {impercipient} of the tension in the room.
e.zh: 他奇怪地没有察觉到房间里的紧张气氛。

e.en: The doctrine stressed human {imperfectibility}.
e.zh: 这一学说强调人类无法达到完美。

e.en: Engineers rejected the supposed {imperfectibility} of the design.
e.zh: 工程师们否定了这种设计无法改进的说法。

imperfectible.t: 无法完善的；不可改进的

e.en: He believed society was flawed but not {imperfectible}.
e.zh: 他认为社会有缺陷，但并非无法完善。

e.en: The old mechanism seemed {imperfectible} to its defenders.
e.zh: 在维护者看来，这套旧机制似乎已无法再改进。

e.en: Russian verbs often distinguish perfective and {imperfective} aspect.
e.zh: 俄语动词常常区分完成体和未完成体。

e.en: The {imperfective} form suggests an ongoing action.
e.zh: 未完成体形式表示动作正在持续。

imperforable.t: 不能穿孔的；不可刺穿的

e.en: The shield was designed to be {imperforable} by arrows.
e.zh: 这面盾牌被设计成箭无法刺穿。

e.en: They chose an {imperforable} membrane for the experiment.
e.zh: 他们为实验选择了一种不能穿孔的薄膜。

e.en: The label was printed on {imperforate} paper.
e.zh: 这个标签印在未打孔的纸上。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with an {imperforate} anus.
e.zh: 这名婴儿被诊断为肛门闭锁。

e.en: The tickets arrived as one {imperforated} sheet.
e.zh: 票券送来时是一整张未打孔的纸。

e.en: An {imperforated} surface kept the liquid from leaking.
e.zh: 无孔表面防止了液体渗漏。

e.en: The stamp's {imperforation} made it valuable to collectors.
e.zh: 这枚邮票未打孔，因此对收藏者很有价值。

e.en: Doctors noted the {imperforation} during the newborn examination.
e.zh: 医生在新生儿检查中注意到了闭锁情况。

e.en: Ancient rulers claimed several overlapping {imperia}.
e.zh: 古代统治者声称拥有多重重叠的统治权。

e.en: The historian compared Roman {imperia} with later empires.
e.zh: 历史学家把罗马的帝权与后来的帝国作了比较。

e.en: The army acted {imperialistically} in the occupied region.
e.zh: 军队在被占地区以帝国主义方式行事。

e.en: Critics said the policy was framed {imperialistically}.
e.zh: 批评者说，这项政策是按帝国主义思路制定的。

e.en: The ceremony displayed the old {imperialities} of the court.
e.zh: 仪式展现了宫廷旧日的帝王气派。

e.en: Her book studies the {imperialities} hidden in modern culture.
e.zh: 她的书研究现代文化中隐藏的帝国特质。

e.en: The crown symbolized his {imperiality}.
e.zh: 王冠象征着他的帝王身份。

e.en: The city preserved traces of its former {imperiality}.
e.zh: 这座城市保留着昔日帝国性质的痕迹。

e.en: The regime tried to {imperialize} local institutions.
e.zh: 该政权试图使地方制度帝国化。

e.en: Writers warned that conquest would {imperialize} the republic.
e.zh: 作家们警告说，征服会让共和国走向帝制。

imperialized.t: 被帝国化的；受帝制影响的

e.en: The province became increasingly {imperialized} after annexation.
e.zh: 吞并之后，这个省份日益被帝国化。

e.en: She analyzed the {imperialized} language of the textbook.
e.zh: 她分析了教科书中受帝国观念影响的语言。

e.en: The court discussed the {imperilment} of public safety.
e.zh: 法院讨论了公共安全受到危及的问题。

e.en: Climate change brings the {imperilment} of coastal communities.
e.zh: 气候变化使沿海社区面临危险。

e.en: The poem's {imperishability} surprised later critics.
e.zh: 这首诗的不朽性让后来的批评家感到惊讶。

e.en: Ancient myths promised the {imperishability} of the soul.
e.zh: 古代神话许诺灵魂具有不灭性。

e.en: Her name is {imperishably} linked with the reform.
e.zh: 她的名字与这场改革永久地联系在一起。

e.en: The scene remained {imperishably} fixed in his memory.
e.zh: 那个场景永远留在他的记忆中。

e.en: The novel reflects on the {impermanency} of youth.
e.zh: 这部小说思考青春的无常。

e.en: Buddhist teaching often emphasizes {impermanency}.
e.zh: 佛教教义常常强调万事无常。

e.en: The council rejected the plan as {impolicy}.
e.zh: 委员会认为这个计划不明智，因而否决了它。

e.en: Such secrecy seemed {impolicy} during a public crisis.
e.zh: 在公共危机中，这种保密做法显得不合政策。

e.en: His blunt speech was {impolitical} but honest.
e.zh: 他的直言不合政治策略，但很诚实。

e.en: It would be {impolitical} to ignore local anger.
e.zh: 无视当地人的愤怒在政治上会很不明智。

e.en: The report ignored the {imponderabilia} of public trust.
e.zh: 报告忽略了公众信任这些难以衡量的因素。

e.en: Diplomacy often depends on subtle {imponderabilia}.
e.zh: 外交常常取决于一些微妙而难以量化的因素。

e.en: The {imponderability} of human choice troubled the modelers.
e.zh: 人类选择的不可衡量性让建模人员感到棘手。

e.en: War adds an {imponderability} to every forecast.
e.zh: 战争给每一项预测都增加了难以估量的因素。

e.en: The mood shifted {imponderably} after the announcement.
e.zh: 公告发布后，气氛以难以估量的方式发生了变化。

e.en: Her silence weighed {imponderably} on the room.
e.zh: 她的沉默以难以言说的分量压在整个房间里。

e.en: He chose to {impone} a small sum on the race.
e.zh: 他选择在那场比赛上押一小笔钱。

e.en: The old rule allowed players to {impone} before drawing cards.
e.zh: 旧规则允许玩家在抽牌前先下注。

e.en: The {imponent} raised the stake with a smile.
e.zh: 那个下注者微笑着提高了赌注。

e.en: An official {imponent} collected the local levy.
e.zh: 一名负责征收的官员收取了地方税款。

e.en: The coating's {imporosity} kept moisture out.
e.zh: 涂层的无孔性阻止了水分渗入。

e.en: Engineers tested the {imporosity} of the ceramic seal.
e.zh: 工程师测试了陶瓷密封件的不渗透性。

e.en: She runs an {import-export} company in Shenzhen.
e.zh: 她在深圳经营一家进出口公司。

e.en: New rules affected the {import-export} trade.
e.zh: 新规定影响了进出口贸易。

e.en: The software's {importability} depends on file format support.
e.zh: 这款软件的可导入性取决于它支持哪些文件格式。

e.en: Inspectors questioned the fruit's {importability} under current law.
e.zh: 检查人员质疑这种水果在现行法律下是否可以进口。

e.en: The old database is {importable} into the new system.
e.zh: 旧数据库可以导入新系统。

e.en: Only certified products are {importable} under the agreement.
e.zh: 根据该协议，只有认证产品可以进口。
