e.en: The letter stressed the {importancy} of quick action.
e.zh: 那封信强调了迅速行动的重要性。

e.en: Few understood the {importancy} of his discovery.
e.zh: 很少有人理解他这一发现的重大意义。

e.en: He carried an {important-looking} folder into the meeting.
e.zh: 他拿着一个看似重要的文件夹走进会议室。

e.en: An {important-looking} notice was pinned to the door.
e.zh: 门上钉着一张看起来很重要的通知。

e.en: The {importee} must provide customs documents.
e.zh: 进口接受方必须提供海关文件。

e.en: In the script, each {importee} is checked before loading.
e.zh: 在脚本中，每个被导入项都会在加载前接受检查。

e.en: The tired clerk finally answered the {importunator}.
e.zh: 疲惫的 clerk 最终回应了那个纠缠乞求的人。

e.en: He dismissed every {importunator} at the palace gate.
e.zh: 他把宫门口每个纠缠请求的人都打发走了。

e.en: The untreated wound began to {imposthumate}.
e.zh: 未经处理的伤口开始化脓。

e.en: Old physicians believed bad humors could {imposthumate} under the skin.
e.zh: 古代医生认为有害体液会在皮下形成脓肿。

e.en: The surgeon cleaned the {imposthumated} tissue carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细清理了已经化脓的组织。

e.en: An {imposthumated} swelling appeared near the old scar.
e.zh: 旧疤附近出现了一处形成脓肿的肿块。

e.en: The doctor noticed an {imposthumating} sore on his arm.
e.zh: 医生注意到他手臂上有一处正在化脓的疮。

e.en: They treated the {imposthumating} abscess with hot compresses.
e.zh: 他们用热敷处理那个正在化脓的脓肿。

e.en: The text described {imposthumation} as a dangerous sign.
e.zh: 书中把化脓描述为一种危险征兆。

e.en: Early treatment may prevent {imposthumation} of the wound.
e.zh: 早期治疗可以防止伤口化脓。

e.en: A painful {imposthume} formed beneath the skin.
e.zh: 皮下形成了一个疼痛的脓肿。

e.en: The herbalist lanced the {imposthume} with a small blade.
e.zh: 草药医用小刀切开了那个化脓疮。

e.en: His {impostorship} was exposed by the missing signature.
e.zh: 缺失的签名暴露了他的冒名顶替身份。

e.en: The scandal centered on years of {impostorship}.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻的核心是多年的冒名顶替。

e.en: The judge condemned the {impostrous} scheme.
e.zh: 法官谴责了这个欺诈性的计划。

e.en: His {impostrous} claims fooled several donors.
e.zh: 他的冒名说法骗过了几位捐助者。

e.en: The nurse dressed the {impostume} each morning.
e.zh: 护士每天早晨为那个脓肿换药。

e.en: Pain from the {impostume} kept him awake.
e.zh: 化脓疮带来的疼痛让他无法入睡。

e.en: They uncovered his {imposturous} identity after months.
e.zh: 几个月后，他们揭穿了他的冒牌身份。

e.en: The pamphlet made {imposturous} promises to investors.
e.zh: 那本小册子向投资者作出了欺诈性的承诺。

impermeator.t: 使不渗透的东西；防水剂

e.en: The wax acted as an {impermeator} for the leather boots.
e.zh: 这层蜡给皮靴起到了防水剂的作用。

e.en: Engineers tested the new {impermeator} on porous concrete.
e.zh: 工程师在多孔混凝土上测试了这种新的防渗材料。

e.en: The judge stressed the {impermissibility} of that evidence.
e.zh: 法官强调那项证据不可采纳。

e.en: Her report examined the moral {impermissibility} of torture.
e.zh: 她的报告探讨了酷刑在道德上的不允许性。

e.en: The contradictory rules seemed to {imperplex} every new clerk.
e.zh: 这些相互矛盾的规则似乎让每个新职员都困惑。

e.en: Do not {imperplex} the issue with irrelevant details.
e.zh: 不要用无关细节把这个问题搅得更复杂。

imperscriptible.t: 不可用文字充分描述的

e.en: She called the grief {imperscriptible} in any ordinary language.
e.zh: 她说这种悲伤无法用普通语言充分写出。

e.en: The cave held an {imperscriptible} darkness beyond the torchlight.
e.zh: 火把照不到的洞穴深处有一种难以描写的黑暗。

e.en: The editor tried to {impersonalise} the angry letter.
e.zh: 编辑试图把那封愤怒的信改得不那么带个人色彩。

e.en: Large systems can {impersonalise} care for vulnerable patients.
e.zh: 大型制度可能会让弱势病人的照护变得冷冰冰。

e.en: His theology leaned toward {impersonalism} rather than a personal deity.
e.zh: 他的神学更倾向于非人格论，而不是人格化的神。

e.en: Bureaucratic {impersonalism} shaped every decision in the office.
e.zh: 官僚式的非个人化态度影响了办公室里的每个决定。

e.en: Automation increased the {impersonalization} of customer service.
e.zh: 自动化加剧了客户服务的非个人化。

e.en: The novel explores the {impersonalization} of workers in factories.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨工厂中工人的去人格化。

impersonalize.t: 使非个人化；使无人情味

e.en: The company tried to {impersonalize} complaints with automated replies.
e.zh: 公司试图用自动回复把投诉处理得非个人化。

e.en: Academic style can {impersonalize} painful human experiences.
e.zh: 学术文体可能把痛苦的人类经历写得缺少人情味。

impersonalized.t: 被非个人化的；客观化的

e.en: The patients felt {impersonalized} by the hospital routine.
e.zh: 病人觉得医院的流程把他们当成了没有个性的人。

e.en: Her account was deliberately {impersonalized} for the official record.
e.zh: 她的叙述被有意改得客观化，以便写入官方记录。

e.en: His {impersonative} talent made the audience laugh.
e.zh: 他模仿他人的本事逗笑了观众。

e.en: The poem uses an {impersonative} voice for the river.
e.zh: 这首诗用拟人化的声音来描写河流。

e.en: The old statue was an {impersonification} of justice.
e.zh: 那座旧雕像是正义的化身。

e.en: Critics noted the {impersonification} of death in the play.
e.zh: 评论家注意到剧中对死亡的拟人化处理。

impersonify.t: 使人格化；作为化身表现

e.en: The painter tried to {impersonify} winter as a silent woman.
e.zh: 画家试图把冬天人格化为一位沉默的女子。

e.en: In the tale, the king seems to {impersonify} greed itself.
e.zh: 在这个故事里，国王似乎就是贪婪本身的化身。

e.en: She ignored the young man's {impertinencies} during dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时，她没有理会那个年轻人的无礼言行。

e.en: The lawyer removed several {impertinencies} from the statement.
e.zh: 律师从陈述中删去了几处不相干的内容。

e.en: His {impertinency} shocked the formal committee.
e.zh: 他的无礼让这个拘谨的委员会感到震惊。

e.en: The editor objected to the {impertinency} of that paragraph.
e.zh: 编辑反对那一段内容离题。

e.en: Her {imperturbability} impressed the rescue team.
e.zh: 她的沉着冷静给救援队留下了深刻印象。

e.en: He maintained his {imperturbability} under fierce questioning.
e.zh: 在激烈盘问下，他依然保持不动声色。

e.en: The monk faced the storm with {imperturbation}.
e.zh: 那位僧人沉着地面对暴风雨。

e.en: Her {imperturbation} annoyed those who wanted an argument.
e.zh: 她的不受扰动让那些想争吵的人很恼火。

e.en: He remained {imperturbed} when the alarm sounded.
e.zh: 警报响起时，他仍然沉着不慌。

e.en: The witness gave an {imperturbed} account of the accident.
e.zh: 目击者冷静地叙述了那场事故。

imperviable.t: 不能通过的；不可渗透的

e.en: The road became {imperviable} after the landslide.
e.zh: 山体滑坡后，这条路无法通行。

e.en: The membrane is {imperviable} to most dissolved salts.
e.zh: 这层膜对大多数溶解盐类不可渗透。

impetiginous.t: 患脓疱疮的；似脓疱疮的

e.en: The doctor examined the child's {impetiginous} rash.
e.zh: 医生检查了孩子类似脓疱疮的皮疹。

e.en: An {impetiginous} infection spread across his chin.
e.zh: 一种脓疱疮样感染扩散到他的下巴。

e.en: Pilgrims came to {impetrate} mercy from the saint.
e.zh: 朝圣者前来向圣徒祈求怜悯。

e.en: The envoy hoped to {impetrate} a pardon for the prisoners.
e.zh: 使者希望为囚犯恳求到赦免。

impetrated.t: 恳求得来的；祈求获得的

e.en: The pardon was {impetrated} after months of appeals.
e.zh: 经过数月上诉，那项赦免终于被恳求获得。

e.en: They believed the rain had been {impetrated} by prayer.
e.zh: 他们相信这场雨是通过祈祷求来的。

impetrating.t: 正在恳求获得；祈求中的

e.en: The priest was {impetrating} forgiveness for the village.
e.zh: 神父正在为村庄祈求宽恕。

e.en: She spent years {impetrating} favors from powerful patrons.
e.zh: 她多年都在向有权势的赞助人恳求恩惠。

e.en: The ritual was an {impetration} of rain.
e.zh: 这项仪式是为求雨而举行的祈愿。

e.en: His letter was a formal {impetration} of royal mercy.
e.zh: 他的信是正式恳求王室开恩。

e.en: The chant had an {impetrative} purpose.
e.zh: 这段吟唱带有祈求的目的。

e.en: Her {impetrative} tone softened the minister's response.
e.zh: 她恳求的语气缓和了部长的回应。

e.en: The chapel kept several {impetratory} prayers in Latin.
e.zh: 小教堂保存着几篇拉丁文祈求祷文。

e.en: His speech was humble and {impetratory}.
e.zh: 他的讲话谦卑而带着恳请意味。

e.en: {Imprimis}, the contract must be signed today.
e.zh: 首先，合同必须今天签署。

e.en: The old inventory began, {imprimis}, with three silver cups.
e.zh: 那份旧清单首先列出了三只银杯。

e.en: She learned timing through weekly {impro} classes.
e.zh: 她通过每周的即兴表演课学会了把握节奏。

e.en: The comedian's best jokes came from {impro}.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员最精彩的笑话来自即兴发挥。

e.en: The proposal met with stern {improbation} from the elders.
e.zh: 这项提议遭到长者们严厉反对。

e.en: Her silence showed {improbation} more clearly than words.
e.zh: 她的沉默比言语更清楚地表明了不赞成。

e.en: The inquiry exposed years of official {improbity}.
e.zh: 调查揭露了多年来的官员不诚实行为。

e.en: He resigned after accusations of financial {improbity}.
e.zh: 他因被指控财务品行不端而辞职。

e.en: The manor tried to {impropriate} the parish revenues.
e.zh: 庄园试图把教区收入转为俗用。

e.en: Old records show the abbey could {impropriate} certain tithes.
e.zh: 旧记录显示，修道院可以占用某些什一税。

e.en: The {impropriated} tithes supported a local landowner.
e.zh: 那些已转为俗用的什一税供养了当地地主。

e.en: Several {impropriated} churches lacked a resident priest.
e.zh: 几座被转为俗用的教堂没有常驻神父。

e.en: The crown was accused of {impropriating} church income.
e.zh: 王室被指控正在把教会收入转为俗用。

e.en: By {impropriating} the benefice, he gained its rents.
e.zh: 通过占用那份圣职收益，他取得了租金收入。

e.en: The charter confirmed the {impropriation} of the rectory.
e.zh: 宪章确认了该教区牧师俸禄的俗用。

e.en: Historians still debate that medieval {impropriation}.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论那次中世纪教产占用。

e.en: The {impropriator} collected tithes but paid the curate poorly.
e.zh: 那名教产占用者收取什一税，却给助理牧师很少报酬。

e.en: A lay {impropriator} often controlled the parish income.
e.zh: 世俗教产占用者常常控制教区收入。

e.en: The coach praised the team's obvious {improvability}.
e.zh: 教练称赞这支队伍明显还有改善余地。

e.zh: 这份草稿的结论部分明显还有改进空间。

e.zh: 经过测试后，他的方法仍显得可以改进且效率不高。

e.zh: 那位即兴诗人把观众的建议变成了诗句。

e.zh: 作为即兴表演者，他宁愿冒险也不喜欢排练。

e.zh: 她的即兴表演能力挽救了那场尴尬的音乐会。

e.zh: 那场讲座带着即兴发挥的活力和魅力。

e.en: The {improvisatrice} composed a song on the spot.
e.zh: 那位女性即兴表演者当场创作了一首歌。

e.en: Critics admired the young {improvisatrice}'s wit.
e.zh: 评论家欣赏那位年轻女即兴诗人的机智。

e.en: A skilled {improvisor} can use any mistake creatively.
e.zh: 熟练的即兴表演者能创造性地利用任何失误。

e.zh: 那位爵士即兴演奏者仔细聆听后才加入演奏。

e.zh: 医生把这个孩子描述为尚未长出阴毛。

e.zh: 在较旧的解剖学文本中，impubic 指青春期前。

e.zh: 他的厚颜无耻震惊了整个法庭。

e.zh: 她不是害怕，而是带着愉快的放肆回答。

e.en: The sermon condemned public {impudicity} in harsh terms.
e.zh: 那篇布道严厉谴责公开的猥亵无耻。

e.en: Victorian writers often equated bold dress with {impudicity}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时期作家常把大胆着装等同于不贞。

e.en: The sudden {imposure} of fees angered the traders.
e.zh: 突然征收费让商贩们很不满。

e.zh: 批评者称这条规定是不公平的强加。

e.zh: 商人在港口缴纳了进口税。

e.zh: 账簿中把丝绸列为贵重进口货物。

e.zh: 洪水过后，井水被判定为不可饮用。

e.en: They carried filters because the stream looked {impotable}.
e.zh: 他们带了滤水器，因为溪水看起来不适合饮用。

e.zh: 这份宪章可以授权委员会征税。

e.en: Education may {impower} workers to demand safer conditions.
e.zh: 教育可能赋予工人要求更安全条件的能力。

e.en: The plan was {impracticably} expensive for a small town.
e.zh: 这个计划对小镇来说贵得难以实行。

e.en: He designed an {impracticably} narrow staircase.
e.zh: 他设计了一段窄得不切实际的楼梯。

e.en: The poem ends with an {imprecatory} cry against the tyrant.
e.zh: 这首诗以对暴君的诅咒呼喊作结。

e.en: Scholars debated the force of the psalm's {imprecatory} language.
e.zh: 学者们讨论这篇诗篇中诅咒性语言的力度。

e.en: The logician rejected the {impredicative} definition as circular.
e.zh: 逻辑学家认为这个自指定义带有循环性而予以拒绝。

e.en: Some modern systems allow {impredicative} types under strict rules.
e.zh: 一些现代系统在严格规则下允许非直谓类型。

e.en: The factory used resin {impreg} for lightweight panels.
e.zh: 工厂用树脂浸渍材料制作轻质板材。

e.en: A fresh {impreg} improved the fabric's resistance to water.
e.zh: 新的浸渍处理提高了织物的防水性。

e.en: The castle's {impregnability} was tested by a long siege.
e.zh: 这座城堡的不可攻破性经受了长期围攻的考验。

e.en: Her calm gave an impression of emotional {impregnability}.
e.zh: 她的镇定给人一种情感上坚不可摧的印象。

impregnably.t: 牢不可破地；难以攻陷地

e.en: The fortress stood {impregnably} above the river.
e.zh: 堡垒牢不可破地矗立在河流上方。

e.en: He argued his case so {impregnably} that few replied.
e.zh: 他的论证严密得几乎无人回应。

e.en: The {impregnant} solution hardened inside the wood fibers.
e.zh: 这种浸透溶液在木纤维内部硬化。

e.en: Older texts described the male as the {impregnant} partner.
e.zh: 旧文献把雄性描述为使对方受孕的一方。

e.en: The ridge was considered {imprenable} by the invading army.
e.zh: 入侵军认为这道山脊攻不下来。

e.en: His position in the debate seemed {imprenable}.
e.zh: 他在辩论中的立场似乎无可撼动。

e.en: The knight chose a falcon as his {impresa}.
e.zh: 骑士选择猎鹰作为自己的徽铭图案。

e.en: Her ring bore an {impresa} about steadfast love.
e.zh: 她的戒指上刻着关于忠贞爱情的象征格言。

imprescriptible.t: 不因时效失效的；不可剥夺的

e.en: The constitution treats dignity as an {imprescriptible} right.
e.zh: 宪法把尊严视为不可剥夺的权利。

e.en: The claim was called {imprescriptible} under old property law.
e.zh: 根据旧财产法，这项请求被称为不因时效失效。

imprescriptibly.t: 不可剥夺地；不受时效限制地

e.en: The rights were held {imprescriptibly} by the community.
e.zh: 这些权利由社群不可剥夺地享有。

e.en: The land was claimed {imprescriptibly} despite centuries of neglect.
e.zh: 尽管荒废了数百年，这片土地仍被主张不受时效限制地归属。

e.en: The manuscript shows several painted {imprese} in the margins.
e.zh: 手稿页边画有几个彩绘的徽铭图案。

e.en: Renaissance nobles used {imprese} to express private ideals.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的贵族用象征图记表达个人理想。

e.en: Children's {impressibility} makes early teaching important.
e.zh: 儿童易受影响，因此早期教育很重要。

e.en: The clay's {impressibility} helped preserve the ancient seal.
e.zh: 黏土的可压印性帮助保存了古代印章的痕迹。

e.en: Young readers are often {impressible} by dramatic stories.
e.zh: 年轻读者常容易受到戏剧性故事的影响。

e.en: The wax remained soft and {impressible} in the heat.
e.zh: 蜡在高温下仍然柔软，可被压印。

e.en: Advertisers often exploit teenagers' {impressionability}.
e.zh: 广告商常利用青少年的易受影响。

e.en: Her artistic {impressionability} made travel especially inspiring.
e.zh: 她在艺术上的易感性使旅行格外能激发灵感。

e.en: The critic offered an {impressional} account of the performance.
e.zh: 评论家给出了对这场演出的印象式描述。

e.en: These notes are {impressional}, not a formal survey.
e.zh: 这些笔记只是基于感觉，并非正式调查。

e.en: He stared back with an {impressionless} face.
e.zh: 他面无表情地回望过去。

e.en: The desert looked vast and {impressionless} under the noon sun.
e.zh: 正午阳光下，沙漠显得辽阔而没有鲜明印象。

e.en: The coin left a clear {impressure} in the wax.
e.zh: 硬币在蜡上留下了清晰的压印。

e.en: Years abroad made a lasting {impressure} on his thought.
e.zh: 多年的海外生活对他的思想留下了深刻影响。

e.en: The clerk received an {imprest} for travel expenses.
e.zh: 职员收到了一笔差旅预付款。

e.en: Auditors checked the office {imprest} at the end of each month.
e.zh: 审计人员每月底核查办公室备用金。

e.en: The officer accounted for every {imprested} sum.
e.zh: 这名官员说明了每一笔预付金额的去向。

e.en: Money {imprested} to the agent had to be returned with receipts.
e.zh: 垫付给代理人的钱必须连同收据一起结清。

e.en: The department began {impresting} small amounts to field teams.
e.zh: 该部门开始向外勤小组预付小额备用金。

e.en: Strict rules governed the {impresting} of public money.
e.zh: 公共资金的预付受到严格规则约束。

e.en: The guide pointed out an {impeyan} pheasant on the ridge.
e.zh: 向导指出山脊上有一只喜马拉雅虹雉。

e.en: An {impeyan} crest flashed green in the morning light.
e.zh: 喜马拉雅虹雉的羽冠在晨光中闪着绿色。

e.en: The old account described an {impi} moving across the plain.
e.zh: 那份旧记述描写了一支祖鲁武士团穿过平原。

e.en: Historians debate how the {impi} was organized in battle.
e.zh: 历史学家争论祖鲁武士团在战斗中如何编制。

e.en: The poet tried to {impicture} grief as a winter sea.
e.zh: 诗人试图把悲伤描绘成冬日的大海。

e.en: Her words {impicture} a city waking before dawn.
e.zh: 她的话描画出一座黎明前醒来的城市。

e.en: The scene was {impictured} in rich and careful detail.
e.zh: 这个场景被细致而丰富地描绘出来。

e.en: He saw the future {impictured} in her anxious face.
e.zh: 他在她焦虑的脸上看见了被勾勒出的未来。

e.en: The wall absorbed the force of the {impingent} waves.
e.zh: 墙体承受了冲击而来的海浪力量。

e.en: Engineers measured the heat from the {impingent} jet.
e.zh: 工程师测量了撞击射流产生的热量。

e.en: The study compared placental and {implacental} modes of reproduction.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了有胎盘和无胎盘的繁殖方式。

e.en: Some older texts call certain mammals {implacental}.
e.zh: 一些旧文献把某些哺乳动物称为无胎盘的。

e.en: The defendant tried to {implead} a third party.
e.zh: 被告试图把第三方追加进诉讼。

e.zh: 法院允许保险公司传唤承包商入庭。

e.zh: 法官询问该供应商是否可被追加进诉讼。

e.zh: 这里只有具有直接利益关系的当事人才可被追加。

e.en: The contractor was {impleaded} after new evidence appeared.
e.zh: 新证据出现后，承包商被追加进诉讼。

e.en: She denied liability as the {impleaded} third party.
e.zh: 作为被追加的第三方，她否认承担责任。

e.en: The lawyer filed an {impleader} to bring in the subcontractor.
e.zh: 律师提交了第三方追加诉讼，要求把分包商纳入案件。

e.en: An {impleader} can shift part of the dispute to another party.
e.zh: 第三方追加诉讼可以把部分争议转向另一方。

e.en: The company is {impleading} its former consultant.
e.zh: 公司正在把前顾问追加进诉讼。

e.en: The judge questioned the timing of the {impleading} motion.
e.zh: 法官质疑这项追加诉讼申请的提出时间。

e.en: He agreed to {impledge} the jewels for a short loan.
e.zh: 他同意把珠宝典当以取得一笔短期贷款。

e.en: The charter allowed citizens to {impledge} goods for credit.
e.zh: 该章程允许市民以货物作抵押取得信用。

e.en: The workshop kept several {implemental} devices near the bench.
e.zh: 作坊把几件工具性装置放在工作台旁。

e.en: Her role was mostly {implemental}, turning policy into practice.
e.zh: 她的职责主要是执行性的，把政策落实为实践。

e.en: The committee drafted {implementary} rules for the new law.
e.zh: 委员会为新法律起草了补充实施规则。

e.en: His {implementary} work made the plan usable.
e.zh: 他的执行性工作让这个计划变得可用。

e.en: The physician warned that {impletion} of the vessels could be dangerous.
e.zh: 医生警告说血管充盈可能很危险。

e.en: The ritual symbolized the {impletion} of the house with blessings.
e.zh: 这个仪式象征着屋子被祝福填满。

e.zh: 论文分析了这个论证的蕴涵结构。

e.en: Linguists found an {implicational} pattern across the languages.
e.zh: 语言学家在这些语言中发现了一种蕴涵模式。

e.en: Her silence was {implicative} of deeper doubts.
e.zh: 她的沉默暗示着更深的疑虑。

e.zh: 这个定理在形式逻辑中具有蕴涵形式。

e.zh: 他以暗示的方式回答，没有明说那项指控。

e.en: The statement functions {implicatively} in the proof.
e.zh: 这个陈述在证明中起蕴涵作用。

e.en: Her {imploration} softened the guard's stern expression.
e.zh: 她的恳求让卫兵严厉的表情缓和下来。

e.en: The letter ended with an {imploration} for mercy.
e.zh: 信的结尾是对宽恕的哀求。

e.en: He raised an {imploratory} hand toward the judge.
e.zh: 他向法官举起一只带着恳求意味的手。

e.zh: 演讲到结尾时带上了哀求的语气。

e.zh: 工程师研究了这栋建筑的内爆式坍塌。

e.zh: 这种语言在那个词中使用了内破音辅音。

e.zh: 雨水从屋顶开口落入古罗马中庭蓄水池。

e.en: The restored villa still has a marble {impluvium}.
e.zh: 修复后的别墅仍保留着一座大理石中庭蓄水池。

e.en: The settlers planned to {impolder} the marshland before winter.
e.zh: 定居者计划在冬天前把沼泽地围垦成圩田。

e.en: Engineers helped {impolder} the low coast for farming.
e.zh: 工程师帮助把低洼海岸围垦成农田。

e.en: The witness gave an {impugnable} account of the accident.
e.zh: 证人对事故的说法是可以质疑的。

e.zh: 在那个法庭上，她的权威几乎不容质疑。

e.zh: 这份报告受到竞争科学家的尖锐质疑。

e.en: His public {impugnation} of her honesty shocked the committee.
e.zh: 他公开指责她不诚实，让委员会感到震惊。

e.en: The lawyer's {impugnment} of the testimony was carefully worded.
e.zh: 律师对证词的质疑措辞十分谨慎。

e.en: Such {impugnment} of his motives seemed unfair.
e.zh: 这样质疑他的动机似乎并不公平。

e.zh: 面对这场危机，委员会显得无能为力。

e.en: He felt old and {impuissant} after the long illness.
e.zh: 久病之后，他感到衰老而虚弱无力。

e.en: She returned the jacket she had {impulse-bought} online.
e.zh: 她退掉了那件在网上一时冲动买下的夹克。

e.en: Most of the souvenirs were {impulse-bought} at the airport.
e.zh: 大多数纪念品都是在机场临时冲动买的。

e.en: Stores place candy near the checkout to encourage {impulse-buying}.
e.zh: 商店把糖果放在收银台附近，以刺激冲动购买。

e.en: Budget apps can help reduce {impulse-buying} during sales.
e.zh: 预算应用能帮助人们在打折时减少冲动购物。

e.en: A sudden {impulsion} made him confess the truth.
e.zh: 一阵突然的冲动让他说出了真相。

e.en: The reform gained {impulsion} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，这项改革获得了推动力。

e.en: His {impulsivity} often led to careless decisions.
e.zh: 他的冲动性常常导致草率的决定。

e.en: The study links childhood {impulsivity} with later risk-taking.
e.zh: 这项研究把儿童时期的冲动性与日后的冒险行为联系起来。

e.en: She became the main {impulsor} of the education campaign.
e.zh: 她成了这场教育运动的主要推动者。

e.en: The engineer replaced the damaged {impulsor} in the pump.
e.zh: 工程师更换了泵里受损的驱动部件。

e.en: They tried to {imput} the failure to poor planning.
e.zh: 他们试图把失败归咎于计划不周。

e.en: The old clerk would {imput} every cost to a separate account.
e.zh: 那位老职员会把每笔费用分别归入不同账户。

e.en: The court examined the {imputability} of the manager's actions.
e.zh: 法院审查了经理行为的可归责性。

e.en: Psychiatrists debated the {imputability} of the crime.
e.zh: 精神科医生们讨论了这起犯罪是否可归责于当事人。

e.zh: 这次延误可归因于沟通失败。

e.en: No blame is {imputable} to the junior staff.
e.zh: 不能把责任归咎于初级员工。

e.zh: 法官质疑这项罪行的可归责性。

e.zh: 他们的报告讨论了公司疏忽的可归咎性。

e.zh: 这项损失可归因地与他的疏忽有关。

e.en: Only actions {imputably} done by the agent were considered.
e.zh: 只有可归责于代理人的行为才被考虑。

e.en: The philosopher rejected the {imputative} theory of guilt.
e.zh: 那位哲学家否定了关于罪责的归因理论。

e.en: The statute created an {imputative} duty for company directors.
e.zh: 该法规为公司董事设立了一种归责义务。

imputatively.t: 以归因方式；以归责方式

e.en: The damages were assigned {imputatively} rather than directly.
e.zh: 损害赔偿是以归责方式分配的，而不是直接分配的。

e.en: He was treated {imputatively} as responsible for the debt.
e.zh: 他被以归责方式视为对这笔债务负责。

e.en: The preservative was valued for its {imputrescibility}.
e.zh: 这种防腐材料因其不易腐烂性而受到重视。

e.en: Ancient writers exaggerated the {imputrescibility} of certain oils.
e.zh: 古代作者夸大了某些油类的不腐性。

e.en: The embalmed body was believed to be {imputrescible}.
e.zh: 人们认为这具防腐处理过的遗体不会腐烂。

e.en: He imagined truth as something pure and {imputrescible}.
e.zh: 他把真理想象成纯净而不朽的东西。

in-and-in.t: 近亲繁殖的；内部循环的

e.en: The farmer avoided {in-and-in} breeding among the cattle.
e.zh: 农场主避免让牛群近亲繁殖。

e.en: Their politics became an {in-and-in} conversation among insiders.
e.zh: 他们的政治讨论变成了圈内人的内部循环。

e.en: The nurse made {in-and-out} visits throughout the night.
e.zh: 护士整夜断断续续地来回查看。

e.en: He worked an {in-and-out} job while studying.
e.zh: 他一边读书，一边做着不稳定的零工。

e.en: Her answer was almost {in-audible} over the traffic noise.
e.zh: 在车流声中，她的回答几乎听不见。

e.en: The old recording became {in-audible} near the end.
e.zh: 那段旧录音到结尾处变得难以听清。

e.en: Choose the {in-between} size if neither pair fits.
e.zh: 如果两双都不合适，就选中间那个尺码。

e.en: She felt stuck in an {in-between} stage of life.
e.zh: 她觉得自己卡在人生的一个过渡阶段。

e.en: The survey counted every {in-migrant} in the village.
e.zh: 这项调查统计了村里每一位迁入者。

e.en: An {in-migrant} may need time to find local work.
e.zh: 迁入居民可能需要时间寻找当地工作。

e.en: Many workers {in-migrate} during the harvest season.
e.zh: 许多工人在收获季节迁入当地。

e.en: Families began to {in-migrate} after the new factory opened.
e.zh: 新工厂开办后，一些家庭开始迁入定居。

e.en: Rapid {in-migration} changed the character of the town.
e.zh: 快速的人口流入改变了这座小镇的面貌。

e.en: The report links rising rents to {in-migration}.
e.zh: 报告把租金上涨与迁入人口增加联系起来。

e.en: The old switch had an {in-off} position marked on it.
e.zh: 旧开关上标着一个进出切换的位置。

e.en: Workers moved {in-off} the site all morning.
e.zh: 工人们整个上午都在工地内外进出。

e.en: The hospital admitted him as an {in-patient}.
e.zh: 医院把他收为住院病人。

e.en: An {in-patient} receives care overnight in the ward.
e.zh: 住院病人在病房里过夜接受护理。

e.en: The nurse checked the {in-patients} before breakfast.
e.zh: 护士在早餐前查看了住院病人。

e.en: Some {in-patients} need daily visits from specialists.
e.zh: 有些住院病人需要专科医生每天查房。

e.en: We finally met {in-person} after months of calls.
e.zh: 通话几个月后，我们终于当面见了面。

e.en: The school offers {in-person} classes twice a week.
e.zh: 学校每周提供两次面对面课程。

e.en: Several {in-process} applications still need approval.
e.zh: 还有几份正在办理的申请需要批准。

e.en: The team reviewed the {in-process} design before launch.
e.zh: 团队在发布前审查了正在进行中的设计。

e.en: Please {in-put} the figures exactly as shown.
e.zh: 请按显示内容准确输入这些数字。

e.en: Extra {in-put} from farmers improved the policy.
e.zh: 农民提供的额外意见改进了这项政策。

e.en: The university has a poet {in-residence} this year.
e.zh: 这所大学今年有一位驻校诗人。

e.en: Students can meet the artist {in-residence} on Fridays.
e.zh: 学生们每周五可以见到驻留艺术家。

e.en: The company made an {in-road} into the Asian market.
e.zh: 这家公司在亚洲市场取得了突破。

e.en: Heavy rain cut an {in-road} through the soft bank.
e.zh: 大雨在松软的河岸上冲出一道缺口。

e.en: Teachers attend {in-service} training every summer.
e.zh: 教师每年夏天参加在职培训。

e.en: Only three buses are {in-service} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后只有三辆公交车仍在运营。

e.en: The fossils were studied {in-situ} before removal.
e.zh: 这些化石在移走前先在原处进行了研究。

e.en: Doctors treated the tumor {in-situ} with radiation.
e.zh: 医生用放疗对原位肿瘤进行治疗。

e.en: She pays lower {in-state} tuition at the university.
e.zh: 她在这所大学缴纳较低的本州学费。

e.en: The company prefers {in-state} suppliers when possible.
e.zh: 这家公司在可能时更愿意选择州内供应商。

e.en: The dancers moved {in-step} across the stage.
e.zh: 舞者们步调一致地穿过舞台。

e.en: Her views are {in-step} with public opinion.
e.zh: 她的观点与公众意见相当合拍。

e.en: The discount is available only {in-store}.
e.zh: 这项折扣只在店内提供。

e.en: We improved the {in-store} experience for customers.
e.zh: 我们改善了顾客的店内体验。

e.en: The doctor noticed the child was slightly {in-toed}.
e.zh: 医生注意到这个孩子有点内八字脚。

e.en: Her {in-toed} walk became less obvious with therapy.
e.zh: 经过治疗，她内八字的走路姿势不那么明显了。

e.en: Leave the invoice in my {in-tray}.
e.zh: 把发票放在我的待办文件盘里。

e.en: Her {in-tray} was full of urgent letters.
e.zh: 她的待办文件盘里堆满了紧急信件。

e.en: The pattern was {in-wrought} with silver thread.
e.zh: 这个图案用银线织入其中。

e.en: Fear seemed {in-wrought} in his earliest memories.
e.zh: 恐惧似乎深深嵌在他最早的记忆里。

e.en: His {in-your-face} style annoyed some voters.
e.zh: 他咄咄逼人的风格惹恼了一些选民。

e.en: The ad used bright colors and {in-your-face} slogans.
e.zh: 这则广告用了鲜艳颜色和张扬口号。

e.en: The material's {inabsorbability} made it useful for coatings.
e.zh: 这种材料的不能吸收性使它适合用于涂层。

e.en: Researchers measured the drug's {inabsorbability} in the gut.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种药物在肠道中的不可吸收性。

e.en: Such delays are {inacceptable} in emergency care.
e.zh: 在急救护理中，这样的延误是不可接受的。

e.en: The committee called the proposal {inacceptable}.
e.zh: 委员会称这项提案不可接受。

e.en: The cabin stood {inaccessibly} high in the mountains.
e.zh: 小屋位于山中高处，难以到达。

e.en: The report was written {inaccessibly} for ordinary readers.
e.zh: 这份报告写得让普通读者难以理解。

e.en: The lab added an {inactivator} to stop the enzyme.
e.zh: 实验室加入灭活剂来阻止这种酶。

e.en: Heat can act as an {inactivator} for some viruses.
e.zh: 热量可以充当某些病毒的灭活因子。

e.en: The camera has an {in-built} flash for dark rooms.
e.zh: 这台相机有内置闪光灯，适合暗房间使用。

e.en: The policy has an {in-built} bias toward larger firms.
e.zh: 这项政策对大公司有一种固有偏向。

e.en: The farmer kept the {in-calf} cow near the barn.
e.zh: 农夫把那头怀小牛的母牛留在谷仓附近。

e.en: They paid more for an {in-calf} heifer at the auction.
e.zh: 他们在拍卖会上为一头怀小牛的小母牛付了更高价。

e.en: The fund reports its {in-cap} assets separately each quarter.
e.zh: 该基金每季度单独报告其纳入资本计算的资产。

e.en: Only {in-cap} spending counts toward the team's official limit.
e.zh: 只有限额内支出才计入球队的官方上限。

e.en: The new model includes an {in-car} navigation system.
e.zh: 新款车型配有车载导航系统。

e.en: Parents often rely on {in-car} entertainment during long trips.
e.zh: 长途旅行时，父母常常依靠车内娱乐设备。

e.en: Maria is {in-charge} while the manager is away.
e.zh: 经理不在时由玛丽亚负责。

e.en: The {in-charge} nurse checked every patient before midnight.
e.zh: 值班主管护士在午夜前检查了每位病人。

e.en: The editor {in-chief} approved the final headline.
e.zh: 总编辑批准了最终标题。

e.en: As commander {in-chief}, the president addressed the troops.
e.zh: 总统以最高统帅身份向部队讲话。

e.en: Several {in-clearing} checks were delayed by the holiday.
e.zh: 几张正在清算的支票因假日而延迟处理。

e.en: The bank flagged an {in-clearing} item for manual review.
e.zh: 银行将一笔票据交换中的项目标记为人工复核。

e.en: The training was handled by an {in-company} legal team.
e.zh: 这次培训由公司内部法务团队负责。

e.en: He becomes more relaxed {in-company} than when alone.
e.zh: 他在有同伴时比独处时更放松。

e.en: The charity hired {in-country} staff for the project.
e.zh: 该慈善机构为项目雇用了当地驻点员工。

e.en: All {in-country} orders are delivered within three days.
e.zh: 所有国内订单都会在三天内送达。

e.en: He tried hard to join the {in-crowd} at school.
e.zh: 他很努力想加入学校里的时髦小圈子。

e.en: The restaurant became popular with the city's {in-crowd}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅在城里的圈内人之间流行起来。

e.en: The car has an {in-dash} screen for maps and music.
e.zh: 这辆车有仪表板内置屏幕，可显示地图和音乐。

e.en: An {in-dash} camera recorded the entire accident.
e.zh: 一台仪表板内置摄像头记录了整起事故。

e.en: The report gives an {in-depth} analysis of housing costs.
e.zh: 这份报告对住房成本作了深入分析。

e.en: We discussed the problem {in-depth} during the meeting.
e.zh: 我们在会议上深入讨论了这个问题。

e.en: The party's latest {in-fight} weakened its public image.
e.zh: 该党最近的内部斗争削弱了公众形象。

e.en: The boxer won the {in-fight} with short, sharp punches.
e.zh: 那名拳手靠短促有力的拳击赢得了近身搏斗。

e.en: Political {in-fighting} delayed the budget vote for weeks.
e.zh: 政治内部争斗使预算投票推迟了数周。

e.en: The team lost focus because of constant {in-fighting}.
e.zh: 团队因不断内斗而失去了工作重点。

e.en: The airline improved its {in-flight} meal service.
e.zh: 这家航空公司改善了机上餐饮服务。

e.en: The rocket made an {in-flight} correction after launch.
e.zh: 火箭发射后进行了飞行中的修正。

e.en: The school compared {in-grade} reading scores across classes.
e.zh: 学校比较了各班同年级内的阅读成绩。

e.en: Workers can receive {in-grade} pay rises without promotion.
e.zh: 员工即使不升职，也可以获得等级内加薪。

e.en: Members of the {in-group} often trusted each other first.
e.zh: 内群体成员往往首先信任彼此。

e.en: The joke made outsiders feel excluded from the {in-group}.
e.zh: 这个笑话让外人觉得被圈内群体排除在外。

e.en: The clinic handles {in-hour} calls at the front desk.
e.zh: 诊所由前台处理工作时段内来电。

e.en: Emergency fees are lower for {in-hour} repairs.
e.zh: 工作时段内维修的紧急费用较低。

e.en: The company built the software {in-house} last year.
e.zh: 这家公司去年在内部开发了这款软件。

e.en: They hired an {in-house} designer for daily projects.
e.zh: 他们聘请了一名内部设计师处理日常项目。

e.en: Nobody understood the {in-joke} except the old classmates.
e.zh: 除了那些老同学，没人听懂这个圈内笑话。

e.en: The nickname started as an {in-joke} in the office.
e.zh: 这个绰号最初是办公室里的内部梗。

e.en: The charity accepted {in-kind} donations of food and blankets.
e.zh: 该慈善机构接受食物和毯子等实物捐赠。

e.en: When insulted, she refused to respond {in-kind}.
e.zh: 受到侮辱时，她拒绝以同样方式回应。

e.en: Her {in-law} family visits every spring.
e.zh: 她的姻亲一家每年春天都会来访。

e.en: He joked that his brother {in-law} knew everyone in town.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说他的姐夫认识镇上的每个人。

e.en: We are having dinner with my {in-laws} tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚要和我的姻亲一起吃饭。

e.en: Her {in-laws} helped care for the children.
e.zh: 她的公婆帮忙照看孩子。

in-line.t: 成一直线的；在线内嵌的

e.en: Keep the wheels {in-line} when you park the trailer.
e.zh: 停放拖车时要让车轮保持成一直线。

e.en: The editor supports {in-line} comments on shared documents.
e.zh: 这个编辑器支持在共享文档中添加内嵌评论。

e.en: The factory checks {in-lot} samples before shipping parts.
e.zh: 工厂在发货前检查同批内样品。

e.en: Guests must use the {in-lot} payment machine before leaving.
e.zh: 客人离开前必须使用停车场内的缴费机。

e.en: His {inadaptability} made the new role difficult.
e.zh: 他的不适应让这个新职位变得很困难。

e.en: The report noted the system's {inadaptability} to change.
e.zh: 报告指出该系统对变化缺乏适应能力。

e.en: Some older tools are {inadaptable} to modern workflows.
e.zh: 一些旧工具无法适应现代工作流程。

e.en: He seemed {inadaptable} after years in one routine.
e.zh: 多年按一种 routine 生活后，他似乎难以适应变化。

e.en: The plan's {inadequation} became clear during testing.
e.zh: 测试期间，这个计划的不充分变得很明显。

e.en: She criticized the {inadequation} between policy and reality.
e.zh: 她批评政策与现实之间的不相称。

e.en: The {inadhesive} surface rejected every label we tried.
e.zh: 这种不黏表面让我们试过的每张标签都贴不上。

e.en: Engineers chose an {inadhesive} coating for easy cleaning.
e.zh: 工程师选择了无黏性涂层，方便清洁。

e.en: The judge explained the evidence's {inadmissibility}.
e.zh: 法官解释了该证据不可采纳的原因。

e.en: Their {inadmissibility} to the club surprised the guests.
e.zh: 他们不得进入俱乐部让客人们感到意外。

e.en: The statement was {inadmissibly} obtained by threats.
e.zh: 这份陈述是通过威胁取得的，因此不可采纳。

e.en: He was {inadmissibly} late for the formal hearing.
e.zh: 他参加正式听证会迟到得令人无法接受。

e.en: A moment of {inadvertency} caused the data loss.
e.zh: 一时疏忽导致了数据丢失。

e.en: Her rude remark was pure {inadvertency}, not malice.
e.zh: 她那句失礼的话纯属无意，并非恶意。

e.en: The lawyer stressed the {inadvisability} of speaking publicly.
e.zh: 律师强调公开发言并不明智。

e.en: Recent failures showed the {inadvisability} of that shortcut.
e.zh: 最近的失败表明那种捷径不可取。

e.en: He {inadvisably} ignored the weather warning.
e.zh: 他轻率地忽视了天气警报。

e.en: The company {inadvisably} launched before testing was complete.
e.zh: 公司在测试完成前贸然发布，做法并不明智。

e.en: The critic called the building {inaesthetic} and cold.
e.zh: 评论家说这栋建筑不美，而且显得冷漠。

e.en: An {inaesthetic} layout can still be highly functional.
e.zh: 一个缺乏美感的布局仍然可能很实用。

e.en: She felt an {inaffable} sadness after the farewell.
e.zh: 告别之后，她感到一种难以言表的悲伤。

e.en: The mountain view had an {inaffable} beauty.
e.zh: 山景有一种无法用语言形容的美。

inagglutinable.t: 不能黏合的；不可凝集的

e.en: The powder was {inagglutinable} under normal pressure.
e.zh: 这种粉末在正常压力下不能黏合。

e.en: The sample proved {inagglutinable} in the laboratory test.
e.zh: 实验室测试证明该样本不可凝集。

inalienability.t: 不可剥夺性；不可转让性

e.en: The constitution affirms the {inalienability} of basic rights.
e.zh: 宪法确认基本权利的不可剥夺性。

e.en: Lawyers debated the land's {inalienability} under old law.
e.zh: 律师们依据旧法争论这块土地是否不可转让。

inalienably.t: 不可剥夺地；不可转让地

e.en: These freedoms are {inalienably} tied to citizenship.
e.zh: 这些自由与公民身份不可剥夺地联系在一起。

e.en: The property was {inalienably} held by the community.
e.zh: 这份财产由社区不可转让地持有。

e.en: The doctrine assumed the {inalterability} of divine law.
e.zh: 这一教义假定神圣法律具有不可改变性。

e.en: Scientists questioned the supposed {inalterability} of the trait.
e.zh: 科学家质疑这种特征所谓的固定不变。

e.en: The contract set an {inalterable} deadline for delivery.
e.zh: 合同规定了一个不可更改的交付期限。

e.en: Her belief in his honesty seemed {inalterable}.
e.zh: 她对他诚实的信任似乎坚定不变。

e.en: Philosophers argued about the soul's {inalterableness}.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论灵魂是否具有不变性。

e.en: The rule's {inalterableness} frustrated the applicants.
e.zh: 规则无法改变让申请者们很沮丧。

e.en: The poet wrote letters to his distant {inamorata}.
e.zh: 诗人给远方的女恋人写信。

e.en: Gossip columns called her the actor's {inamorata}.
e.zh: 八卦专栏称她是那位演员的情妇。

e.en: Her {inamorato} waited beneath the balcony.
e.zh: 她的男恋人在阳台下等待。

e.en: The scandal named him as the duchess's {inamorato}.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻称他是公爵夫人的情夫。

e.en: Her former {inamoratos} appeared in the memoir.
e.zh: 她过去的男恋人们出现在回忆录中。

e.en: The play mocks jealous {inamoratos} with comic songs.
e.zh: 这出戏用滑稽歌曲嘲弄嫉妒的情夫们。

e.en: The river was once full of {inanga} in spring.
e.zh: 这条河过去春天满是新西兰小银鱼。

e.en: Local rules protect {inanga} during their migration.
e.zh: 当地规定在新西兰小银鱼洄游期间保护它们。

e.en: The statue's {inanimation} made its face seem eerie.
e.zh: 雕像的无生命感让它的脸显得诡异。

e.en: After the defeat, a strange {inanimation} filled the room.
e.zh: 失败之后，房间里弥漫着一种奇怪的死气沉沉。

e.en: The prisoners suffered from {inanition} after weeks without proper food.
e.zh: 囚犯们数周没有像样食物后，因饥饿而虚弱。

e.en: His speech had an air of intellectual {inanition}.
e.zh: 他的演讲透出一种思想空乏的气息。

e.en: The damage was {inapparent} until the wall was opened.
e.zh: 直到墙面被打开，损坏才显现出来。

e.en: Her influence remained {inapparent} to most observers.
e.zh: 大多数观察者并未看出她的影响力。

e.en: The disease progressed {inapparently} for several months.
e.zh: 这种病在几个月里不显山露水地发展。

e.en: He worked {inapparently} behind the scenes.
e.zh: 他在幕后默默地工作，外人很难察觉。

inappeasable.t: 无法平息的；难以安抚的

e.en: She felt an {inappeasable} anger after the betrayal.
e.zh: 遭到背叛后，她感到一种无法平息的愤怒。

e.en: The child became {inappeasable} once he grew tired.
e.zh: 孩子一累起来就怎么也哄不好。

e.en: The treaty confirmed the {inappellability} of the tribunal's decision.
e.zh: 条约确认了该法庭裁决的不可上诉性。

e.en: Lawyers debated the {inappellability} of the ruling.
e.zh: 律师们争论这项裁定是否具有终局性。

e.en: The court issued an {inappellable} judgment.
e.zh: 法院作出了一项不可上诉的判决。

e.en: In that system, the monarch's order was {inappellable}.
e.zh: 在那个制度下，君主的命令是最终裁断。

e.en: The doctor noted the patient's {inappetence} and weight loss.
e.zh: 医生记录了病人的食欲不振和体重下降。

e.en: A strange {inappetence} for success troubled him.
e.zh: 一种对成功缺乏欲望的怪异心态困扰着他。

e.en: Persistent {inappetency} can signal a serious illness.
e.zh: 持续食欲不振可能预示严重疾病。

e.en: Her {inappetency} for public attention surprised the press.
e.zh: 她对公众关注毫无兴趣，这让媒体很意外。

e.en: The {inappetent} patient refused even soup.
e.zh: 这名食欲不振的病人连汤都不肯喝。

e.en: He seemed {inappetent} for praise or promotion.
e.zh: 他似乎对表扬或升职都没有什么欲求。

e.en: The judge explained the {inapplicability} of that precedent.
e.zh: 法官解释了那个先例为何不适用。

e.en: Its {inapplicability} to small firms became obvious.
e.zh: 它对小公司的不适用性变得很明显。

e.en: The rule was applied {inapplicably} to a different case.
e.zh: 这条规则被不恰当地套用到另一个案件上。

e.en: He quoted the theory {inapplicably} in the meeting.
e.zh: 他在会上不合适地引用了那个理论。

e.en: The policy failed through {inapplication} rather than bad design.
e.zh: 政策失败是因为没有执行，而不是设计不好。

e.en: His {inapplication} at school worried his parents.
e.zh: 他在学校不用功，让父母很担心。

e.en: His joke was {inapposite} at such a solemn event.
e.zh: 在这样庄重的场合，他的玩笑很不恰当。

e.en: The comparison is {inapposite} because the facts differ.
e.zh: 这个比较并不切题，因为事实情况不同。

e.en: She spoke {inappositely} about profits during the memorial.
e.zh: 她在追悼会上不合时宜地谈起利润。

e.en: The clause was {inappositely} placed in the contract.
e.zh: 这个条款在合同中的位置放得不恰当。

e.en: The {inappositeness} of his remark silenced the room.
e.zh: 他那句话的不恰当让全场安静下来。

e.en: Reviewers noted the {inappositeness} of the analogy.
e.zh: 评论者指出这个类比并不切题。

inappreciably.t: 微不足道地；难以察觉地

e.en: The temperature changed {inappreciably} during the night.
e.zh: 夜间温度变化微乎其微。

e.en: The new rule affected sales only {inappreciably}.
e.zh: 新规定对销售的影响几乎察觉不到。

e.en: His {inappreciation} of her work hurt their friendship.
e.zh: 他不赏识她的工作，伤害了两人的友谊。

e.en: The essay shows an {inappreciation} of local history.
e.zh: 这篇文章显示出对当地历史缺乏理解。

e.en: The manager sounded {inappreciative} of the team's effort.
e.zh: 经理听起来并不赏识团队的努力。

e.en: An {inappreciative} audience can discourage young performers.
e.zh: 不懂欣赏的观众会打击年轻表演者的信心。

e.en: Her {inappreciativeness} made the volunteers feel ignored.
e.zh: 她的不懂感激让志愿者觉得被忽视。

e.en: Critics complained of his {inappreciativeness} toward tradition.
e.zh: 批评者抱怨他对传统缺乏赏识。

inapprehensible.t: 无法理解的；不可领会的

e.en: The manuscript was almost {inapprehensible} without notes.
e.zh: 没有注释，这份手稿几乎无法理解。

e.en: To the child, death seemed {inapprehensible}.
e.zh: 对那个孩子来说，死亡似乎不可领会。

e.en: The error arose from {inapprehension} of the instructions.
e.zh: 这个错误源于没有理解说明。

e.en: His {inapprehension} of the danger was alarming.
e.zh: 他没有意识到危险，这令人担忧。

e.en: He remained {inapprehensive} of the legal risk.
e.zh: 他仍未意识到其中的法律风险。

e.en: The children were {inapprehensive} as the storm approached.
e.zh: 暴风雨逼近时，孩子们却毫无忧虑。

inapproachable.t: 难以接近的；不可企及的

e.en: The peak was {inapproachable} after the avalanche.
e.zh: 雪崩之后，那座山峰已难以接近。

e.en: Her reputation made her seem {inapproachable}.
e.zh: 她的名声让人觉得她难以亲近。

e.en: His {inaptitude} for diplomacy soon became clear.
e.zh: 他不适合做外交工作的弱点很快显露出来。

e.en: The accident revealed the driver's {inaptitude}.
e.zh: 这起事故暴露了司机的无能和笨拙。

e.en: Gardeners {inarch} young shoots onto stronger roots.
e.zh: 园丁把嫩枝嫁接到更强壮的根上。

e.en: They decided to {inarch} the damaged tree rather than replace it.
e.zh: 他们决定给受损的树做接枝，而不是换掉它。

e.en: The {inarched} branch survived the dry summer.
e.zh: 那根接枝的枝条熬过了干燥的夏天。

e.en: She inspected the {inarched} plants for signs of disease.
e.zh: 她检查那些已嫁接的植物是否有病害迹象。

e.en: The villagers chose to {inarm} themselves before nightfall.
e.zh: 村民们决定在天黑前把自己武装起来。

e.en: Old poems often say a hero will {inarm} for battle.
e.zh: 古诗里常说英雄会披挂上阵。

e.en: His {inarticulacy} made the apology sound cold.
e.zh: 他表达不清，让道歉听起来很冷淡。

e.en: The witness struggled with {inarticulacy} under pressure.
e.zh: 证人在压力下说话结结巴巴。

e.en: Her {inartificial} manner won their trust.
e.zh: 她自然不做作的态度赢得了他们的信任。

e.en: The essay has an {inartificial} charm despite its roughness.
e.zh: 这篇文章虽粗糙，却有一种自然的魅力。

e.en: The poster was {inartistically} arranged and hard to read.
e.zh: 海报排得很拙劣，也很难读。

e.en: He {inartistically} forced jokes into a serious speech.
e.zh: 他很不高明地把笑话硬塞进严肃演讲里。

e.en: The recording suffered from near {inaudibility} in places.
e.zh: 录音有些地方几乎听不见。

e.en: Her whisper faded into {inaudibility} across the room.
e.zh: 她的低语在房间另一头变得听不见了。

e.en: She was the {inaugurator} of a new research program.
e.zh: 她是这个新研究项目的开创者。

e.en: The mayor served as the ceremony's official {inaugurator}.
e.zh: 市长担任了典礼的正式揭幕人。

e.en: The president delivered an {inauguratory} address at noon.
e.zh: 总统在中午发表了就职演说。

e.en: An {inauguratory} concert opened the new hall.
e.zh: 一场开幕音乐会启用了这座新大厅。

e.en: The article felt {inauthoritative} because it cited no sources.
e.zh: 这篇文章没有引用来源，显得不可靠。

e.en: His {inauthoritative} tone weakened the committee's confidence.
e.zh: 他缺乏权威感的语气削弱了委员会的信心。

e.en: The philosopher discussed the object's {inbeing}.
e.zh: 哲学家讨论了这个物体的内在存在。

e.en: Their customs had no real {inbeing} outside memory.
e.zh: 那些习俗离开记忆就没有真正的存在。

e.en: The old gate had an {inbent} iron bar.
e.zh: 旧大门上有一根向内弯曲的铁条。

e.en: His {inbent} posture suggested years of desk work.
e.zh: 他向内佝偻的姿势让人想到多年伏案工作。

e.en: The {inblowing} wind scattered ash across the floor.
e.zh: 吹进来的风把灰烬散到地板上。

e.en: Engineers measured the {inblowing} air inside the tunnel.
e.zh: 工程师测量了隧道内吹入的空气。

e.en: The wall collapsed after an {inbreak} of water.
e.zh: 水突然涌入后，墙塌了。

e.en: The quiet town feared an {inbreak} of soldiers.
e.zh: 这个安静的小镇害怕士兵突然闯入。

e.en: The {inbreaking} waves flooded the cellar.
e.zh: 涌入的海浪淹没了地窖。

e.en: They spoke of an {inbreaking} light in the darkness.
e.zh: 他们说黑暗中有一道突然照进来的光。

e.en: She took a slow {inbreath} before speaking.
e.zh: 她说话前慢慢吸了一口气。

e.en: The doctor listened to each {inbreath} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细听着每一次吸气声。

e.en: Patients should {inbreathe} gently through the mask.
e.zh: 病人应通过面罩轻轻吸气。

e.en: The poem asks readers to {inbreathe} the morning air.
e.zh: 这首诗让读者吸入清晨的空气。

e.en: The {inbreathed} dust irritated his throat.
e.zh: 吸入的灰尘刺激了他的喉咙。

e.en: She called the melody an {inbreathed} gift.
e.zh: 她称这段旋律是灵感注入的礼物。

e.en: Deep {inbreathing} helped calm his nerves.
e.zh: 深吸气帮助他平静下来。

e.en: The machine records {inbreathing} and exhalation separately.
e.zh: 这台机器分别记录吸气和呼气。

e.en: Farmers avoid letting the animals {inbreed} for many generations.
e.zh: 农民会避免让动物连续多代近亲繁殖。

e.en: Small isolated populations may {inbreed} over time.
e.zh: 小而隔绝的种群久而久之可能会近亲繁殖。

e.en: This line of rabbits {inbreeds} easily in captivity.
e.zh: 这一系兔子在圈养环境中容易近亲繁殖。

e.en: The report says the herd {inbreeds} because it is isolated.
e.zh: 报告说这个兽群因被隔离而发生近亲繁殖。

e.en: The cave flooded after an {inburst} of rainwater.
e.zh: 雨水突然涌入后，洞穴被淹了。

e.en: His anger came in a sudden {inburst}.
e.zh: 他的怒气突然爆发出来。

e.en: They tried to {incage} the injured hawk safely.
e.zh: 他们试图安全地把受伤的鹰关进笼中。

e.en: Fear can {incage} a person's imagination.
e.zh: 恐惧会禁锢一个人的想象力。

incaged.t: 被关进笼中的；受禁锢的

e.en: The {incaged} bird beat its wings against the wire.
e.zh: 被关进笼中的鸟拍打着铁丝网。

e.en: He felt {incaged} by the town's narrow expectations.
e.zh: 他觉得自己被小镇狭隘的期待禁锢住了。

e.en: The handler was {incaging} the injured bird for transport.
e.zh: 管理员正把受伤的鸟关进笼中以便运送。

e.en: The poem describes fear as {incaging} the mind.
e.zh: 这首诗把恐惧描写成囚禁心灵的力量。

e.en: The museum displayed several {Incaic} stone carvings.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几件印加文化的石雕。

e.en: Her paper compared {Incaic} roads with Roman roads.
e.zh: 她的论文比较了印加人的道路和罗马道路。

e.en: The {incalculability} of the loss stunned the town.
e.zh: 损失之难以估量让全镇震惊。

e.en: Markets dislike the {incalculability} of sudden political crises.
e.zh: 市场不喜欢突发政治危机带来的不可预测性。

e.en: The chemist noted the liquid's {incalescence} during the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家注意到液体在反应过程中逐渐发热。

e.en: A slow {incalescence} spread through the metal plate.
e.zh: 金属板上慢慢扩散出一阵热意。

e.en: The {incalescent} wire began to glow faintly.
e.zh: 正在变热的金属丝开始微微发光。

e.en: She touched the {incalescent} stone and pulled back.
e.zh: 她碰到那块发热的石头后缩回了手。

e.en: The judge heard the evidence {in camera}.
e.zh: 法官以不公开方式听取了证据。

e.en: They discussed the security report {in camera}.
e.zh: 他们秘密讨论了那份安全报告。

e.en: The filament will {incandesce} when enough current passes through it.
e.zh: 有足够电流通过时，灯丝会白热发光。

e.en: Coals seemed to {incandesce} in the dark fireplace.
e.zh: 煤块在黑暗的壁炉里似乎炽热发亮。

e.en: The metal {incandesced} under the intense flame.
e.zh: 金属在猛烈火焰下变得白热发光。

e.en: Her anger {incandesced} into a fierce speech.
e.zh: 她的愤怒炽烈起来，化成了一场激烈演说。

e.en: Tungsten {incandesces} at extremely high temperatures.
e.zh: 钨在极高温下会白热发光。

e.en: The horizon {incandesces} as the sun rises.
e.zh: 太阳升起时，地平线炽亮起来。

e.en: The {incandescing} filament lit the small room.
e.zh: 正在白热发光的灯丝照亮了小房间。

e.en: An {incandescing} cloud hung above the volcano.
e.zh: 一团炽亮的云悬在火山上方。

e.en: The lamp produced a warm {incandesence}.
e.zh: 那盏灯发出温暖的白炽光。

e.en: His prose has moments of sudden {incandesence}.
e.zh: 他的散文有时会突然显出炽烈的光彩。

e.en: The priest began to {incant} the ancient words.
e.zh: 祭司开始吟诵那些古老的词句。

e.en: Fans {incant} the team's name before every match.
e.zh: 球迷每场比赛前都会反复念诵球队的名字。

e.en: The song has an {incantational} rhythm.
e.zh: 这首歌带有咒语般的节奏。

e.en: His {incantational} delivery held the audience silent.
e.zh: 他吟诵式的表达让观众安静地听着。

e.en: She {incanted} a blessing over the child.
e.zh: 她为孩子吟诵了一段祝福。

e.en: The protesters {incanted} the slogan for hours.
e.zh: 抗议者连续数小时反复喊着口号。

e.en: The stun round can {incap} a target without killing.
e.zh: 眩晕弹可以让目标失去行动能力而不致命。

e.en: One lucky hit managed to {incap} the guard.
e.zh: 一次幸运的击中让守卫失去了反抗能力。

e.en: His {incapability} became clear during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机中他的无能变得很明显。

e.en: The machine's {incapability} to detect smoke worried inspectors.
e.zh: 这台机器无法探测烟雾，让检查人员很担心。

e.en: He handled the negotiations {incapably}.
e.zh: 他无能地处理了这场谈判。

e.en: The shelves were {incapably} fixed to the wall.
e.zh: 这些架子装得很差，根本不牢靠。

e.en: They slept in an {incapacious} attic room.
e.zh: 他们睡在一间狭小的阁楼房里。

e.en: The {incapacious} bag could not hold her books.
e.zh: 这个容量不足的包放不下她的书。

e.en: The report identified the gas as an {incapacitant}.
e.zh: 报告确认这种气体是一种失能剂。

e.en: Police tested a new {incapacitant} for riot control.
e.zh: 警方测试了一种用于防暴的新型致失能物质。

e.en: The device was designed as a nonlethal {incapacitator}.
e.zh: 这种装置被设计成非致命的失能设备。

e.en: Fear can be a powerful {incapacitator}.
e.zh: 恐惧可能是一种强大的致人失能因素。

e.en: The lab will {incapsulate} the medicine in a coating.
e.zh: 实验室会把药物包入一层胶囊外衣中。

e.en: A good title can {incapsulate} the whole argument.
e.zh: 一个好标题可以概括整篇论证。

e.en: The novel portrays the jailer as a cruel {incarcerator}.
e.zh: 小说把狱卒描写成残酷的监禁者。

e.en: Debt became an invisible {incarcerator} for the family.
e.zh: 债务成了这个家庭看不见的囚笼。

e.en: The bishop agreed to {incardinate} the priest into his diocese.
e.zh: 主教同意将这名神父接收入自己的教区。

e.en: Church law explains how to {incardinate} a cleric properly.
e.zh: 教会法说明了如何正式接收一名神职人员入教区。

e.en: His {incardination} into the diocese took months.
e.zh: 他加入该教区的手续花了几个月。

e.en: The documents confirmed her canonical {incardination}.
e.zh: 文件确认了她在教会法上的教区归属。

e.en: The sunset turned the river {incarnadine}.
e.zh: 夕阳把河水染成了血红色。

e.en: Shakespeare used {incarnadine} to suggest blood and guilt.
e.zh: 莎士比亚用incarnadine暗示鲜血与罪疚。

e.en: The sunset {incarnadined} the clouds above the harbor.
e.zh: 夕阳把港口上空的云染成深红色。

e.en: His {incarnadined} hands shook after the battle.
e.zh: 战斗过后，他血红的双手在发抖。

e.en: The poet says blood {incarnadines} the sea.
e.zh: 诗人说鲜血把大海染成血红。

e.en: Autumn light {incarnadines} the old brick walls.
e.zh: 秋日的光把旧砖墙染成深红。

e.en: The wine was {incarnadining} the white cloth.
e.zh: 红酒正把白布染成深红色。

e.en: Dawn was {incarnadining} the eastern sky.
e.zh: 黎明正把东方的天空染成红色。

e.en: They {incase} each specimen in clear resin.
e.zh: 他们把每个标本都封在透明树脂里。

e.en: Please {incase} the fragile part before shipping.
e.zh: 发货前请把易碎部件包好。

e.en: The phone was {incased} in a thick rubber shell.
e.zh: 手机被包在厚厚的橡胶壳里。

e.en: Her old medals lay {incased} in glass.
e.zh: 她的旧奖章被陈列在玻璃盒中。

e.en: A metal frame {incases} the battery pack.
e.zh: 金属框架包住了电池组。

e.en: The museum {incases} rare books behind glass.
e.zh: 博物馆把珍本书封存在玻璃后面。

e.en: Workers are {incasing} the cables in plastic tubes.
e.zh: 工人正在把电缆套进塑料管里。

e.en: The chef finished by {incasing} the filling in pastry.
e.zh: 厨师最后把馅料包进酥皮里。

e.en: The jeweler set an {incast} stone in the ring.
e.zh: 珠宝匠在戒指里嵌入了一颗铸入式宝石。

e.en: The sculpture has an {incast} shadow at its center.
e.zh: 这座雕塑中心有一道向内投下的阴影。

e.en: His {incaution} cost the team valuable time.
e.zh: 他的不谨慎让团队浪费了宝贵时间。

e.en: A moment of {incaution} can ruin a delicate experiment.
e.zh: 一时粗心可能毁掉一项精细实验。

e.en: The police investigated the fire as {incendiarism}.
e.zh: 警方把这场火灾作为纵火案调查。

e.en: The speech was condemned for political {incendiarism}.
e.zh: 那场演讲因煽动政治暴力而受到谴责。

e.en: The warehouse stored {incendive} chemicals near the door.
e.zh: 仓库把易燃化学品存放在门边。

e.en: Her {incendive} remarks angered the crowd.
e.zh: 她煽动性的话激怒了人群。

e.en: Engineers tested the {incendivity} of the new coating.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种新涂层的易燃性。

e.en: The editor toned down the article's {incendivity}.
e.zh: 编辑削弱了那篇文章的煽动性。

e.en: The ceremony began with solemn {incensation}.
e.zh: 仪式以庄重的焚香开始。

e.en: His public insult caused immediate {incensation}.
e.zh: 他的公开侮辱立刻引起愤怒。

e.en: The unfair verdict led to public {incensement}.
e.zh: 不公的判决引发了公众愤慨。

e.en: Her calm reply only deepened his {incensement}.
e.zh: 她平静的回答反而加深了他的怒气。

e.en: The {incensor} walked slowly before the altar.
e.zh: 焚香者在祭坛前缓缓走过。

e.en: In the debate, he became the chief {incensor}.
e.zh: 在辩论中，他成了主要的煽怒者。

e.en: A silver {incensory} hung beside the altar.
e.zh: 一只银香炉挂在祭坛旁边。

e.en: The priest carried an {incensory} vessel through the aisle.
e.zh: 神父提着焚香器穿过过道。

e.en: The bonus will {incent} staff to finish early.
e.zh: 这笔奖金会激励员工提前完成。

e.en: The policy aims to {incent} cleaner transport choices.
e.zh: 这项政策旨在鼓励选择更清洁的交通方式。

e.en: The triangle's {incenter} lies where its angle bisectors meet.
e.zh: 三角形的内心位于角平分线的交点。

e.en: Draw a circle from the {incenter} to touch all three sides.
e.zh: 从内心画圆，可与三条边都相切。

e.en: The program will {incentivize} doctors to work in rural areas.
e.zh: 该计划将激励医生到农村地区工作。

e.en: Tax breaks can {incentivize} companies to reduce emissions.
e.zh: 税收优惠可以促使企业减少排放。

e.en: The {incentre} is equidistant from every side of the triangle.
e.zh: 内心到三角形每条边的距离都相等。

e.en: British textbooks often spell incenter as {incentre}.
e.zh: 英国教材常把 incenter 拼作 incentre。

e.en: The project will {incept} with a small pilot study.
e.zh: 这个项目将以小规模试点研究开始。

e.en: They helped {incept} a new school of design.
e.zh: 他们帮助创立了一个新的设计流派。

e.en: The plan is still in its {inceptive} stage.
e.zh: 这项计划仍处在起始阶段。

e.en: Some languages mark {inceptive} action with a special verb form.
e.zh: 有些语言用特殊动词形式表示动作开始。

e.en: The theory was {inceptively} framed as a moral argument.
e.zh: 这个理论最初被表述为一种道德论证。

e.en: Her plan worked {inceptively}, but later failed.
e.zh: 她的计划起初奏效，但后来失败了。

e.en: He was the {inceptor} of the reform movement.
e.zh: 他是这场改革运动的发起者。

e.en: The first rumor became the {inceptor} of wider panic.
e.zh: 最初的谣言成了更大恐慌的开端。

e.en: The witness gave an {incertain} account of the night.
e.zh: 证人对那晚的描述并不确定。

e.en: They moved with {incertain} steps through the dark hall.
e.zh: 他们在黑暗的大厅里步伐迟疑地前行。

e.en: The {incessancy} of the noise exhausted everyone.
e.zh: 噪声持续不断，让所有人都筋疲力尽。

e.en: She admired the {incessancy} of his efforts.
e.zh: 她佩服他坚持不懈的努力。

e.en: The tailor checked the {inchage} before cutting the cloth.
e.zh: 裁缝在裁布前核对了英寸尺寸。

e.en: Old contracts sometimes listed timber by {inchage}.
e.zh: 旧合同有时按英寸数列出木材规格。

e.en: The captain would {incharge} the officer with the keys.
e.zh: 船长会把钥匙交托给那名军官保管。

e.en: They {incharged} him with settling the dispute.
e.zh: 他们委托他来解决这场纠纷。

e.en: The family chose to {inchest} the letters for safekeeping.
e.zh: 这家人决定把那些信件装箱妥善保存。

e.en: She seemed to {inchest} every slight in her memory.
e.zh: 她似乎把每一次冒犯都深藏在记忆里。

e.en: The tale describes an {inchling} hiding under a leaf.
e.zh: 故事描写了一个藏在叶子下的小矮人。

e.en: He called the tiny screw an {inchling} of metal.
e.zh: 他把那颗小螺丝称作一小点金属。

e.en: The glacier moved {inchmeal} down the valley.
e.zh: 冰川沿着山谷一点一点地移动。

e.en: Reform came {inchmeal}, never in a single dramatic act.
e.zh: 改革是逐步到来的，从不是一次戏剧性的行动。

e.en: The book traces the {inchoation} of modern science.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了现代科学的开端。

e.en: At its {inchoation}, the project had almost no funding.
e.zh: 项目初创时几乎没有资金。

e.en: The policy remained in an {inchoative} stage for years.
e.zh: 这项政策多年里一直处于初始阶段。

e.en: Latin has several {inchoative} verb forms.
e.zh: 拉丁语有几种表示动作开始的动词形式。

e.en: The poem opens {inchoatively}, with only a hint of plot.
e.zh: 这首诗开头只略显情节，带着初始的意味。

e.en: The verb is used {inchoatively} in this passage.
e.zh: 这个动词在这段文字中表示动作的开始。

e.en: An {inchworm} crawled along the garden stem.
e.zh: 一只尺蠖沿着花园里的茎爬行。

e.en: She did an {inchworm} exercise before the run.
e.zh: 跑步前她做了尺蠖式热身动作。

e.en: Doctors detected the {incipience} of the disease early.
e.zh: 医生很早就发现了疾病的初期迹象。

e.en: The essay captures the {incipience} of a new style.
e.zh: 这篇文章捕捉到一种新风格的萌芽。

e.en: The committee studied the {incipiency} of urban unrest.
e.zh: 委员会研究了城市骚动的萌芽阶段。

e.en: Her notes show the {incipiency} of a larger novel.
e.zh: 她的笔记显示出一部长篇小说的雏形。

e.en: The manuscript's {incipit} identifies the lost sermon.
e.zh: 手稿的开篇词确认了那篇失传的布道文。

e.en: Students memorized the {incipit} of the medieval poem.
e.zh: 学生们背下了那首中世纪诗歌的开头。

e.en: The dentist examined the {incisal} edge of the tooth.
e.zh: 牙医检查了这颗牙的切缘。

e.en: The crown restored the {incisal} surface after injury.
e.zh: 牙冠修复了受伤后的切牙表面。

e.en: The fossil showed an {incisiform} front tooth.
e.zh: 化石显示出一颗形似切牙的前牙。

e.en: Some mammals have {incisiform} canines adapted for cutting.
e.zh: 有些哺乳动物有适于切割、形似切牙的犬齿。

e.en: The animal's {incisory} teeth were unusually sharp.
e.zh: 这种动物用于切割的牙齿异常锋利。

e.en: Surgeons used an {incisory} instrument for the first cut.
e.zh: 外科医生用切割器械做了第一道切口。

e.en: The scan revealed a small {incisura} near the stomach.
e.zh: 扫描显示胃部附近有一个小切迹。

e.en: Anatomists marked the {incisura} on the bone diagram.
e.zh: 解剖学家在骨骼图上标出了凹口。

e.en: The leaf had a deep {incisure} along one side.
e.zh: 这片叶子一侧有一道很深的缺刻。

e.en: The surgeon inspected the {incisure} after the procedure.
e.zh: 手术后，外科医生检查了切口。

e.en: Caffeine can act as an {incitant} in sensitive patients.
e.zh: 咖啡因在敏感患者身上可能起刺激作用。

e.en: The speech had an {incitant} tone that worried officials.
e.zh: 那场演讲带有煽动性语气，让官员们担忧。

e.en: The speech was seen as an {incitation} to violence.
e.zh: 那场演讲被视为对暴力的煽动。

e.en: Her praise gave him fresh {incitation} to continue.
e.zh: 她的称赞给了他继续下去的新动力。

e.en: The article used {incitative} language during the protest.
e.zh: 那篇文章在抗议期间使用了煽动性的语言。

e.en: A teacher's {incitative} remarks can awaken real curiosity.
e.zh: 老师激励性的话语能唤起真正的好奇心。

e.en: He spoke {incitingly} to the angry crowd.
e.zh: 他煽动地对愤怒的人群讲话。

e.en: The headline was written {incitingly} to provoke readers.
e.zh: 标题写得很有挑动性，意在激怒读者。

e.en: His {incivil} reply shocked the guests.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的回答让客人们很震惊。

e.en: The rules punished {incivil} behavior in public meetings.
e.zh: 这些规定惩罚公共会议中的不文明行为。

e.en: The writer feared a slide into {incivilization}.
e.zh: 作者担心社会滑向不文明状态。

e.en: War brought hunger, fear, and {incivilization} to the region.
e.zh: 战争给该地区带来了饥饿、恐惧和野蛮化。

incivism.t: 缺乏公德；不守公民义务

e.en: Littering in the park is a common form of {incivism}.
e.zh: 在公园乱扔垃圾是一种常见的缺乏公德行为。

e.en: The mayor blamed low turnout on public {incivism}.
e.zh: 市长把投票率低归咎于公众不守公民义务。

e.en: She tried to {inclasp} the child in her arms.
e.zh: 她试图把孩子紧紧抱在怀里。

e.en: The old bracelet could {inclasp} the wrist securely.
e.zh: 那只旧手镯能牢牢扣住手腕。

e.en: The match was canceled because of the weather's {inclemency}.
e.zh: 比赛因天气恶劣而取消。

e.en: They suffered the {inclemency} of a harsh winter.
e.zh: 他们忍受了严冬的严酷。

e.en: The desk has an {inclinable} writing surface.
e.zh: 这张书桌有一个可倾斜的书写面。

e.en: He seemed {inclinable} to accept the offer.
e.zh: 他似乎有意接受这个提议。

e.en: Engineers tested the seat's {inclinableness} under load.
e.zh: 工程师测试了座椅在承重时的可倾斜性。

e.en: Her {inclinableness} toward compromise surprised everyone.
e.zh: 她愿意妥协的倾向让所有人都很意外。

e.en: The survey measured {inclinational} changes among young voters.
e.zh: 这项调查衡量了年轻选民倾向方面的变化。

e.en: The instrument records {inclinational} movement in the tower.
e.zh: 该仪器记录塔身的倾斜运动。

e.en: The technician adjusted the {inclinator} before the test.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前调整了测斜仪。

e.en: A small {inclinator} showed the platform's angle.
e.zh: 一个小型倾斜器显示了平台的角度。

e.en: The machine made a slight {inclinatory} movement.
e.zh: 机器做了一个轻微的倾斜动作。

e.en: Her {inclinatory} nod suggested cautious agreement.
e.zh: 她那表示倾向的点头暗示了谨慎同意。

e.en: You must {inclip} the wire before closing the panel.
e.zh: 合上面板前你必须把电线夹住。

e.en: The strap will {inclip} neatly into the buckle.
e.zh: 这条带子会整齐地扣入搭扣。

e.en: They plan to {inclose} the garden with a low wall.
e.zh: 他们打算用矮墙把花园围起来。

e.en: Please {inclose} a copy of your receipt.
e.zh: 请随信附上一份收据复印件。

e.en: The {inclosed} courtyard was quiet and cool.
e.zh: 这个被围住的院子安静而凉爽。

e.en: Read the {inclosed} document before signing.
e.zh: 签字前请阅读随附的文件。

e.en: The {incloser} built fences around the common land.
e.zh: 围地者在公地周围建起了栅栏。

e.en: A metal {incloser} protects the delicate motor.
e.zh: 一个金属围护物保护着精密电机。

e.en: The stone wall {incloses} the old cemetery.
e.zh: 石墙围住了那座旧墓地。

e.en: She {incloses} a cheque with every order.
e.zh: 她每次下单都会随信附上一张支票。

e.en: They are {inclosing} the field for sheep.
e.zh: 他们正在把田地围起来养羊。

e.en: I am {inclosing} the contract for your review.
e.zh: 我随信附上合同供你审阅。

e.en: The horses grazed inside the wooden {inclosure}.
e.zh: 马匹在木制围场里吃草。

e.en: The letter mentioned an {inclosure} with payment details.
e.zh: 信中提到有一份随附物说明付款细节。

e.en: Travel costs are {includable} in the final budget.
e.zh: 差旅费用可以纳入最终预算。

e.en: Only verified expenses are {includable} in the report.
e.zh: 只有经核实的费用才可列入报告。

e.en: The allowance is {includible} as taxable income.
e.zh: 这项津贴可计入应税收入。

e.en: Several small items are {includible} in the package.
e.zh: 几个小物件可以包括在这个套装里。

e.en: The company promotes {inclusivity} in hiring.
e.zh: 这家公司在招聘中提倡包容性。

e.en: True {inclusivity} means listening to quiet voices too.
e.zh: 真正的包容也意味着倾听沉默者的声音。

e.en: The sample remained {incoagulable} after heating.
e.zh: 样本加热后仍然不能凝固。

e.en: Doctors described the blood as unusually {incoagulable}.
e.zh: 医生说这种血液异常地不易凝固。

e.en: The engineer will {incode} the settings tonight.
e.zh: 工程师今晚会把这些设置编码进去。

e.en: Old manuals used {incode} to mean put into code.
e.zh: 旧手册里用incode表示写入代码。

e.en: Her conscience seemed {incoercible} under pressure.
e.zh: 在压力下，她的良知似乎无法被强迫屈服。

e.en: The judge called belief an {incoercible} matter.
e.zh: 法官称信仰是不能被强制的事。

e.en: The celebrity traveled {incog} through the city.
e.zh: 那位名人在城里隐姓埋名地旅行。

e.en: He went {incog} to hear honest opinions.
e.zh: 他乔装前去听取真实意见。

e.en: The philosopher stressed the {incogitability} of nothingness.
e.zh: 那位哲学家强调虚无的不可思议性。

e.en: Its sheer {incogitability} made the theory hard to teach.
e.zh: 它本身难以设想，使这个理论很难讲授。

e.en: Such cruelty was {incogitable} to the villagers.
e.zh: 这样的残酷对村民来说简直不可想象。

e.en: The plan assumed an {incogitable} level of precision.
e.zh: 这个计划假定了一个难以想象的精确程度。

e.en: His {incogitancy} led to a foolish decision.
e.zh: 他的不加思考导致了一个愚蠢决定。

e.en: The essay attacks public {incogitancy} in politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评公众在政治上的思想麻木。

e.en: The speech mocked an {incogitative} obedience to fashion.
e.zh: 演讲嘲讽了对潮流不加思考的顺从。

e.en: He sat {incogitative}, staring at the rain.
e.zh: 他无所思地坐着，望着雨。

e.en: The queen traveled as an {incognita}.
e.zh: 女王以隐姓埋名的身份出行。

e.en: The letter mentions an {incognita} at the ball.
e.zh: 信中提到舞会上有一位身份不明的女子。

e.en: The object was almost {incognizable} in the fog.
e.zh: 雾中那个物体几乎无法辨认。

e.en: Some truths may be {incognizable} to human minds.
e.zh: 有些真理对人类心智来说也许无法认识。

e.en: His {incognizance} of the rule caused trouble.
e.zh: 他不知道这条规定，结果惹出了麻烦。

e.en: The report notes public {incognizance} of the risk.
e.zh: 报告指出公众并未察觉这种风险。

e.en: She was {incognizant} of the hidden cost.
e.zh: 她并不知道那笔隐藏费用。

e.en: The guards remained {incognizant} of the escape.
e.zh: 卫兵仍未察觉有人逃走。

e.en: The bright sofa looked {incogruous} in the chapel.
e.zh: 那张鲜艳的沙发放在礼拜堂里显得很不协调。

e.en: His joke felt {incogruous} during the solemn meeting.
e.zh: 在庄重的会议上，他的笑话显得不合时宜。

e.en: The letter's {incoherency} worried her family.
e.zh: 那封信语无伦次，让她的家人担心。

e.en: Critics attacked the policy's {incoherency}.
e.zh: 批评者抨击这项政策缺乏连贯性。

e.en: Team {incohesion} hurt the project badly.
e.zh: 团队缺乏凝聚力严重影响了项目。

e.en: The novel suffers from narrative {incohesion}.
e.zh: 这部小说的问题在于叙事不够连贯。

incohesive.t: 缺乏凝聚力的；不连贯的

e.en: The group became {incohesive} after the merger.
e.zh: 合并之后，这个团队变得缺乏凝聚力。

e.en: Her argument was detailed but {incohesive}.
e.zh: 她的论证很详细，但不够连贯。

e.en: The material's {incombustibility} made it useful in labs.
e.zh: 这种材料的不可燃性使它在实验室很有用。

e.en: Engineers tested the panel for {incombustibility}.
e.zh: 工程师检测了这块面板的耐燃性。

e.en: The vault was lined with {incombustible} brick.
e.zh: 保险库内衬了耐火砖。

e.en: They chose {incombustible} fabric for the curtains.
e.zh: 他们为窗帘选择了不可燃织物。

e.en: The trust pays the {income-beneficiaries} each quarter.
e.zh: 该信托每季度向收益受益人付款。

e.en: All {income-beneficiaries} must report these payments.
e.zh: 所有收益受益人都必须申报这些款项。

e.en: Her son is the main {income-beneficiary}.
e.zh: 她的儿子是主要的收益受益人。

e.en: An {income-beneficiary} receives profits but not the asset.
e.zh: 收益受益人领取收益，但不拥有资产本身。

e.en: She is the only {income-earner} in the family.
e.zh: 她是家里唯一有收入的人。

e.en: Tax credits vary by each {income-earner}'s salary.
e.zh: 税收抵免会根据每个收入者的工资而不同。

incommensurably.t: 无法相比地；不可同量地

e.en: Their sacrifices were {incommensurably} greater than ours.
e.zh: 他们的牺牲比我们的要大得无法相比。

e.en: The two theories measure value {incommensurably}.
e.zh: 这两种理论以不可同量的方式衡量价值。

e.en: I hope I did not {incommode} you.
e.zh: 希望我没有给你添麻烦。

e.en: The repairs will {incommode} residents for a week.
e.zh: 维修会让居民不便一周。

e.en: She felt {incommoded} by the late request.
e.zh: 这个临时请求让她感到不便。

e.en: Guests were barely {incommoded} by the renovation.
e.zh: 翻修几乎没有给客人造成不便。

e.en: The narrow stairs caused considerable {incommodement} to the movers.
e.zh: 狭窄的楼梯给搬运工造成了很大不便。

e.en: He apologized for the {incommodement} his delay had caused.
e.zh: 他为自己的延误带来的不便道歉。

e.en: The road closure {incommodes} everyone who drives to work.
e.zh: 道路封闭让所有开车上班的人都很不方便。

e.en: I hope my request {incommodes} you as little as possible.
e.zh: 我希望我的请求尽量少给你添麻烦。

e.en: He worried about {incommoding} his hosts with special requests.
e.zh: 他担心提出特殊要求会麻烦主人。

e.en: The repairs are {incommoding} residents on the upper floors.
e.zh: 维修工程正给楼上住户带来不便。

e.en: They spent the night in an {incommodious} little room.
e.zh: 他们在一间狭小不便的小房间里过夜。

e.en: The old carriage was charming but {incommodious}.
e.zh: 那辆旧马车很有情调，但坐起来并不舒服。

e.en: The guests were {incommodiously} packed into one small cabin.
e.zh: 客人们被不方便地挤在一间小木屋里。

e.en: The desk stood {incommodiously} close to the door.
e.zh: 书桌摆得离门太近，十分碍事。

e.en: The {incommodiousness} of the lodging soon became obvious.
e.zh: 住处的狭促不便很快就显露出来。

e.en: She complained about the {incommodiousness} of the old train seats.
e.zh: 她抱怨那列旧火车的座位不舒服又不方便。

e.en: Travelers accepted many {incommodities} on the long winter road.
e.zh: 旅人在漫长的冬季路途中忍受了许多不便。

e.en: The report listed the {incommodities} caused by the new layout.
e.zh: 报告列出了新布局造成的种种麻烦。

e.en: The broken lift was a daily {incommodity} for the tenants.
e.zh: 坏掉的电梯成了租户每天都要面对的不便。

e.en: He endured every {incommodity} without complaint.
e.zh: 他毫无怨言地忍受了各种麻烦。

e.en: The poem explores the {incommunicability} of private grief.
e.zh: 这首诗探讨了私人悲痛难以传达的状态。

e.en: Language sometimes reveals the {incommunicability} of certain experiences.
e.zh: 语言有时会显出某些经历无法被真正交流。

incommunicable.t: 无法传达的；不可交流的

e.en: Her fear felt {incommunicable}, even to her closest friend.
e.zh: 她的恐惧似乎无法传达，即使对最亲近的朋友也是如此。

e.en: The mystic described an {incommunicable} vision of peace.
e.zh: 那位神秘主义者描述了一种难以言传的平和景象。

incommunicably.t: 无法传达地；难以言说地

e.en: He felt {incommunicably} alone in the crowded station.
e.zh: 他在拥挤的车站里感到一种难以言说的孤独。

e.en: The memory remained {incommunicably} vivid after many years.
e.zh: 多年以后，那段记忆仍鲜明得无法言传。

incommunicative.t: 不爱说话的；沉默寡言的

e.en: The witness became {incommunicative} when the lawyer pressed him.
e.zh: 律师追问时，证人变得沉默寡言。

e.en: He was friendly but strangely {incommunicative} about his past.
e.zh: 他很友善，但谈到过去时却出奇地不愿多说。

e.en: The contract emphasized the {incommutability} of the two obligations.
e.zh: 合同强调这两项义务不可互相替换。

e.en: Mathematicians discussed the {incommutability} of the operation.
e.zh: 数学家们讨论了该运算的不可交换性。

incommutable.t: 不可交换的；不可变更的

e.en: The judge treated the sentence as {incommutable}.
e.zh: 法官认为这项判决不可更改。

e.en: In this system, the two values are {incommutable}.
e.zh: 在这个系统中，这两个值不能互换。

incommutably.t: 不可交换地；不可变更地

e.en: The rule fixed their duties {incommutably}.
e.zh: 这条规则把他们的职责固定下来，不可更改。

e.en: The symbols are ordered {incommutably} in the formula.
e.zh: 这些符号在公式中的顺序不可交换。

e.en: The doctrine rested on the {incommutation} of certain rights.
e.zh: 该学说建立在某些权利不可交换的基础上。

e.en: The prisoner feared the {incommutation} of his sentence.
e.zh: 囚犯担心自己的刑期不会得到减免。

e.en: The soil was too {incompact} to support the wall.
e.zh: 土壤太松散，无法支撑那堵墙。

e.en: His argument seemed {incompact} and poorly arranged.
e.zh: 他的论证显得松散，结构也很差。

e.en: The builder refused to lay bricks on {incompacted} ground.
e.zh: 建筑工拒绝在未压实的地面上砌砖。

e.en: The powder remained {incompacted} after gentle shaking.
e.zh: 轻轻摇晃后，粉末仍然没有压实。

e.en: The study noted the {incomparability} of the two surveys.
e.zh: 研究指出这两项调查无法直接比较。

e.en: Critics praised the {incomparability} of her singing voice.
e.zh: 评论家称赞她的歌声无与伦比。

e.en: The two programs interact {incompatibly} on older machines.
e.zh: 这两个程序在旧机器上会发生不兼容的交互。

e.en: He behaved {incompatibly} with the values he claimed to hold.
e.zh: 他的行为与自己声称秉持的价值观相矛盾。

e.en: The grammar marks this verb form as {incompletive}.
e.zh: 语法书把这个动词形式标为非完成体。

e.en: His notes were {incompletive} and left the argument unfinished.
e.zh: 他的笔记并不完整，使论证没有收束。

e.en: The company was fined for {incompliance} with safety rules.
e.zh: 公司因不遵守安全规定而被罚款。

e.en: Her quiet {incompliance} irritated the committee.
e.zh: 她沉默的不顺从让委员会很恼火。

e.en: The officer reported repeated {incompliancy} among the recruits.
e.zh: 军官报告说新兵中反复出现不服从。

e.en: His {incompliancy} was subtle but persistent.
e.zh: 他的不顺从很隐蔽，却一直存在。

e.en: The device was judged {incompliant} with the new standard.
e.zh: 该设备被认定不符合新标准。

e.en: An {incompliant} patient may ignore the treatment plan.
e.zh: 不配合的病人可能会忽视治疗方案。

e.en: The mineral appeared {incomposite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，这种矿物看起来并非复合结构。

e.en: He preferred an {incomposite} style with few ornamental parts.
e.zh: 他偏爱一种简单朴素、少有装饰的风格。

inconsequentiality.t: 无关紧要；微不足道的性质

e.en: The report stressed the {inconsequentiality} of the delay.
e.zh: 报告强调这次延误无关紧要。

e.en: She laughed at the {inconsequentiality} of their argument.
e.zh: 她觉得他们争论的事太微不足道，便笑了。

inconsequently.t: 不合逻辑地；无关紧要地

e.en: He spoke {inconsequently} after a sleepless night.
e.zh: 一夜没睡后，他说话前后不太合逻辑。

e.en: The detail was added {inconsequently} at the end.
e.zh: 这个细节无关紧要地被加在了末尾。

e.en: The essay's {inconsequentness} made it hard to follow.
e.zh: 这篇文章的不连贯让人很难读懂。

e.en: His sudden anger showed the {inconsequentness} of his mood.
e.zh: 他突然发怒，显示出情绪的反复无常。

e.en: He acted {inconsiderably} toward the waiting staff.
e.zh: 他对服务员表现得很不体贴。

e.en: The rule was changed {inconsiderably} and without warning.
e.zh: 这条规定被轻率地改了，而且没有提前通知。

e.en: Her {inconsideration} upset everyone in the room.
e.zh: 她的考虑不周让房间里所有人都不快。

e.en: Leaving early showed real {inconsideration} for the team.
e.zh: 提前离开确实显得对团队很不体贴。

e.en: The judge noted an {inconsistence} in his testimony.
e.zh: 法官注意到他的证词中有一处前后矛盾。

e.en: This {inconsistence} weakens the whole theory.
e.zh: 这种不一致削弱了整个理论。

e.en: There was clear {inconsonance} between policy and practice.
e.zh: 政策和实际做法之间明显不一致。

e.en: The bright music created {inconsonance} with the tragic scene.
e.zh: 明快的音乐与悲伤的场景形成了不协调。

e.en: His actions were {inconsonant} with his public promises.
e.zh: 他的行动与公开承诺并不一致。

e.en: The modern tower looked {inconsonant} among old houses.
e.zh: 这座现代高楼夹在老房子中显得不协调。

e.en: Her {inconstance} made long-term planning impossible.
e.zh: 她的反复无常让长期规划变得不可能。

e.en: The poet wrote often about love and {inconstance}.
e.zh: 这位诗人常写爱情与人心不定。

inconsumable.t: 不能消耗的；不可消费的

e.en: The emergency ration was old and {inconsumable}.
e.zh: 这份应急口粮已经过期，不能食用。

e.en: Some digital goods are practically {inconsumable} by use.
e.zh: 有些数字商品实际上不会因使用而被消耗。

inconsumably.t: 不能消耗地；不可消费地

e.en: The resource exists {inconsumably} in their economic model.
e.zh: 在他们的经济模型中，这种资源被视为不会被消耗。

e.en: The data was treated {inconsumably}, unlike physical stock.
e.zh: 这些数据被当作不可消耗之物处理，不同于实物库存。

e.en: The lawyer emphasized the {incontestability} of the evidence.
e.zh: 律师强调这项证据的无可争辩性。

e.en: Its {incontestability} made further debate pointless.
e.zh: 它的确凿性使进一步争论失去了意义。

e.en: She is {incontestably} the best candidate.
e.zh: 她无可争辩地是最佳候选人。

e.en: The documents {incontestably} prove his ownership.
e.zh: 这些文件确凿地证明了他的所有权。

e.en: The patient suffered from {incontinency} after surgery.
e.zh: 病人手术后出现了失禁。

e.en: The sermon warned against moral {incontinency}.
e.zh: 这篇布道告诫人们不要在道德上缺乏自制。

e.en: The signal became {incontinuous} inside the tunnel.
e.zh: 信号在隧道里变得断断续续。

e.en: Their records form an {incontinuous} history of the town.
e.zh: 他们的记录构成了这座城镇一段不连续的历史。

incontrollable.t: 无法控制的；难以抑制的

e.en: The fire grew {incontrollable} in the dry wind.
e.zh: 在干燥的风中，火势变得无法控制。

e.en: She felt an {incontrollable} urge to laugh.
e.zh: 她感到一阵难以抑制的笑意。

e.en: The scientist defended the {incontrovertibility} of the results.
e.zh: 科学家为这些结果的无可反驳性辩护。

e.en: Their case depended on the evidence's {incontrovertibility}.
e.zh: 他们的案子取决于证据是否确凿无疑。

e.en: We apologize for the {inconveniency} caused by repairs.
e.zh: 我们为维修造成的不便表示歉意。

e.en: The old bridge was a daily {inconveniency} for commuters.
e.zh: 这座旧桥每天都给通勤者带来麻烦。

e.en: Currency {inconvertibility} worried foreign investors.
e.zh: 货币不能兑换让外国投资者感到担忧。

e.en: The file's {inconvertibility} delayed the archive project.
e.zh: 文件无法转换，拖慢了归档项目。

inconvertible.t: 不可转换的；不能兑换的

e.en: The old bonds were {inconvertible} into shares.
e.zh: 这些旧债券不能转换成股票。

e.en: They held {inconvertible} currency during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间他们持有的是不能兑换的货币。

e.en: The contract stressed the {inconvertibleness} of the assets.
e.zh: 合同强调这些资产不可转换。

e.en: His doctrine assumed the {inconvertibleness} of human nature.
e.zh: 他的学说假定人性不能改变。

inconvertibly.t: 不可转换地；不能改变地

e.en: The debt was fixed {inconvertibly} in foreign currency.
e.zh: 这笔债务被不可转换地固定为外币。

e.en: She believed the decision was {inconvertibly} final.
e.zh: 她认为这个决定已经最终定下，无法改变。

inconvincible.t: 不能说服的；难以信服的

e.en: He remained {inconvincible} despite clear evidence.
e.zh: 即使证据清楚，他仍然无法被说服。

e.en: The claim sounded {inconvincible} to most listeners.
e.zh: 这个说法在多数听众看来难以令人信服。

inconvincibly.t: 不能令人信服地；无说服力地

e.en: He explained the missing money {inconvincibly}.
e.zh: 他对那笔失踪的钱解释得毫无说服力。

e.en: The actor smiled {inconvincibly} during the sad scene.
e.zh: 在悲伤的场景中，演员笑得很不自然，难以令人信服。

e.en: The witness was {incooperative} during questioning.
e.zh: 证人在询问过程中很不配合。

e.en: An {incooperative} attitude slowed the whole project.
e.zh: 不合作的态度拖慢了整个项目。

e.en: The report was {incomprehensive} and missed key evidence.
e.zh: 这份报告不够全面，漏掉了关键证据。

e.en: His {incomprehensive} reply showed he had misunderstood the question.
e.zh: 他那理解不全的回答说明他误解了问题。

incomputable.t: 无法计算的；不可估量的

e.en: The exact risk is {incomputable} with the data available.
e.zh: 凭现有数据无法计算出确切风险。

e.en: Her grief seemed {incomputable} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故之后，她的悲痛似乎难以估量。

incomputably.t: 无法计算地；不可估量地

e.en: The model becomes {incomputably} complex at that scale.
e.zh: 模型在那种规模下会复杂到无法计算。

e.en: The loss was {incomputably} greater than anyone expected.
e.zh: 损失大得不可估量，超出所有人的预料。

e.en: The {inconceivability} of the plan made investors hesitate.
e.zh: 这个计划的不可想象让投资者犹豫不决。

e.en: She stressed the {inconceivability} of abandoning the children.
e.zh: 她强调抛弃这些孩子是难以置信的事。

e.en: Critics noticed the {inconcinnity} of the building's mixed styles.
e.zh: 评论家注意到这栋建筑混合风格的不协调。

e.en: The poem's {inconcinnity} gives it a strange energy.
e.zh: 这首诗的不雅协调感反而带来一种奇特的活力。

inconclusible.t: 无法断定的；不能终结的

e.en: The dispute remained {inconclusible} without the missing records.
e.zh: 缺少那些记录，这场争议仍无法断定。

e.en: For him, the philosophical question was {inconclusible}.
e.zh: 对他来说，这个哲学问题是不能最终解决的。

e.en: The gas's {incondensability} complicated the storage design.
e.zh: 这种气体的不可冷凝性使储存设计更复杂。

e.en: Engineers tested the {incondensability} of the vapor mixture.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种蒸汽混合物的不能凝缩特性。

incondensable.t: 不能凝缩的；不可冷凝的

e.en: The system removes {incondensable} gases from the condenser.
e.zh: 该系统会从冷凝器中去除不可冷凝气体。

e.en: Some vapors are {incondensable} under normal pressure.
e.zh: 有些蒸汽在常压下不能被冷凝。

incondensibility.t: 不可凝缩性；不可压缩性

e.en: The {incondensibility} of the fluid affected the experiment.
e.zh: 这种流体的不可凝缩性影响了实验。

e.en: Old textbooks discussed the {incondensibility} of certain gases.
e.zh: 旧教材讨论过某些气体的不可压缩性。

e.en: He published an {incondite} essay full of abrupt turns.
e.zh: 他发表了一篇粗糙杂乱、转折突兀的文章。

e.en: The archive contained {incondite} notes from his early research.
e.zh: 档案里有他早期研究中尚未成形的笔记。

e.en: The noisy room was {inconducive} to careful study.
e.zh: 吵闹的房间不利于认真学习。

e.en: Rigid rules are often {inconducive} to creative work.
e.zh: 僵硬的规则往往无助于创造性工作。

e.en: The material's {inconductivity} makes it useful as insulation.
e.zh: 这种材料的不导电性使它适合用作绝缘材料。

e.en: They measured the {inconductivity} of the ceramic coating.
e.zh: 他们测量了陶瓷涂层的不传导性。

e.en: His conduct was {inconformable} with the school's rules.
e.zh: 他的行为与学校规定不一致。

e.en: She remained {inconformable} to every fashionable opinion.
e.zh: 她始终不顺从任何流行观点。

e.en: The audit found {inconformity} between policy and practice.
e.zh: 审计发现政策与实际做法不一致。

e.en: His {inconformity} made him unpopular in a strict office.
e.zh: 他的不顺从让他在严苛的办公室里不受欢迎。

incongealable.t: 不能凝固的；不可冻结的

e.en: The chemist searched for an {incongealable} liquid for the device.
e.zh: 化学家为这台装置寻找一种不能凝固的液体。

e.en: At that temperature, the mixture remained {incongealable}.
e.zh: 在那个温度下，这种混合物仍然不会冻结。

e.en: Several {inconnected} wires hung behind the old radio.
e.zh: 几根未连接的电线挂在旧收音机后面。

e.en: The witness gave a series of {inconnected} memories.
e.zh: 证人说出了一连串彼此无关联的记忆。

e.en: The child made an {inconscient} movement in his sleep.
e.zh: 孩子睡梦中做了一个无意识的动作。

e.en: Her {inconscient} bias shaped the final decision.
e.zh: 她不自觉的偏见影响了最终决定。

e.en: He lay {inconscious} after the fall.
e.zh: 他摔倒后失去了知觉。

e.en: The habit was almost {inconscious} by then.
e.zh: 到那时，这个习惯几乎已经是不自觉的了。

e.en: The pages were numbered in an {inconsecutive} order.
e.zh: 这些页码的顺序并不连续。

e.en: His {inconsecutive} speech confused the audience.
e.zh: 他那无条理的讲话让听众感到困惑。

e.en: The files were stored {inconsecutively} across several folders.
e.zh: 这些文件不连续地存放在几个文件夹里。

e.en: He spoke {inconsecutively} after a sleepless night.
e.zh: 一夜未眠之后，他说话变得毫无条理。

e.en: The essay's {inconsequence} weakened its central argument.
e.zh: 这篇文章的不合逻辑削弱了中心论点。

e.en: He smiled at the {inconsequence} of their little quarrel.
e.zh: 他想到他们那场小争吵无足轻重，便笑了。

inconsequent.t: 不合逻辑的；无关紧要的

e.en: Her conclusion was {inconsequent} from the evidence presented.
e.zh: 从所给证据看，她的结论并不合逻辑。

e.en: They wasted hours on an {inconsequent} detail.
e.zh: 他们在一个无关紧要的细节上浪费了好几个小时。

e.en: The dancers looked {incoordinate} during the rushed rehearsal.
e.zh: 匆忙排练时，舞者们看起来动作不协调。

e.en: His {incoordinate} movements suggested a neurological problem.
e.zh: 他不协调的动作显示可能有神经方面的问题。

e.en: The doctor noted mild {incoordination} in her left hand.
e.zh: 医生注意到她左手有轻微动作失调。

e.en: Poor planning caused {incoordination} among the rescue teams.
e.zh: 计划不周导致救援队之间缺乏协调。

e.en: These clauses are {incorporable} into the final contract.
e.zh: 这些条款可以并入最终合同。

e.en: The nutrients are easily {incorporable} into healthy tissue.
e.zh: 这些营养物质很容易被健康组织吸收。

e.en: The committee proposed an {incorporative} model for local groups.
e.zh: 委员会提出了一种把地方团体纳入其中的模式。

e.en: Some languages have highly {incorporative} verb structures.
e.zh: 有些语言具有高度合成性的动词结构。

e.en: The {incorporator} filed the documents with the state.
e.zh: 公司设立人向州政府提交了文件。

e.en: He acted as an {incorporator} of several small charities.
e.zh: 他曾担任几家小型慈善机构的合并发起人。

e.en: The philosopher discussed the {incorporeity} of the soul.
e.zh: 那位哲学家讨论了灵魂的非物质性。

e.en: Digital assets challenge old ideas of {incorporeity}.
e.zh: 数字资产挑战了人们对无形性的旧观念。

e.en: The editor marked each {incorrection} in the manuscript.
e.zh: 编辑标出了手稿中的每一处错误。

e.en: His speech had force but also grammatical {incorrection}.
e.zh: 他的演讲很有力量，但也有语法不正确之处。

e.en: The alloy was advertised as {incorrodable} in seawater.
e.zh: 这种合金被宣传为在海水中不会腐蚀。

e.en: They needed an {incorrodable} lining for the chemical tank.
e.zh: 他们需要一种不受腐蚀的内衬来保护化学罐。

e.en: She remained {incorrupt} despite years in politics.
e.zh: 尽管从政多年，她仍然保持廉洁。

e.en: The relic was said to be {incorrupt} after centuries.
e.zh: 据说这件圣物历经数百年仍未腐坏。

e.en: The judge was praised as an {incorrupted} public servant.
e.zh: 那位法官被赞为一名未受腐化的公仆。

e.en: They hoped to preserve an {incorrupted} version of the text.
e.zh: 他们希望保存一份未被篡改的文本版本。

e.en: He served {incorruptibly} for more than thirty years.
e.zh: 他廉洁任职三十多年。

e.en: The saint's body was believed to remain {incorruptibly} whole.
e.zh: 人们相信那位圣人的遗体奇迹般地保持完整不腐。

e.en: The constitution demanded {incorruption} from public officials.
e.zh: 宪法要求公职人员保持廉洁。

e.en: Medieval writers treated bodily {incorruption} as a sign of holiness.
e.zh: 中世纪作家把遗体不腐视为圣洁的标志。

e.en: They praised the law's {incorruptive} influence on public life.
e.zh: 他们称赞这项法律对公共生活有防腐败的影响。

e.en: The material was valued for its {incorruptive} properties.
e.zh: 这种材料因其不易腐坏的特性而受到重视。

e.en: The official managed the funds {incorruptly}.
e.zh: 这名官员廉洁地管理资金。

e.en: She judged the dispute {incorruptly} and without fear.
e.zh: 她正直无畏地裁决了这场争端。

e.en: His {incorruptness} made him trusted by both parties.
e.zh: 他的廉洁让双方都信任他。

e.en: The legend emphasized the {incorruptness} of the martyr's body.
e.zh: 这个传说强调殉道者遗体不腐。

e.en: The old spelling {incovenient} appears in a few manuscripts.

e.zh: 这些蛋需要温暖的孵化环境。

e.en: Doctors watched for symptoms during the {incubative} stage.
e.zh: 医生在潜伏期阶段观察症状。

e.en: The laboratory kept rare eggs in an {incubatorium}.
e.zh: 实验室把珍稀鸟蛋放在孵化室里。

e.en: Students entered the {incubatorium} only after sterilizing their hands.
e.zh: 学生们给手消毒后才进入培养室。

e.en: The team adjusted the {incubatory} temperature every morning.
e.zh: 团队每天早上调整孵化温度。

e.en: An {incubatory} device kept the samples warm overnight.
e.zh: 一台培养用设备让样本整夜保持温暖。

e.en: Medieval legends warned of {incubi} visiting sleepers at night.
e.zh: 中世纪传说警告说，梦魇恶魔会在夜里造访睡眠者。

e.en: Old debts became {incubi} that haunted the family for years.
e.zh: 旧债成了沉重负担，多年来一直困扰着这个家庭。

incubous.t: 覆瓦状排列的；向上覆盖的

e.en: The botanist noted the {incubous} leaves on the liverwort.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种地钱有覆瓦状排列的叶片。

e.en: An {incubous} pattern can help identify certain mosses.
e.zh: 覆瓦状排列的模式有助于识别某些苔藓。

e.en: The surgeon examined the tiny {incudes} inside the middle ear.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了中耳内细小的砧骨。

e.en: Several damaged {incudes} were described in the anatomy report.
e.zh: 解剖报告描述了几块受损的砧骨。

indecipherability.t: 无法辨认；难以破译的性质

e.en: The {indecipherability} of the note delayed the investigation.
e.zh: 那张字条无法辨认，拖慢了调查。

e.en: Scholars debated the {indecipherability} of the ancient script.
e.zh: 学者们争论这种古文字是否难以破译。

e.en: In Latin class, she learned that some borrowed nouns are {indeclinable}.
e.zh: 在拉丁语课上，她学到有些外来名词没有词形变化。

e.en: The grammar notes marked the foreign adjective as {indeclinable}.
e.zh: 语法说明把这个外来形容词标为无词形变化。

indecomposable.t: 不可分解的；不能腐解的

e.en: The chemist described the residue as nearly {indecomposable}.
e.zh: 化学家说这种残留物几乎不可分解。

e.en: Some plastics are effectively {indecomposable} in ordinary soil.
e.zh: 有些塑料在普通土壤中基本不能腐解。

e.en: His loud joke caused visible {indecorum} at the ceremony.
e.zh: 他大声开的玩笑在仪式上显得很失礼。

e.en: The judge would not tolerate {indecorum} in the courtroom.
e.zh: 法官不容忍法庭上的不得体行为。

e.en: It is cold today, {indeedy}, colder than yesterday.
e.zh: 今天确实很冷，比昨天还冷。

e.en: She nodded and said, {indeedy}, that was the whole truth.
e.zh: 她点点头说，真的呢，那就是全部事实。

e.en: Her {indefatigability} kept the rescue team moving all night.
e.zh: 她不知疲倦，带着救援队整夜行动。

e.en: The biography praises his {indefatigability} as a reformer.
e.zh: 这本传记称赞他作为改革者的坚韧耐劳。

indefeasibility.t: 不可废止性；不可剥夺性

e.en: The lawyer argued for the {indefeasibility} of the title.
e.zh: 律师主张该产权具有不可废止性。

e.en: The doctrine concerns the {indefeasibility} of registered ownership.
e.zh: 这一原则涉及登记所有权的不可剥夺性。

indefeasible.t: 不可废止的；不可剥夺的

e.en: The court treated the buyer's title as {indefeasible}.
e.zh: 法院认定买方的产权不可废止。

e.en: They claimed an {indefeasible} right to the land.
e.zh: 他们声称对这块土地有不可剥夺的权利。

indefeasibly.t: 不可废止地；不可剥夺地

e.en: The property was {indefeasibly} registered in her name.
e.zh: 该房产以不可废止的方式登记在她名下。

e.en: He believed the rights were {indefeasibly} secured by law.
e.zh: 他认为这些权利已由法律不可剥夺地保障。

e.en: The theologian wrote about the {indefectibility} of the church.
e.zh: 这位神学家论述教会永不失效的性质。

e.en: Their theory assumed the {indefectibility} of divine truth.
e.zh: 他们的理论假定神圣真理具有无缺失性。

e.en: He described justice as an {indefectible} moral principle.
e.zh: 他把正义描述为永不失效的道德原则。

e.en: The sermon spoke of an {indefectible} faith through suffering.
e.zh: 布道谈到一种历经苦难仍无缺失的信仰。

e.en: The promise was presented as {indefectibly} true.
e.zh: 这个承诺被说成是永不失效的真理。

e.en: She believed grace worked {indefectibly} in the faithful.
e.zh: 她相信恩典在信徒身上无缺陷地运行。

e.en: The philosopher imagined an {indefective} form of reason.
e.zh: 哲学家设想了一种无缺陷的理性形式。

e.en: Their system was praised as {indefective}, though critics disagreed.
e.zh: 他们的体系被赞为完整无缺，但批评者并不同意。

e.en: The report exposed the {indefensibility} of the policy.
e.zh: 报告揭示了这项政策站不住脚。

e.en: She admitted the moral {indefensibility} of his actions.
e.zh: 她承认他的行为在道德上无法辩护。

e.en: The committee issued an {indefinitive} statement after the meeting.
e.zh: 委员会会后发表了一份不确定的声明。

e.en: His answer was {indefinitive} and left everyone confused.
e.zh: 他的回答没有定论，让所有人都困惑。

e.en: The old treatise called the beam {indeflectible} under pressure.
e.zh: 那本旧论著称这根梁在压力下不可弯曲。

e.en: She showed an {indeflectible} commitment to the truth.
e.zh: 她表现出对真相不偏移的坚定承诺。

e.en: The botanist noted the {indehiscence} of the seed capsule.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这个蒴果不开裂。

e.en: Fruit {indehiscence} helps some plants retain their seeds longer.
e.zh: 果实不开裂能帮助一些植物更久保留种子。

e.en: The plant produces an {indehiscent} fruit with a hard shell.
e.zh: 这种植物结出外壳坚硬的不开裂果实。

e.en: Botany students compared dehiscent and {indehiscent} seed pods.
